tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig mthong ba don ldan gyi lhan thabs 'od brgya 'bar ba bzhugs/
༄༅/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig mthong ba don ldan gyi lhan thabs 'od brgya 'bar ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig mthong ba don ldan gyi

lhan thabs 'od brgya 'bar ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /'khor ba'i 'ching ba grol mdzad pa/ /bla ma mchog gi zhabs pad la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal byin gyis rlobs/ /'dir rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i khrid ston pa la/ thog mar chos khungs dang 'brel ba'i che ba cung zad brjod par spro na/ 'dir bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung las/ mdo rgyud thams cad kyi don gyi bcud ma lus pa phyung ba/ theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam mchog mthar thug rnal 'byor dbang phyug thams cad kyi gshegs shul lam 'jug ngogs/ khams drug ldan pa rdo rje'i lus dang ldan pa'i gang zag cig tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'khrid par byed pa'i nye lam myur lam khyad par can/ rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan du ma rnams su rdo rje'i tshig gis sbas shing gsang pa'i don/ /mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lor ma sbas gsal bar bstan pa/ phyag rgya chen po zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa zhes gsungs pa'i dbang du byas nas/ chos 'di mdo rgyud thams cad kyi don gyi bcud ma lus pa phyung ba yin te/ mdo sngags kyi lam thams cad kyi mthar thug stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can yin/ rgyud las kyang/ gang zhig stong nyid snying rje gnyis su med par smra bo phyogs nyams de ni mnyam par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ brtse ba snying rje chen po dang*/ spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i stong nyid zung du 'jug pa ste/ chos 'di nyid kyi snying por rtag tu bzhugs pa yin te/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum thams cad kyi skabs su/ byang chub kyi sems kyis zin par byed pa yin/ stong nyid kyi lta ba go yul du 'jog pa'i gnas skabs kyang mang du yod la/

'on kyang go yul gyi stong nyid de tsam kho na gnad du mi che ste/ don gyi gtso bo dpyad pa las 'das shing*/ rjes dpag tsam gyi yul ma yin pa'i spros bral stong nyid ni chos 'di'i dmigs pa'i mthil yin no/ /yang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i khyad chos/ gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa ni/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba snying rje chen po dang*/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs stong pa nyid de/ de gnyis zung du 'jug pa ni stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can yin na/ de ni chos tshul 'di la yod pa tsam du ma zad/ zung 'jug gi lam de ni sbyor ba yan lag drug pa 'di kho na yin gyi/ lam gzhan la med ces dam 'cha' ru yang rung ste/ rgya bod du phal cher la grags pa'i man ngag rjes 'brang gi yi ge ris su 'khod cing rgyun yod pa rnams kyi dbang du byas na/ sbyor drug las gzhan pa'i rim lnga/ phyag rgya bzhi pa/ phyag rdzogs zhi gcod/ chos drug lam 'bras sogs gang la yang zung 'jug gi lam yongs su rdzogs par mtshan nyid tshang ba med na/ gzhan blun po mgo skor gyi chos dang*/ rtog ge bas brtags pa rnams la lta smos kyang ci dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang de dang de'i lugs srol 'dzin par 'dod pa'i rjes 'jug rgya bod rnams kyi 'chad tshul la de ltar yin gyi/ klu sgrub kyi rim lnga/ dzñā na pa'i grol thig dril bu rim lnga/ nag po rim bzhi sogs kyi gzhung rtsa ba rnams kyi dgongs brtad ni/ chos 'di dang gcig pas grub thob de dag gis kyang lam 'di kho na thugs su chud pa yin zhing*/ gzhung de dag chos 'di dang mthun par 'chad shes na dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par 'gyur ro/ /don gyi gtso bo ni de lta bu yin la/ gzhan yang dad pa dang*/ nges 'byung dang*/ blang dor gyi spyod pa dang*/ zhi gnas/ lhag mthong dang*/ tshad med bzhi/ phar phyin bcu/ bsdu dngos bzhi/ byang phyogs so bdun sogs mdo dang thun mong ba rnams dang*/

smin grol gyi lam/ mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor/ dbang bzhi'i ye shes/ bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa rnam grangs mi 'dra ba thams cad/ don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di'i khongs su chud pa'i phyir/ chos 'di mdo rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa zhes bya'o/ /theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse zhes bya ba ni/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ sangs rgyas pa yi bzhi pa dang*/ /lnga pa thub pa'i dgongs pa min/ /zhes gsungs pas nyan thos rang rgyal theg chen te/ theg pa gsum du ma 'dus pa'i theg pa bzhi pa med mod kyang/ gsum po'i nang sel gyi dbye ba la brten pa'i rnam grangs kyi theg pa mang du 'byung pa'ang mi 'gal te/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ theg pa rnam pa mang bshad pa/ /sems can rnams ni drang ba'i phyir/ /theg pa tha dad ngas bshad de/ /theg pa gcig tu'ang ngas bstan to/ /ji srid sems ni 'jug pa'i bar/ /theg pa dag la thug pa med/ / ces gsungs pas so/ /des na dad pa phun sum tshogs pas blang dor phyin ci ma log par byed pa ni lha'i theg pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams sgom pa ni/ tshangs pa'i theg pa ste/ de gnyis 'jig rten pa'i theg pa yin pas/ theg pa dngos ma yin la/ de las mchog tu gyur pa nyan thos kyi theg pa dang*/ de bzhin du rang rgyal dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ bya rgyud dang*/ spyod rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i theg pa rnams snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma mchog tu gyur pa yin zhing*/ rnal 'byor bla med gzhan thams cad las kyang ches mchog tu gyur pa ni/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo yin/ rgyud 'di'i zab don mthar thug ni/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di kho na yin pas/ lam dang 'bras bu'i theg pa thams cad kyi yang rtse'am mthar thug pa ni/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa 'bras bur bcas pa dang*/ gsung rab sde snod kyi theg pa thams cad kyi mthar thug pa'i yang rtse/

dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud yin no/ / skabs 'dir dogs pa 'di 'byung ste/ 'dus pa bde dgyes sogs kyang bla na med pa yin na/ de dag las dus 'khor lhag pa mi 'thad do snyam na/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bka'i glegs bam dang*/ tshig la byin rlabs che chung ngam/ phyag mchod kyi yul du bzang ngan gyi khyad par 'byed pa sogs nam du yang mi rung na/ rnal 'byor bla med nang tshan du lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta na yang*/ tshig zin gyi don dang*/ sgra ji bzhin pa'i don la rgya che chung dang*/ zab mi zab kyi khyad par yod pas/ don 'di'i dbang du byas te/ bla med gzhan rnams las dus kyi 'khor lo zab cing rgya che ba yin pas/ 'di nyid theg pa'i yang rtser 'jog la/ rgyud gzhan thams cad kyi sbas don 'dis gsal bar mdzad cing*/ de'i tshe bla med kyi rgyud gzhan rnams kyi dgongs don gyi gnad thams cad 'di dang gcig par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'dus pa bde dgyes sogs kyang bla na med pa ma yin par thal ba'i skyon ga la yod/ yang blo dman 'ga' zhig la dogs pa 'di 'byung ste/ 'di theg pa'i yang rtse kho na yin na/ theg pa gzhan thams cad dang thun mong ma yin par gyur pa'i phyir/ mdo rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin par 'gal/ yang mdo rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin na/ theg dman gyi don yang yin pa'i phyir/ yang rtse yin par 'gal snyam pa 'di 'byung ngo*/ /de'i lan ni/ theg pa che chung mdo rgyud thams cad kyi thugs kyi brtad so'i dgongs pa gcig yin zhing*/ gcig po de yang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor kho na'o/ /'on kyang so so'i tshig gi dngos bstan sgra ji bzhin pa la zab don 'di gsal mi gsal dang rgyas mi rgyas kyi khyad par shin tu gal che bas/ mchog dman med pa'ang ma yin no/ /des na nges don shin tu gab pa'i gsung rab rnams la gang zag skal dman dag yid rton pas theg dman gyi mdo zhes grags shing*/

nges don ci rigs gab cing ji ltar 'os pa gsal bar mdzad pa rnams gang zag dbang po 'bring gi rigs rnams kyis skal par thob pa ni phar phyin theg pa nas yo ga'i theg pa'i bar du grags te bla na yod pa'o/ /zab don mthar thug gsal bar ston pa rnams dbang po mchog rnams kho na'i chos kyi skal bar byon pa la theg pa bla na med pa zhes grags pa yin no/ /des na rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud thams cad las/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di spyir gsal por bstan pa tsam yin mod kyang*/ dpal ldan dus 'khor dang bskrun na/ gzhan de rnams rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi rnam gzhag 'ga' zhig tu mi gsal ba dang*/ kha cig tu bsdus pa dang*/ la la dag tu ma tshang ba'i tshul du yod la/ rgyud kyi rgyal po 'dir ni/ zab lam mthar thug 'di shin tu gsal ba dang/ ches rgyas pa dang*/ yongs su rdzogs shing gab pa dang 'khrugs pa med la/ 'thor thabs ma yin par gsungs pa'i phyir mchog dang rtse mor gyur pa'ang yin no/ /des na dngos su gsal bar bstan pa'i sgo nas gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa theg pa'i yang rtse yin/ dgongs pa'i brtad so phugs kyi zhe 'dod kyi dbang du byas na/ theg pa mtha' dag gi dgongs pa yin no/ /de yang 'di ltar go dgos te nyan thos kyi sde snod nas rnal 'byor rgyud man chad kyi gzhung na/ spyi ldog nas grub pas khyad par can gyi don yang shugs la 'grub pa mang ste/ dper na mi'i 'gro ba tsam bde 'gro yin par grub na/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po bde 'gro'i mchog yin par shug la grub pa bzhin du/ spyi ldog nas stong nyid sgom pa lam gyis mchog tu gsungs pas/ khyad par can rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong nyid sgom pa lam gyi ches mchog tu shugs la bstan pa dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom tshul spyi ldog nas nam mkha'i rnal 'byor tsam dang*/ bla gab med pa'i rnal 'byor tsam yin par dngos su gsungs pas/

de'i shugs la nam mkha' dang bla gab med pa'i rnal 'byor khyad par can sor sdud kyi lam 'di shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgom pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo yin pa gsungs par 'gro ba lta bu ste/ des gzhan rnams la'ang mtshon no/ /yang bla med kyi bsdus rgyud gzhan rnams las ni/ khyad par can de rnams spyi khyab kyi khog tu sbas te gsungs pa nyung la/ rgyud tshig bgram po go dka' ba'i tshul gyis sbas pa dang*/ dang por nag po rab tu bsgom/ zhes pa lta bu nag po mun pa'i nam mkha' la dgongs pa yin yang*/ skye bo phal gyis don gzhan la 'khrul 'gro ba'i tshul gyis sbyar ba'i sbas pa dang*/ bskyed rim gyi zol gyis rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid bshad pa dang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba zhu bde'i khongs su sbas pa dang*/ dbang bzhi pa dbang gsum pa'i nang du sbas pa dang*/ gzhan yang brda thabs sna tshogs pas bstan te/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa dang*/ bla ma'i man ngag dang*/ rgyud ni rgyud gzhan gyis rtogs par bya ba'i rim pas go bar bya dgos kyi/ gzhan du mkhas par rlom pa rnams mgo rmongs par 'gyur ro/ /rgyud kyi bstan don ni rdo rje'i rnal 'byor kho na yin gyi rigs mthun spyi khyab tsam smros pa ma yin no/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas zhes bya ba la/ gsang 'dus phyi ma las/ mi snang la sogs dngos grub ni/ tha mal pa zhes bshad pa yin/ /sangs rgyas nyid 'grub sangs rgyas kyis/ /dngos grub mchog ces bshad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ril bu mig sman rkang mgyogs la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub chung ngu/ 'dod pa'i lus kyi rigs 'dzin 'bring po/ gzugs kyi rigs 'dzin chen po ste/ de rnams 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub yin/ 'jig rten las 'das pa ni phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub ste gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa yan chad nas mthar thug pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/

/thun mong 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub ni bskyed rim gyi rang 'bras su zad pa ma yin/ rdzogs rim pas ma bsgrubs par yang zhor la 'grub ste/ sambu ṭi las/ ral gri mig sman rkang byug dang*/ /ri lu sa 'og gnod sbyin mo/ /dngul chu las kyi rjes 'gro dang*/ /'jig rten gsum yod dngos grub 'gyur/ /'dod pa lnga dang ldan pa las/ /kun tu bdag nyid chen por 'gyur/ / zhes dang*/ bsam mi khyab kyi gzhung las kyang*/ /kun mkhyen gnas kyi sbyor pa 'di/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mi rtog pa/ /kun tu bzang po zhes bya lha/ /yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du 'byung*/ /sa 'og ral gri ril bu dang*/ /shing lham bum pa gnod sbyin mo/ /bcud dang mig sman bzang po yang*/ /rang nyid 'grub ste gzhan du min/ /zhes so/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ni rdzogs rim kho nas 'grub pa las rdzogs rim gyi lam yin nges 'khrul med bden pa can rang btags pa tsam ma yin pa'i dngos rang ste/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di kho na yin pas dngos grub gnyis ka'i sgrub thabs bla na med pa'o/ /zhi sogs las chen rnams ni dngos grub dngos ma yin rjes mthun pa tsam yin pas phra mo zhes grags pa de dag kyang zhor la 'grub pa yin la/ da lta mi nor dar ba tsam dang*/ zas gos than thun byung ba la dngos grub zer ba dang*/ the brang gi dngos grub/ rgyal 'gong gi dngos grub zer ba sogs ni mi nag pa blun po'i kha skad tsam yin pas chos skad kyi gseb tu smra bar mi bya'o/ /chos 'di las te 'phral gyi 'dod don 'phran bu de kun yang 'bad med du 'byung mod/ de 'dra tsam smos rin yang mi chog go /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam zhes pa ni/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di bsgoms te mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang 'di bsgoms pas 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur/

de ltar phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang lam 'di bsgoms pas sangs rgyas pa kho na yin zhes pa ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang byang chub sems dpa' thog ma nas sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa rnams la smos ma dgos/ re zhig mdo lam kho na la zhugs pa rnams kyang mthar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob kar sngags la mi 'jug pa'i thabs gtan nas med/ de lta bu'i sngags lam de yang rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi lam tsam mam/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi lam bskyed rim dang*/ las rab 'byams sogs kyis ma yin te/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa mthar thug la brten nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub bsgrub dgos pa la/ de 'dra ba'i rdzogs rim de ni sbyor ba yan lag drug pa kho na las gzhan du med pas/ sangs rgyas ma yin na phar zhog yin na yin tshad kyi lam dngos gzhi nyams len gyi gtso bo rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa 'di kho na yin pas bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam zhes bya'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug thams cad kyi gshegs shul du'ang grub mod/ rnam grangs gzhan gyi sgo nas bshad na/ rgya skad du yo ga zhes bya ba dmigs pa'i yul la sems rtse gcig tu sbyor ba'i phyir/ mnyam bzhag ting nge 'dzin gyi ming la sbyor ba'am rnal 'byor zhes bya/ de lta bu'i rnal 'byor de gang gi rgyud la yod pa'i skyes bu de la ni rnal 'byor pa zhes bya'o/ /de yang mu stegs la sogs pa 'jig rten pa dang*/ nyan rang dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' so so skye bo sogs mang du yod mod kyang*/ de dag rnal 'byor pa tsam yin gyi/ rnal 'byor can gyi dbang phyug ni ma yin pas/ rnal 'byor can gyi dbang phyug ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnams yin te/ rnal 'byor can thams cad kyi rgyal po'am gtso bo'am/ 'khor los bsgyur ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /de ltar yin pa las sangs rgyas rnams kyi bsgom bya yin tshul bshad zin/

'dir byang chub sems dpa' sngags kyi sgor spyad pa spyod pa rnams kyi dbang du byas nas bshad na/ rgyal sras thu bo 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dang*/ phyag na rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje snying po la sogs pas kyang*/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di nyid bsgom par mdzad pa yin te/ 'jam dpal gyi rang gi lta 'dod mdor bstan dang*/ spyan ras gzigs kyi dri med 'od dang*/ phyag na rdo rje'i bde mchog gi rgyud kyi 'grel pa dang*/ rdo rje snying po'i dgyes rdor gyi 'grel pa rnams su lam 'di nyid kho na rgyas shing gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de rnams kyi dgongs don de ltar du grub pas/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi dgongs don du grub ste/ de rnams dgongs pa gcig cing lam bgrod pa gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang grub thob kun gyi spyi mes/ sa ra ha yang lam 'di kho na bzhed de/ des mdzad pa'i do ha mdzod kyi glu las/ chos sbyor ba yan lag drug pa kho na'i dbang du byas pa'i chos skad kyis dbu zhabs thams cad khyab bo/ /dpal o rgyan gyi gnas na grub thob gtso che shos rgyal po ind+ra bhu tis kyang*/ ye shes grub par lam ngan pa thams cad bkag ste/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di nyid bstan to/ /slob dpon ārya de bas kyang khungs su lung 'dren pa'i dpal gsang ba grub pa zhes bya ba'i gzhung slob dpon padma badzra thog mas mdzad pa las kyang*/ yi ge dgod pa dang phyag rgya bzhi'i don gsungs pa rnams ni chos 'di dang don gcig cing*/ slob dpon grub thob rta mchog la sogs pa grub thob mang po'i dgongs 'dus/ slob dpon rtog rtse bas yi ger bkod pa phyag rgya chen po bsam mi khyab kyi gzhung don yang lam 'di kho nar gnas pa dang*/ gzhan yang grub thob rnams kyi do ha rdo rje'i glu mtha' yas pa zhig kyang*/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi lam yongs su rdzogs pa'am/

cha shas cha shas ston pa kho na shas che ba yin zhing*/ der ma zad slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rim lnga dang*/ 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa'i spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron ma las kyang*/ la la na ming 'dogs tha dad tsam ma gtogs lam 'di nyid bstan pa yin te/ lus dben ni sor bsam/ ngag dben ni srog rtsol/ sems dben ni 'dzin pa/ sgyu lus ni rjes dran/ 'od gsal ni tin nge 'dzin/ zung 'jug ting nge 'dzin gyi 'bras bu'o/ /slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa'i rim pa lnga pa las kyang*/ don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyid ston te/ de'i rim pa lnga ni/ bdag byin brlab pa dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ nor bu 'gengs pa dang*/ dza lan dha ra dang*/ bsam mi khyab kyi rim pa ste lnga'o/ /de las sa bon med pa'i bdag byin brlab pa ni/ sor bsam dang*/ sa bon dang bcas pa'i bdag byin brlab pa ni srog rtsol dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa ni 'dzin pa dang*/ nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim pa dang dza lan dha ra'i rim pa gnyis rjes dran dang*/ bsam mi khyab ni ting nge 'dzin 'bras bur bcas pa'o/ /slob dpon nag po spyod pa pa'i rim pa bzhi pa las kyang*/ rgyud kyi rim pa sor bsam/ sngags kyi rim pa srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i phyed snga ma/ ye shes kyi rim pa 'dzin pa'i phyed phyi ma dang rjes dran/ gsang ba'i rim pa ni ting nge 'dzin 'bras bur bcas pa'o/ /de bzhin du slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birwa pas mdzad pa'i shin tu spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid la sogs pa mang po zhig ni/ 'ga' zhig la rdo rje'i rnal 'byor cha tshang ba dang*/ 'ga' las sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor tsam dang*/ kha cig las gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor tsam ston pa sogs/ mdor na grub thob ches che ba rnams kyi gsung ni rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di kho na la gzhol zhing 'bab pa'i phyir/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig pa dang dbyangs gcig pa yin no/

/'o na 'dus pa rim lnga'i man ngag mar 'gos gnyis las brgyud pa dang/ bde mchog rim bzhi rim lnga'i man ngag nā ro pa las brgyud pa sogs lag len du 'debs pa'i man ngag mang po zhig la dmigs pa 'di dang mi 'dra bar 'byung ba ci snyam na/ grub thob chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i gzhung rnams kyi phugs kyi dgongs don yin par ma zad/ 'phral gyi tshig don yang rnam par mi rtog pa'i lam rdzogs rim rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di kho na bzhin ston pa yin mod kyang*/ lam 'di sgom mi nus pa dang*/ mi mos pa dang*/ re zhig 'di la dngos su 'jug pa'i skal ba med pa rnams la/ gzhung de dang de'i dgongs don rdzogs rim dngos de ma yin yang mos pa'i sgo nas lam du byed pa'i rtog bcas bskyed rim phra thig gi rnal 'byor la rdzogs rim gyi mtshan gsol nas bstan pa yin no/ / de la goms na rim gyis rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i skal ba can du 'gyur ba'i phyir shin tu 'brel chags pa yin mod kyang*/ rtog bcas kyi man ngag de dag rang rang gi gzhung rtsa ba de dag gi dgongs don bstan bya'i gtso bo ni ma yin par shes par bya'o/ khams drug ldan pa rdo rje'i lus dang ldan pa'i gang zag cig ces pa'i don ni/ khams drug ni sa khams chu khams me khams rlung khams nam mkha'i khams ye shes kyi khams te drug go /'dir gzugs med khams zhes pa dman pa la dgag sgra sbyar ba yin zhing*/ gzugs ni yod de/ de'i phyir sems can thams cad kyi lus la khams drug gi cha shas tshang ba tsam yin mod kyi shas cher spyod pa'i dbang du byas nas ye shes bzhag pa'i khams lnga po la/ gzugs med khams pa nam mkha'i khams kho na ste gcig ldan dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi pa la de'i steng du rlung khams te gnyis ldan dang*/ gzugs khams gzhan bsam gtan gsum pa gnyis pa dang po'i/ lha rnams snga ma'i steng du me khams bsnan pas gsum ldan dang*/

'dod khams kyi lha rnams de'i yang steng du chu khams bsnan pas bzhi ldan dang*/ mi'i 'gro ba rnams de'i yang steng du sa khams bsnan pas khams lnga ldan yin la/ ye shes kyi khams ni kun la khyab pa yin yang*/ khams gzhan rnams phra ba na ye shes kyang phra la/ gzhan rnams rags pa na/ ye shes kyang rags par 'byung bas mi lus la khyab bya khams lnga stobs chen yod pa bzhin du/ khyab byed ye shes kyang stobs che ba'i phyir/ khams drug ldan pa zhes bya ste/ de ltar na 'dir nam mkha'i khams zhes bya ba/ nam mkha' dang ni 'gog pa gnyis/ /zhes pa lta bu'i nam mkha' dngos med la mi 'jog stong pa'i rdul zhes bya ba reg thogs kyi bya ba cher mi byed kyang rdul gyi khyad par yin zhing*/ dbang po'i spyod yul las 'das pa zhig go /mdo lugs las kyang*/ skyes bu khams drug 'dus pa zhes pa dang gnad gcig de ltar na skyes bu'i lus spyi khyab khams lnga ldan yin pa ltar rten thig le byang chub kyi sems kyang khams lnga ldan yin zhing*/ lnga po dang dbyer med du 'dres pa'i brten pa sems kyi chos 'gyur bde bag chags dang bcas pa ni/ ye shes kyi khams yin la/ de ltar na 'byung ba rnams kyi nang nas rags shos sa khams yin pas/ de'i thig le dang de la brten pa'i 'gyur bde ye shes kyi khams kyang shin tu rags pa'i phyir/ lam sgom pa'i gnas skabs su/ sa khams rags pa de 'chang sla zhing*/ rags pa bcings pas phra ba yang rang shugs kyis 'ching bar 'gyur/ thog mar rags pa ma bcings na/ phra ba kho na 'ching ba'i thabs med/ des na tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub thob pa la mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba bsgrub dgos/ de la zhu bde 'gyur med grub dgos/ de gnyis ka byang chub kyi sems 'ching ba la rags las pas/ 'ching ba'i skabs su rags rim nas 'ching dgos pa'i phyir/ khams drug ldan gyi lus la ye shes kyi sku mchog gi dngos grub tshe gcig lus gcig la 'grub pa yod par gsungs kyi/

gzhan rnams la ma gsungs so/ /de yang mi srid pa ma yin mod kyang 'byung ba shin tu dkon no/ /tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'khrid par byed pa zhes pa ni/ sngon gyi skye bar gsang sngags la zhugs pa'i las 'phro can tshe 'dir mchog thob pa lta bu ni/ skye ba brgyud nas mchog thob pa yin gyi/ tshe gcig la sangs rgyas par mi 'gro la/ der ma zad tshe rabs snga mar mdo lugs la brten nas lam sna zin zhing*/ thar pa cha mthun rgyud la bskyed pa zhig tshe 'dir gsang sngags bsgoms pas grol ba thob kyang*/ thar pa'i lam rgyud la bskyed zin pa'i rjes su 'khor bar las nyon gyis skye ba gcig slar len dgos byung ba'i phyir tshe gcig la mchog grub pa ma yin no/ /'o na ci snyam na/ skye ba snga mar bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba spyi dang khyad par can cher bskyed cing*/ smon lam khyad par can btab pa ni dgos te/ gzhan du na tshe 'dir sngags kyi theg pa la mi 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang tshe snga mar tshogs lam chung ngu tsam yang rgyud la ma skyes pa gcig tshe 'di la sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas thar pa cha mthun gsar du bskyed de/ tshe gcig po de la 'chi ba'i srid pa ma byung ba'i snga rol nyid nas mchog 'grub pa'i don te/ rnam par smin pa'i lus 'di bor ba med par ma dag pa'i lus spangs te ye shes kyi lus su gnas gyur pa de ni tshe gcig la mchog grub pa'am/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob pa'am/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa'am/ zung 'jug thob pa zhes bya ste/ 'di sangs rgyas chung ngu'i gnas thob pa yin pas/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so zhes tha snyad thob/ de phyin chad las nyon gyi dbang gis skye 'chi ye med cing*/ ye shes kyi sku de yang rgyun chad pa med pa'i phyir/ rten de la brten nas mthar thug gi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos sam mi slob pa'i zung 'jug mngon du byed do/

/de lta na dang por mi'i lus dang*/ phyis zung 'jug gi sku ste lus gnyis brgyud pa'i phyir tshe gcig lus gcig tu mi 'gyur ro snyam na/ spyir gong du smos pa ltar zung 'jug thob pa la yang sangs rgyas par 'jog pa dang*/ thun mong gi dngos grub rab mtha' zhig thob pa la yang sangs rgyas par 'jog pa sogs rnam gzhag du ma zhig yod pas/ chos skad phyogs gcig la zhen du mi rung la/ 'on kyang 'dir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dbang du byas na yang*/ dang po thar pa cha mthun bskyed pa nas/ phyis mthar thug gi gnas thob kyi bar du 'chi srid kyis bar ma chod pa'i phyir tshe gcig kho na yin pa dang*/ spyir lus la rnam smin gyi lus snga phyi gnyis su ma zad lus je bzang je bzang du 'gro ba'i rnam 'gyur du ma zhig brgyud yod kyang*/ rnam smin sha khrag gi lus rigs rgyun ma chad pa'i ngang nas gnas gyur pa yin gyi/ shul du lus pa'i tshul gyis bor ba ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ rnam smin gyi lus gnyis pa gsar du blangs pa med pa'i phyir lus gcig kho nar brjod do/ /don dam par na ye shes kyi lus ni/ gnyug ma'i lus yin pa'i phyir/ rnam smin zad pa na de gsal bar mthong ba tsam yin gyi/ gsar du lus blangs pa kho na yang min zhing*/ ye shes kyi sku de ni lus rang yang min pas/ lus gcig dang du ma'i tha snyad 'jog pa'i gzhi yang ma yin no/ /gang dag sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mngon 'gyur ba thob kyang*/ mi gtsang ba'i lus gnas ma gyur par 'dod pa dang*/ sha khrag gi lus 'di ka ye shes kyi skur 'dod pa sogs ni/ gti mug gis kun nas bslangs shing rgyud 'grel chen po rnams las bkag mod kyang*/ dgag sgrub kyi spros pa 'dir mi 'chad do/ /nye lam myur lam khyad par can zhes pa ni/ deng sang 'ga' zhig gis skye bo rmongs pa rnams mgu bar bya ba'i phyir/ go ba tsam gyis grol/ thos pa tsam gyis grol zhes sogs zab zab mang po smra ba ni/

tshig gi shugs bskyed pa tsam kho nar zad la/ sems nam mkha' la yas pa dang*/ da ni thod pa mi 'gel lo zhes skye ba mi len pa tsam la sangs rgyas thob pa'i don du smra ba sogs ni/ blun gtam kho na yin pas mkhas pa'i dpyad gzhir yang mi rung ngo*/ /des na nyan rang gi lam kho nas sangs rgyas mi thob cing*/ phar phyin theg par bskal pa grangs med gsum dang*/ rgyud sde 'og ma rnams la yang bskal pa brgyad dang gsum dang skye ba bcu drug sogs gsungs pa rnams ring lam dang*/ tshe gcig la sangs rgyas 'grub pa yang bla med kyi lam las kyang bskyed rim la 'chad rgyu ma yin pas/ rdzogs rim rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di kho na nye lam myur lam yin no/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan du ma rnams su rdo rje'i tshig gis sbas shing gsang ba'i don/ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lor ma sbas par gsal bar bstan pa zhes pa ni/ de la rgyud sde so so'i rtsa rgyud ces pa la/ rtsa rgyud bshad rgyud gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i rtsa rgyud dang*/ rtsa rgyud bsdus rgyud gnyis kyis zlas phye ba'i rtsa rgyud gnyis yod pa las/ phyi ma'i dbang du byas te/ gsang 'dus kyi rtsa rgyud rgyas pa stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rgyas pa rnal 'byor rjes su rig pa stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug pa dang*/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba khri drug stong pa dang*/ dgyes rdor 'bum phrag lnga pa dang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog mngon brjod 'bum pa la sogs pa rtsa rgyud rgyas pa de rnams su rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di ma sbas par rgyas shing gsal por bstan mod kyang*/ de dag shambha la sogs rdo rje'i gnas khyad par can dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'am/ lha klu mthu bo che rnams kyi gnas na bzhugs pa yin gyi/ 'dzam gling lho phyogs 'dir mi rnams la thun mong du spyod pa'i yul du ma gyur pas/ re zhig bor te bsdus rgyud kyi dbang du byas nas/

gsang ba 'dus pa stong bzhi brgya pa dang*/ /'khor lo bde mchog le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa dang*/ dgyes rdor brtag pa gnyis pa sogs rgya gar dang bod la sogs pa 'dzam gling lho phyogs kyi yul kun du dar ba/ bsdus rgyud 'di dag tu dbang bzhi pa'i don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di/ rdo rje'i tshig gis rgyas btab cing sbas pa yin la/ dus 'khor la ni rtsa rgyud rgyas pa mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas stong phrag bcu gnyis par gsal la rgyas par bstan pa bzhin du/ dus kyi 'khor lo bsdus pa'i rgyud du yang ma sbas par gsal bar bstan pa'i phyir/ bsdus rgyud gzhan dang mi 'dra'o/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'am/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba la/ phyag rgya chen po zhes brgyud gzhung rnams las kyang don du ma la bshad cing*/ rgya bod kyi lugs srol tha dad la/ rang blo'i lam las drangs pa'i 'dod tshul mang zhing*/ sgrub byed du 'dod pa'i smra ba'ang mang mod kyi/ gzhan rnams skabs kyi don ma yin pas/ 'dir ni theg pa bla na med pa'i lam gyi nang nas kyang*/ rdzogs rim gyi phyag chen de yin la/ de la'ang 'dod tshul mang po yod pa dag bshad kyi mi lang bas/ skabs 'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang sems 'grel skor gsum gyi dgongs pas/ rnam par mi rtog pa mtshan ma med pa'i rim pa las/ stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po sgom pa nyid lam gyi rkangs su byas te/ gzhan phyag rgya gsum ltar na las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya gnyis sam/ bzhi ltar na las dang chos dang dam tshig ste/ phyag rgya gsum gyi lam de rnams gang dang gang skabs su bab pa de dang der lam dngos gzhi'i bogs dbyung ba'i bogs 'don nam/ lam gyi sna 'khrid pa'i phyir du sbyor ba yin no/ /skabs 'dir phyag chen gyi rnam gzhag zhib mor go dgos kyang*/ gzhan la 'chad mi dgos pa'i dbang du byas nas bzhag go

/yang 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyi gzugs/ chos nyid don dam pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin chen po'i sku rdo rje'i rnam cha mthong ba dang*/ gsung rdo rje nyams su myong bar byed pa dang*/ thugs rdo rje dang*/ ye shes rdo rjer rang nyid zhugs pa'i sgo nas gdod ma'i rdo rje bzhi po de/ sgrub pa pos mngon du byed pa'i thabs yin pas phyir/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zhes bya la/ de yang mngon sum lam byed yin gyi mos pa lam byed tsam ma yin no/ /dmigs bcas dang 'brel ba'i sngags kyi lam gzhan rnams kyang ye shes kyi sna 'dren par byed pa sogs spyir thabs mi zab pa ta ma yin zhing*/ theg pa 'og ma rnams las thabs kyi sgo nas shin tu zab par yang grub mod kyang*/ mngon sum lam byed rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di la bltos na de dag mi zab ste/ dang por nyams myong skye ba yang shin tu bul ba dang*/ phyi nang gi spros pa la brten pa'i phyir dang*/ yun ring du goms kyang mthar thug gi 'bras bu la sbyor mi nus par/ slar yang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di la 'jug dgos pa sogs kyi phyir/ lam gzhan rnams mi zab la 'di ches zab par grub pas zab lam zhes bya'o/ /de la chos zab mo 'di nyid ston par byed pa la 'phags yul la sogs par bla ma dam pa'i man ngag ces sam/ zhal gyi gdams pa zhes pa'am/ de kho na nyid sbyin pa zhes bya la/ bla ma mchog gi zhal lung zhes kyang grags kyi/ 'khrid ces pa'i tha snyad med kyang bod yul 'dir 'khrid ces grags so/ /de yang skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i brda chad yin zhing don dang yang shin tu mthun te/ thar pa'i lam du 'khrid par byed pa'i thabs yin pas so/ /de yang don bzhi ste/ gang 'khrid na skabs su bab pa rdo rje slob ma'i sems rgyud 'khrid par byed/ gang du 'khrid par byed na sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid/

gang gis 'khrid par byed na bla ma dam pas 'khrid par byed de/ de yang rgyud rnams las bla ma'i mtshan nyid mtha' yas pa zhig bshad kyang*/ rdzogs rim gyi ye shes bskyed par gyur pa'i bdag rkyen ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ sangs rgyas zhal 'di gang gi thugs dang zhal la gnas par gyur pa de ni dpal ldan bla ma'o/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di rnam pa kun tu dgos pa'i med mi rung yin/ mtshan nyid gzhan rnams tshogs na ni legs la/ ma tshang yang 'di nges par dgos so/ /de'i don yang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhal zhes pas sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i sgo ste/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zung 'jug gi lam 'di yin la/ de 'dra thugs la 'khrungs pas thugs rgyud la gnas shing*/ zhal la gnas pa ste chos zab mo 'di slob ma'i sems rgyud la 'god pa'i phyir/ chos ston pa la mkhas pa'o/ /de ltar na yan lag drug gi man ngag rnams la rang byan chud cing*/ slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i brtse ba khyad par can mnga' ba dang*/ lam 'di nyid bsgom pa'i nyams rtogs ma 'khrul pa gnyis 'dzoms pa'o/ /nyams rtogs kyang rab tu rim pa drug ka thob na smos ma dgos kyang*/ da lta rnyed par dka'/ 'bring du na thog mar dge ba'i rtogs pa mthar phyin/ bar dge'i rtogs pa rjes mthun pa mnga' ba zhig dgos/ chung ngu la yang sor sdud phyin ci ma log pa thob cing*/ bsam gtan gyi nyams myong ci rigs pa mnga' na/ lam 'di'i rtsa ba tshugs pa yin pas de tsam phyis kyang rung ngo*/ /tshul ji ltar 'khrid pa ni/ yid ches gsum dang ldan pa'i lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can gyi sgo nas 'khrid pa yin te/ dpal dri med 'od las/ sngags kyi theg pa 'di la yid ches pa rnam pa gsum bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs te/ dang por re zhig rgyud la yid ches pa dang*/ de nas bla ma la yid ches pa dang*/ de nas bdag nyid la yid ches pa ste/ yid ches pa 'di gsum gyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi lam yongs su dag par 'gyur

ro/ /rnam pa gzhan du na yid ches pa gsum med par lam gang bla mas slob ma la bstan pa ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyi 'bras bu ster ba por mi 'gyur te/ slob ma blun pa'i dad pa nyid kyi phyir/ kun rdzob kyi bden pas 'jig rten pa'i 'bras bur 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ yid ches gsum ldan gyi lam dang phrad na/ skal ldan gyi gang zag gcig tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba yin/ de yang rgyud la yid ches tsam yod kyang*/ bla ma la yid ches med na ma 'ongs pa yun ring po lon pa'i 'og tu skye ba gzhan zhig la sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ba'i rgyu tsam yin mod kyang*/ 'phral du nyams myong mi skye bas tshe 'di la mchog thob par mi nus so/ /rgyud la yid ches pa med na ni/ bla ma la yid ches pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'ang mi 'byung la/ slob dpon de la yid ches 'dra rung ba 'phral gyi myong bas grub pa than thun yod du chug kyang*/ yang dag pa'i lam la yid ches pa'i rtags ma yin te/ las tshogs than thun dang rdzogs rim ltar snang gi nyams than thun tsam skye srid kyang yang dag pa'i lam du mi 'gyur/ zhes pa'o/ /de la yid ches gsum dang bral ba kha cig ni/ blun po rang gtso mkhan gyi zog chos dang*/ rtog ge ba mkhas 'dod can gyi blos btags tsam yin pas/ dgos pa thams cad kyis stongs la/ kha cig ni de bas kyang thu ste nag phyogs kyi 'dre gdon 'ga' zhig gis byas pas/ 'phral gyi byin rlabs ltar snang gis mgo bskor te/ bsod nams dman pa dag de la yid ches skye na/ tshe 'dir bkra mi shis shing*/ phyi ma ngan song du 'khrid/ gzhan kha cig ni rgyal bas gsungs pa'i chos rnam dag yin du chug kyang*/ bar skabs su byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa chad pas/ da lta nyams myong 'phral du skyed mi nus te/ brgyud pa gtun nas med na/ gsang sngags rang nyid len pa dmyal ba'i rgyur grags pa dang*/

tshig bshad dang lag len khrigs bkod tsam gyi dbang chog la rgyun yod du chug kyang*/ nyams len gyi rgyun chad cing byin rlabs yal ba rnams ni gzugs brnyan tsam mo/ yang kha cig spyir chos rnam dag yin zhing byin rlabs kyang ma chad mod kyi/ bskyed rim dngos sam/ phra thig la rdzogs rim du ming du btags pa dang*/ stong rkyang bsgom pa la rdzogs rim gyi ming btags pa rnams kyang 'phral du yid ches kyi rtags med cing*/ dbang po rnon pos bsgoms kyang tshe 'dir mchog mi thob ste/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam ma tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang de dag gi nang na 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub thob pa tsam ni srid do/ /yid ches gsum dang ldan par gyur na ni/ lam yongs su dag par 'gyur ro zhes sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam cha tshang la ma nor ba yin pa'i don no/ /de las rgyud la yid ches pa ni/ chos de sangs rgyas kyis rgyud las gsal bar gsungs pa zhig dgos pa yin na/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di ni/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las tshang zhing gsal bar gsungs pa dang*/ 'khor lo sdom pa rtsa rgyud las/ sngags bzlas pa dang bsam gtan dang*/ /bde bas kyang ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bsam gtan 'dzin pa ting 'dzin te 'bras bu'i yan lag gsum gsal bar gsungs pas/ rgyu'i yan lag gsum shugs la go ba dang*/ dgyes rdor rtsa rgyud las/ so so'i mtshan nyid brda thabs kyis gsungs nas/ yan lag drug bsgom rnal 'byor pas/ /zhes sogs sbyor drug yin par gsungs pa dang*/ de bzhin du mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las kyang*/ so sor sdud dang de bzhin du/ /bsam gtan srog rtsol 'dzin pa dang*/ rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid rnam drug go /zhes sogs gsungs/ gzhan yang rgyud kyi rgyal po phal cher las/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di ci rigs par gsungs pa kho na yin zhing*/ khyad par du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las shin tu rgyas shing gsal ba mtha' gcod dang bcas pas yang nas yang du bstan zhing*/

rtsa rgyud kyi dum bu dbang mdor bstan dang*/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud kyi snying po 'jam dpal mtshan brjod sogs kyang lam 'di kho na ston pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa skor gsum gyis kyang rgyas par bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bla ma yid ches pa ni/ brgyud pa'i thugs sangs rgyas nyid nas brtsams te/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa/ byin rlabs ma nyams shing nyams myong rgyun ma chad pa zhig la zer te/ tshig rkyang dang*/ dam nyams dang*/ 'dres khyer gyi lhad ma zhugs pa cig dgos so/ /de yang dngos sam brgyud pa'i bla ma zhig la/ bdud kyi bar chad zhugs pa'am 'dres khyer na/ de las brgyud pa'i chos de bsgom pa kun la'ang bar chad tshan che ba re nges par 'ong ba yin/ bla ma'i ming can brgyud pa la dam sel yod pa zhig byung na/ de nas brgyud pa'i chos bsgoms kyang yon tan mi skye/ nyon mongs ldang*/ 'brel ba can thams cad la bkra mi shis so/ /de dag ma yin yang tshig brgyud rkyang pa la shor na/ de zhus nas bsgoms kyang nyams myong skye dus med/ bsgom ma bsgom med pa 'dra ba 'ong*/ rdzun chung na bla ma de na re/ dpe cha 'di'i nang na ni de tsug gda'/ nga la ni yod ma myong ngo zer/ 'ga' zhig rdzun po che yin na/ slob ma bslu ba'i phyir/ nyams myong 'dra yod skad byed pa'ang 'ong*/ 'ga' zhig gnas skabs kyi man ngag lag len phran bu la'ang rdugs te 'di bya 'di byed med pa'i rigs kyang 'ong bas/ de dag ni bla ma la yid ches pa'i mi mthun phyogs yin/ de la chos 'di ni da lta'i bar du byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma chad/ gdams ngag gi lag len ma nub/ nyams myong gi yon tan skye bzhin pa yin te/ da lta'i bar gyi rdo rje slob dpon rnams la'ang*/ sor sdud kyi nyams myong phyin ci ma log pa dngos dang*/ srog rtsol dang rjes dran rjes mthun pa thugs la 'khrungs pa mang po dngos su yod/

rgyu'i yan lag gsum gyi lag len dang nyams myong ma nor bar yod pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu'i yan lag gsum da lta dngos su ma thob kyang*/ phyis kyi rten 'brel bslu med du 'grig pa yin no/ /de lta na chos 'di ni 'phags pa'i yul du nyi zla ltar grags pa'i stobs kyis bod yul 'dir yang lo tsā ba chen po du mas spyan drangs te/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud rtsa 'grel la/ lo paṇa sdeb pa'i 'gyur mi 'dra ba bcu drug ni nges par yod la/ shong 'gyur sogs bod yul nyid du 'gyur bcos byas pa'ang mang du yod pas/ spyir 'gyur gyi rnam grangs nyi shu rtsa bzhi tsam yod par grags na/ de thams cad la yang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag re yod dgos shing*/ de dag la ma gtogs pa'i lo paṇa gzhan 'ga' zhig dus 'khor gyi dbang dang rgyud bshad ma mdzad kyang*/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi man ngag ma nor bar yod pa'ang mang du byung bas/ spyir ni sbyor drug gi man ngag la rnam grangs shin tu mang ba zhig byung na'ang*/ rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku chos rje kun spangs chen po zhang thugs rje brtson 'grus kyi zhal snga nas/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i man ngag bka' yod cing lhad med pa rigs mi 'dra ba bcu bdun gsan zhing*/ lam gyi ngo bo la khyad med kyang gdams pa so so'i che bar dgongs te/ re re bzhin nyams khrid du nyams su bzhes te gdams ngag dang mthun pa'i nyams myong sku nyams su bstar par mdzad do/ /de la sbyor drug lugs srol bcu bdun ni/ lo tsā ba chen po gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyi sbyor drug gi man ngag sbyor drug gi sgos kyi rgyud chung 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang*/ lo tsā ba rma dge ba'i blo gros kyi lugs kyi sbyor drug dang*/ khrom lo tsā ba padma 'od zer gyi sbyor drug dang*/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas bla ma nag po mngon shes can la gsan pa'i sbyor drug dang*/

kha che'i paṇa chen zla ba mgon po nas brgyud pa'i sbyor drug la 'bro lugs su grags pa'i sbyor drug dang*/ rwa lo tsā ba chos rab kyis paṇḍi ta sa manta shrī la gsan pa'i sbyor drug dang*/ tsa mi lo tsā ba sangs rgyas grags kyis mdzad pa'i sbyor 'phreng gi lugs/ se lo dang gnyos ston 'od ma nas brgyud pa 'di la tsa mi lugs rang du grags pa dang*/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa'i a mo gha badzra la gsan pa'i sbyor drug dang*/ tsa mi nas brgyud pa yin yang sbyor 'phreng lugs dang mi gcig pa dpal chen rga lo nas brgyud pa lugs gsum ste/ rga los dus 'khor rang lugs kyi sbyor drug zhang 'tshal ba sogs la gnang ba dang*/ ma rgyud kyai'i rdo rje'i sbyor drug bla ma sa skya pa chen po la gnang ba dang*/ pha rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa'i sbyor drug dge bshes skyu ra a skyabs la gnang ba dang gsum mo/ rga los tsa mi la gsan pa yin yang*/ sbyor 'phreng gi lugs dang rga lo lugs gnyis gdams ngag ston tshul mi 'dra ba cher yod pas lugs so sor bgrong ngo*/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrīs dpyal lo chos bzang la gnang ba/ dgyes rdor nā ro 'grel chen gyi man ngag tu mdzad/ dpyal pas nā ro pa'i sgrom lder grags pa'i yi ge yang yod pa dang*/ paṇa chen gyis chos rje sa skya paṇa chen la gnang ba snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig drug gis khyad par du byas pa ste/ kha che paṇa chen nas brgyud pa lugs gnyis so/ /grub thob dpe med 'tsho'i lugs kyi sbyor drug slob dpon ratna rakṣi ta la panḍi ta bi bhu ti tsand+ras gsan pa bi bhu ti'i ring brgyud du grags pa dang*/ phyis bal yul gyi sthaṃ bi ha rar grub thob shā bā ri'i zhal mngon sum du bstan dus gnang ba'i sbyor drug nye brgyud de bi bhu ti'i lugs gnyis so/ /chag lo tsā ba chos rje dpal gyis bla ma bal po'i paṇa chen nyi dbang srung ba dang*/

'phags yul gyi skyes mchog ra hu la shrī bha dra la gsan pa'i man ngag kyang yod la/ man lung gu rur grags pa grub chen puṇya shrī'am/ rgya gar gyi yul du grub chen dī paṃ ka rar grags pa 'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes te da lta ri bo po ta la na bzhugs pa des/ dang por 'bro lugs gtso bor gyur pa rwa 'bro gnyis 'dus kyi man ngag bsgom par mdzad pa yin yang*/ phyis grub pa brnyes pas brgyud pa gzhan la ma ltos mod/ gang ltar yang des mdzad pa'i mtshan brjod sbyor drug ste/ de ltar na lugs srol bcu bdun no/ /sdom ni/ gyi jo rma khrom jo bo dang*/ /'phro rwa tsa mi rdo rje grags/ /rga lo'i gsum dang kha che'i gnyis/ /bi bhu ti gnyis chag man lungs/ /zhes so/ /paṇa chen bi bhu ti tsand+ra'i lugs kyi nye brgyud la/ mar ston g.yang 'bar/ lho pa gzhon tshul/ nyeg po chos ldan te dngos slob gsum la rnal 'byor seṅge 'bum gyis zhus/ de la kun spangs chen pos gsan/ yang bi bhu ti'i dngos slob dpyal ston padma can la/ kun mkhyen chos sku bas gsan/ de la kun spangs chen pos gsan pa'am/ dpyal padmo can dngos la'ang gsan no/ /bu ston chen po'i gsung bgros gcig la/ ko brag pa nas brgyud pa ded pas chog pa gcig kyang yod par bshad/ don la'ang yod par 'dug da lta yongs su grags pa bi bhu ti dngos slob bzhi'i lugs gsan par byed/ 'di rnams la'ang nang sel mi 'dra ba phran tshegs yod pas/ lugs tha dad du byas na sbyor drug mi 'dra ba lugs nyi shur 'gro/ skabs 'dir brgyud pa tha dad pa'i rnam thar mtha' dag ni 'chad pa dang 'bri bar dka'/ 'bro lugs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar rags rim tsam bshad thub na legs te yi ge logs su yod/ brgyud pa gzhan rnams kyi rnam thar khrigs chags su mi dgos kyang*/ gtam rgyud rnam thar ngo mtshar che ba chos 'di nyid dang 'brel ba 'chad rgyu yod na tho re long nge ba bshad par bya'o/

/bi bhu ti tsand+ra'i lugs kyi lo rgyus cung zad tsam brjod na/ 'di'i ring brgyud rtsa ba thug sa de grub thob dpe med 'tsho yin/ de yang grub thob dpe med 'tsho de rten dge slong*/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la mkhas pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyang mkhyen/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyang yi dam du mdzad pa zhig yin/ 'khrungs yul ma ga dha pa/ rigs rje rigs/ sde pa mang pos bkur ba yin no zhes gsung rgyun las 'byung*/ gang ltar na'ang khong gi rgya gar shar phyogs yul li khar shing 'phel/ kha sarba ṇa rang byung gi gtsug lag khang du bzhugs nas lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du yang dag pa'i gnas lugs bsgoms shing*/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug bsgrubs kyang rtag mtshan cung zad kyang ma byung bas thugs mug ste/ nam phyed tsam na mnal du cung zad song*/ der kha sarbaṇas lung bstan pa/ bu bi kra ma pu rir song zhig 'dod pa'i don 'grub par 'gyur ro gsung*/ de'i nang par rang gi slob ma legs pa'i bu dang lhan cig rim gyis chas te/ nam zhig bi kra ma pu rir phebs pa'i nyin mor sna tshogs pa'i zlos gar dang ltad mo du ma 'dug pa gzigs pas/ de'i rkyen gyis snang ba thams cad sgyu ma lta bur rtogs/ nub mo 'khor gyi 'khyams shig tu bzhugs pas nam phyed tsam na rang gi lhag pa'i lha'am dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nyid/ a wa dhū tī'i spyod pa can gyi cha byad du byon nas/ bu de kho na nyid 'di yin no zhes gsungs pa gsan pa tsam gyis skad cig de la nyams rtogs ni yan lag drug gi rim pa rdzogs/ gnas lugs kyi don gzigs/ mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i grub thob chen por gyur kyang*/ sems can gyi don du lo mang por 'gro don mdzad cing*/ mi lus kyi rnam pa de kas bzhugs/ g.yang sa dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ dug dang*/ mtshon dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa gang gis kyang gnod pas mi tshugs/

rtsig pa dang ri la thogs pa med/ sku lus kyi bkod pa dang*/ gsung gi snang ba mang po cig car 'byung*/ stag dang*/ glang po che dang*/ kla klo'i dpung rengs par mdzad/ mthar sku lus ma spangs par 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes/ slob dpon a bha yā ka ra dang dus mtshungs yin/ des slob dpon dpal 'dzin sde la bshad/ des 'od byed lha la bshad/ des rgyal po'i bla ma chos 'byung zhi ba la bshad/ des nyi ma dpal ye shes la bshad/ de la paṇa chen ratna rakṣi tas gsan/ de la bi bhu ti tsand+ras gsan te/ de thams cad kyang rig pa'i gsan lnga la mkhas shing*/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud thams cad la mkhyen pa rgyas pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshul khong du chud pa/ mdzad pa chos las mi 'da' ba/ thun mong gi nus pa'i rtags ci rigs pa mnga' zhing*/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams rtogs shar ba sha stag go /nye brgyud ni grub thob shā bā ris bi bhu ti tsand+ra la dngos su gnang ba yin te/ de la bi bhu ti tsand+ra ni rgya gar shar phyogs bha lend+rar tshong dpon zhig gi sras su 'khrungs/ rten dge slong sde pa ni mang pos bkur ba/ bi kra ma shrī la sogs ma ga dha dang*/ o ṭi bi sha sogs su yang bslab sbyangs ci rigs pa mdzad/ gtso bor shar phyogs bhaṃ ga la'i yul na chos 'khor dza gad da la bya ba'i chos grwa bzang la rgya che ba yod pa der bslab sbyangs mdzad pas sde snod gsum dang*/ phyi rol kyi rig pa'i gnas la shin tu mkhas par gyur/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī rgya gar du lo gsum dang*/ bod yul du lo bcu gcig bsten/ sa sde lnga dang/ gsang sngags kyi chos shin tu mang ba sogs mdo sngags kyi gsan pa mtha' yas pa mdzad/ kha che paṇa chen rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/ drang srong srin po rir bde mchog gi lha khang bzhengs/ 'jim bzo bi bhu ti rang gis mdzad/ rab gnas kha che paṇa chen la zhus/ de nas bal yul du byon te/ buddhā shrī sogs mkhas grub gzhan la'ang sngar ma gsan pa'i gzhung gdams pa ci rigs pa gsan/

khyad par paṇa chen ratna rakṣi ta la dus 'khor bde mchog sogs mang po zhig mkhas nyan du mdzad/ lhag par dus 'khor gyi rgyud bshad la nan tan chen po mdzad cing*/ ches mkhas pa'i paṇa chen du gyur/ sbyor drug gi nyams khrid bskyar ma la rtsol ba chen po dang ngo sprod mdzad pas/ rtsa rlung dbang du 'dus/ nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs/ phyis sthaṃ bhi ha ra'i mkhan por phebs/ chos kyi sgo rnam grangs mang po gsungs/ 'phreng ba skor gsum/ thub pa dgongs rgyan/ man ngag snye ma sogs la'ang rkang tshugs kyi grwa btsugs shing*/ lhag par dus 'khor la bshad sgrub gnyis ka rtsal 'don du mdzad/ yi dam 'phags pa 'jam dpal dang*/ rdo rje phag mo snga mo nas zhal gzigs/ phyis 'khor lo sdom pa dang dus 'khor yang gzigs/ bde mchog gi dbang mdzad pas/ ye shes dbab pa'i dus bal po kirti shrī bya ba zhig dang*/ rgya gar tha ru ba'i btsun pa ma no ra ta bya ba skal ldan gnyis la nam mkha'i ye shes phebs te/ dbang gral nas mi snang bar gar song cha med du yal/ de sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas du ma mnga'/ yang bod du phebs te 'gro don cher byung*/ mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos mang po la rang 'gyur yang mdzad/ yang bal yul du byon te/ dgung lo'ang mang rab song skabs/ rnal 'byor ba gzhon nu snyan la rwa dung bcug pa gcig byung nas/ sna len cung zad cig mdzad nas grang khang zhig tu bskyal/ der sgra slob pa'i paṇa chung zhig gis bltas pas/ rlung mi rgyu ba dang*/ lus kyi mdog dbyibs sna tshogs su 'gyur ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rtags 'ga' re 'dug nas/ bla ma paṇḍi ta la zhus pas paṇḍi tas kyang de spyan drangs te yid kyi dri ba byas tshad la thogs med du lan shar shar byung*/ nyid su yin zhus pas/ grub thob shā bā ri pa yin gsungs/ mchog tu dgyes shing gus nas rjes su gzung bar zhus pas sbyor drug gsungs/ yi ger bkod pa da lta'i gzhung chung 'di yin/

spyir zab mo'i gdams pa mtha' yas pas tshims par mdzad cing rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam dngos su bzhugs par yang grags/ de nas gang du bzhud zhus pas/ 'di nas o rgyan du 'gro/ skal ldan 'ga'i don byed/ de nas dpal gyi ri la ka 'gro gsung ste mi snang bar gyur/ der slob dpon bi bhu ti tsand+ra ni byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa skad cig la brnyes/ 'dzin pa'i yon tan mthar thug pa'i rtags thob/ mi ring ba zhig na thugs dgongs la bod na skal ldan mang po yang yod/ nye brgyud kyi chos zab mo 'di dar na ci ma rung dgongs/ dus de tsa na bod sgom la grub thob ko brag pa las bzang ba dang mtshan grags che ba med/ sngar nas slob ma'ang yin pas rdo sku mdzad brgyad brkos ma gcig ka ra'i glang po che gcig sogs bskur nas/ nga la chos zab mo khyad par can gsar pa yod pas nyan par shog gsung pa'i 'phrin btang*/ der ko brag pas bdag gcig pu der yongs kyang sems can la phan thogs che rgyu ma mchis/ bla ma nyid bod du phebs na skal ldan dpag tu med pa'i 'gro don yong bas/ bod du cis kyang phebs par zhu zhes spyan 'dren btang bas zhu ba de la paṇa chen thugs dgyes te/ kyi rong tshun chad la phebs bsu'i mthun rkyen mang po dang bcas phebs/ 'di skabs kyang bod du lo gsum song*/ drang srong srin po rir yang phebs/ ding ri gla 'khor du lo ngo gnyis tsam bzhugs/ spyir chos zhu ba shin tu mang*/ sgos su sbyor drug zhu ba mang zhing*/ nyams rtogs khyad par can skyes pa mang du byung*/ nye brgyud la phyis brgyud pa zin zhing 'gro don can gyi slob ma dgu byung bar grags/ de skabs sgom chen mtshan grags che ba rgod tshang bas kyang 'di'i zhabs la gtugs pa yin te/ khong rang gi bka' 'bum du bltas pas gsal/ bla sgrub phyi nang gsang gsum gyi gzhung chung bi bhu ti la zhus/

gzhung chung de dag la khong bas mchan bu dang sa dpyad kyang mdzad gda'/ rnam thar na bgros mi 'dug ste slob ma tshos gsungs pa yin las che/ de nas paṇa chen bal por bzhud de/ de rjes kyang lo mang rab song ba na mi snang ba'i dngos grub brnyes pa la rtsod pa med/ 'dzin pa mthar phyin nas yun ring lon pas zung 'jug brnyes pa yin te mchi/ sku gdung ma byung*/ gang ltar yang slob dpon de yul shin tu gnyan pa zhig tu 'dugasngon rong pa sher seng dang rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa sogs kyis kyang zhal smod mang po mdzad de/ nang gi snye ma'i 'gyur de ma bde ba zhig 'dug pas 'khrul gzhi byung nas don ma dgongs par ma zad/ phyis byung gi sa skya bar 'dod pa rnams brnyes thabs dang skur 'debs byed de/ 'ur 'brogs langs pa kho nar zad do/ /de'i rgyu mtshan kha che paṇa chen sa skyar phebs dus paṇa chung gzhan rnams kyis rje btsun grags pa la phyag phul/ bi bhu tis ma phul/ rje sa paṇa gyis de'i sngon du sadgha shrī la sgra dang*/ da na shrī la la tshad ma gsan/ de dus paṇa chung gzhan rnams la'ang chos 'brel re tsam zhus/ rdzong pa bzang po mdzad pa la/ bi bhu ti de dus nas paṇa chung dgu'i nang nas mkhas shos yin/ de dus paṇa chen rang du ka yod kyang*/ chos kyang ma gsan/ rdzong pa yang ma mdzad skad/ bi bhu ti ni de sngon nas 'bri khung pa dang 'brel chags yod/ lan bar pa phebs skabs kyang 'bri khung gling du 'phrin las cher byung*/ de rjes srin po ri ba'i dge bshes zhig yin nam yang zer/ 'bri khung ba'i phyogs 'dzin zhig yin nam yang zer te/ rje btsun chen po'i rtsa ltung 'khrul spong gi grub mtha' la dgag pa yod pa'i sdom gsum 'od 'phreng zer ba'i gzhung chung de brtsams nas/ bi bhu ti tsand+ras mdzad do zhes kha 'phangs byas 'dugagrub mtha' bi bhu ta'i bzhed pa ni yin yod par yang gda'/ phyis kyi sa skya ba rnams bod rtsom dang rgya rtsom gyi nyams ni med/

dgag pa de mthong bas snying na ba yin te/ 'od 'phreng gi gzhung de bod rtsom sang sang sngon rtags can yin pas/ bi bhu tis ma mdzad par nges/ khong la tshig pa de tsam za mi dgos/ dper na rgyud brdzus ma gcig gi nang na/ lta spyod log pa 'dug kyang*/ de rdo rje 'chang la khag med pa dang 'dra/ lar sdom gsum 'od 'phreng gi lugs de la'ang lung rig gis gnod byed yod na khyogs shog rje btsun grags rgyal la phyag ma phul ba dang*/ dgag pa byas pa tsam la snying 'kham pa ni gu dog tsam yin gyi/ mkhas pa'i bya ba ma yin no/ /de na mkhas pa yin du re na mkhas pa la 'os pa zhig byas na dga' 'o/ /de ltar brgyud pa tha dad pa du ma'i nang nas/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi thog mtha' bar gsum thams cad du rtsa ba'i rkang ni 'gro lugs kyi man ngag la gzhung srong bar mdzad de/ gzhan thams cad las man ngag rgyas pa'i phyir dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad kyang rtags mngon gyur gyi grub brnyes 'ba' zhig yin pas byin rlabs kyi bka' babs 'gran zla med pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i 'og nas bi bhu ti tsand+ra'i nye brgyud la gtso bor mdzad de/ gdams pa zab cing bka' gsar ma nyid kyi phyir byin rlabs kyi bka' babs kyang che ba yin pas thog mtha' bar gsum kun tu 'phra bkod pa'i tshul ston par mdzad do/ /de las gzhan brgyud pa so so'i man ngag thams cad kyang*/ dpal jo nang pa'i lugs 'di la 'dus te/ nyams len gyi spyi khog ni thams cad 'dra bas zlos pa'i tshul gyis ston mi dgos la/ srog rtsol sogs kyi skabs su mi 'dra ba'i khyad par zab khyad yod tshad rnam grangs su bkod nas 'dus pa mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar na rgyud dang bla ma la yid ches zhes bya ste/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkral/ grub thob rnams kyis bsgoms/ pandi ta rnams kyis bshad/ lo tsā ba rnams kyis bsgyur/

tshad mar gyur pa'i skyes bu thams cad kyis rtsis su mdzad/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa gces par 'dzin pa'i mkhas sgrub dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis nyan bshad sgom sgrub mdzad pa'i the tshom dang rtsod pa'i gzhi thams cad dang bral/ sṛd pa gsum du nyi zla ltar grags pa'i chos yin/ mkhas pas ma bcos/ blun pos ma bslad/ rgyal ba'i bka' mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa drang thal le ba/ nyams dang*/ rmi lam dang*/ zhal gzigs ma dang*/ gter ma dang*/ lung bstan ma yin zer nas khungs med rdzab rdzub rab rib la skyabs 'tshol mi dgos pa/ legs legs bsdus pa ma yin pa/ blo bzo'i ris gcod ma byas pa/ sgom chen 'ga' zhig gis 'tsho ba'i don du brtsams pa dang*/ bla dpon 'ga' zhig gis rang gi 'khor dang yon bdag mgo rmongs pa'i ched du byas pa'i gyabs skor dang rdzus chos dang*/ log chos kyi bsre bslad ye ma zhugs pa/ rnam dag legs pa'i lam 'di lta bu la 'jug pa skal ba bzang ba yin no/ /bdag nyid la yid ches pa zhes pa ni/ chos de rang gis nyams su blangs pas bshad tshod dang mthun pa'i nyams myong skyes tsa na/ chos de slob ma rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid kyis nyams su myong ba'i sgo nas chos la yid ches tshad ma rnyed pa ste/ de yang rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs te/ /nyi ma gcig tu yongs su brtag /gal te rtags ni ma byung na/ /de tshe nga yi rdzun tshig yin/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ dgyes pa rdo rje las kyang*/ bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /lha yin gzugs su sems pa yis/ /rgyun mi chad par nyin mtshan gcig /bsgom pa yongs su brtag par gyis/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /'khor bar thabs gzhan yon ma yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu gnas pas nyin mo gcig dang mtshan mo gcig goms par byas na/ dus de nyid du lam rtags sngon ma rnams 'char thub pa zhig dgos te/ nyi ma shar na dus de nyid du 'od 'byung dgos pa bzhin no/

/ gzhan du na mi rtogs pa dang*/ gtum mo bsgom pa sogs zla drug gam lo'am lo gsum sogs yun ring du goms pa las phyis rtags rnams 'byung ba dang*/ de ltar 'byung ngo zhes bla mas lung ston yang*/ bdag nyid la yid ches pa rnam dag ma yin zhing*/ 'thad pa'ang ma yin te/ nyin zhag dang po bsgom pa de ka yang dag pa'i de kho na nyid bsgom pa yin na/ de nyid du de'i rtags 'byung ba 'thad la/ de ni de kho na nyid bsgom ma yin na/ de dag dmigs rnam la khyad med pas/ phyis bsgom pa rnams kyang yang dag pa ma yin par 'gyur la/ de yang 'dod na khyed kyi chos de dngos gnas la de bzhin bden mod/ phyin ci log gi lam yun ring goms pa las/ yang dag pa'i rtags 'byung ba yang mi rigs shing yang rtags de yang log pa'i rtags yin na ni/ phyin ci log kho na yun ring du goms pa la rtsol pa byed pa'i bla ma dang*/ slob ma de dag ni ngo mtshar can brjod pa las 'das pa zhig go /yang nyin zhag dang po nas bsgoms pa de rnam dag yin yang de'i rtags ni phyis yun ring po nas 'byung ngo zhe na/ nyi ma de ring shar ba yi/ / 'od zer nang par 'byung ba mtshar/ /zhes pa dang 'dra'o/ /de lta bas na rtsa bzang na thun thun mtshams gcig /'bring la nyin mtshan gang rung gcig thams mas kyang nyid zhag phrugs gcig bsgoms pas rtags snang 'char bar the tshom med pa'i lam ni chos 'di kho na yin no/ /'o na da lta 'khrid btab pa rnams la zhag 'ga' shas nas rtags snang 'byung ba mang du mthong ba dang mi 'gal lam snyam na/ las dang po pas thun bzhir bsgoms na/ res 'ga' dmigs pa la sems gnas kyang phal cher mi gnas pas gang dmigs pa la sems brtad pa snga phyir byung ba rnams bsdoms pas nyin zhag gcig gi tshad du sleb pa na/ nges par rtags snang 'char zhing*/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgom cung zad tsam rtsol med rang babs su 'byung ste/ rdo rje 'bebs pa'i cha shas yin no/

/des na dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i rgyun ma chad pa zhag gcig thub dgos pa gtan nas min yang*/ thun mtshams spyod lam dang sems yengs pa'i gus te sgom byas pa la mi the bas/ nam mkha'i rnal 'byor zhag gcig bsgom pa la rtags med pa mi srid par gsungs pa dang*/ rnam g.yeng dang bsres kyin bsgoms pas/ zhag gnyis gsum du rtags ma byung ba la 'gal ba sdeb rgyu ga la yod/ spyir deng sang gi mis kyang chos 'di'i sgom la zhugs pa'i nyi ma dang po nyid nas rtags snang dang rdo rje 'bebs pa thob pa mang du 'byung ba mngon sum du grub pa 'dir snang zhing*/ zhag shas bsgoms pas mi 'byung ba ni mi srid do/ /de la ma mtha' yang zhag gcig gi mtha' 'dzin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni nyin zhag gcig po de'am zhag snga phyi sna tshogs pa bsdoms pa yin yang rung ste/ zhag gcig gi tshad du longs pa na dbugs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya la/ mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis gnad du bsnun par song ba'i rten 'brel las the tshom med pa yin la/ dbang po rno ba la ni dbugs sum brgya drug cu tsam la yang 'byung ba la sogs pa nges pa med do/ / des na chu tshod gcig dang*/ dus sbyor gcig dang*/ dus sbyor gnyis nas bcu gnyis kyi bar du ci rigs par sbyar ro/ /gzhan yang 'di ltar shes dgos te/ stong rkyang tsam bsgom pa la ni rtags snang mi 'byung ba shas che la/ byung yang rtsis su mi byed do/ /phra thig sogs bsgoms pas du sogs 'char ba ni bem po'i rlung rags pa'i dbu mar thim pa'i nyams tsam yin/ de ni rlung gi mdangs sam rtsa'i mdangs zhes bya/ spyir lam du 'gyur mod kyang 'khrul shes yin zhing rnam pa thams cad par 'char ba'ang ma yin no/ /chos 'di las byung pa'i rtags snang gi gtso bo rnams ni mi rtog pa'i stobs kyis ma dag pa'i rtsa rlung thig le cung zad thim pas/ de ma thag ye shes kyi rtsa rlung thig le cung zad mngon du gyur pa'i phyir/

chos nyid kyi mdangs yin la/ de'i phyir rnam pa phyogs re tsam ma yin par rnam pa mtha' yas par 'char ba yin no/ /des na lam 'bras dang chos drug sogs las 'chad pa'i rtags snang dang*/ sbyor drug pa la 'byung ba'i stong gzugs gnyis/ du sogs su mtshungs pa'i 'dra chos tsam yod kyang ngo bo bzang ngan shin tu khyad che ste/ rgyu mtshan de nyid kyis na/ chos de dag tu stong gzugs kyi tha snyad mi mdzad la/ 'dir stong gzugs dang rdzogs rim gyi lha yin par 'jog pa yin no/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang rtog bcas de dag tu du sogs 'char ba ni/ rtogs pa de shin tu goms pa las/ 'dod 'jigs mya ngan sogs dang mtshungs par rtog med gsal snang 'khrul pa can zhig skye la/ de la brten nas du sogs 'char te/ mdor na rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i phyir/ ye shes kyi dbu ma la reg mi thub bo/ lugs 'di'i stong gzugs ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i sems kyis rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i phyir/ thog mar rags pa'i rtsa dbu ma la brten nas de ma thag tu ye shes kyi rtsa dbu ma la reg par 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ sgom byed lam gyi ye shes dang*/ bsgom bya ye shes kyi rtsa gnyis kar mi rtog pa'i ye shes su mtshungs pa'i phyir des de la gnad du bsnun thub la/ rnam rtog sgoms pas ye shes kyi rtsa la gnad du bsnun mi thub ste/ bcos ma dang bcos min gyi khyad par shin tu che ba'i phyir/ nam mkha' la khu tshur bsnun mi nus pa bzhin no/ /mdor na rtog pa las byung ba'i rtags snang dang mi rtog pa las byung ba'i rtags snang mi 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ /spyir 'di la mu bzhi yod de/ rtog bcas kyi sgom pa yin zhing rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa dang mi bsnun pa gnyis/ rtog med kyi sgom pa la'ang rdo rje lus la gnad du bsnun pa dang mi bsnun pa ste bzhi'o/ /gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi pa lta bu gsang sngags nang pa'i phra thig gi rnal 'byor rnams ni/

rtog bcas yin zhing lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i mu yin la/ bod yul 'dir sems 'khrid du grags pa'i mi rtog pa rnams ni mi rtog pa yin yang lus la gnad du mi bsnun pa'i mu'o/ /dpyad sgom gyi stong nyid sgom pa dang*/ nges 'byung snying rje phal pa sogs rnam rtog kyang yin la rdo rje lus la gnad du mi bsnun pa'i mu'o/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgom pa yang yin la/ rdo rje lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i mu'o/ / de dag las bod yul 'dir grags pa'i phyag rdzogs zhi gcod la sogs pa phal che ba ni/ rdzogs rim yin par 'dod cing grags mod kyang*/ rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa med pa'i phyir dang*/ theg chen mdo lugs dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ kha cig 'jig rten pa'i ting nge 'dzin kun dang yang thun mong yin pa'i phyir rdzogs rim ma yin la/ yang kha cig rdzogs rim gyi skad dod ni ṣpanna ma bcos pa dang*/ ma brtags pa la 'jug cing*/ pa ri ni ṣpanna zhes pa yongs su grub pa la'ang 'jug pas/ sgra bshad de dag tshang ba'i phyir rdzogs rim yin no snyam na/ sgra bshad phyogs re tshang ba tsam gyis de dang de yin par mi 'gyur te/ chu las skyes dang chu skyes bzhin/ /zhes pa ltar yin pa dang ha cang thal bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang sher mdo dang*/ rgyud bla dang*/ zla ba sgron me'i mdo dang*/ rig tshogs kyi gzhung la sogs pa'i dngos bstan yin par khas len bzhin du/ gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rdzogs rim yang yin no zhes smra ba ni/ ches 'gal bar smra ba yin mod kyi/ phyogs 'dzin gyi gdon gyis bslad pas rig pa rnal mar med pa de dag la smras kyang dgos pa mi snang bas re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag go /'od zer 'gro 'ong la dmigs pa sogs dang*/ rags pa'i khams tsam kho na la 'gro 'ong gi bya ba byed nus kyi las rgya ye rgya sogs 'di rnams kyang rdzogs rim dngos ma yin te rnam par rtog pa'i sgom pa yin pa'i phyir dang*/

kha cig lus ngag gi bya rtsol gtso bor ston pa'i rnam 'gyur tsam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na 'di dag rgyud gzhung tshad ldan nas rdzogs rim du bshad pa min nam zhe na/ 'di dag kyang man ngag gi gnad dang ldan na rdzogs rim gyi nye ba'i rgyu byed pa yod cing*/ rdzogs rim dang rnam pa 'dra ba nyid kyi phyir/ rdzogs rim gyi ming gis btags pa ste/ 'di dag gi rags pa'i rtsa dbu mar bem chos kyi rlung thim pa sogs dang*/ rdul chos kyi thig le 'ching ba tsam sogs yod pas/ lus la gnad du bsnun pa tsam yin mod/ ye shes kyi rtsa rlung thig le la reg par mi nus pa dang*/ gnas lugs sgom pa'ang ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ /rnam par rtog pa can nyid kyi phyir rdzogs rim dngos ma yin te/ bskyed rim dngos dang rdzogs rim btags pa ba yin zhes bya'o/ /de lta na yang gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos tsam ni yin te/ dbang bskur ba dang lha bsgom sngags bzlas la sogs pa bzhin no/ /mi rtog pa ma yin zhing lus la gnad du bsnun pa yang ma yin pa'i mu rnams ni/ dngos su rdzogs rim ma yin par ma zad/ de dag rdzogs rim yin zhes smra mkhan yang cher med pa'i dpyad pa mi dgos mod/ yang rnam pa gcig tu na mu gsum po de dag thams cad kyang zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyud sbyang ba'i thabs dang*/ sngon 'gror ni 'gyur du rung ba sha stag yin pas/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di la brtan pa cung zad thob na/ de dag la 'dis rgyas btab ste bsgoms na/ lam 'di'i bogs 'don du 'gro ba dang*/ gser 'gyur rtsis lcags gser du 'gyur ba ltar de dag kyang rdzogs rim du gnas 'gyur ba'i skabs ni yod do/ /de lta bas na rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis gnas lugs bsgom pa yang yin/ sgom pa de kho nas rdo rje lus la phyin ci ma log par gnad du bsnun pa yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa zhig byung na/

de ni rdzogs rim dngos yin te/ de yang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di kho na las gzhan la med do/ /yang 'di snyam du da lta phyag chen du grags pa 'di lta bu mi rtog pa'i gnas lugs bsgom pa yin la/ de'i steng du gtum mo dang las rgya sogs kyis rdo rje lus la gnad du bsnun na bde stong phyag chen du 'gyur ba dang*/ mi rtog pa dang lus la gnad du bsnun pa gnyis kar tshang bas/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang khyad med par 'gyur snyam na/ nyams myong rnam pa 'dra rung yod du chug kyang*/ de ni rgyu tha dad gnyis 'dus pa'i bcos ma yin pas/ ye shes kyi rtsa sogs la gnad du bsnun mi nus te/ rtsi brgya mang du sdom na yang*/ khang pa'i gdung ma bzod par dka'/ /zhes pa ltar yin pas so/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'dir ni thabs gzhan gyis byas pa ma yin par mi rtog pa'i ye shes gcig po des rdo rje lus la gnad du bsnun par byed pa yin pa'i phyir shin tu khyad che ste skar ma'i tshogs pa dang nyi ma bzhin no// 'dir gang la gnad du bsnun rgyu'i rdo rje lus ni steng 'og rtsa drug dang*/ rtsa 'khor lo drug dang*/ de dag gi rlung dang thig le sogs yin gyi/ lus tsam po la mi 'jog go /de ltar na lam thams cad las ches khyad par du gyur pa'i rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di ni/ nyams myong la zhag dus thebs pa/ grub thob la zla dus thebs pa/ sangs rgyas la lo dus thebs pa'i chos gzhan gang dang yang mi mnyam pa yin no/ /'di dag la gong du bshad pa ltar go ba chags dgos la/ 'khrid 'debs pa'i skabs/ spros bshad dang mtha' gcod de dag 'chad mi 'chad skabs dang bstun 'tshal/ de yan chad ni 'khrid dmigs ma tshugs gong thog ma'i 'jug sgo'i skabs kyi gsung bgros yin te/ chos thun gsum bzhi lnga sogs ji ltar 'tsham pa re mdzad do/ /sngon 'gro thun mong ba'i dmigs pa'i skabs su 'di skad ces/ sbyor drug la bod snga rabs pa rnams kyi yig rnying rnams bsdus pa tsam dang*/

'thor thabs su yod pa dang*/ man ngag gab pa'i phyir khrigs chags su bsgrigs pa tsam med/ sngon shin tu bka' yang gnyan pa la/ chos rje kun spangs chen pos yun ring du dgongs pa brtad de/ yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams la gsol ba btab pa na/ chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi bka'i gnang ba byung ba la brten nas bka' rgya bkrol te 'khrid yig rgyas pa mdzad/ kun spangs chen po'i 'khrid yig 'di sbyor drug gi 'khrid yig khrigs chags ma kun gyi thog ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ brgyud pa khungs ldan gyi sbyor drug phal che ba/ chos rje 'di las brgyud pa'ang yin pa'i phyir/ rang gi blos btags gtso bor byas pa'i yi ge rnams ma gtogs/ sbyor drug gi 'khrid yig phyi ma phal che ba yang*/ 'di la gzhi brten mdzad pa yin no/ /de yang ci lta bu zhe na/ mkhas mchog bu ston rin po che'i lugs kyang*/ dang por mkhan chen thar lo la bi bhu ti'i lugs gcig gsan/ rje rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan la dbang rgyud zhib mor gsan kyang*/ rwa ba'i sbyor drug la tshig 'khrid ma gtogs don 'khrid mi bzhugs pas/ sbyor drug mtha' rgyas rang de phyis 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtsho la gsan pa yin/ khong gis kun spangs chen po la sbyor drug gi nyams 'khrid dang*/ rgyud snying gi bshad pa tshar mang du gsan/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes la yang gsan te/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug kyang gtso bor kun spangs chen po las brgyud pa yin zhing*/ khrid yig mdzad pa'ang*/ kun spangs chen po'i khrid yig la rtsom gdan mdzad par 'dug chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas kyang*/ dang por kun spangs chen po'i dngos slob brag kha ba grags pa seṅge la gsan/ yang kun spangs chen po'i dngos slob sron pa kun rgyal de'i slob ma sron pa chos dpal bzang po dang*/ sron pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gnyis ka la nyams 'khrid du gsan/

phyis bu ston rin po che la'ang gsan/ khrid yig rtsom par mdzad pa ni sron lugs gtso che bas/ kun spangs chen po'i bka' srol nyid yin no/ /yang o rgyan bsnyen sgrub tu grags pa ni/ kun spangs chen po dang dus mnyam du byung ba yin yang*/ spung bkra o rgyan pa rin chen dpal ba rang gis zhal gzigs kyi chos yin gyi/ lo paṇa sdeb pa rgya gar nas bsgyur ba ma yin/ rgya gar paṇḍi ta nags rin gyi lugs ni dus phyis byung ba yin/ de min gzhan par skabs dang phyis sbyor drug gi man ngag byung ba thams cad/ kun spangs chen po 'di las ma brgyud pa med pa lta bu ste/ chos 'di'i bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gcig pu ba yin no/ /des na kun spangs chen po'i gsung la brten par 'dra yang*/ brgyud pa gzhan 'ga'i lugs kyis/ sngon 'gro thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis su mi 'byed par/ sngon 'gro'i 'khrid thung gsum zhes mdor bsdus re mdzad pa'i lugs 'dug kyang*/ las dang po pa la sngon 'gros rgyud sbyong ba gal che bas/ dpal jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sngon 'gro rgyas par mdzad pas/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro rang la'ang dmigs skor lnga byed pa lags/ /skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa 'bogs pa la/ chos thun gcig song ba'i mtshams su/ skyabs 'gro'i go don bshad mi dgos na der zad/ dgos na ci rigs pa 'tsham zhing ran par bshad dgos te/ de yang phyogs mtshon na 'di ltar/ spyir skyabs su 'gro ba zhes bya ba skyabs zhu ba la zer/ skyabs su song ba zhes 'das pa'i sgra byung na/ skyabs zhus grub pa'i don yin/ de yang rang la 'jigs skrag gang yang med cing rang dbang thob par yod na/ su la'ang skyabs 'tshol mi dgos pas/ gang skyabs 'tshol ba de ni 'jigs pa yod cing*/ de las skyob pa'i skyabs don du gnyer ba yin pas/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i rgyu 'jigs pas nyen pa yin/ de la 'jig rten pa'i skyabs 'gro dang*/

'jig rten las 'das pa'i skyabs 'gro gnyis yod/ dang po la tshe 'di kho na'i phyir gyi skyabs 'gro dang*/ gtan gyi skyabs 'gror rlom pa gnyis yod/ de'i dang po ni/ 'jigs pas skrag pa'i mi rnams ni/ /phal cher ri dang nags tshal dang*/ /kun dga' ra ba mchod rten dang*/ /ljon shing rnams la skyabs su 'gro/ /skyabs de gtso bo ma yin zhing*/ /skyabs de la ni brten nas su/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ri rdzong la blo brtad 'cha' ba lta bu sems med la yang skyabs su 'gro/ ri dang lha rten sogs la gnas pa'i mi ma yin dang*/ gzhan yang lha phran nam yi dwags su gtogs pa'i yul lha gzhi bdag sde brgyad lha ma srin la sogs pa la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ rgyal po la sogs pa mi'i 'gro ba kha drag dbang po che la blo gtod pa rnams yin te/ grub mthas blo kha ma bsgyur ba'i 'jig rten phal pa blun po rnams kyi bsam pa yin/ tshe 'di pa skyabs kho na ste mig rgyang shin tu thung ba yin/ gnyis pa ni/ skyabs kyi yul khyab 'jug dang*/ drag po dang*/ ser skya dang*/ lha rgyal pa dam pa sogs 'jig rten gyi lha dang*/ 'jig rten gyi dge sbyong chen po rnams la dmigs nas/ de dag skyob pa rnam dag ma yin yang*/ skyob pa mthar thug yin snyam log par gzung ste/ tshe 'di phyi gnyis dang thar pa'i re ltos zhu ba ste/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa las phyi rol tu gyur pa mu stegs byed la sogs pa rnams kyi skyabs 'gro yin/ gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa la yang bsam sbyor rgya chung ba theg dman nyan rang gnyis kyi skyabs 'gro dang*/ rgya che ba theg chen gyi skyabs 'gro gnyis yod pa las/ 'dir theg chen yin/ de la yang thun mong ba mdo lugs dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi lugs zhes dbye ba cung zad tsam yod pa las/ 'dir sngags lugs ltar bya/ yang skyabs yul 'jig rten las 'das pa dkon mchog gsum yin yang*/

bsam pa tshe 'di'am phyi ma 'khor ba'i bde ba thob 'dod las med na/ 'jig rten pa'i skyabs 'gro las ma 'das mod/ yul mchog la dmigs pa'i phyir/ phugs kyi bag chags khyad par can 'jog cing*/ gnas skabs kyi phan yon yang gzhan rnams las ches lhag par che'o/ /de la 'jig rten pa'i skyabs 'gro rnams ni/ skyabs 'gro'i ming can tsam las mtshan nyid pa ma yin la/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum ka yod do/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i skyabs 'gro zhes pa/ skyabs su 'gro lugs sam ngo bo'i sgo nas 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das gnyis ka yod kyang*/ skyabs yul 'jig rten las 'das pa kho nar nges pa'i phyir/ de skad ces bya ste/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i skyabs 'gro mtshan nyid tshang ba thams cad yin/ de la dbye na/ nyan rang theg chen gsum yod kyang thams cad spyir dge ba 'ba' zhig yin zhing*/ sgos su dad pa dang tshul khrims kyis bsdus pa yin/ de la skyabs su 'gro pa'i yul gang yin la ni/ grub mtha' so so'i 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang*/ de thams cad rigs pas dpyad na song tshod la 'di lta bu zhig las mi 'da' 'o zhes so so'i 'dod pa smra ba yin gyi/ dmigs pa bsgom pa dang lag len du 'debs pa la mi 'dra ba'i 'gal ba cher med cing*/ theg pa che chung gi dbang gis rgya che chung gi 'dor len cung zad tsam ni yod do/ / des na spyir thun mong du mdo sngags gnyis ka 'dra ba yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i chos kyi sku yin la/ sangs rgyas rang snang gi sku skye 'gag dang bral ba de dang*/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi sku de dang*/ de nyid kyi gsung sgra skad thams cad pa ste/ gsum po de longs skus bsdus pa dang*/ bzo dang skye ba dang mchog gi sprul sku sogs sangs rgyas dngos kyi sprul pa thams cad sprul pa'i skus bsdus pa ste/ mdor na mos pa'i yul gyi sangs rgyas dkon mchog ni sku gsum gyis bsdus pa thams cad yin la/

/chos dkon mchog ni lung dang rtogs pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ chos gsung rab ming tshig yi ger snang ba dang*/ ngag tu brjod pa rnams yin la/ rtogs pa'i chos ni mthar thug gi zhi ba myang 'das chos dbyings de bzhin nyid dang*/ de nyid sgrib pas dag pa'i cha nas zhi ba myang 'das 'gog bden 'bras bu'i chos dang*/ gnas lugs de rtogs pa yang yin/ 'bras bu de mngon du byed pa'i skabs kyang yin pas lam gyi ye shes ni lam bden gyi chos zhes bya ste/ ngo bo byang chub kyi phyogs chos rnams yin la/ de yang 'phags rgyud kyi lam rnams lam bden dang chos dkon mchog yin par rtsod pa med/ tshogs sbyor gyis bsdus pa rnams kyang phyogs mthun yin pas/ ji srid tshogs sbyor gyi lam ma thob pa de srid du skyabs yul du byed dgos pas/ de ltar lung rtogs kyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams so/ /'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i phyir mi ldog pa rnams theg chen pa'i skyabs yul gyi dge 'dun dngos yin/ de dang rjes su mthun zhing*/ nyan rang 'phags pa las kyang bzang ba'i phyir tshogs sbyor gyi phyir mi ldog thob pa rnams kyang skyabs yul gyi khongs su bsdu la/ nyan rang 'phags pa rnams theg chen gyi skyabs yul du byed mi byed lugs gnyis yod pa don la mi 'gal te/ theg chen pa'i skyabs yul dngos ma yin pa dang*/ ji srid du 'phags pa de dag dang yon tan mnyam par ma gyur gyi bar du/ skyabs su 'os pa'i yang phyir ro/ /gzhan yang mdun du bzhag pa'i sangs rgyas zhes mdo las gsungs pa'i phyir/ chos dang dge 'dun la yang rigs 'gre pas/ mdun bzhag gi sangs rgyas ni sku gzugs dang mchod rten lta bu/ mdun bzhag gi chos ni bka'i glegs bam dang*/ sngags kyi yi ge'i gzugs sogs dang*/ mdun bzhag gi dge bdun ni so so skye bo'i dge 'dun tshul khrims dang ldan nges pa rnams so/ /gzhan yang chos yang dag par bsdud pa'i mdo las/

sangs rgyas bcu gsungs pa'i skabs na/ mkhan po dang slob dpon sogs kyang rnam grangs pa'i sangs rgyas su bshad pa yod pas/ mdo lugs las kyang*/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi khongs su bla ma bsdu ba zhig bshad cing*/ sangs rgyas dang 'dra bar mos gus byed mod/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dngos su bsgom pa rang ni min par bzhed do/ /yang sku gzugs glegs bam la sogs pa la ni gus pa byed dgos par grub mod kyang*/ sems med bem po'i bkod pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ skyabs yul gyi khongs su mi bsdu'o snyam na/ 'dir rigs pas dpyad nas skyabs 'gro byed pa 'di kun/ phugs kyi brtad so gang la skyabs zhus par 'gro zhes dpyad nas/ 'di las mi 'da' zhes grub mtha' rnam par 'jog pa'i skabs kyi skyabs yul yin min gyi go ba tsam ste/ de 'dra nyams len gyi skabs 'dir mi dgos shing*/ 'dir mos pa'i sgo nas dmigs yul du byed pa nyid gtso che bas/ mdun bzhag gi dkon mchog gsum dkon mchog gsum dngos yin par mos te skyabs su 'gro ba'i phyir/ bem chos dang so so skye bo la skyabs 'gro byas par mi 'gro'o/ /des na grub mtha'i dpyad pa kha thal nas dad pa dang mos gus la gnod pa shin tu mang la/ dmigs pa bsgom pa'i skabs su dpyad pa med par rgya bkyed nas dad pa mkhul che bar byed dgos so/ /de dag kyang ji srid snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ zhes 'byung ba ltar/ sangs rgyas ma thob bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bshad pa ni/ de ltar smos pa'i skyabs gnas de gsum gyi thun mong gi dbang du byas pa yin la/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog ni gtan gyi skyabs yul yin pa'i phyir/ de rang ni byang chub ma thob bar zhes pa'i ngos gzung yang med do/ /des na mthar thug gi skyabs gnas ni/ sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin te/ rgyud bla las/ dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi/ /skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin/

zhes so/ /mthar thug gi chos dang mthar thug gi dge 'dun yang sangs rgyas nyid yin te/ thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ /tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug phyir/ /zhes so/ /yang ji skad du/ mi zad pa'i skyabs/ rtag pa'i skyabs/ g.yung drung gi skyabs/ dam pa'i skyabs ni gcig nyid de/ 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so zhes 'phags pa thogs med kyis gsungs so/ /des na sangs rgyas ma yin pa'i skyabs yul rnams ni/ sangs rgyas thob pa rnams kyi skyabs su mi 'gyur bas/ gnas skabs pa'am re zhig pa'i skyabs yul yin no/ /sangs rgyas dkon mchog ni de dag dang mi 'dra ste/ skyabs su song pa rnams ji srid sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas kyi skyabs 'og dang*/ des grib mas bskyangs pa'i tshul tsam yin la/ nam sangs rgyas thob pa nas 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral zhing*/ skyabs yul nyid la 'dun pa las ches lhag pa'i 'dres pa nyid du gyur nas/ nam du'ang so sor bye ba dang*/ phan tshun spong ba mi srid pa'i phyir/ rtag tu skyabs gnas ma spangs pas gtan gyi skyabs zhes bya'o/ / des na byang chub ma thob bar ngu zer ba 'di/ byang chub thob nas re ltos med ces blun po rnams kyi kha nas rgyu ba la yid brtan ci yang med do/ /re ltos te theg chen 'phags pa su la'ang med de/ stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa la re ba mi 'byung*/ rang stobs kyis sa lam rtsol med du bgrod pa la gzhan la ltos gzhag med pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas thob nas skyabs gzhan dor ba de'ang rang spangs la song ba yin gyi brnyas chos byas nas bor ba ga la yin/ mthar thug gi skyabs la bltos te nam mkha' ma zhig bar ram 'khor ba ma stongs bar ram/ gtan nas gtan du rtag par skyabs su 'gro'o zhes bya yi/ dus mtshams nges pa can gzung du med do/ /gzhan yang rgyas par na/ rgyan dang rgyud bla sogs las drangs te bshad na rung ngo*/

/thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lugs kyis/ spyi khyab kyi dkon mchog gsum dang*/ khyad par gyi yul bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la'ang skyabs su 'gro dgos pas/ skyabs 'dir skyabs 'gro drug skor du mdzad do/ /'o na dkon mchog gsum las gzhan pa'i skyabs mi 'thad do snyam na ma yin te/ yi dam lha tshogs ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi nang tshan yin/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong ye shes pa rnams ni dge 'dun dkon mchog gi nang tshan yin/ 'jig rten pa la ni skyabs su mi 'gro/ bla ma ni dkon mchog gsum ka'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na gsum gyis chog pa la drug gi ci bya snyam na/ gsum du ma 'dus pa min yang*/ dgos pa khyad par can gzhan yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ gsang sngags 'dir dngos su bka' drin thob pa'i yul de'i byin rlabs 'jug dgos pa dang*/ bka' drin dran dgos pa'i phyir bla ma la logs su skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub rnams zhu ba'i yul thun mong ma yin pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang*/ bar chad sel ba dang gnas skabs kyi 'dod don rnams 'grub pa'i 'phrin las 'tshol dgos pa'i phyir/ chos skyong srung ma ste de rnams la gal po che'i tshul gyis sgos su nan chags byed pas skyabs su 'gro ba yin no/ /skyabs 'gro bzhi skor byed pa rnams yi dam chos skyong rtsal du mi 'don pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gzhan 'dra/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa ni/ sdom 'byung las/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rgyud kyi rgyal po dus kyi 'khor lo las/ slob dpon dag ni sangs rgyas nyid de rab mchog sa gzhi dag la chos ni de yis bstan pa'o/ /dge 'dun gang zhig der gnas rab tu dga' ba'i thugs ldan sems can kun la rjes su brtse ba ste/
