/ zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs/ des na sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa rnams/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang yi dam la skyabs gnas gzhan thams cad las rtsal 'don du byed pa nges par dgos shing*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams ni bka' drin dran pa dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i 'khor du smos pa tsam yin/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong ni sgos su bsten zhing sgrub na 'dir yang gal che la/ gzhan dge 'dun la bsdus pas kyang chog pas mtha' gcig tu nges pa yang med do/ /spyir gsang sngags pa'i lugs kyi skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa sgom tshul la dkyil 'khor chen po gcig gi nang du skyabs gnas thams cad bsdu ba dang*/ bla ma gcig pur bsdu ba sogs rnam grangs ma nges pa sna tshogs yod pas dmigs pa'i rim pa la nges pa med/ go babs sngar bshad pa bzhin yin no/ /don tshan gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dgra dang gdon dang nad la sogs pa tshe 'di'i 'jigs pa byung gi dogs pa rnams kyang 'jigs pa de las skyob nus sam sems pa re la 'bad de skyabs 'tshol ba bzhin du/ rang cag rnams 'khor ba'i gnas 'dir tshe 'di phyi bar do thams cad du 'jigs pa'i rnam grangs dpag tu med pa zhig ni 'dug 'jigs pa de rang stobs kyis zlog nus pa'i go skabs ni mi 'dug pas/ de las skyob pa'i skyabs zhig 'tshol dgos par byung*/ de yang 'jig rten 'di'i pha ma la sogs pa'i nye du dang*/ yar gyi dpon/ mar gyi g.yog thad kar rang dang mnyam pa'i grogs po sogs sus kyang skyob pa'i nus pa mi 'dug ji skad du/ bdag ni mal na 'dug bzhin du/ /gnyen bshes kun gyis mtha' bskor kyang*/ /srog 'chad pa yi tshor ba ni/ /bdag nyid gcig pus myong bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i tshul du de dag gis shi ba phan chad mthong thos tsam yang med na/ phan thogs ta ga la yod/ tshe 'dir yang skyob nus pa tsam med/ phan las gnod che ba kho na yin/ der ma zad khyab 'jug dbang phyug la sogs pa lha dbang che bar grags pa rnams dang*/

'khor los bsgyur rgyal la sogs pa mi rdzu 'phrul che ba rnams kyis kyang*/ tshe 'di'i gnod pa cung zad las skyob nus pa srid mod/ mi 'khyobs pa yang ches mang zhing*/ las 'bras kyi blang dor bag tsam bstan nas/ skye ba re gnyis ngan song las skyob pa tsam res 'ga' yod pa ltar yang snang mod/ phal cher blang dor gyi gnas kyang log pas/ gnas skabs su yang ngan song las skyob mi thub/ sgos su 'khor ba las 'dren pa'i nus pa nam yang med de/ de rnams nyid kyang 'khor ba las ma thar 'khor bar 'khyams/ nyon mongs kyis sems dkrugs pas rang dbang ma thob pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis 'di phyi bar do gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad las skyob par nus/ dkon mchog gsum du ma gtogs pa sus kyang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las skyob nus pa med pas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro dgos pa yin no/ /don tshan gsum pa ji ltar skyob pa'i tshul ni/ sangs rgyas la ston pa zhu ste/ blang dor gyi gnas mi shes pa ston mkhan zhu ba dang*/ chos la skyabs dngos te/ sangs rgyas kyis blang dor bstan pa de ka chos yin pas/ chos kyi nang nas 'byung ba bzhin du lag len la btab pas/ 'jigs pa kun las thar bde ba thams cad thob pa'i phyir ro/ /dge 'dun la zla grogs te/ rgyus med kyi lam du 'gro ba la lam sna ba 'tshol ba lta bu yin/ dper na lam sna ba gar song la 'gro dgos pa ltar de rnams gang mdzad byed dgos pa'o/ /de ni 'phags pa rnams mngon sum du mjal ba'i dbang du byas pa yin mod kyang*/ 'phags pa rnams las gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i man ngag dang lag len gyi rgyun yod pa'i so so skye bo'i dge 'dun rnam dag yod na de la yang dmigs brtad du rung ste/ dus deng sang ni 'di gtso che la/ gsang sngags pa'i ni bla ma nyid ston pa dang*/ bla ma nyid lam sna bar byed pa yin no/

/gzhan yang sangs rgyas ni mkhyen brtse nus gsum mtha' yas pa mnga' ba'i phyir/ mkhyen pa'i skyabs su song ba'i sems can thams cad 'jigs pa/ sdug bsngal las nyon rnams las skyob pa'i thabs ma lus pa mkhyen/ brtse bas sems can gyi don la btang snyoms mi mdzad par rtag tu skyob par yang mdzad/ nus pas skal ba dang 'tshams par skyob thub pa'ang yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyis skyabs thub pa yin/ dge 'dun 'phags pa yang rlabs che chung gi khyad tsam ma gtogs/ de dang phyogs mtshungs te/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum khyad par can mnga' bas skyabs su 'os shing skyob par mdzad pa yin/ skyob lugs kyi gtso bo ni/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun dang bcas pas gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos ltar bsgrubs pas rgyu nyon mongs spangs pa na/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang 'jigs pa thams cad las grol 'gro ba'i tshul 'di yin/ skyob lugs kyi rnam grangs gzhan ni 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu spang pa kho na la ma rag ste/ mtshan gzung ba dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis kyang 'jigs pa bcu drug la sogs pa nyer 'tshe thams cad las dngos su skyob par mdzad cing*/ ngan song du skye bar 'gyur ba yang gtan nas zlog pa'am/ thag sring bar byed pa sogs sgo thams cad nas skyob par mdzad do/ /don tshan bzhi pa skyabs su song ba'i tshad ni/ yon tan shes pa/ khyad par shes pa/ khas blangs pa/ skyabs gnas gzhan mi 'tshol ba ste khyad chos bzhi tshang na/ skyabs 'gro rnam dag tu 'gyur ba'o/ /de la yon tan shes pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum po nyid kyi yon tan rags pa rnams shes pa ste/ dkon mchog rjes dran gyi mdo lta bu'am/ rgyan rnam gnyis sogs gzhung rnams las bshad pa ji ltar rigs pa go zhing yid ches pa'o/ khyad par shes pa ni/ spyir sangs rgyas la skyabs su song bas/ gzhan gnyis zhor la 'byung ba sogs gsum po phan tshun nam yang 'bral ba med pa'i phyir/

skyabs gcig kho nas chog pa ltar 'dug kyang*/ ji skad du/ theg pa gsum dang byed gsum la/ /mos pa rnams kyi dbang byas nas/ /skyabs gsum rnam par bzhag pa yin/ zhes pa ltar/ dgos pa la bltos nas gsum du grangs nges byed pa dang*/ gnas skabs gtso che ba'i dbang du byas nas/ skyabs gnas gsum po nyid kyi so so'i khyad par dang*/ dgos pa dang*/ skyob tshul rnams shes pa dang*/ ston pa gzhan las sangs rgyas lhag tshul dang*/ lam log pa las dam pa'i chos ches khyad par du 'phags tshul dang*/ mu stegs byed kyi tshogs pa sogs las dge 'dun ches khyad par du 'phags tshul rnams legs par shes shing yid ches rnyed pa'o/ khas len pa ni/ yon tan shes pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar dam bcas pa'o/ /skyabs gnas gzhan mi 'tshol ba ni/ khyad par shes pa la brten nas/ dkon mchog gsum las gzhan gcig yin na che ba che bar grags pa gang la'ang yid mi brton na/ 'dre bkren sogs la skyabs su 'gro ba lta ga la zhig skyabs gnas gzhan mi 'tshol ba 'di med na/ dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan mthong bas skyabs su khas blangs pa tsam kyis skyabs 'gro rnam dag tu mi 'gyur te/ blo rtse gnyis dang ma bral ba'i phyir ro/ /yon tan shes pa dang*/ khyad par shes pa med na ni/ khas blangs pa dang skyabs gzhan mi 'tshol ba tsam yod du chug kyang*/ blun dad kho nas zhugs pa tsam yin pas lam du 'gyur ba shin tu dka'o/ /des na khyad par bzhi char tshang ba dgos so/ /don tshan lnga pa skyabs su song ba'i phan yon ni/ skyabs su song ma thag rgyud 'gyur ba'i khyad par nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grar chud pa'o/ /sdom pa gsum gyi rten du 'gyur ba ste/ skyabs su ma song ba la cho gas blangs pa'i sdom pa gsum skye ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /sngar byas kyi sdig pa zad pa dang bsod nams chen po dang ldan par 'gyur ba ni/ skyabs su song ba la brten nas phyis sdig sbyong dang dge ba gsar ba sgrub pa sogs dpag tu med par 'phel ba rnams phar bzhag

/skyabs 'gro byas pa nyid kyis sdig pa mang po byang ba dang*/ sbyin sogs phal pa las ches lhag pa'i phan yon yod pa'o/ /bzhi po de skyabs su song ma thag nas 'byung ste/ skyes bu dam pa'i grangs su chud/ sngar rgyud ngan pa yin pa las bzang por gyur pa'i don yin no/ /tshe 'dir 'byung ba'i phan yon ni 'jigs pa bcu drug dang*/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba brgyad sogs phyi nang gi bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa dang*/ bsam pa'i don chos dang mi 'gal ba rnams yid bzhin du 'grub pa gnyis so/ /tshe phyi ma'i 'bras bu ni/ ngan song du mi ltung ba'am skyes kyang myur du thon pa dang*/ mtho ris su yang bde ba thob pa dang*/ der yang dkon mchog gsum skyabs su 'dzin pa ste gsum mo/ /mthar thug gi phan yon ni sangs rgyas myur du thob par 'gyur ba ste/ phan yon rnam pa bcu po de dag ji ltar 'os pa brjod do/ /sgos su theg chen gyi skyabs 'gro la ni/ mdo rgyan las/ skyabs su 'gro ba 'dir song don che ste/ /des ni tshad med yon tan tshogs 'phel 'gyur/ /'gro ba 'di la snying rje'i bsam pas khyab/ /mtshungs med 'phags chen chos kyang rgyas par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar dang*/ theg dman las skyabs te/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas nyid myur du thob par 'gyur ba'i nges pa thob pa yin no/ /don tshan drug pa skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya ni/ skyes bu dam pa la brten pa/ dam pa'i chos nyan pa/ tshul bzhin yid la byed pa/ chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i chos sgrub pa ste bzhi tshan dang po dang*/ dbang po mi rgod pa dang sdom pa ci nus su len pa dang*/ sems can la snying rje che ba dang*/ dkon mchog mchod pa la brtson pa la bslab ces bzhi tshan phyi ma ste brgyad 'phags pa thogs med kyis gsungs pa ltar bshad kyang rung*/ mchog gsum gyi yon tan dran pas rtag tu dad pa sgom zhing gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ bka' drin dran pas rtag tu mchod pa dang*/

snying rje dran pas skye bo gzhan rnams skyabs 'gro la 'god pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro'i phan yon dran pas nyin mtshan dus drug tu skyabs 'gro bsgom pa dang*/ skyabs su ma song ba'am skyabs 'gro btang ba'i nyes dmigs dran pas srog dang bdos kyang skyabs yul mi spong ba dang*/ yid ches dran pas bde sdug mtho dman gnas skabs ci byung yang dkon mchog la mi 'khang zhing gzhan la blo mi gtong pa ste/ don tshan drug gi sgo nas bshad kyang rung la/ yang mdor bsdus na dang po nyid nas nye bar mkho zhing gal che ba'i bslab bya ni/ bla ma dkon mchog la dad pa sgom/ skur 'debs sogs sdig mi gsog /sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan brjod/ phyag 'tshal ba dang bstod pa sogs gus pa'i spyod lam la bslab/ dkon mchog gsum gyi rten la dkon mchog dngos su 'du shes pa'i sgo nas mchod pa ci 'grub byed/ 'khor rnam bzhi la gus pa bskyed/ rten gsum sa rjen la 'jog pa dang*/ 'o brgyal ba'i gnas su 'jog pa dang*/ 'gom yugs gtong ba dang*/ btsongs te sku blud za ba dang*/ gted par 'jog pa sogs rnam pa kun tu spong ba gal che/ yang mdo sde myang 'das las/ gang zhig gsum la skyabs 'gro ba/ /de ni yang dag dge bsnyen te/ /nam du'ang lha gzhan dag la ni/ /skyabs su 'gro ba ma yin no/ /dam pa'i chos la skyabs song bas/ /'tshe zhing gnod pa'i sems dang bral/ /dge 'dun la yang skyabs 'gro ba/ /mu stegs can dang 'grogs pa min/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang grags che ba ltar bslab dgos mod/ 'di'i thog mtha' gnyis po cung zad sla yang bar ba ni shin tu dka' ste 'di la kha dang lag len mthun par byung na ni ngo mtshar che/ don thog tu ma khel na kha bshad chal chol tsam re rang ta kun gyis shes te mdo tsam mi gda'o/ /don tshan bdun pa theg pa che chung gi skyabs 'gro'i khyad par ni/ thun mong pa theg dman pa'i lugs la dus ji srid 'tsho'i bar dang*/

khyad par can theg chen gyi lugs la ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar ro/ /bsam pa'i khyad par yang*/ theg dman ni gtso bor rang nyid 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar 'dod tsam dang theg chen ni sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i phyir ro/ /smon lam gyi khyad par yang*/ so so'i byang chub tu smon lam 'debs pa'o/ /skyabs yul dang*/ cho ga dang byed las sogs la ni rgya che chung gi khyad par tsam yod kyang*/ gong ma'i nang du 'og ma 'dus pa'i phyir 'gal ba ni ma yin no/ khyad par gsang sngags kyi lugs la/ dus kyi khyad par mtha' med pa dang bsam pa'i khyad par sems can rnams myur du skyob par 'dod pa dang*/ smon lam gyi khyad par lam 'jug pa bde bas 'bras bu lhan skyes kyi sku thob par 'dod pa rnams/ lhag por bsnan pas don 'grub pa yin no/ /sems bskyed kyi dmigs pa phog pa'i rjes su/ don cung zad 'chad par spro na gnyis te/ byang chub kyi sems bshad pa dang*/ tshad med bzhi bshad pa'o/ /dang po la don tshan thog ma byang chub sems kyi ngo bo ngos bzung ba ni/ spyir byang chub kyi sems zhes bya ba/ don dam dbyings de bzhin nyid la 'jug pa yang yod/ spros bral mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes la yang 'jug ste/ don dam sems bskyed ces pa'ang de rgyud la skyes pa'i ming yin/ de lta na yang kun rdzob don dam gyi dbye ba ma byas par/ byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes ma skyes dang*/ byang chub kyi sems kyis zin ma zin sogs byang chub sems kyi tha snyad 'jug pa'i gzhi/ grags che ba gtso che shos ni brtse ba snying rje chen po kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems su grags pa 'di yin no/ /theg chen 'dir snying rje dang snying rje chen po'i khyad par cung zad yod de/ snying rje ni gzhan gyi sdug bsngal mi bzod cing 'bral bar 'dod pa tsam yin la de ni tshad med bzhi'i nang gi snying rje yin/

snying rje chen po ni byang chub kyi sems kyi ming ste/ de yang de'i rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rgyu byams snying rje rlabs po che las byung ba/ grogs sems can gyi don gyi khur chen po bdag nyid kyis 'khyer ba'i snying stobs lhag bsam can/ ngo bo gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob 'dod de/ de'i skabs kyi gzhan don du zhes pa ni/ sems can thams cad rdzogs byang la 'god pa'i ched du zhes pa'o/ /don tshan gnyis pa dbye ba ni/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis su dbye ba'am/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems gnyis su dbye ba'o/ /de la smon pa byang sems ni/ gzhan don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod tsam yin la/ 'jug pa byang sems ni sangs rgyas thob pa'i phyir du/ phyin drug dang bsdu dngos sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'phral du sbyor bar 'dod pa'o/ /'di la 'jug pa dang bral ba'i smon pa rkyang pa'ang yod la/ 'jug pa rkyang pa med/ 'jug sems rgyud la yod pa'i gang zag de la/ smon sems kyang yod pas khyab mod/ blo'i spu ris mi gcig go /bdag gzhan mnyam brje gnyis ni/ mnyam pa gtso bo yin la/ brje ba ni de'i gegs sel bogs 'don yin no/ /de la mnyam pa ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad rang bzhin med par yang mnyam/ chos nyid ye shes gcig tu yang mnyam/ sems can gyi don nyid bdag gi 'dod don yin pas 'dod pa'i don yang mnyam/ bdag dang sems can bde ba 'dod par mnyam/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod par mnyam/ bde ba sgrub dgos dang sdug bsngal sel dgos su'ang mnyam/ gal che chung gi dbye ba med pa dang gces mi gces kyi dbye ba med par/ gnyis ka gces par mnyam ste/ de'i phyir bdag sangs rgyas thob nas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la 'god par 'dod pa'o/ /'dir gal che bar mnyam pa ni/ sems can gzhan thams cad phyogs gcig tu byas pa dang*/

bdag gcig pu mnyam pa'i don ma yin/ sems can gang yang rung ba zhig dang bdag nyid mnyam pa na/ sems can ni shin tu mang por gyur na bdag las lhag pa kho na yin no/ /de lta na yang sems can rnams byang chub thob 'dod bdag gis byed pa bzhin du/ bdag kyang byang chub de thob 'dod yin pas/ 'bras bu gcig la sbyor 'dod mnyam pa'i phyir bdag gzhan mnyam pa'o/ /bdag gzhan brje ba ni/ 'khor ba pa rnams bdag nyid bde ba dang bzang bar 'dod pa tsam gzhan su la'ang mi 'byung ste/ 'gro ba gzhan kha cig sdug bsngal bar 'dod/ 'ga' zhig btang snyoms su 'jog nye du sogs nyung zad cig la bde bar 'dod pa srid kyang*/ bdag rang las mi gces shing gal chung ba kho nar sems pa las/ byang chub sems dpa' ni gzhi bdag gzhan gnyis kyi steng du/ gal che chung brjes te/ bdag mi gces shing*/ sems can gang ci yang rung ba gcig kyang bdag las ches shin tu gces par 'dzin pa yin te/ gzhan bde ba'i phyir bdag nyid sdug bsngal la yang 'jug par spro ba dang*/ rang nyid ma grol na sems can zhig thog mar grol bar 'gyur la/ bdag grol ba'i thabs byas na/ sems can de re zhig mi grol ba'i rigs shig 'dug na/ bdag 'khor bar gnas nas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong ba la mi 'dod pa med cing*/ sems can de thog mar grol bar 'dod pas/ de'i thabs la brtson par byed pa'o/ /des gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa la rang don yid byed cung zad 'dre ba srid pas/ bdag gzhan brje ba bsgoms na de dag par 'gyur bas bdag gzhan mnyam pa'i gegs sel ba yin no/ /bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du ma gyur pa la/ 'di yi sa la dor bas mnyam par 'dre ba'i phyir bogs 'byin pa'ang yin no/ /rtsa ba bdag gzhan mnyam pa yin brje ba 'di yan lag yin yang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rmad du byung ba phal cher/ bdag gzhan brje ba 'dis byed cing*/ thabs mkhas kyi khyad par mchog gcig yin pas 'di med du mi rung ba'i gal po che yin te/

rgyal po'i bya ba blon pos byed pa bzhin no/ /don tshan gsum pa sgra don ni don dam de bzhin nyid la byang chub sems zhes zer ba/ de bzhin nyid ni byang chub kyi ngo bo yin la/ sems nyid kyang yin pa'i phyir*/ kyi zhes pa drug pa'i sgra ni gzhi mthun bsdu ba yin no/ /de nyid rtogs pa'i lam gyi ye shes ni/ byang chub kyi rang bzhin dngos su mthong zhing*/ de la dmigs pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir/ de skad ces bya la/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems 'di ni/ byang chub rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la dmigs nas rang gzhan rnams de thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa dang bcas pa'i sems pa yin pa'i phyir byang chub kyi sems zhes bya ste/ 'di kun rdzob byang sems su 'jog /snga ma gnyis po don dam byang sems yin no/ /de lta na yang chos dbyings la don dam byang sems zhes brjod kyi/ sems bskyed kyi tha snyad mi 'jug gzhan gnyis la don dam sems bskyed dang*/ kun rdzob sems bskyed ces 'jog pa'i skabs mang ngo*/ /de yang sems dang sems bskyed kyi khyad par ci snyam na/ ngo bo dang rdzas kyi sgo nas khyad med/ gnas skabs kyi khyad par las ming 'dogs byed pa yin te/ sems bskyed pa zhes pa la 'jog mtshams gnyis las/ gcig ni smon sems mi 'dor bar dam bcas pa dang*/ 'jug sdom cho gas blangs pa la smon pa sems bskyed pa dang*/ 'jug pa sems bskyed pa zhes/ smon 'jug gi byang sems gnyis po de/ tshul khrims kyi ngo bor skyes pas shin tu brtan zhing stobs che la/ yon tan thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa'o/ /des na sems bskyed 'di dam bca' 'am/ cho gas blangs pa'i byang chub kyi sems khyad par dam bca' dang 'brel ba'i byang chub sems kyi ming yin/ 'di'i ltar na sems bskyed yin pa la byang sems yin pas khyab kyang*/ byang sems tsam la sems bskyed kyis ma khyab bo/ /yang sems bskyed kyi 'jog tshul gnyis pa/

byang chub kyi sems rtsol bas rgyud la skyes shing blo la shar ba la byang chub tu sems bskyed pa zer ba ni/ sems de rtsol bas bskyed pa'i phyir sems bskyed de/ 'jog tshul 'di la kun rdzob byang sems yin tshad de'i sems bskyed kyang yin no/ /khrid rim kun tu skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ces pa'i sems bskyed ni phyi ma 'di yin te/ byang chub kyi sems dran par byed pa la zer ro/ /don tshan bzhi pa khrid dmigs kyi sems bskyed gnyis ngos 'dzin pa ni/ skabs 'dir sems bskyed gnyis kyi cho ga dang*/ byang sdom gyi rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad kyis mi lang zhing*/ skabs kyi don ma yin pas mi 'chad do/ /'dir rgyud kyi rgyal po'i ye shes le'u las/ dus kun tu ni byang chub sems kyang 'gro ba dang ni 'gro bar 'dod pa rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur/ /thar par 'jug pas dman zhing smon pa rnam par spangs pa dag ni thams cad dus su bdud kyi sems/ / zhes gsungs te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ zhes bsgom pa ni/ dpe 'gro bar 'dod pa dang mtshungs pa'i don smon pa byang sems yin la/ de'i phyir du zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom par bgyi'o snyam pa ni/ dpe lam du 'gro ba dang mtshungs pa'i don 'jug pa byang sems yin no/ /bdag ma 'ongs pa dus gzhan zhig na sbyin sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya'o snyam pa tsam spyod pa la slob 'dod rgya yan pa yin gyi 'jug sems su mi 'gro la/ 'dir ngo bo ni/ da lta nyid slob 'dod yin zhing*/ sems 'di nyid kyis bskul nas/ byang chub kyi rgyu'i dge ba gcig la 'phral du 'jug pa zhig kyang dgos so/ /des na rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i mchog yin pa'i phyir/ de bsgom par 'dod cing bsam pa de dang 'bral bar lag len la 'phral du sbyor bas sgom yang sgom pa ni 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems mchog tu gyur pa yin la/

spyir 'jug sems dang 'jug sems kyi sdom pa'i khyad par phyed par bya'o/ /slob dpon zhi ba lhas/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdu na/ / rnam pa gnyis su shes par bya/ /byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni/ /byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no/ /'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi/ /bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes bshad pa'ang gong du drangs pa ltar/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs pa'i rjes su 'brangs te bshad pa yin no zhes kho bo smra'o/ /rgyu mtshan 'dis kyang dus 'khor gyi chos ci rigs pa 'phags yul du snga mo nas byon par yang grub bo/ /don tshan lnga pa phan yon ni/ gang zag de theg chen par 'gro mi 'gro byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skyes ma skyes la rag dge ba gang yang rung ba byas pa de sangs rgyas sgrub byed du 'gro mi 'gro yang*/ byang chub kyi sems kyis zin ma zin la rag ste/ de'i phyir byang chub kyi sems skyes ma thag theg pa chen po bar chud ba dang*/ tshul khrims rnam pa gsum sogs bslab pa gsum dang yon tan thams cad kyi rten thob pa dang*/ nam zhig na rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob nges par 'gro bas/ byang chub kyi rtsa ba tshugs pa dang*/ ji skad du/ sdig pa stobs chen shin tu mi bzad pa/ /de ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems min pa/ /dge gzhan gang gis zil gyis gnon par 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ des na dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig chen rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis nges par sreg par byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar sngar byas kyi sdig pa mang po zhig 'bras bu gtan nas 'byin par mi nus pa'i tshul gyis dag par 'gyur la/ kha cig da lta rnam smin thag srings pa'i tshul gyis 'bras bu phyi 'gyangs su gyur pa'i bar der/ gnyen po dge ba gzhan gyis 'joms par byed do/ /de ltar na sems bskyed pa tsam gyis sdig pa'i tshogs dpag tu med par byang bar 'gyur ro/

/dpa' sbyin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang*/ /gal te de la gzugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang ste/ /de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur/ /zhes dngos sam brgyud pa'i sgo nas phan yon tshad med par gsungs shing*/ dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni/ /'bras bu bskyed nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid/ /byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang*/ /'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel par 'gyur/ /zhes bshad pa ltar dge ba zad pa med pa dang*/ sems bskyed kyis ma zin pa'i sbyin sogs dge ba bskal par bsgrubs pa las kyang*/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed tsam nyid kyang phan yon che ste/ sems bskyed pa tsam kho na'i rnam par smin pas kyang*/ brgya byin dang 'khor los bsgyur rgyal gyi go 'phang lan brgya stong 'bum phrag tu 'gyur ba'ang yod/ sems bskyed nyid la brten nas phyis rim gyis 'byung ba'i phan yon ni/ bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyang 'grub na gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos so/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa'i mchog kyang 'di yin te/ mdo las/ gaṅgā'i bye ma grangs snyed kyi/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams mi gang gis/ /rin chen dag gis kun bkang nas/ /'jig rten mgon la phul ba bas/ /gang gis thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed na/ mchod pa 'di ni khyad par 'phags/ /de la mtha' ni ma mchis so/ /zhes gsungs/ zang zing gi mchod pa ci tsam che yang sgrub pa'i mchod pa gcig gis zil gyi gnon pa yin la/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ni/ sgrub pa'i mchod pa rnams kyi nang nas kyang bla na med pa ches mchog yin pa'i phyir dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung rigs rgyun mi 'chad par byas pa'i phyir mchod pa'i mchog go /gzhan yang ngan 'gro las ni bzlog bgyid cing*/ mtho ris lam ni rab ston la/ /rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa'i/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes gsungs pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ 'dis ni tshad med skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bde mchog bde blag nyid du thob par byed/ / srid pa'i sdug bsngal brgya phrag gzhom 'dod cing*/ /sems can mi bde bsal bar 'dod pa dang*/ /bde mang brgya phrag spyod par 'dod pas kyang*/ /byang chub sems nyid rtag tu btang mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin zhing*/ 'jug pa byang chub sems kyi phan yon ni/ sems de bskyed ma thag pa nas/ sems can dpag tu med pa'i sdug bsngal sel/ bde bas tshim par byed/ gti mug la sogs pa nyon mongs thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i sems can gyi don phyogs med ris med la zhugs pa yin te/ gang zhig bde bas 'phongs pa dang*/ /sdug bsngal mang ldan de dag la/ /bde ba kun gyis tshim byed cing*/ /sdug bsngal thams cad gcod byed la/ /gti mug kyang ni sel byed pa/ /de dang dge mtshungs ga la yod/ /de 'dra'i bshes kyang ga la yod/ /bsod nams de 'dra'ang ga la yod/ /phan btags lan lon gang yin pa/ /de yang re zhig bsngags 'os na/ /ma bcol legs par byed pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs/don tshan drug pa spangs pa'i nyes dmigs ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed nyams na/ so so thar pa'i phas pham bzhi phog pa las kyang lci ba lta ci smos/ mtshams med lnga las kyang ches nyes dmigs che bas/ dmyal ba mnar med dam ngan song gi sdug bsngal dos drag la yun ring ba yang nas yang du myong ba dang*/ gzhan yang rang dang gzhan gyi don nyams lugs mang po dang*/ mi 'dod pa dang sdug bsngal mtha' yas pa dag 'byung bar bshad do/ /don tshan bdun pa bslab bya ni/ spyir nyams su blang bya'i chos thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyi bslab byar 'gro ba yin/ khyad par du 'jug sdom la rtsa ba bzhi dang sbom po zhe drug spong ba sogs dang nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las rtsa ltung bcu bzhi gsungs pa spong ba sogs/

'phral gyi 'jug ldog la nye bar mkho ba spang bya ldog pa'i tshul khrims kyi bcas pa rnams dang*/ phar phyin drug dang bsdu dngos sogs blang bya sgrub pa'i bslab par bya ba rnams yin mod kyi/ de dag re zhig 'dir rgyas par mi 'chad/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom phyin chad 'di gal che/ sems can blos spangs pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i sems bskyed pa gnyis kyis sems bskyed gtong ste cho gas blangs pa'i sdom pa yin na 'jig pa lta ci smos/ dam bcas pa tsam gyis sems rgyun yang 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /sems can blos spangs pa ni/ sems can gcig gam mang po yin yang rung*/ gnas skabs re zhig blos spangs skyang*/ phugs blos ma btang na spangs pa dngos su mi 'gyur la/ yul sems can gcig kho na yin yang*/ 'phral phugs thams cad du blos spangs na nyes pa 'dir 'gyur ro/ /mi mthun pa'i sems ni/ log lta skyes pa'am rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob 'dod ldog pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems la phan yon med snyam skur 'debs kyis log par gzung pas byang chub kyi sems spong bar byed dam skur 'debs med kyang byang sdom gyi bslab pa phul ba la sogs pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems can la rtag tu phan 'dogs pa kho na yin pa'i phyir/ de thams cad kyi rtsa ba sems can blos mi spang ba la thugayang dag par theg chen la zhugs pa de gnod byed tshun la bde bar 'dod pa'i bsam pa yod phyin/ gzhan nyes byas grangs med pas kyang byang chub kyi sems rin po che rtsa ba nas gzhom par mi nus so/ /gnas skabs su skye ba thams cad du byang chub kyi sems mi brjed pa'i rgyu/ dkar po'i chos bzhi la bslab/ brjed pa'i rgyu nag po'i chos bzhi spong*/ de yang nag po re'i gnyen por dkar po re 'byung ste/ zung bzhi ya brgyad kyi bslab bya zer/ dkar chos bzhi la bslabs na/ nag po bzhi spong ba de'i khongs su 'dus pas logs na med/

de yang mchod 'os bslu ba nag po'i chos kyi gnyen por/ shes bzhin gyi brdzun mi smra ba dkar po'i chos te zung gcig byang chub sems dpa' la mi bsngags pa brjod pa nag po'i gnyen por/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bstod pa byed pa dkar po'i chos te zung gnyis/ gzhan 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa dge ba byed pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa nag po'i chos kyi gnyen por/ rang gis ci nus ci lcogs kyis sems can 'brel yod thams cad theg pa gsum gyi dge ba la 'god pa dkar po'i chos te zung gsum/ sems can la g.yo sgyus spyod pa nag po'i gnyen por sems can thams cad la lhag pas bsam pas gnas pa dkar po'i chos te zung bzhi'o/ /de la g.yo sgyus gnas pa ni/ g.yo sgyus kun nas blangs pa'i lus ngag gi spyod pa yin la lhag pa'i bsam pa ni/ gzhan gyi don la rang gis 'khur 'khyer ba/ khe dang rgyal kha gzhan la 'bul ba lta bu'am/ yang na phyi nang dang bag 'dzoms ky-is sgrubs pa med par pha bu'am phu nu lta bur gsong por smra zhing nang ma brton pa'i don yang yin gsung ngo*/ / gnyis pa tshad med bzhi bshad pa la/ tshad med bzhi po 'di ni byang chub kyi sems ma skyes pa skye ba'i rgyu dang*/ skyes pa brtan par byed pa dang*/ 'phel bar byed pa'i thabs bla na med pa yin pas/ gang theg pa chen po la rnal 'byor du byed pa de thams cad/ tshad med bzhi'i sgrub pa nyams len la brtson par bya'o/ /de la don tshan dang po tshad med bzhi dang bral ba'i nyes dmigs ni/ / nyon mongs du mas dkrugs par 'gyur te/ gnod sems dang*/ rnam par 'tshe ba dang*/ gzhan bde ba la mi dga' ba dang*/ 'dod pa la 'dun pa'i 'dod chags rnams gnyen po med pas rang gar spyod pa na/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi nyes spyod mang po 'phel ba dang*/ 'dod 'dun dang*/ gnod sems la brten nas nyon mongs gzhan mang po'ang 'phel bar 'gyur bas/ 'di dang phyi ma'i nyes dmigs mtha' med du skyed par byed do/

/de skad du yang mdo rgyan las/ byang chub sems dpa' gnod sems dang*/ /rnam 'tshe mi dga' gnod sems dang*/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags dang ldan pa/ /nyes dmigs rnam pa mang la reg /ces gsungs shing*/ nyes dmigs kyang 'di ltar/ nyon mongs rnams kyis bdag 'joms sems can 'joms shing tshul khrims 'joms/ /nyams bcas rnyed pas dman zhing srung dang de bzhin ston pas smad/ /rtsod bcas mi snyan de ni gzhan du mi khoms rnams su skye/ /thob dang ma thob nyams pas yid la sdug bsngal chen po thob/ /zhes gsungs te nyes dmigs 'di rnams nyon mongs thams cad dang*/ nyes par spyad pa spyi'i nyes dmigs kyang yin mod/ de thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am gtso bo ni 'dod 'dun gnod sems mi dga' ba rnams yin pa'i phyir/ de rnams kyi nyes dmigs su smos so/ /don tshan gnyis pa tshad med sgom pa'i phan yon ni/ de nyid las/ nyes pa 'di kun byams sogs la/ /legs par gnas la mi 'byung ste/ /nyon mongs can min sems can gyi/ /don du 'khor ba yongs mi gtong*/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ byams pas gnod sems kyi gnyen po byed/ snying rjes rnam par 'tshe ba'i gnyen po byed/ dga' bas mi dga' ba'i gnyen po byed/ btang snyoms kyis nye ring dang*/ 'dod pa la 'dun pa dang*/ gnod sems gnyis kar gyi gnyen po byed/ de ltar na tshad med bzhis nyon mongs de rnams spongs par byed de/ de dag spangs pas nyon mongs kyi nyes dmigs de dag phyis mi 'byung ngo*/ /spong tshul bsam gtan gyi nyer bsdogs la brten nas spong pa sogs/ mngon pa las mang du bshad kyang*/ re zhig mi mkho bas bzhag go /byams sogs nyon mongs kyi sa bon spong byed ma yin par bshad pa rnams ni/ 'jig rten pa dang nyan thos kyi dbang du byas te spyi ldog nas bshad pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' dbang rtul thabs la mi mkhas pa'ang de 'drar 'gyur mod/ de dag la ni nyon mongs de rnams mngon 'gyur ba 'gog cing mgo gnon gyi gnyen po tsam yin mod kyang*/

byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas can gyi tshad med bzhi ni/ chos kyi bdag med pa'i rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs rnams kyi sa bon dang bag chags 'joms pa'i gnyen po yang shin tu byed do/ /des na byams pa yin pa'i ldog cha tsam nas sa bon 'joms pa'i gnyen por mi 'gro ba dang*/ byams pa tshad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sa bon 'joms nus pa'i dbye ba phyed dgos pas/ byams sogs rmongs dang 'gal med phyir/ /nyes pa shin tu tshar gcod min/ /zhes pa'i tshig rkyang gi kha skad rags pa sbom yor tsam khyar ba'i 'ol chod la mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod yin par rlom pa ni/ mi mkhas pa'i rnam thar ro/ / yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams khams gsum du skye ba'i nyon mongs spangs kyang*/ smon lam dang ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis 'khor bar skye ba blangs te/ sems can gyi don yongs su mi gtong pa'i spyod pa rmad du byung ba thams cad kyang*/ tshad med pa bzhi'i mthu yin te/ de ltar na nyon mongs nyes dmigs dang bcas pa spong ba dang*/ 'phags mchog rnams sems can gyi don mdzad pa ni/ phan yon gyi gtso bo smos pa yin no/ /gzhan yang tshad med kyi byed las 'bras bu lnga'i sgo nas bshad pa yang phan yon nyid de/ ji skad du/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa'i gnas pa yi/ /blo ldan rtag tu 'dod par skye/ /des ni tshogs rnams rdzogs byed cing*/ /sems can rnams yongs smin par byed/ /kun tu tshangs dang mi 'bral la/ /de yi mi mthun phyogs dang 'bral/ /bag med gyur kyang de yi rkyen/ /mi zad pas kyang mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /phan yon ci rigs pa 'og tu'ang 'chad do/ /don tshan gsum pa ngo bo ni/ sems can rnams sngar med kyi bde ba gsar pa dang phrad par 'dod pa ni byams pa dang*/ da ltar yod pa'i sdug bsngal dang 'bral zhing phyin chad kyang sdug bsngal 'byung pa'i sgo 'gog par 'dod pa ni snying rje dang*/ sems can gzhan rnams da ltar bde ba la dmigs nas dga' zhing yi rang bas drangs pa'i yid bde ni dga' ba dang*/

de gsum gyi drangs pa'i zhe sdang med pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i ma chags pa'i sems kyi khyad par ni/ btang snyoms yin par bshad de/ de ltar na btang snyoms nyid dge ba'i sems sogs pa rkang tshugs shig yin te/ ma chags pa dang mi sdang ba'i rgyu las byung ba nye ring med par sems snyoms pa yin la/ byams sogs dang po gsum la rjes su chags pa'i cha shas 'dre ba srid la de ni nyon mongs yin pas skyon rjes su 'brangs pa ste/ btang snyoms kyis skyon de sel ba'i phyir btang snyoms la ma chags pa dang*/ nyon mongs med pa dang ma 'dres pa'i mtshan nyid can zhes gsungs so/ /snying rje ni gzhan bde ba la bar chad sel ba'i rnam pa can dang*/ byams pa dang dga' ba gnyis sems can bde ba 'dod pa dngos yin pas/ de gsum char bde ba'i bsam pa tsam yin la/ btang snyoms ni/ zhe sdang med pa'i phyogs nas bde ba bsam pa'i mtshan nyid kyang yod la/ bdag nyid ma chags shing sems can rnams ma chags mi sdang ba la 'god pa'i bsam pa nyid kyi phyir phan pa'i bsam pa nyid yin pas/ btang snyoms ni phan bde gnyis car gyi bsam pa'o/ /byams sogs bzhi'i ngo bo ni de ltar yin la/ tshad med par 'gyur ba la yul sems can dpag tu med pa la dmigs shing*/ rnam pa bde ba dpag tu med pa la 'god pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa 'bral bar 'dod pa sogs dang*/

(<<dzaṃ>>+ yul sems can dpag med kyi bde ba dpag med la dmigs nas dga' zhing yid rangs pas drangs pa'i yid bde dang ) ngo bo dgra gnyen bar ma'i bye brag med pa thams cad mnyam snyoms par bde ba 'dod pa sogs dgos so/ /de ltar na byams pa tshad med sogs kyi mtshan nyid de 'dra yin la/ dmigs rnam de 'dra dang ldan pa'i sgo nas sems rtse gcig par gnas pa ni tshad med bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /tshad med 'di rnams mos pa yid byed tsam yin yang*/ dge ba bla na med pa yin te sems can thams cad la phan par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /don tshan bzhi pa dbye ba ni/ brtan pa rnams kyi de dag bde 'dod dang*// sdug bsngal gyi nyam thag dang bde ba dang*/ /nyon mongs can dang de dag bstan bcos dang*/ /de yi de bzhin nyid la rab tu 'jug /zhes gsungs te/ tshad med bzhi po re re yang sems can la dmigs pa dang*/ chos la dmigs pa dang*/ dmigs pa med pa gsum gsum du dbye'o/ /nyon mongs can dang zhes pa yan chad sems can la dmigs pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ bdag dang sems can dang gang zag tu 'dzin pa ched du bkag pa ma yin par/ sems can rnams bde bar 'dod pa nas/ sems can chags sdang gi nyon mongs can rnams nyon mongs med pa la 'god par 'dod pa'i bar/ sems can la dmigs pa'i byams sogs bzhi ste/ 'di la kha cig sems can bden par 'dzin pa dgos par 'dod pa ni mi 'thad do/ /da lta sems can du snang ba rnams kyi shul na sems can rjes su med par/ phung khams skye mched tsam zhig ste phung sogs kyi tshogs pa la sems can du btags pa tsam du shes nas/ dmigs yul phung sogs la dmigs te/ gang zag btags yod tsam du chos sde snod las gsungs pa yid ches pa'i rgyu mtshan dmigs brtad du byas nas/ phung sogs kyi rgyun la bde ba dang*/ nyon mongs med pa'i bar du 'god pa'i bsam pa ni chos la dmigs pa'o/ /'dir yang chos la dmigs par 'jog pa la/

phung sogs chos su bden par 'dzin pa dgos so zer ba'ang 'khrul te/ gang zag bden med kyi rnam par ma shar ba tsam dang*/ gang zag bden yod du 'dzin pa gnyis khyad che zhing*/ phung sogs chos stong nyid kyi rnam pa can du ma shar ba tsam dang*/ chos bden dngos su 'dzin pa gnyis kyang shin tu mi 'dra ba'i khyad mi phyed ba'i smra ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang snying rje gsum kar yon tan yar ldan gyi tshul gyis 'phags mchog rnams la'ang yod par/ rgyud sde mchog nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ gang zag dang chos su zhen pa'i mtshan nyid can du mi 'thad do/ /yang so so skye bo rnams sems can dang chos su zhen pa ma spangs pa yin mod/ 'phags pa'i gang zag rnams kyi rgyud la de dang der zhen pa med kyang*/ de'i rgyud kyi shes pa yin tshad de dang de bden med du rtogs pa'i rnam pa can du 'char dgos pa ma yin no/ /yang chos phung sogs la dmigs pa dang*/ chos sde snod la dmigs pa gnyis chos la dmigs pa'i 'jog mtshams so sor 'dod pa yang gzhung don go ba ma yin no/ /des na bstan bcos dang bcas pas chos la dmigs pa bstan/ sems can dang phung sogs chos rang bzhin gyis stong par mthong nas/ sems can dang chos su snang ba tsam gyis 'khrul pa rnams de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings su zad par bzhed pa tsam ni/ dmigs pa med pa'i byams sogs tshad med bzhi yin no/ /de yang dmigs med byams sogs bzhi po rim pas yang dag pa'i mtha' rtogs pa dang*/ 'khrul pa zad pa dang*/ mtha' la gnas pa dang*/ 'phel zad gnyis bral gyi dgongs pa sems can rnams la shar ba'o/ /tshad med 'di dag bsam gtan la brten dgos par 'dod pa/ nyan thos bye brag smra ba'i rnam rtog yin/ mdo sde pa yan chad 'dod khams na'ang yod par 'dod pa ltar/ 'di yang smra mod/ spyir byang chub sems dpa' thabs mkhas kyi khyad par la/ tshad gzung mi nus pa nyid bsam par bya ba yin no/

/don tshan lnga pa theg chen lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i tshad med bzhi thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ ji skad du rgyan las/ brtan pa'i tshangs pa mi mthun spangs/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes ldan/ /dmigs pa rnam pa gsum la 'jug/sems can rnams ni yongs smin byed/ /ces gsungs te/ mi mthun phyogs gnod sems la sogs pa spangs pa dang*/ 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i lta bas zin pa dang*/ sems can dang chos dang de bzhin nyid de dmigs pa'i yul rnam pa gsum la 'jug pa dang*/ bde 'dod dang sdug bsngal spong 'dod tsam gyi bsam pa kho na la mi 'jog par/ sems can mang po yongs su smin par byed pa'i las can te khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'o/ /'dir rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis zin pas/ dmigs pa gsum la 'jug pa gzhi gcig la 'du bar bshad pa yang go dgos te/ des na sems can dang chos la dmigs pa yang stong nyid kyis zin pa yod do/ /da ni 'phros don gal che la nye bar mkho ba cung zad bshad na/ gzhan yang rin chen phreng ba las/ /rdzi'u btsos gsum brgya'i kha zas dag /nyin re dus su sbyin pa bas/ /byams pa yud tsam thengs gcig gi /bsod nams dag ni char mi phod/ /lha mi byams par 'gyur ba dang*/ /de dag kyang ni srung ba dang*/ /yid bde ba dang bde mang dang*/ /dug dang mtshon gyi gnod med dang*/ /'thab pa med par don 'thob dang*/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten skye 'gyur te/ /gal te grol bar ma gyur kyang*/ /byams chos yon tan brgyad thob bo/ / zhes byams pa'i phan yon brgyad bshad pa ni/ snying rje sogs gzhan gsum po'i yang phan yon yin zhing*/ de bzhin du bshes spring las/ byams dang snying rje bdag dang dga' ba dang*/ /btang snyoms rtag tu yang dag goms mdzod cig /gong ma brnyes par ma gyur de lta na'ang*/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ tshad med bzhi rab tu goms par byas pas/

tshangs pa'i 'jig rten bsam gtan dang por skye ba yang yang gsungs shing*/ de nyid kyi phyir tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi zhes gsung rab kun tu grags so/ /'dir mtha' cung zad dpyad na/ byams sogs sgoms pa tsam gyis 'dod pa la chags bral mi nus pas/ tshangs par skye ba mi 'thad gzhung rnams las der skye bar gsungs pa ni/ bsam gtan dang po'i nye bsdogs zhi rags kyi rnam pa can gyis 'dod pa la chags bral byas pa'i 'og tu nyer bsdogs nyid la brten pa'am bsam gtan dngos gzhi bsgrubs te de la brten nas tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa'i 'bras bu tshangs par skye ba'o snyam na/ de 'dra gzhung gi dgongs pa ma yin te/ tshad med bzhi med kyang nyer bsdogs rdzogs par thob la ma nyams pa yod na tshangs par skye nges pa'i phyir/ tshad med bzhi smos pa don med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /des na 'dod yon ma spangs bsam gtan dang po'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la ma skyes par tshangs gnas su skye ba min yang*/ 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin la brten nas tshad med bzhi bsgoms pas/ 'dod nyon srabs te/ tshad med bzhi po nyid nyer bsdogs su 'gyur te de las dngos gzhi skye la/ 'bras bu rgyu'i rjes su 'jug pa nyid kyi phyir/ dngos gzhi yang tshad med dang mtshungs par ldan pa kho na 'byung ngo*/ /byams sogs gsum gyis khong khro dang/ btang snyoms kyis 'dod pa'i 'dod chags spangs pas gtso bo bcom pa na 'khor bros pa ltar 'dod nyon gzhan rnams shugs la spangs te/ 'dod pa la chags bral du 'gyur ba yin pas/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyis chags bral byed phyi na zhi rags kyi rnam pa can kho na bsgom dgos kyi gzhan med do snyam du sems pa ni/ phyogs gcig las gzhan ma rtogs mi mthong ba'o/ /des na/ gang gi 'phags dang lha dang tshangs pa yi/ /gnas pa dpe med rgya chen rtag tu gnas/ /zhes 'phags pa'i gnas pa/ lha'i gnas pa/ tshangs pa'i gnas pa/ zhes rnam grangs mi 'dra ba gsum du gsungs pa'ang*/

lha'i gnas pa la ma brten pa'i tshangs pa'i gnas pa zhig yod pa'i dbang gis yin te/ gzhan du na lha'i gnas pa las tshangs pa'i gnas pa gzhan du med par thal bas/ gsum gyi rnam gzhag nyams par 'gyur ro/ /dais na mngon pa las zhi rags kyi dmigs rnam can gtso bor bshad kyang*/ der khyab mtha' 'cha' ba min la/ mdo sde rnams las tshad med bzhi gtso bor gsungs te/ sems sbyong ba la gal che bar dgongs te/ dgos don 'grub pa mnyam po la/ zhi rags las 'di bsod nams rgya che ba'i phyir ro/ /'khrid kyi skabs su mtha' dpyod 'di rigs 'chad mi dgos kyang*/ 'di na mdzod gzhung sogs la phran tshegs sbyangs par rlom pa rnams/ ches khyad par du 'phags pa nges don theg pa chen po'i lugs srol la nor ba'o snyam log par rtog pa 'byung srid pas/ de dag gi blo mun bsal ba'i phyir snga phyir cung zad tsam brjod do/ /de ltar tshad med bzhi'i nang nas kyang*/ ches gtso bor gyur pa ni snying rje ste/ snying rje yod na pha rol tu phyin pa drug 'byung la/ snying rje med na byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnams mi 'byung ngo*/ /dang po'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rgyan las/ bkren la brtse dang ma rungs pa la brtse/ /kun 'khrugs la brtse bag med rnams la brtse/ /yul gyi gzhan dbang can la snying rje dang*/ /log par mngon par zhen la snying rje'o/ /zhes bkren zhing 'phongs pa la snying rje yod na nges par sbyin pa gtong ba sogs rang pha rol tu phyin pa drug la 'jug pa dang*/ gzhan phar phyin la 'jug pa thams cad 'byung ngo*/ /phyi ma'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ rgyan las/ snying rje dang ni bzod dang sems pa dang*/ /smon lam skye ba sems can yongs smin byed/ /dang po rtsa ba tha ma 'bras mchog ldan/ /'di ni snying rje'i ljong shing chen po yin/ /rtsa ba snying rje med gyur na/ /dka' spyod bzod pa nyid mi 'gyur/ /blo ldan sdug bsngal mi bzod na/

/ sems can don sems nyid mi 'gyur/ /sems pa dang ni bral ba'i blo/ /skye ba dkar po rnam dag tu/ /smon lam 'debs par mi 'gyur ro/ /skye ba bzang po ma thob na/ /sems can yongs smin byed mi 'gyur/ /snying rje'i 'chu ba byams pa ste/ /de sdug bsngal ni bde ba yi/ /sangs rgyas tshul bzhin yid byed pas/ / yal ga bde chen 'phel ba dang*/ /smon lam rgyun ni ma chad pas/ /lo ma 'dor len rkyen rnam gnyis/ /grub pa de phyir me tog dang*/ /'bras bu don yod shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ byams pa la sogs pa ni snying rje 'phel bar byed pa'i rgyu yin la/ snying rje yod na sems can gyi don du dka' spyad bzod par nus/ bzod pa de yod na sems can thams cad kyi don bdag nyid kyis khur du khyer ba'i gzhan don sems pa khyad par can 'byung*/ des gzhan don gyi smon lam khyad par can btab pa ni/ bsam bzhin du srid pa len pa'i skye ba khyad par can 'byung ste/ de las 'gro ba'i don mtha' yas par spyod do/ /rgyu de rnams kyis tshogs gnyis rdzogs sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba yin na/ gal te snying rje spangs par gyur na/ de dag thams cad mi 'byung bas/ byang chub 'dod pa rnams kyis snying rje la nan tan du bsgrub par bya'o/ /yi ge brgya pa'i 'khrid dmigs phog tshar mtshams sdig bshags la sogs pa'i go don cung zad brjod na/ spyir shes ldan rnams kyis blang dor du byed dgos pa'i las ni/ dge sdig gnyis su nges pa'o/ /de yang las ni/ rgyu'i dus su chung yang 'bras bu'i dus su 'phel che ba dang*/ dkar nag gi 'bras bu bde sdug so sor nges pa dang*/ rang gis ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad pa dang*/ byas pa rnams gnyen pos bcom na ma gtogs chud mi 'dza' ba ste/ khyad chos bzhi po rnams kyi don go bde bar bshad/ khyad par du sdig pa mi dge ba'i las la ngo bo ngos bzung ba ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/

/des {bskyed }:bskyang las ni mi dge ba/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ zhe sdang gi rigs su gyur tshad dang*/ 'dod pa la 'dun pa'i 'dod chags dang*/ las 'bras la rmongs pa'i gti mug gis dngos su kun nas bslangs pa'i las thams cad sdig pa mi dge ba'i las yin no/ /de la las kyi ngo bo dngos ni/ sems pa yin zhing*/ de dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i shes pa 'du byed du gyur pa gzhan rnams kyang*/ lus ngag gi bya ba dang ma 'brel na/ yid kyi las sam sems pa'i las su 'gyur/ sbyor ba lus ngag tu thon thub pa'i nus pa can/ 'du byed sems pa de nyid kyis bskul ba'i lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur dang 'brel ba de ni/ bsam pa'i las sam lus ngag gi las yin no/ /lus ngag gi las thams cad la yid las/ sngon du 'gro ba yin pas/ yid kyi las rkyang pa dang lus ngag gi las zhes dbye'o/ /de la skabs 'dir srog gcod sogs mi dge ba bcu rags rim tsam bshad cing*/ ji skad du/ de las che long bsdus nas ni/ dge dang mi dge ci rigs pa/ las kyi lam ni bcu gsungs so/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar/ skye bo phal cher la 'byung nye ba'i sdig pa'i las rags rim ni mi dge ba bcur 'dus la/ gzhan la brnyes pa dang log 'tsho la sogs pa/ spyir gzhan yang sdig pa mi dge ba'i las kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas mod kyi/ de dag rnams rnam smin ngan song gsum gyi skye ba 'phen pa ste/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ chags pa'i yi dwags 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhe sdang gis ni dmyal bar 'phen/ / rmongs pas phal cher dud 'gror 'gro /zhes gsungs pa ltar ram sdig pa cher spyad pa dmyal ba dang*/ 'bring du spyad pas yi dwags dang*/ chung ngur spyad pas dud 'gror 'phen pa shas che/ de dag tu skyes pas sdug bsngal ngos drag la yun ring ba dpag tu med/ rgyu mthun ba'i 'bras bu ni/ lha mir skyes pa'i tshe sngar gyi las kyi 'bras bu'i lhag ma/ tshe thung ba dang*/

nad mang ba sogs sdug bsngal dang gnod pa dpag tu med pa 'byung*/ bdag po'i 'bras bu yang*/ phyi rol yul phyogs la lo nyes dang dus log sogs sdug bsngal gyi rkyen ci snyed cig 'byung ba yin no/ /rnam par dkar ba dge ba'i las la ni/ sdig las kyi 'bras bu de dag phyin ci log pa'i bde ba dang*/ gzhan yang phun sum tshogs pa ji snyed pa 'byung ngo*/ /de skad du/ zhi ba lhas kyang*/ dge ba'i chos rnams thams cad kyi/ / rtsa ba mos par thub pas gsungs/ /de yi rtsa ba rtag tu ni/ /rnam smin 'bras bu sgoms pas so/ /sdug bsngal yid mi bde ba dang*/ /'jigs pa rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ /'dod pa rnams dang bral ba ni/ /sdig pa spyod las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /yid la bsam pa'i dge byas pas/ /gang dang gang du 'gro 'gyur ba/ / de dang der ni bsod nams des/ /'bras bu'i yon gyis mngon mchod 'gyur/ / sdig pa byed pa bde 'dod kyang*/ /gang dang gang du 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de dang der ni sdig pa des/ /sdug bsngal mtshon gyis rnam par 'joms/ /rgya che dri bzang bsil pa'i padmo'i snying por gnas/ /rgyal ba'i gsung snyan zas kyis gzi brjid bskyed byas la/ /thub 'od kyis rgyas padma las byung lus mchog can/ / rgyal pa'i mdun gnas bde gshegs sras su dge bas 'gyur/ /gshin rje'i skyes bus pags pa ma lus bshus pas shin tu nyam thag cing*/ /rab tu tsha ba'i me yis bzhus pa'i zangs zhun lus la blugs gyur la/ /'bar pa'i ral gri mdung thung gis bsnun sha yi dum bu brgyar lhag shing*/ /shin tu 'bar ba'i lcags kyi sa gzhir lhung ba mi dge mang pos 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /skabs 'dir mi dge ba bcu'i rang bzhin dang*/ de dag gi rnam smin ngan song gi sdug bsngal ci rigs pa dang*/ rgyu mthun pa dang bdag 'bras kyi dbye ba rnams ji ltar 'tsham pa bshad/ 'khor ba la skyo ba skyed cing*/ mi dge ba'i las la blo ldog tu gzhug go

/skabs 'dir thun mtshams kun tu sdig bshags gal che/ de la bshags bya'i nyes pa ni/ mtshams med lnga/ nye ba lnga/ mi dge ba bcu/ sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba'i nyes ltung rnams gtso bor smos pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba'i las rang gis bgyis pa dang*/ gzhan byed du bcug pa dang*/ byas pa la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ sdig las byas pa la bstod pa brjod pa sogs mdor na nag po phyogs mthun dang bcas pa thams cad bshags par bya ba yin te sbyong bar byed pa'i mthol bshags zhes bya ba la/ nyes pa byas pa gsangs shing sbas na/ sdig pa'i sa bon btab pa la g.yo rgyu'i chu drangs pa lta bu yin pas/ sdig pa je 'phel du 'gyur/ ma sbas shing skyon du shes pa'i sgo nas bsgrags na/ bden pas mtha' bsdoms pa yin pas/ cung zad stobs chung du 'gro ba dang*/ nam yang 'phel bar mi 'gyur des na bdag gis nyes pa 'di lta bu bgyis so zhes bshags pa'i yul gtso bor gyur pa'i tshogs su sgrog pa ni mthol ba yin la/ bdag gis 'di ltar bgyis pa ni shin tu nyes shing blun zhes 'gyod pa drag pos sems gdung ba dang bcas te las de skyon du khas len pa ni bshags pa ste/ rang nyid nyes pa dang bcas pas zhum zhing dma' ba'i gnas su zhugs/ gzhan nyes pa de dang mi ldan pa rnams mngon par mtho zhing*/ mchog dang ngo mtshar can du shes pas gus pas gtsug tu 'khur ba'i blos kun nas blangs te/ nyes spyod bgyis pa la ngo tsha yang*/ gsong por smra ba'i sgo nas khyed rnams kyis brtse bas rjes su gzung du gsol/ las 'di dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes snying thag pa nas brjod pa ni bshags pa'i don gyi snying po'o/ /de lta bu'i mthol bshags de yang khyad chos stobs bzhi tshang ba zhig dgos te/ chos bzhi bstan pa'i mdo las/ byams pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos bzhi dang ldan na sdig pa byas shing bsags pa zil gyis gnon par 'gyur ro/

/bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ rnam par sun 'byin pa kun tu spyod pa dang*/ gnyen po kun tu spyod pa dang*/ nyes pa las ldog pa'i stobs dang*/ rten gyi stobs so/ /zhes gsungs/ de la mthol bshags dngos kyi skabs su sngar byas kyi sdig pa la/ dug 'thung ba lta bu'i 'gyod sems drag po sun 'byin pa'i stobs dang*/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi bgyid pa'i sdom sems drag po slar ldog pa'i stobs rnams dgos so/ /skabs der 'gyod sems dang sdom sems gnyis ka med mi rung du dgos par mnyam yang*/ ldog sems med na ni 'gyod sems kyang rnam dag ma yin pas/ bshags pa kha tsam tshig tsam du 'gro ba shes che bas/ phyin chad sdom sems kho na gal che'o/ /rten gyi stobs ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa ste/ sngar skyabs 'gro ma blangs na/ skyabs 'gro blang bar bya la/ skyabs 'gro ma blangs bar bshags pa lan brgya stong phul ba bas/ skyabs 'gro blangs pa'i bshags pa lan 'ga' zung phul ba yang sdig pa byang stobs che bas/ sngar skyabs 'gro blangs zin pa yin na skabs der skyabs 'gro gsar pa len mi dgos kyang*/ yang yang gsal btab pas/ blangs pa dang 'dra ba'i don 'grub cing*/ yang sngar skyabs 'gro cho gas blangs pa ye med kyang*/ skabs der skyabs 'gro snying nas dran par byas na yang snga ma dang rjes su mthun pa'i sdig pa 'dag stobs 'byung ngo*/ /de bzhin du sems bskyed pa la'ang rigs 'gre mod/ spyir sems bskyed cho gas blangs phyin/ skyabs 'gro'ang sngon du 'gro bas khyab ste/ rten gyi stobs sems bskyed blangs pa yin na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnyis kar tshang ba yin la/ skyabs 'gro blangs shing sems bskyed med par/ bshags pa lan 'bum phrag byas pa las kyang*/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas bshags pa 'ga' zung byas pa yang sdig pa 'dag stobs che'o/ /sems bskyed cho gas blangs pa med na nam dgos pa'i tshe/

byang chub kyi sems dran par byas pa rnams la skyabs 'gro gsal thebs par ma nges pas/ cho gas ma blangs pa'i dad pa tsam gyi skyabs 'gro dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dran pa tsam rten du byas na/ skyabs 'gro rkyang pa rten chung ngu dang*/ sems bskyed rkyang pa rten chen po dang*/ gnyis kar 'dzom na rab tu gyur pa zhes bya'o/ /cho gas blangs pa ni/ skyabs 'gro yod pa tsam la sems bskyed yod par ma nges kyang*/ sems bskyed yod phyin skyabs 'gro med pa mi srid pas/ mu gsum ma gtogs bzhi'i dbye ba mi rung ngo*/ /cho gas sdom pa len pa'i rigs la/ skyabs sems gnyis rten gyi stobs su bshad pa ni/ khyim pa dang rab byung thun mong gi dbang du mdzad pa yin la/ gzhan sdom pa'i khyad par gang blangs kyang rten gyi stobs su 'gyur bas/ skabs 'dir dbang bskur zhus te dam tshig gsar du len pa'am gso bar byed pa nyid gnad du che'o/ /de'i phyir skyabs sems thob cing dbang bskur ma thob pas lo mang por sdig pa bshags pa bas/ dbang bskur thob pas bshags pa nyin gcig byas pa yang sdig pa 'dag tshab che'o/ /yang rten gyi stobs zhes bya ba bshags pa 'bul ba'i yul la ngos 'dzin pa'ang yod de/ bshags yul ji tsam bzang ba de tsam sdig pa 'dag stobs che bar nges pas/ de ltar yang rung ba'i phyir/ rten gyi stobs la dbye na/ rang rgyud kyi rten dang bshags yul gyi rten gnyis su dbye bar bya'o/ /gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs ni/ spyir dge ba byas pa thams cad sdig pa'i gnyen por 'gyur ba yin mod kyi/ skabs 'dir gang zhig sdig pa'i las byas pa de dang de'i gnyen por/ ched du dmigs nas sgrubs pa'i dge ba rnams la/ gnyen po kun tu spyod pa zhes bya/ de yang sdig sbyong la dmigs nas dge ba gang bsgrubs kyang der 'gyur ba yin mod/ gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i sgo drug ces grags pa ni 'grub sla zhing phan yon che ba 'ga' zhig nye bar mkho bas bsdus pa'o/

/de la dang po mtshan bzung ba la brten pa ni/ mdo rnams las sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' mang po zhig la 'di'i mtshan bzung ba tsam gyis las sgrib byang bar 'gyur zhes dmigs bsal gsungs pa rnams/ rang nyid brjod cing gzhan la'ang sgrog pa ste/ mtshan de yang brjen par mi bzung che ba 'dogs dang bcas pas bzung bar bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa lta bu'o/ /mdo rgyan las/ sangs rgyas mtshan mi grags par sangs rgyas mtshan/ /yang dag sgrags pas de dag khams gzhan 'gyed/ ces pa ltar phan yon che ste/ bod las gzhan pa chos dar ba'i yul gzhan rnams na srol ka yang shin tu dar ro/ /gnyis pa sku gzugs bzhengs pa yang*/ spyir sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa thams cad yin yang*/ sdig sbyong la dmigs bsal du gsungs pa rnams gtso che ste/ sku gzugs kho nar ma zad sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten nam/ bka'i glegs bam bzhengs pa rnams kyang ngo*/ /gsum pa mchod pa la brten pa ni/ rten gsum mchod pa dang*/ dge 'dun mchod pa dang*/ maṇḍal mchod pa dang*/ gsang sngags la zhugs pas ni/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa dang*/ 'khor lo'i mchod pa dang*/ mchod pa thams cad kyi mchog bla ma mnyes par byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa mdo sde zab mo la brten pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' mnyam po la khyad cher med kyang*/ gtso bor sdig sbyong la bsngags par gsungs pa'i mdo rgyud zab mo klog pa dang*/ kha ton byed pa la sogs pa'o/ /lnga pa bzlas pa la brten pa ni ched du bsngags par gsungs pa'i gzungs sngags zab mo rnams bzla ba ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa la sogs pa'o/ /drug pa stong pa nyid la mos pa ni bdag med pa dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i don bsgom zhing*/ gal te sgom par mi nus na yang*/

mos pa yang yang bskyed pa ste/ khyad par du sdig pa'i las nyid dang*/ byed pa po gang zag dang*/ sdig pa'i sa bon 'dzin pa'i rnam shes dang*/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal dang bcas pa thams cad bden med sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun pa dang mos pa sbyong ba'ang yin no/ /de ltar na stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags par byed pa la/ dang por sun 'byin pa 'gyod pa drag po gal che na/ las 'bras la yid ches brtan po yod pa zhig yin na shugs la 'gyod pa skye yang*/ deng sang phal cher la de med pa'i phyir/ gzhan gyi tshig phyir 'brangs pa'i g.yam la rgyugs tsam las/ 'gyod sems shugs drag mi yong bas/ rgyu mtshan bsam gyin 'gyod pa bskyed dgos so/ /de yang sdig pa byas pas tshe 'dir skye bo thams cad kyis smod/ skye bo ngan pa'i gral chud/ lha dang srung ma rnams khrel/ 'byung po rnams kyis glags blta/ byur chags mang po 'phral du ldang*/ gnyen tshan dang grogs dang 'khor g.yog sogs rang dang 'brel can thams cad la grib mas non pa sogs bkra mi shis/ rang yang ma nong bkur bas blo mi bde/ rmi lam thams cad kyang mi 'tshams pa kho na rmi/ ya rabs blo ldan thams cad khrel bar 'gyur/ 'chi khar nad dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs ldang*/ sems la 'gyod pa du ma 'byung*/ 'chi ba rang gi tshe 'jigs pa dang gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal gzhan pas che/ shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ dus gzhan zhig na las gzhan gyis mtho ris su skyes kyang*/ las kyi lhag ma'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa 'byung*/ sdig pa byas pas bag chags ngan pa sos thebs te/ skye ba gzhan du yang nyon mongs shugs drag cing*/ sdig pa la dga' bar 'gyur bas/ sdug bsngal rgyun mi 'chad du 'phel bar 'gyur/ bdag 'di lta bu'i bya ba ma yin pa byed pa shin tu rang glen zhing gti mug pa ang*/ 'byung pos zin nam ci/ smyo ba yin nam ci/ las 'di la khye bogs ye mi 'dug pa la de tsam du dga' ba skye ba ang*/

nyes dmigs 'di tsam cig 'dug pa la/ sna cig kyang ma dran/ ma shes pa/ skyob pa'i lha zhig kyang med dam/ sha tsha ba'i gros 'debs pa cig kyang med pa a/ a tsam las ngan 'di lta bu byas zin pa aṃ snyam du 'dun pa drag po sbyangs/ de ltar sdig pa nyes dmigs che yang gal po che'i don gzhan sgrub dgos mang po yod pas/ mi byed ka med pa yin snyam na/ de yang shin tu blun te/ sdig pa byed pa ni/ yang na rang gi lus srog 'tsho ba'i phyir yin/ yang na nor dang longs spyod kyi phyir yin/ yang na kha drag dang gtam grags pa'i phyir yin/ yang na dgra 'dul ba'i phyir yin/ yang na gnyen skyong ba'i phyir yin na/ kha drag pa ni gzhan la gnod pa tsam yin/ gtam ni brag cha dang 'dra/ dgra gnyen ni 'phral 'phral 'gyur zhing 'jig nor rdzas longs spyod ni/ phugs lta ci smos/ yad yud re yang rtag mi thub/ lus srog kyang nas 'jig cha med cing 'dor bas/ dgos don med pa'i bya ba de dag gi phyir du/ rtag tu sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa'i las ngan kham po che 'di lta bu gsog tu ga la rung snyam du bsgom/ dpa' byin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ pha ma spun zla bu dang chung ma dang*/ /bran dang nor dang rtsa lag tshogs rnams kyang*/ /shi ba'i rjes phyir de dag 'gro ba med/ /las rnams rjes su 'brang zhing de dag 'gro/ /shin tu sdug bsngal gyur pa de dus su/ /bu dang chung ma skyabs su 'gyur ma yin/ /bdag nyid gcig pus sdug bsngal myong bar 'ong*/ /de dag de tshe bdag gi skal mi len/ /zhes gsungs/ gang gi don du bsams bsams te 'bad pa du mas sdig pa byas pa'i dgra gnyen nor rdzas sogs de dag ni/ rang ngan song du 'khyams phan 'dogs dgos pa'i dus su/ tho phyir yang sleb mi 'ong*/ sdig pa byas pa'i 'bras bu ni/ rang kho nas myong dgos pas sdig pa byas pa de bdag rang gcig pu la sdug gyong kho na yin snyam du'ang bsams/

de ltar sdig pa byas pa de don med ma legs pa chen po zhig byung 'dug kyang*/ da bcos thabs med snyam na ma yin te/ mdo las/ gang zhig sdig pa'i las byas pa/ /dge bas 'gebs par byed pa ste/ / sprin bral nyi ma zla ba ltar/ /'jig rten 'di na kun tu gsal/ /zhes gsungs te/ phyin chad sdig pa spangs pa'i sgo nas/ bsam pa dag pas dge ba la 'bad na/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis mun pa bsal ba ltar/ sdig pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ stobs bzhi la 'bad dgos so/ /'o na sbyong thabs yod pa'i phyir/ rim pas go le sbyangs pas chog snyam na ma yin/ tshe thung zhing tshe la nges pa med pas 'phral du sbyong thabs la 'bad dgos/ ji skad du/ bdag ni sdig pa ma byang bar/ /sngon du 'gum par 'gyur du 'chi/ /ji ltar 'di las nges thar par// myur ba'i tshul gyis bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /skabs 'dir/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba yi ge brgya pa'i 'khrid ces pa'i sdig sgrib ni/ dngos gzhi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi nyams myong 'phral du skye ba la bar du gcod pa'i sdig sgrib rags pa 'ga' zhig yin la/ de yang sdig sgrib nyes ltung zhes pa ltar/ tshe 'dir bsags pa'i sdig pa rnams dus nye bas nyams myong skye ba la sgrib tshabs che/ sdig pa gzhan pas kyang sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba'i nyes ltung sgrib tshabs che/ khyad par du dam tshig 'gal 'khrul dang*/ dkor sku glud zos pa sogs lhag par nyams myong skye ba la gegs che bas/ de rnams sbyong ba la rdor sems yig brgya'i sgom bzlas dang bcas pa 'di bsngags/ spyir sgrib sbyong gi yi ge brgya pa la/ rtsa ba nas mi 'dra ba gnyis yod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa'o/ /dang po ni dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rgyud las 'byung*/ gnyis pa la lha so so'i mtshan sngags spos na/ rgyud sde rab 'byams nas 'byung ba'i 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha ji tsam pa de tsam gyi yig brgya mtha' yas par 'gyur la/

de yang sngags rigs gcig pas yig brgya zhes smos kyi/ yi ge'i grangs brgyar ma nges te/ lha'i mtshan ring thung gi dbang gis sna tshogs par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu'i 'gres sbyar ba ma yin par rtsa ba'i dbye ba ni gnyis te/ rdor sems zhi ba'i yi ge brgya pa dang*/ rdor sems khro bo he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa'o/ /dang po ni deng sang rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya par grags pa 'di yin la/ de la'ang yo ga dang mthun par 'khor los bsgyur ba byang chub sems dpa'i tshul gyis dpa' bo gcig pa bsgom pa dang*/ gsang sngags nang pa'i lugs de bzhin gshegs pa kha sbyor lhan skyes su byed pa gnyis yod de sngags ni 'dra'o/ /he ru ka'i yig brgya 'di ni/ sngags kyi rnam pa phal cher snga ma dang 'dra yang*/ 'gres sbyar ba ma yin te/ dpal mngon brjod bla ma'i rgyud las gsal bar gsungs so/ /skabs 'di'i lha rdo rje sems dpa' la gzhan lugs pa kha cig dus 'khor gyi rang lugs yin par rlom nas sngon po zhal gsum phyag drug par byed pa'ang byung ste/ de ni gsar du blos bcos pa'i rang bzo kho nar zad do/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ lha de dus 'khor las gsungs kyang*/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba la gzhan las lhag pa'i phyir du yang ma gsungs la/ de'i sngags kyang yi ge brgya pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yig brgya 'di yang sgrib sbyongs dang*/ nyams chags bskang ba dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa'i sngags yin gyi/ rdor sems yin tshad kyi sngags su mi 'gyur ba'i phyir/ lha de lta bu bsgoms nas sngags yig brgya bzla ba ni/ rdor sems kyi ldog par gcig pa tsam la bsams par 'dug kyang*/ dper na/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rnam snang zhal gsum phyag drug pa bsgoms nas/ sngags ngan song sbyong rgyud las byung ba'i durga bzlas pa lta bur 'gyur ba'i phyir mi 'thad do/ /'bro lugs kyi bla ma gong ma 'ga' res/ yab rdor sems zhi ba dkar po la yum dmar mos 'khyud pa/

sngags zhi ba'i yig brgya bzla ba sogs mdzad 'dug pa spyir mi legs pa ma yin mod/ kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas dol po pa man chad kyi phyag bzhes la/ rdor sems he ru ka spyi dang mthun par mdzad pa nyid khungs bzang zhing ches legs pa yin no/ / de'i rgyu mtshan yang spyir sbyor drug rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin pas dus 'khor kho na'i bskyed rim dang sbrel dgos pa'i nye tshe ba min la/ ci ste bskyed rim dus 'khor kho na dang sbrel du chug kyang*/ yan lag phra mo dmigs bsal med pa rnams la/ gzhan dang mi mthun pa'i khyad chos yod mi dgos te/ dper na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bzhin no/ /des na dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel las/ yig brgya'i man ngag logs pa ma gsungs shing da lta'i 'di rgyud kyi gsungs pa mngon brjod bla ma yin yang*/ bla med kyi gsang ba spyi la 'jug pa yin pas skabs 'dir sbyor ba shin tu legs so/ /dpal dus 'khor nyid kyi dbang du byas na yang*/ dus 'khor sna tshogs gtso bo 'di lha rigs rdo rje sems dpa' dang mi bskyod pa zung du 'jug pa las rdor sems gtso che ba tsam yin mod kyang*/ sku'i rnam 'gyur khro nyams can du yod pa'i phyir/ he ru ka'i cha shas su yang 'gyur ba dang*/ dus 'khor rdo rje 'jigs byed ni he ru ka dngos kyang yin pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir yang rdor sems zhi ba las he ru ka'i lugs su byas na 'brel chags shing*/ dus kyi 'khor lo dang 'khor lo sdom pa lha rigs mtshungs pa dang*/ rdo rje bzhi dang rigs drug ston par mtshungs pa sogs/ phan tshun kha 'gengs byed na 'brel chags che ba'i rgyu mtshan mang du yod mod/ rgyas par ma smos so/ /skabs 'di'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs ni/ bdag bskyed kyi tshul ma yin/ mdun bskyed kyi rigs su gtogs te/ rang las gzhan pa'i tshul gyis lha sgrub pa la/ phal cher du mdun bskyed kyi tha snyad 'jog pa'i phyir ro/

/spyi bor bsgom pa ni/ rigs bdag gam rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pa'i don dang*/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis sdig sgrib bkru ba sogs la dmigs pa gsal ba'i phyir ro/ / 'di la yang cho ga rgyas par na gdan pad zla ba sa bon dang*/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa 'od zer spro bsdu dang bcas pa las dam tshig pa bskyed/ rdo rje bzhi'am rigs drug byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa spyan drangs mchod/ dgug gzhug bya/ dbang lha spyan drangs mchod de rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab/ slar yang mchod bstod byed pa'o/ /cung zad rgyas pa ni/ dbu rgyan rang chas bsgoms nas/ dbang bskur gyi skor rnams bor ba yin/ dkyus su bshad pa ni 'bring po'am bsdus pa yin te/ thog ma nyid nas sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsgoms pas/ dam ye dbyer med yin pa'i phyir ye shes dgug gzhug mi dgos la/ rang rigs mtshon byed rdor sems kyi dbu rgyan tsam byas kyang rung mod/ ngo bo nyid kyi rigs la rgyas btab med pas dbang bskur lta ci smos rigs bdag kyang nges bzung du mi dgos rdo rje bzhi'i sa bon dgod pa yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rdo rje bzhi 'dus pa mtshon byed tsam yin gyi byin rlabs kho na'i don ma yin no/ /shin tu bsdu na rdor sems yab yum gdan dang bcas pa skad cig gis bskyed pa kho na stai/ spyir skyed chog rgyas bsdus bzhi po gang ltar byas kyang rung ngo*/ /'dir rdo rje bzhi'i sa bon dus 'khor nyid la gtso bor grags pa yin mod/ mngon brjod bla ma las kyang lte bar ye shes rdo rje 'god par bshad do/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi spyan 'dren pa 'di ni/ ye shes spyan 'dren gyi rigs ma yin/ 'og tu sdig sgrib bkru ba'i dmigs pa dgos pa la/ de'i don du byin brlabs bsdu ba yin no/ /yig brgya bzla ba'i skabs/ sngags don dang mthun par gsol ba 'debs pa yin yang*/

bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis bkru ba'i dmigs pa 'di yang dmigs pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo nas sdig sgrib sbyong ba la bsngags pa lta ci smos/ 'phral du'ang nad gdon sogs phan yon phra mo kha thag nye ba yang du ma yod do/ /yab kyi thugs kar sa bon sngags 'phreng dang*/ de las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis yab kyi sku gang*/ rdo rje'i lam nas padmar brgyud de yum gyi sku yang gang*/ yab yum gnyis kar gyi sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi 'bab par bsgom pa yang yod/ dmigs pa de'i steng du/ yum gyi thugs kar yang sa bon sngags 'phreng bsgoms nas/ de las kyang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te/ yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gnyis kar gyi sku las bdud rtsi 'bebs pa yang yod/ sku'i sbyor mtshams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bebs pa yang yod/ yab rkyang ba'i sku las 'babs pa'ang yod de/ skabs 'dir de dag 'dam kha tsam spyir yin yang*/ dkyus su bshad pa nyid lag len gyi rgyun yin/ lar rdor sems yab rkyang sems dpa'i skyil krung can la zhabs kyi mthe bong nas 'bebs pa sogs yod pas gcig tu nges pa med de/ rang rang gi man ngag las 'byung ba bzhin du dpyad pa med par bzung ngo*/ /bdag ni mi shes sogs tshigs bcad dang tshig lhug pa'i bshags pa ste/ sgom thengs 'di la stobs bzhi yang tshang ste/ rten gyi stobs las bshags yul ni ches mchog tu gyur pa bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags tshogs thams cad yin la/ rang rgyud kyi rten skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gsal 'debs pa ni/ thun gyi 'gor yang byed cing*/ sngags don bsam pa dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad ces sogs la'ang tshang*/ gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs ni lha bsgom sngags bzlas nyid yin/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /zhes pa mthol ba dang*/ bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig

/ces pa bshags pa yin te/ 'thol bshags de gnyis la/ sun 'byin pa dang*/ slar ldog pa gnyis tshang ste/ dam tshig 'gal nyams zhes pas ltung ba'i nyes dmigs dran pa dang*/ mi shes rmongs zhes pas sngar byas la 'gyod pa dngos bstan la/ de byung tsa na da ni nyes dmigs shes pas slar ldog ces pa'ang shugs la 'byung*/ skyobs mdzod cig zhes pa'ang da phyin chad mi bgyid pas rjes su gzung du gsol zhes par 'gro bas/ slar ldog pa'i stobs so/ /gsol 'debs gong ma 'phrin las 'chol ba'i tshul yin/ phyi ma bshags pa dang 'brel bas bzod gsol yin no/ /jo bo rje a ti sha'i gsung gis/ gsang sngags kyi nyes ltung phra mo 'di rtag tu 'byung nye/ dper na sa phyogs rdul chen po gcig tu maṇḍal phyis te bzhag na/ de ma thag rdul gyis thib thib 'gengs pa dang 'dra gsung pa la/ 'o na lam rgyud la skye ba'i dus tsam mi yong ngam zhus pas/ 'on kyang gsang sngags thabs la mkhas pa mang bas/ nyes ltung phra mo shin tu mang po yang*/ thabs sna res skad cig gis dag par 'gyur gsung nas rdor sems dang yig brgya'i sgom bzlas zab cing rgyas pa zhig gnang bar gda'/ 'di la brtson par byas na nyes ltung phra mo dang 'bring po rnams rtsa ba nas 'dag chen po rnams kyang mi 'phel zhing*/ mgo mnan te rim gyis byang bar 'gyur gsung*/ de sngon bod na gsang sngags pa so so la yig brgya'i gdams ngag mang du yod kyang*/ rang rang gi slob ma nyung shas re ma gtogs spyi la ma khyab/ jo bo'i gsung des rkyen byas nas/ sngags par gtogs so cog gsar rnying thams cad la chos 'di'i 'ur langs pa yin skad do/ /maṇḍal 'bul ba'i skabs su maṇḍal 'bul tshul gyis lag len dang ngag 'don rnams byang ba'i rjes su/ go babs cung zad brjod dgos te/ go ba rags rim tsam med na dmigs pa bsgom mi shes pa'i phyir ro/ /de la chos 'di rgyud thams cad kyi thun mong pa yin zhing*/

'dus pa la sogs pa bsdus rgyud shas che ba zhig la/ 'jig rten khams kyi rnam gzhag logs pa med pas/ rnal 'byor rgyud man chad mngon pa'i lugs ji bzhin byed/ bla med mang rab cig la me'i dkyil 'khor lhag por 'dod/ spyi rags pa mngon pa dang 'dra/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs nas 'jig rten khams kyi rnam gzhag logs su rgyas par gsungs pa med kyang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa dang*/ las tshogs kyi zhor la tshig zur gsungs pa rnams dus 'khor dang mthun no/ /des na 'jig rten khams mngon pa'i lugs dang 'dra bar bsgoms kyang*/ 'gal ba med mod kyi/ gtso bo bla ma rnams kyi phyag len gyi rgyun dang*/ smin grol rgyud bshad brgyud pa gcig pa'i 'brel chags dang*/ gsung rab thams cad kyi mthar thug theg pa mtho ba'i dbang las/ dus 'khor gyi lugs su bsgom pa nyid gtso bor bya'o/ /des na maṇḍal gyi gzhi rten du/ rlung me chu'i dkyil 'khor rnams bsgom nus na'ang legs/ ma bsgoms kyang mi 'gal te/ maṇḍal gyi sa gzhi la chu me rlung gi bgros med par dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi zhes pa kho na 'don pa'i phyir ro/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi char bsgom pa la'ang*/ zlum po phyed gshags kyi rnam pa byed pa/ dus 'khor rang lugs yin pas gtso che yang*/ dmigs pa'i skabs rnam pa gsal ba'i ched du/ mchod rten bang rim zlum po bzhi pa lta bu sgoms kyang mi 'gal te/ 'dir rgyas par ma spros/ des na sa'i dkyil 'khor gser gyi rang bzhin zlum po thad kar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig de'i dbus su ri rab dpangs su dpag tshad 'bum/ rtsa ba'i rgya la ri'i snying po dpag tshad bcu drug dang*/ 'gram stegs khor yug la zheng dang dpangs su stong phrag gcig pa yin pas/ de'i rgya la thad kar brtsis na stong phrag bco brgyad yod/ ri rab ni mtshams de nas steng du cung zad je sbom du song zhing*/

dpangs su dpag tshad 'bum yod pa las/ phyed gong ma dpag tshad lnga bcu'i steng nas/ gdengs kha phyi la 'phyar ba/ rwa rnams skye ba'i gzhi snying po'i phyogs su srab 'thug la stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga pa dbyibs zlum po phyir 'phags pa'i rtse khor yug je srab tu song ba'i dbus nas thad kar gzhal na dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcu pa/ de'i steng du dpag tshad stong phrag nyer lnga'i dpangs gyen du 'phags pa'i ri'i rtse mo lnga dbus dang phyogs bzhi yod pa/ dper na rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa 'dra zer yang*/ me long gi steng du bshos bu lnga bzhag pa lta bu'o/ /ri rab de'i rtsa ba nas rwa'i rtse mo'i bar gyi kha dog ni/ shar ind+ra nī la te kha dog sngon po/ lho padma rā ga ste dmar po/ byang zla ba chu shel te dkar po/ /nub karka ta na stai ser po/ dbus marka ta ste ljang khur gsal btab/ dmigs pa gsal zhing go nus na ri rab de la gling drug mtsho drug ri drug gis bskor ba sgom dgos pas/ de dag gi rnam gzhag 'chad dgos la/ blo 'khobs chung na re zhig de'i dmigs pa dor te yod par mos pa tsam bya/ gser gyi sa gzhi de la/ padma 'dab ma bcu gnyis lta bur mtshams bcad pa'i re kha gyen du 'phags pa/ dngos gnas la ri yin zhing*/ rnam pa gyang gis bcad pa 'dra ba zhig yod pa/ de lta bu'i sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yang chus khyab pa las/ dbus su gyen du 'phags pa'i gling rnams ni/ rgyud las/ sa'i steng du dpag tshad stong phrag rnams ni ri dang klu dang gza' dang phyogs rnams dag tu 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shar lus 'phags po dbyibs zla gam rgyar dpag tshad stong phrag bdun/ bcad kha nang du bstan pa/ lho 'dzam bu gling gru gsum rtse mo phyir bstan rgyar stong phrag brgyad/ byang sgra mi snyan dbyibs zlum po rgyar stong phrag dgu/ nub ba glang spyod rgyar stong phrag bcu dbyibs gru bzhi'o/ /lus dang lus 'phags la sogs pa'i gling phran rnams la rgya tshad nges can ma gsungs kyang*/

dmigs pas bsgoms pa'i tshe/ rang rang gi gling dbus ma las cung zad chung ba re bsgom dbyibs dbus ma dang 'dra/ 'dir sa'i khor yug dum bu bcu gnyis la so so'i dbus su ri bo ltar steng du 'phags pa'i mtshan ma zla gam la sogs par gsungs pa yod pa stai/ /da lta mi rnams spyod pa'i gling bcu gnyis yin la/ gling bcu gnyis zhes mi gsung bar dum bu bcu gnyis zhes gsungs pa'i skabs mang ba ni/ mtshan ma bcu gnyis po ma yin pa'i gling phran gzhan du ma yod pa yang 'du dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ de dag thams cad sdom pa gling chen po bdun gyi nang tshan gyi 'dzam gling chen po zhes bya ba'i gling gcig tu go dgos pa'i phyir yin te/ shar lus 'phags po dang 'dzam gling chung ngur grags pa'i lho 'dzam bu gling dang byang sgra mi snyan sogs ni gling bdun pa 'dzam gling chen po'i nang sel yin gyi/ re re nas gling rang rkang tshugs pa ma yin pa la dgongs so/ /gling rnams la dngos po la kha dog nges pa can med kyang rang rang gi 'byung ba'i khams mtshon pa'i phyir/ shar gling gsum rlung ste nag po/ lho'i gsum me ste dmar po/ /byang gi gsum chu ste dkar po/ nub kyi gsum sa ste ser por sgom/ phyi lcags ri ni 'dir rdo rje'i ri zhes gsungs te/ sa'i khor yug gi mtha' la skor ba yin/ sngar 'og gzhi la chu me rlung gsum ma sgom na/ skabs 'dir yang de tshun chad ka gsal btab pas chog chu me rlung gi khor yug sgom mi dgos so/ /'dir cung zad rgyas par sgom na ri mtsho gling gi rnam gzhag ni 'di lta bu zhig ste/ rgyud las/ lan tshwa chang dang chu dang 'o ma zho dang mar dang sbrang rtsi'i rgya mtsho bdun te ri bo ni/ /'od sngon mandha ra ri ni ṣa ṭa dang nor bu'i 'od dang dro ṇa bsil ri rdo rje'o/ /gling ni zla ba 'od dkar dag dang rab mchog ku sha dang ni mi'am ci dang khrung khrung dang*/ /drag po yang ni longs spyod sa ste bdun pa 'dzam bu mi rnams gnas pa dag ni las kyi sa/

/shar du rlung ni shin tu zlum por 'gyur te mi yi bdag po lho ru me ni gru gsum mo/ /byang du chu ni phyed kyi zla ba dag dang nub ni gser mchog sa ni chu yi gter gyi zur/ /zhes pa dang*/ chu gter drug po thams cad dag kyang zla ba zla ba gcig gis dman pa'i stong phrag re re ste/ /gling rnams dang ni ri rgyud mchog rnams dag kyang de lta'i stong phrag stong phrag nyi shu rtsa lnga ni/ /'dzam bu gling gi yangs pa dag dang lan tshwa'i chu yi gter ni 'bum phrag phyed kyi tshad yin te/ /zhes gsungs te dbus kyi lhun po'i rtsa ba 'gram stegs zlum po de'i 'khor yug tu dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcu nga bzhi/ dbus kyi thad kar gzhal na stong phrag bco brgyad pa de'i 'og gzhi ri rab kyi 'gram stegs la 'brel ba'i tshul gyi khor yug tu bskor ba'i sa gzhi/ zheng du dpag tshad brgyad brgya dgu bcu pa zhig yod pa ni zla ba'i gling zhes bya/ gling de'i phyi khor yug la 'obs kyi tshul gyis bskor ba/ kha zheng dpag tshad brgyad brgya dgu bcu pa ni/ sbrang rtsi'i rgya mtsho zhes bya/ de'i phyi rol khor yug tu lcags ri zlum pos bskor ba lta bur/ 'od sngon zhes bya ba'i ris bskor ba ste/ ri de'i sa mtshams kyi rtsa ba'i zheng srab 'thug la yang*/ dpag tshad brgyad brgya dgu bcu'o/ /des rigs 'gre ste/ ri de'i rtsa ba dang 'brel bar 'od dkar gyi gling gi khor yug tu bskor ba dang*/ de'i phyi la mar gyi rgya mtshos khor yug tu bskor ba dang*/ de'i phyi nas mandha ra zhes bya ba'i ris bskor ba sogs go bar bya ste/ ku sha'i gling dang*/ zho'i rgya mtsho dang*/ ri bo ni ṣa ṭa dang*/ mi'am ci'i gling dang*/ 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dang*/ ri nor bu'i 'od dang*/ khrung khrung gi gling dang*/ chu'i rgya mtsho dang*/ ri bo dro ṇa zhes bya ba dang*/ drag po'i gling dang*/ chang gi mtsho dang*/ bsil ba'i ri'am/

kha ba'i ri ste de ltar na/ ri rab ma gtogs pa'i ri drugagling drug mtsho drug ste bco brgyad de dag ni zheng du dpag tshad brgyad brgya dgu bcu rer mnyam la/ dpangs kyi tshad gsal bar gsungs pa med/ bsil ri'i phyi rol ri'i rtsa ba dang 'brel bar/ 'dzam gling chen pos khor yug tu bskor ba yin zhing/ 'on kyang gling chung bcu gnyis sogs gling chung mang po yod pa rnams ma gtogs/ bar lan tshwa'i rgya mtsho'i chu lag gis khyab pa yin/ 'on kyang sa dum bu bcu gnyis po re re la/ nang mtha'i rgya la dpag tshad khri nyis stong lnga brgya dang*/ phyi mtha'i zheng la nyi khri lnga stong re yod do/ /de phan chad lan tshwa'i rgya mtsho chu'i khor yug ni/ zheng dpag tshad 'bum phrag phyed kyi tshad can no/ /bar gyi ri mtsho gling drug po ni/ yongs su bsdoms pa la phyogs rer dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug re'i zheng yod/ de dag ri rab kyi gdengs ka'i 'og tu chud pa/ gdengs ka'i mtha' dang*/ bsil ba'i ri'i phyi logs steng 'og tu thad kar 'bab pa tsam bya'o/ /de la spyir maṇḍal gyi cho ga rgyas pa rnams la sa bon dang sngags sogs mang du 'byung yang*/ nyin re bzhin lan re tsam ma gtogs maṇḍal gyi 'khrid kyi skabs maṇḍal brgya stong mang po bsnyen pa'i tshul du byed pa la/ de lta bu mi 'grub pas/ deng sang maṇḍal tshig tsam gyis 'bul ba 'di la thams cad phyag len mdzad/ de la tshom bu so bdun dang nyer lnga dang*/ nyer gsum ma dang bdun ma sogs rnam grangs mang po 'dug kyang*/ tshom bu mang nyung dang de dang mthun pa'i ngag gi brjod tshul mang nyung tsam ma gtogs/ skad cig gis bskyed pa'i phyir cho ga bsdus pa yin par 'dra zhing*/ tshom bu lhag po rnams dmigs pa gsal bar byed pa'i khyad tsam ma gtogs/ dmigs yul rgya che chung yang 'dra'o/ /de ltar na yang dpal ldan gsang 'dus las/ zhing 'di rin chen sna bdun gyis/ /mkhas pa dag gis yongs bkang nas/

/dngos grub 'dod pas sby-in pa'i phyir/ /nyin re shes rab can gyis 'bul/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lag len gyi dbang du byas nas rgyal srid rin po chen sna bdun/ dbang sngon sogs rin po che bdun gyi gter te/ brgyad po de sa bon las skyed cing sngags kyis 'bul bar maṇḍal gyi cho ga chen mo rnams las kyang bshad 'dug gang ltar yang skabs 'dir spros pa la dga' na thun gyi 'go 'jug gnyis su/ tshom bu so bdun ma lta bu tshig cung zad rgyas pa yang 'ga' shas 'bul na ni legs/ nges par dgos pa rang yang min/ dkyus ma grangs su bcad pa rnams gzhan kun la grags pa'i tshom bu bdun ma'i steng du/ sgra gcan dus me bsnan pa'i tshom bu dgu pa nyid la mdzad/ de la maṇḍal gyi cho ga rgyas pa ma lcogs phyin/ maṇḍal rgyu rin po che las grub pa yin na chung yang mi to/ rdza dang shing sogs rgyu ngan na/ rgya che ba dgos zhes gsung rgyun las 'byung*/ de yang 'byor pa dang bstun pa'i dbang du byas/ ye ma 'byor na g.yam leb sogs kyis kyang rung gsung*/ tshom bu'i 'bru ni 'byor ldan yin na/ bskyar ldab mi byed par tshar re re bzhin gyis 'bru de zur du spungs nas/ tshom bu'i 'bru gsar ba 'ba' zhig 'bul/ de ltar rim pas bsags pa'i maṇḍal gyi mchod 'bru rnams bla ma dkon mchog la 'bul gyis rang gis longs mi spyod/ 'byor pa med na gcig po de bskyar gyin 'bul ba las 'os med/ dri bzang gi chus kyang byug ste 'byor pa dang bstun rgyu gang 'byor yin/ sngon bod 'dir bka' gdams pa'i maṇḍal skam po dang*/ sngags pa'i maṇḍal rlon pa zhes grags shing*/ mdo sngags kyi khyad yin tshul byed kyang*/ mdo sngags la skam rlon la khyad med/ brgyud pa so so'i phyag len gyis khyad cig yin par 'dug /'dir ni maṇḍal legs par phyis pa sems kyi rang bzhin dri ma med pa dang*/ dri bzang gi chus byugs pa sems la byang chub kyi sems kyi rlan gyis khyab pa mtshon/

maṇḍal gyi gzhi gser gyi sa gzhi dang*/ dri bzang rgya mtshor yang bsgom mo/ /oṃ badzra re khe zhes pa'i skabs su/ gser gyi sa gzhi'i mtha' la rdo rje'i ri'am lcags ris bskor ba bsgom/ de rjes dbus su hūṃ zhes pa maṇḍal gyi bgegs bsal ba yin gyi/ sa bon hūṃ las ri rab bskyed pa ma yin/ 'dir bsdus pa yin skad cig gis bskyed pa yin pas sa bon mi dgos/ sa bon rang byed na haṃ las ri rab bskyed pa yin gyi hūṃ ma yin no/ /de'i tshe na ya las lus 'phags sogs tshom bu thams cad la sa bon byed do/ /'dir de ltar min/ dbus su ri rab kyi tshom bu bkod pa na/ dmigs pas gsal thebs shing spros pa la mos pas ri rab kyi rjes 'brangs sgom na mngon pa sogs kyi lugs ltar na/ gser gyi ri dang*/ rol mtsho rnams sam/ dus 'khor rang lugs ltar na gling drug /mtsho drug ri drug rnams kyang sgom/ de rnams mi shes pa dang*/ mi gsal ba dang*/ sgom par mi spro na ri rab kho nas chog go /tshom bu dgu ma'i dbang du byas na/ shar lus 'phags po zhes brjod pa dang shar du tshom bu gcig kho na 'god kyang*/ dmigs pas shar gyi gling gsum ga bsgom dgos/ des gzhan gsum la'ang rigs 'gre/ de rnams kyi nang du tshom bu chung ba re re 'god/ dmigs pas ni gling gi nang du mi byed/ gling rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la zla nyi sgra dus bzhi 'god par bsam pa ni/ lhor nyi ma dang byang du zla ba spyi dang mthun/ shar du sgra gcan kha dog mthing nag nub tu dus me kha dog ser po/ de gnyis kar yang dwangs shing 'tsher la 'od zer 'phro ba/ /dbyibs zlum po'o/ /bzhi po de grub pa dang mnyam du gza' skar gyi tshogs mtha' dag kyang bsgom/ skor phyogs kyi rim pa g.yas skor du byas kyang chog mod kyi/ gtso cher rlung me chu sa'i dbye bas shar lho byang nub ces pa'i rim pa'o/ /dbus su lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa zhes pa'i skabs/
