'jig rten gyi khams stai mchod rdzas 'dod pa'i yon tan nyer spyod rim gro pa sogs dgos 'dod thams cad kyis byur bur bkang ste 'bul bar mos pa ni nges par byed dgos la/ dmigs pa rgya che zhing gsal na 'jig rten gyi khams mang po zhig 'dod dgus bkang ste phul bar bsgoms nas/ nam mkhas gar khyab mchod pas bkang ste phul yod snyam pa'i mos pa tsam byed/ dmigs pa rgya chung na dngos su zhing khams gcig po de kha dmigs nas mkha' khyab tu phul snyam pa bya/ maṇḍal tshigs bcad ma/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum zhes sogs 'di bod du 'gyur ba'i rgyud na med kyang spyir rgyud tshig yin/ slob dpon tsā ri ta dang*/ rnyog med dpal gyi maṇḍal gyi cho ga sogs na yod/ bdag gi zhes pa bdag gzhan dang*/ thub pa'i skyes mchog ces pa bla ma yi dam zhes par 'don par spos/ tshig rkang snyoms pa'i phyir bzang po zhes pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bcug pa yin/ 'di thun mong ma yin pa'i lag len yin pa'i phyir gal che/ sa gzhi spos kyi sogs spyi 'gro de mi spro na ma byas kyang chog go /de ltar maṇḍal 'bul ba 'di snga ma la kha gso tsam mi byed par/ re re bzhin tshom bu snga ma bsal nas rting ma 'god/ dri chab kyang skam ras kyis byug ste rlon thag ma chad par 'byug pa sogs bla chos ma byas par sgrub pas lus kyi las dang*/ tshig dag nas brjod pa ngag gi las dang*/ re re bzhin dmigs pa dang bcas te 'bul ba'i bsam pa yid kyi las te/ sgo gsum gyi dge ba khyad par can cha tshang ba dang*/ dngos po chung yang dmigs pa dang bsam pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ dge ba'i rnam grangs mtha' yas pa yod pas/ dka' tshegs chung ngus tshogs rgya chen po gsog thub pa'i thabs mkhas khyad par can du snang zhing*/ maṇḍal gyi mdo las/ ba lci chur bcas sbyin pa ste/ /byi dor byas pa tshul khrims yin/ /srog chags bsal ba bzod pa ste/ /brtson 'grus bya ba byed la brtson/

/bsam gtan der sems skad cig ma/ /ri mo legs 'bar shes rab bo/ /pha rol phyin pa drug rnams kyi/ /thub pa'i maṇḍal legs byas pa'i/ /'dir ni lus kyi las byas na/ kha dog gser ltar 'gyur ba dang*/ /nad rnams kun las rnam par grol/ /lha dang mi las ches lhag cing*/ /zla ba lta bur gzi brjid ldan/ /nor dang gser ni phun sum tshogs/ /rgyal po'i rigs dang sangs rgyas pa/ /mchog gi khy-im du skye ba nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ dkon mchog gi drung du maṇḍal cha tshang gcig byas pa la/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug kar gyi cha shas tshang bas/ ji skad du/ longs spyod dang lus phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /'khor rtsom phun sum tshogs pa mngon mtho dang*/ /rtag tu nyon mongs dbang nyid mi 'gro dang*/ /bya ba rnams la phyin ci ma log pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi phan yon rnams kyang thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ gnas skabs su rigs phun sum tshogs pa skye/ gzugs mdzes nad med longs spyod che/ lhar skyes na lha gzhan las lhag pa dang*/ mir skyes na mi gzhan las lhag par 'gyur/ zla ba dang 'dra'i gzi brjid can zhes pa la/ gzi brjid che ba'i don stobs dang dbang thang dang shugs che ba yin/ yang nyi ma gzi brjid che yang tsha bas gdung bar byed pas stobs chen po gzhan la gnod pa'i dper 'gyur la/ zla ba ni yid du 'ong zhing tsha gdung sel ba'i phyir/ stobs chen po de gzhan la 'jigs skrag dang gzhan la gnod pa mi skyed cing shin tu phan 'dogs pa'i dpe'o/ /de ltar na bla ma bsten tshul lnga bcu pa las/ mchog tu gus pas dus gsum du/ /maṇḍal me tog bcas thal mos/ /bla ma ston pa bsnyen bkur zhing*/ /zhabs la spyi bos phyag dag bya/ zhes bshad pa dang*/ dpal don dam bsnyen pa las/ thun mtshams gsum du shin tu rnam par dag pa yis/ kha dang lag pa rkang pa dag ni bkrus byas nas/ /me tog yang dag blangs te bla ma'i spyan sngar ni/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi dkyil 'khor shin tu zlum po bya/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma'i maṇḍal la brtson par bya'o/ /thun bzhi'am/ gsum la sogs par maṇḍal tshom bu dgu pa tshig lhug pa tshigs bcad dang sbrags pa de/ ci nus ci lcogs su 'bul/ ma tha yang thun re la brgya rtsa re 'bul bar bya'o/ /spyir sgom 'khrid pa gang la yang thun yun ring zhing*/ thun mtshams ni zas g.yo skol sogs mi dgos ka med rnams ma gtogs/ sos dal du 'dug pa dang*/ long gtam dang*/ don med rnam g.yeng gi bya ba mi byed de/ thun mtshams yun ring na ma bsgoms pa kho na yin pas/ ji ltar yun ring yang gnyid kyi bya ba phar bzhag la/ nyin mo'i thun gyi bzhi cha bas lhag pa'i thun mtshams mi bya'o/ /'on kyang dmigs bsal la/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i khrid kyi skabs bla ma'i bka' lung nos nas/ mchod rten bzhengs pa la sogs pa lus thog tu ci gal 'bab pa/ rnam g.yengs bzhad gad/ snyoms las le lor mi 'gyu ba'i dge las la dka' ba spyod pa'i rigs yin na/ de kha rang sdig pa sbyangs thabs yin pas/ de 'dra'i thun mtshams la yun ring du song yang skyon med pa yin/ 'dir yang de dang mtshungs pas/ thun mtshams su tshogs gyi sgo du ma nas gsog pa'i dbang du byas nas phyag 'bul ba dang*/ mchod pa bshams pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang dang byi dor gyi las sogs dang*/ rang gi longs spyod nas ma chags par dad pas gtong ba dang*/ lus thog tu ngal dub 'bab pa'i dge las sems rnam g.yeng gi dbang du mi gtong bar sgrub na/ tshogs gsog gi skabs 'dir thun mtshams yun ring yang skyon med do/ /bsags sbyang gi skabs 'di ma gtogs/ /sgom sgrub byed pa la dge las yin yang rnam g.yeng gi rigs rnams spong dgos na/ gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ gang zhig ting ngai 'dzin sgom pa la zhugs nas/ don du gnyer ba'i ting nge 'dzin che chung gang rung cig rgyud la skyes nges pa dang*/ de yang tshe 'di la rkyen gyis nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i gdeng ma thob kyi bar du bya ba gzhan bskyungs te sgom kho na la 'bad dgos la/

dmigs pa la brtan pa thob nas ni/ sgom des zin pa'i sgo nas dge ba'i rnam grangs rgya chen po la slob pa nyid/ spyi btang nas mchog yin mod/ gang zag gi blo'i rigs dang dgag dgos kyi dbang las/ sgom la brtan pa thob kyang spros pa lhur mi byed par mnyam bzhag nyid la sgril na chod che ba ka shin tu mang ngo*/ /shin tu ches skal pa dman pa 'bad pa chen pos yun ring bsgoms kyang*/ ting nge 'dzin ma skyes pa 'ga' zhig tshe 'dir sgom skye ba'i re thag chad na ni/ re zhig bsags sbyangs kyi don du lus ngag gi tshogs bsag la 'bad pa nyid gnad che mod/ gang zag gi rigs 'ga' zhig sgom la brtson pas lo zla mang po song yang*/ re zhig nyams myong sna re yang mi skye ba la/ dus lan gcig nam zla'i drod phebs pa ltar nyams myong rlabs chen thog babs su yod pa yang yod pas/ da ni sgom mi skye'o zhes re thag gcod pa snga bar yang mi bya'o/ ting nge 'dzin skye bar 'dod pa'i bsags sbyang gi skabs 'dir/ bsags sbyang gi sgom pa nyid spyir bzang mod kyang*/ rnam g.yeng dang long gtam dang kyal ka sogs don med kyi las dang 'dres pa'i mchod pa skor bas las khur skyed sogs dge las su rlom/ kha yengs mig yengs la snying po med pas/ de bas thun gyi nyams len rang la sgril ba gal che'o/ /'dir tshogs gsog pa maṇḍal gyi khrid ces bya ba la/ tshogs gsog thabs dngos ni/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dngos gzhi rnams yin mod kyang*/ 'dir ni skye ba snga ma'i las 'phro bsags khyab khyad par can yod na des chog kyang*/ de ni dkon la/ rang rgyud la dge ba'i rtsa ba dngos su bsags pa'i gzhi rten zhig med na ni/ dge ba'i bag chags tsam yod kyang 'phral du smin pa dang sad par mi nus/ de ma nus pas lam dngos gzhi'i nyams myong 'phral du skye ba dka' zhing bul la rlabs chung ba dang 'phel skyed mi 'byung ngo*/ /dge rtsa khyad par can gsar du skyed na ni sngar gyi bag chags kyang sad de/

nyams rtogs skye ba myur zhing stobs che ba yin no/ /tshogs gsog rgyu'i tshogs dngos ni/ ji skad du rgyan las/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshogs/ /bsod nams ye shes mtshungs pa med/ /gcig gis 'khor bar mngon mtho byed/ /gzhan gyis nyon mongs med par 'khor/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs yin shes rab ye shes kyi/ /gsum po gzhan ni gnyis ka'i ste/ /lnga char yang ni ye shes tshogs/ / rgyun du sgoms pa thob nas ni/ dge ba yang dang yang du sgrub/ /bstan pa'i tshogs gang yin pa stai/ /don kun sgrub par byed pa'ang yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i rgyu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshogs ni gnyis te/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs so/ /bsod nams kyi sgos kyi 'bras bu ni/ byang chub sems dpa' 'khor bar sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshe/ gzhan don spyod pa la mthu dang ldan par 'gro ba'i lus dang longs spyod dang dbang phyug la sogs pa mngon par mtho ba rnams thob pa dang*/ mthar thug gzugs sku gnyis kyi sgo nas sems can kyi don byed pa yin la/ ye shes kyi rang 'bras ni/ gnas skabs su sems can gyi don du 'khor bar spyod pa na/ nyon mongs med cing thabs la mkhas pa'i ye shes kyis 'jug pa dang*/ mthar thug tu rang don chos kyi sku 'grub par byed do/ /de las bsod nams kyi tshogs su nges pa ni/ sbyin pa dang tshul khrims gnyis yin la/ ye shes kyi tshogs su nges pa ni shes rab yin zhing*/ phar phyin gzhan gsum la gnyis ka'i cha shas yod de/ bzod pa la gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa dang sdug bsngal dang len ni bsod nams/ chos la nges par sems pa'i bzod pa ni ye shes gtso chai/ brtson 'grus la yang bsod nams la rtsol ba dang ye shes la rtsol ba gnyis yod/ bsam gtan yang kun rdzob la dmigs pa bsod nams dang*/ don dam la dmigs pa ye shes kyi tshogs so/

/de ni gnas skabs ldog chas phye na tshogs gnyis tha dad pa'i rnam gzhag yin la/ gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas zin pa de'i tshe/ sher phyin tu ma zad sbyin sogs phar phyin lnga yang ye shes kyi tshogs yin pas/ thams cad ye shes kyi tshogs su 'gyur ba'i skabs shig kyang yod/ gzhan lnga char la bsod nams kyi 'bras bu 'byung ba bzhin du/ sher phyin las kyang bsod nams kyi 'bras bu 'phel ba'i phyir/ thams cad bsod nams kyi tshogs su 'gyur ba'i skabs kyang yod pas/ des na phyin drug thams cad bsod nams kyang yin la ye shes kyang yin zhes bya ste/ spyod pa dngos sam ngo bo'i sgo nas tshogs gnyis gcig tu rnam par bzhag pa zhes bya'o/ /spyir byang chub spyod pa la srid tshad kyi dbang du byas na/ so so rkyang pa ba gnyis dang gnyis ka yin pa'i gzhi mthun pa ste/ mu gsum yod byang chub kyi sems gyi zin zhing mi rtog ye shes kyis ma zin pa'i sbyin pa lta bu bsod nams rkyang pa dang*/ so so skye bo'i dus na lus ngag gi spyod pa spangs shing stong nyid gcig pu la dmigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin lta bu ye shes kyi tshogs rkyang pa yin la/ so skye'i dus na mi rtog ye shes rjes mthun pas zin pa'i sbyin sogs dang*/ stong pa'i nyams las shar ba'i snying rje sogs spros pa'i rnam pa can dang*/ stong nyid sgyu ma lta bu sogs tshogs gnyis zung 'jug rjes mthun pa'am/ zung 'jug gi sgrub pa'am/ rgyu'am zung 'brel yin no/ / 'phags pa rnams kyi rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ sbyin sogs spyod pa thams cad ro mnyam du gyur pa ni/ tshogs gnyis zung 'jug dngos dang tshogs gnyis gzhi mthun pa yin no/ /dper na byang chub sems dpa'i gtong sems de/ sems can bde zhing smin par byed pas bsod nams kyi tshogs kyang yin/ gtong sems de kho nas gdong thug gi dngos po rnams gtso bor gyur pa'i chos dang gang zag stong par rtogs pa'i phyir/

ye shes kyi tshogs kyang yin no/ /des gzhan rnams la'ang mtshon/ de'i tshe sbyin pa'i ldog cha bsod nams dang*/ de kho na nyid rig pa'i ldog cha nas ye shes yin gyi/ gtong sems dang de kho na nyid de gnyis rig pa rdzas tha dad med de ngo bo gcig yin/ des gzhan rnams la 'gre'o/ /de lha bu'i bsod nams dang ye shes gang yin pa de yang*/ yang nas yang du sgrub cing rgyun du goms par byed pa dang*/ 'dod don thams cad 'grub par byed pa'i phyir tshogs zhes bya ste/ saṃ skṛ ta'i skad kyi sgra bshad las drangs pa'ang yin/ bod skad la yang don de gnas pa yin no/ /tshogs ni tshogs pa ste mang po gsog par 'os shing bsags na legs pa yin pa'i phyir/ tshogs par byed dgos rgyu la tshogs pa'i ming gis btags pa'o/ /skye ba sngon du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs mang du bsags pa'i 'bras bu la spyod pa'i dge ba rlabs chen 'grub pa rnams kyis ji ltar bsgrubs kyang sla ba yin mod/ de ltar ma yin pa rnams kyis dge ba phra mo nas sgrub pa la 'bad dgos so/ /de dag ni tshogs gnyis spyi'i go don yin la/ dpal dus 'khor dang sems 'grel rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa khyad par gyi bzhed pas tshogs gsum zhes kyang gsungs te/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ tshul khrims kyi tshogs dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs so/ /bsod nams ni gtso bor snying rje chen pos gzhan la phan pa sgrub pa yin na/ spyod pa sbyin sogs spyi dang 'dra/ yang shas che ba'i dbang du byas na/ bskyed rim dang las tshogs dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnams sngags lugs kyi khyad chos lhag po'o/ /tshul khrims kyi tshogs ni bskyed rdzogs gnyis kar du 'byung ba'i zhu bde 'gyur med thabs dang bcas pa de yin la/ ye shes kyi tshogs ni spyir 'dra ba las/ mthar thug gi khyad chos rnam kun mchog ldan dang mi 'gyur ba zung du 'jug pa'o/ /de nyid pha rol tu phyin pa bcu yang yin te/

sbyin pa dang*/ thabs dang*/ smon lam rnams bsod nams kyi tshogs yin la/ tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus gsum tshul khrims kyi tshogs/ bsam gtan shes rab stobs dang ye shes rnams ye shes kyi tshogs te/ tshogs gsum dang*/ phyin bcu rdzogs pa las bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ /rtsa rgyud las/ tshul khrims tshogs ni yang dag rdzogs/ / bsod nams ye shes yang dag ldan/ /pha rol phyin bcu thob pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dus gsum 'jug /ces gsungs pas so/ /gzhan yang skabs 'dir 'phros don cung zad bshad na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims la/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims bya ba/ rang nyid dge chos kyi sgo thams cad la bslabs pas/ rang rgyud yongs su smin pa zhig 'ong*/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims bya ba/ gzhan rnams kyang gang la gang 'tshams kyi dge ba sne ma 'gags pa la bkod pas/ sems can smin par byed pa zhig dgos pa yin/ gnyis po de 'grub tu rung bzhin du mi byed na/ byang chub sems dpa'i nyes pa yin tshul khrims la gnod pas/ skabs su bab na nges par sgrub dgos so/ /gzhan yang dge ba sgo du ma nas bsgrubs pas tshogs bsag dgos te/ bsam pa dag pa dang*/ yul mchog dang*/ dge ba'i las gtsang ma'i khyad par 'ga' las bya ba chung ngu las kyang 'bras bu rgya chen po 'byung ste/ dper na 'phags pa khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdo las/ kun dga' bo gang la la zhig gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa byed na de byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi gling gi dbang phyug gi bdag por 'gyur zhing*/ lus zhig nas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar nga smra'o zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du dkyil 'khor zlum po la/ ba glang spyod kyi bdag po dang 'thab bral gyi lhar skye ba dang*/ zla gam la lus 'phags gling gi bdag po dang dga' ldan du skye ba dang*/ shing rta'i dbyibs byed na 'dzam gling gi bdag po dang 'phrul dgar skye bar gsungs/

'dir dkyil 'khor zhes pa maṇḍal yin zhing*/ mdo tshig 'di dag gis zhor la 'phang pa'i don mang po zhig ston te/ maṇḍal gyi zhal zhal tsam byas pa dang*/ me tog tsam phul bas kyang*/ khams kyi rgyal phran nam/ rgyal chen bzhi rigs kyi lhar skye ba dang*/ maṇḍal de dag gnyis ldan gsum ldan bzhi ldan du phul bas gling gnyis sam gsum mam bzhi'i bdag por 'gyur zhing*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lhar skye ba yang don gyi go nus la/ der ma zad chos mngon par ma grags pa'i gling gzhan gsum du skyes pa'i 'khor los sgyur rgyal yang yod pa dang*/ spyir btang la sgra mi snyan pa dbang po rtul ba dang*/ 'dzam gling chung ngu ba dbang po rno bar grags kyang*/ gzhan gnyis la gling brjod med pa las/ 'dis ni byang gling pa las nub pa dang*/ de las shar pa dang*/ de las lho pa mchog tu gsung pa dbang po rno ba'i sgo nas mchog tu bzhag pa rnams kyang go bar bya'o/ / de bzhin du gtsug lag khang sogs phyags dar byas pa'i phan yon yang rang gi sems dang ba dang*/ gzhan gyi sems dang ba dang*/ lha rnams dga' ba dang*/ dge ba rgya chen po gsogs pa dang*/ lha'i 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ba ste lnga'o/ /gzhan yang mdo las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod rten rnams dang ni/ /sku gzugs rnams la rdul phran ci song ba/ /de yi grangs snyed de byed mi rnams kyis/ /lha yul sa steng nges par rgyal srid thob/ /su dag 'dir ni rgyal ba'i gzugs byed pa/ /de dag gzugs bzang yid 'ong yon tan ldan/ /dbang po bsdams shing 'od 'bar nyi ma bzhin/ /'jig rten dag na mig tu sdug par 'gyur/ /thub pa'i mchod rten byed pa'i mi rnams ni/ /mya ngan yongs med lus kun brtan pa dang*/ /longs spyod mchog ldan rin chen mdzod dang ldan/ /dgra yi tshogs rnams kun kyang thub par 'gyur/ /zhes sogs dang*/ dal ba rnyed dka' thob gyur nas/ /skad cig gcig tsam bar du yang*/

/mchod rten skor ba byas pas ni/ /mi khom brgyad rnams spong bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ dkon mchog la phyag btsal ba'i phan yon bcu ste/ mdog bzang mdzes dang tshig btsun dang*/ /'khor rnams zil gnon lha mi dga'/ /dam pa dang 'grogs gzi brjid che/ /longs spyod mtho ris thar pa thob/ /ces bya/ dkon mchog la thal mo sbyar ba kho na la yang rgya chen po'i khyim du skye ba len pa dang*/ gzugs bzang ba dang*/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa phan yon bcu gsungs te/ mdo sde las rnam 'byed du blta'o/ /yang mdo las/ dri zhim 'bru mar rnams kyis mchod rten khru/ /spos dang me tog sil snyan sna tshogs 'bul/ /yid du 'ong bas mkhan po slob dpon bsten/ /de lus sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan dang ldan/ /zhes pa la sogs pa sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzheng ba dang*/ bla ma dge bdun rten gsum rnams la phyag 'bul ba/ skor ba byed pa/ mchod pas mchod pa/ bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa la sogs pa/ re re la yang phan yon dpag tu med par gsungs pa ltar yin te/ rin chen 'phreng ba las kyang*/ sems can rnams ni byang chub tu/ /sems bskyed bcug cing brtan byas na/ /ri dbang rgyal po ltar brtan pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni rtag tu thob/ /dad pas mi khoms 'gro mi 'gyur/ khrims kyis 'gro ba bzang por 'gro/ /stong pa nyid la goms pa yis/ /chos rnams kun la chags med thob/ /g.yo med pas ni dran pa thob/ /sems par byed pas blo gros te/ /bkur sti byed pas don rtogs ldan/ /chos srung shes rab can du 'gyur/ /chos nyan pa dang sbyin pa dag /sgrib pa med par byed pa yis/ /sangs rgyas nyid dang 'grogs pa nyid/ /'dod pa myur du thob par 'gyur/ /ma chags pas ni don 'grub ste/ /ser sna med pas longs spyod 'phel/ /nga rgyal med pas gtso bor 'gyur/ /chos la bzod pas gzungs thob bo/ /snying po lnga rnams byin pa dang*/

/'jigs la mi 'jigs sbyin pa yis/ /bdud rnams kun gyis mi tshugs shing*/ /stobs po che yi mchog tu 'gyur/ /mchod rten mar me'i 'phreng ba dang*/ /mun pa dag tu sgron me dang*/ / mar me 'bru mar sbyin pa yis/ /lha yi mig ni thob par 'gyur/ /mchod rten mchod par rol mo dang*/ /dril bu dag ni phul ba dang*/ /dung dang rnga ni rab phul bas/ lha yi rna ba thob par 'gyur/ /gzhan gyi 'khrul pa mi gling zhing*/ /yan lag nyams pa rnams mi brjod/ /sems ni rjes su bzung bas na/ /gzhan gyi sems ni shes pa thob/ /lham dang bzhon pa byin pa dang*/ /nyams chung bkur bar byed pa dang*/ /bzhon pas bla ma bkur ba yis/ /mkhas pas rdzu 'phrul thob par 'gyur/ /chos kyi ched dang de bzhin du/ /chos gzhung don dag dran pa dang*/ /chos kyi sbyin pa dri med pas/ /tshe rabs dran pa thob par 'gyur/ /dngos rnams ngo bo nyid med par/ /yang dag ji bzhin yongs shes pas/ /mngon shes drug pa zag pa kun/ /zad pa mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /sems can thams cad sgrol ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin nyid shes mnyam ldan pa/ /snying rjes brlan pa bsgom pa yis/ /rnam pa mchog ldan rgyal bar 'gyur/ /thub dbang rin chen phul ba yis/ /mtha' yas 'od ni rnam par 'phro/ /zhes gsungs/ btsun pa chos ldan rab 'byor dbyings kyis kyang*/ mi 'tshe ba yis lha dang mi/ /lha min rnams su tshe ring 'gyur/ /'tshe bas thung ngur skye bar 'gyur/ /de phyir 'tshe ba rnam par spangs/ /gang zhig 'di la zas sbyin pas/ /tshe dang mdog dang stobs ldan zhing*/ /dpal dang ldan zhing nad spangs pa/ /rtag par bde dang ldan pa 'gyur/ /gang zhig gos ni sbyin byed de/ /'dzes bcas gzugs bzang longs spyod ldan/ /brjid can srog chags rnams la sdug /gos rnams kyang ni rnyed par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'di la rab dga' ba'i/ /sems kyi gnas ni sbyin par byed/ /lus can de la khang bzang ni/

/'dod pa kun dang ldan pa 'byung*/ /zhes dang*/ gang zhig rtag par yid dga' bas/ /bla ma rnams kyi bka' bzhin byed/ /phan dang mi phan ston pa'i mi/ /de yi tshig ni btsun par 'gyur/ /gzhan brnyes pa yis smad par 'gyur/ /zlog pa yis ni mthon por 'gyur/ /bde ba chen pos bde dang ldan/ /sdug bsngal chen pos sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ gang zhig bdag bde mi 'dod cing*/ /yongs su bzung pa mi dga' ba/ /de ni gza' rnams dag gi mchog /rgyal chen bzhi pa nyid du 'gyur/ /pha ma pha tshan gtso bo yang*/ /bkur zhing gtong dang bzod par ldan/ /'thab mo la ni dga' ba gang*/ /de ni sum cu rtsa gsum skye/ /rtsod par mi dga' 'thab mo la/ /yid ni dga' bar mi byed pa/ /gcig tu dge la brtson pa gang*/ /de dag 'thab bral nyid du 'gro/ /thos pa mang dang chos 'dzin dang*/ /shes rab ldan zhing thar pa 'dod/ /yon tan dag la dga' ba'i mi/ /de dag dga' ldan nye bar 'gro/ /mi gang rang nyid dul ba la/ /zhugs shing tshul khrims 'bogs pa yang*/ /spro ba che dang ldan pa ste/ /gdon mi za bar 'phrul dgar 'gro/ /sems can gang zhig mi dman mchog /sbyin dang dul dang yang dag sdom/ /phul byung yon tan ldan gyur te/ /nges par gzhan 'phrul dbang byed 'gro/ /tshul khrims kyis ni mtho ris thob/ /bsam gtan gyis ni khyad par 'gyur/ /yang dag ji bzhin yongs shes pas/ /mthar ni yang srid med par 'gro/ /chags dang bral dang bsod nams thob/ /de bzhin sdig pa'ang spong bar byed/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi don byed dang*/ /gzhan la gnod pa spong ba ni/ /bsod nams yin no bzlog pa sdig /bdag nyid chen po de skad gsungs/ /zhes sogs mang du 'byung zhing*/ 'di tsam gyis mtshon nas mdo dang bstan bcos rnams nas/ tshogs kyi sgo mtha' yas pa dang*/ dge ba'i phan yon dpag tu med par gsungs pa rnams rig par bya'o/ /des na dge rtsa sna re la chog shes mi byed par/

tshogs kyi sgo rnam grangs mi 'dra ba du ma nas ci nus su bsags par bya'o zhes brjod/bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi dmigs pa phog zin pa'i rjes su/ chos thun rting ma gzhan la go babs cung zad 'chad par spro na 'di ltar bya ste/ de la don tshan dang po slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid bshad pa ni/ ji skad du/ /snying rje med cing khro la gdug khengs shing chags la ma bsdams dang*/ /rang bstod bla ma slob mar ni/ /blo dang ldan pas mi bya'o/ /brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ / bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu med/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ /snying brtse ldan zhing bstan bcos mkhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i las la mkhas/ /gsang sngags 'chad byed slob dpon te/ /rab tu dang zhing dbang po dul/ /zhes pa 'di bla ma lnga bcu par yang 'byung mod kyi/ dri med 'od du lung drangs 'dug pas rgyud tshig cig yin par gsal lo/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las/ dang por yang dag bsten bya bla ma dag kyang dam tshig ldan zhing rdo rje theg la lhag par gnas/ /de nyid bsgom zhing ma chags dri ma dag dang rnam par bral ba bzod pa'i ngang tshul lam la zhugs/ / slob ma rnams la lam ni sbyin byed dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog pa de nyid las ni tshangs spyod ldan/ /bdud rnams la ni rdo rje'i dbyug pa de yang 'dzin ma'i gzhi la rdo rje sems dpar rab grags pa'o/ /zhes bla ma'i yon tan dang*/ nga rgyal dang ldan bro bas zil mnan dam tshig rnam 'dral rdzas la brkam zhing thos pa dag kyang med/ /slob ma rnams ni bslu ba don du gnyer zhing mchog gi bde ba'i gnas la sems nyams dbang ma bskur/ /longs spyod dag la kun chags bag med rtsub mo'i tshig dang ldan zhing dbang po'i don du 'dod ldan pa/ /de nyid dmyal ba bzhin du slob ma mkhas pa rnams kyis rdzogs pa'i byang chub rgyur ni spang bar bya/

/zhes skyon gyi rnam gzhag dang*/ zab cing rgya che la sems bla ma'i nges pa la dga' gtong ba'i ngang tshul dang ldan yon tan shes/ thar pa don gnyer rgyud la gus shing g.yo ba min pa'i sems ldan de nyid thob pa shin tu sbed/ /gdug pa rnams kyi grogs nyams slob ma de nyid bla ma shin tu mkhas pa rnams kyis bsdu bya ba/ /shes rab dbang la sogs pa'i rgyur te gzhan zhes bya ba slar yang 'bring po bsod nams dag gi rgyur/ zhes slob ma'i mtshan nyid rnams gsungs/ de la slob dpon gnyis te/ mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa ni slob dpon mchog tu 'gyur ba dang*/ skyon spangs yon tan can gyi mtshan nyid thams cad ma rdzogs kyang med mi rung gi yon tan dang ldan pa'i slob dpon du 'os pa gnyis so/ /de bzhin du slob ma'i mtshan nyid rab 'bring tha ma'i dbye bas gsum du 'gyur ro/ /bla ma'i yon tan la/ dbang bskur bas dam tshig thob pa dang*/ de nyid bcu shes pa la sogs pa/ gsang sngags rang gi khyad chos ci rigs pa ma gtogs/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid spyi rnams theg chen dge ba'i bshes gnyen spyi dang 'dra bas/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid mdo sngags gnyis la mi 'dra ba chen po ni med do/ /de dag las snying rje med cing zhes sogs skyon bdun po de ni/ slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis ka'i skyon yin te/ slob dpon skyon de dag shas cher spyod pa yin na bla mar mi bya la/ de dag cha phra mo'ang spangs pa ni mchog yin mod kyang deng sang rnyed par dka'o/ /skyon bdun las lnga'am drug spangs na/ gnyis sam gcig lta bu yod kyang nyes pa mi bskyed pa'ang yod mod/ skyon de dag gi nang nas snying rje med pa kho na skyon che bas de spangs pa gal che'o/ khro ba dang gdug pa'i khyad par ni 'phral 'phral khro skyen pa khro ba dang*/ zhe ba rnag cing 'khon 'dzin dam pa ni gdug pa'o/ /gzhan dngos bstan rnams go sla'o/ / de rnams la bshad pa'i rnam grangs cung zad mi 'dra ba ni/

rdo rje snying 'grel las/ brtse med zhing las byed pa gang*/ khro zhing gnad du bsnun par byed/ / gdug pa dge slong skye bo ldang*/ khengs pa shes pa ngan pas khengs/ /'dod chen spyad bya min don gnyer/ /shin tu chang 'thungs ma bsdams pa/ /rang la bstod pa 'dir brjod cing*/ /yon tan can la skyor 'byin byed/ /ces gsungs pa dang*/ 'jam dpal gyi blta 'dod mdor bstan las/ brtse med sha za ba la gsungs/ khro ba dga' bar bsnun byed dang*/ /gdug pa legs pa'i skye bor sdang*/ khengs pa ye shes spangs pa'o/ /chags pa lha yi dkor la spyod/ /ma bsdams shin tu chang 'thung ba/ /rang bstod stong pa nyid lam la/ /smod cing smod pa byed pa'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ de dag la 'ga' zhig de dang de'i ngo bo bshad pa'ang yin la/ phal cher mtshan gzhi gzung bar snang ngo*/ /slob ma mchog la ni skyon de dag sngar nas spangs pa dgos kyang*/ spyir slob ma la ma nges te da lta skyon de dag shas cher spyod du zin kyang*/ slar chos kyi sgor zhugs bla ma la brten nas skyon de dag rim gyis spong bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dper na da ltar snying rje med pa yin yang*/ slar snying rje skyer rung ba sogs blo bsgyur nus shing rgyud bcos su rung na slob mar sten du rung pa'i phyir ro/ /brtan zhing zhes sogs yon tan drug kyang dpon slob gnyis ka'i dbang du byas pa ste/ 'di la'ang slob dpon la ni de rnams tshang ba dgos/ slob ma la ni skyes stobs la yon tan ci rigs pa tshang na/ lhag ma slar glo bcos te phyis yon tan skyer rung ba'i rigs rnams bzung ngo*/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi sbyor ba shes/ zhes pa man chad slob dpon kho na'i yon tan te/ sngags rgyud kyi sbyor ba ni sngags dang de'i lag len te las tshogs dang dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi ming ngo*/ /de nyid bcu ni/ dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang*/

/stangs stabs 'dug stangs bzlas brjod dang*/ /sbyin sreg mchod pa las la sbyor/ /slar bsdu ba yi rnam pa ste/ /phyi yi de nyid bcu yin no/ /phyir bzlog gnyis kyi cho ga dang*/ /gsang ba shes rab ye shes dang*/ kha sbyor dbye ba'i cho ga dang*/ /gtor ma rdo rje bzlas pa dang*/ / drag shul sgrub pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ /rab tu gnas dang dkyil 'khor sgrub/ / gsang ba'i de nyid bcu yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsang sngags 'chad byed ni rgyud shes pa dang*/ dang ba'i bdag nyid ni slob dpon rang nyid dad pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas/ chos las bshad pa'i blang dor las mi 'da' ba'o/ /tshig don gzhan rnams go sla/ thun mong gi rdo rje slob dpon 'di dag gi mtshan nyid la/ dad pa dang ldan pa dang*/ dam tshig ma nyams pa dang*/ bsnyen pa la sogs pas lha mnyes par byas pa dang*/ chos gang la brten nas slob ma de rjes su 'dzin rgyu'i chos de la mkhas pa rnams med du mi rung pa'o/ / dang por yang dag bsten bya sogs kyi dbang du byas nas/ dam tshig dang ldan pa ni/ spyir sngags sdom thob la ma nyams pa'i steng du/ sgrub pa'i dam tshig rigs drug gi sdom pa lta bu la/ phyi drang don dang nang nges don gyi dam tshig yang dag par spyod pa ste/ 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub man chad kyi don du/ bskyed rim gyi man ngag tsam zhu ba yin na/ phyi'i dam tshig la spyod pa kho nas kyang chog cing*/ mchog 'dod pas rdzogs rim don du gnyer na ni/ nang gi dam tshig la gnas pa'ang nges par dgos so/ /mu stegs dang theg dman gyis mi phyed pa'i phyir rdo rje theg pa ste sangs rgyas kyi theg pa yin la/ pha rol tu phyin pa ni sngags kyi lam stegs yin pas/ sngags kyi nang du 'dus/ lam 'dis gzhan la ma ltos par rang dbang du sangs rgyas thob nus pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi theg pa ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la zer/ de la lhag par gnas pa ni gsang sngags la yid ches pa'i sgo nas lam gzhan mi 'tshol ba'o/

/de kho na nyid ni/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim ste rim gnyis sgom pa dang*/ dri ma ni nyon mongs te/ nyon mongs dug lnga shes chung ba dang*/ bzod pa'i ngang tshul ni/ tshe 'di'i bde sdug la ma ltos par rang gzhan gyi don du chos spyod pa dang*/ sngags kyi lam la zhugs shing lam kyi ye shes ci rigs pa rgyud la skyes pa dang*/ chos ston pa'i nus pa yod cing*/ snying rje dang phan sems kyis slob ma rnams la lam ste chos sbyin pa'am ster bar byed cing*/ de nyid kyi dmyal ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog pa yang yin no/ / de kho na nyid rlung dbu mar 'gags pa dang*/ stong gzugs kyi ye shes la bsten nas/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba thob na rab/ de min na'ang zhu bde 'gyur med kyi tshangs spyod dang ldan pa'o/ /bdud rnams la ni rdo rje'i dbyug pa zhes pa'i don/ 'grel chen gyi dngos bstan las/ bdud bzhi 'joms pa la gsungs te/ de yang yon tan gzhan rnams kyis kyang byed mod kyi/ de kho na nyid las tshangs spyod grub pa ni/ srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i rim pa grub pa nas 'byung zhing*/ 'dzin pa thob na bdud dang nyon mongs la sogs nyams zhes 'byung ba ltar/ rang rgyud kyi bdud bzhi cung zad choms pa yin la/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba thob na ni rtsa ba nas 'joms par byed de rang la yon tan 'di yod pa sngon du song ba'i sgo nas slob ma rnams la lam sbyin pas ni/ gzhan rgyud kyis bdud bzhi yang 'joms par byed do/ /dngos bstan yi ge'i don ltar na/ yon tan de dag ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon de ni/ bdud rigs kyi 'byung po sems can rnams la 'tshe bar byed pa rnams 'joms shing 'dul bar byed pa la/ rdo rje'i dbyug pa dang mtshungs zhes pa ste gong gi {lha'i }:lta'i bu'i bdud 'joms par 'dus mod kyang*/ 'chad tshul cung mi 'dra ste snga ma ni rang dang gzhan bdud kyi las 'dod pa tha mal pa'i chags srid las zlog pa'i don yin la/

'dir ni 'byung po'i gnod pa srung ba dang bzlog pa'i don yin no/ /'grel chen las gzhung gi khog don dbyings che ba de ma go dogs nas bshad par mdzad/ sgra ji bzhin pa ni go sla bas rgyas bshad ma gsungs pa'o/ /slob dpon de ni rdo rje sems dpa'i sprul pa'i skur sa la rab tu grags pa ste/ sprul pa'i sku dngos kyang yod la de min na'ang phal cher byin gyis rlabs pa'i sprul par nges so/ /de dag ni slob dpon la dgongs pa'i yon tan rnam par bzhag pa'o/ /nga rgyal dang ldan zhes sogs la nor dang*/ dbang thang dang*/ thos pas khengs pa dang*/ de nyid bcu sogs bya ba dang*/ lam ting nge 'dzin phra mo dang*/ gzugs dang rigs la sogs pas nga rgyal ba ste/ de yang gong ma la ltos na/ nga rgyal bral bar 'gyur zhing*/ rang bas dman pa'i skyon la ltas na/ nga rgyal skye ba'i phyir na/ gang nga rgyal shas che ba de ni/ mchog gi yon tan la dad pa mi bsgoms shing*/ rang dang mtshungs pa'am dma' ba rnams la brnyas shing khyad du gsod pa nyid gyi phyir/ nga rgyal gyi khengs pa de ni dam pa ma yin pa'i spyod pa skyon che bar gsungs so/ /de bzhin du yang yang khro ba'i ngang tshul can gyi 'grogs dka' ba dang*/ gsang ba'i dam tshig dbral te/ rtsa rlung dang phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor dang lha dang sngags dang las tshogs la sogs pa skye bo phal pa'i nang du/ dam dum rab rib shod kyin ngom pa dang*/ bza' bya ma yin pa skye bo'i mngon du bsten pa dang*/ bgrod bya ma yin pa bsten zhing de dag chos zab pa dang theg pa mtho ba yin par ngo 'phyar ba ni/ dam tshig rnam par dral ba ste gsang sgrogs dang log pa'i lam la spyod pa'o/ /de bzhin du dkon mchog gi rdzas la brkam zhing*/ gzhan yang nor la shin tu chags pa dang*/ man ngag mchog ma thos pa dang*/ rang gi spyod pa dang mthun pa tsam snying la bzhag nas log chos chos su ston pas slob ma bslu ba dang*/ mchog gi bde ba'i gnas mi 'gyur ba'i thabs mi shes pa dang*/

dbang skur med par rgyud dang man ngag 'chad pa dang*/ bza' btung sogs longs spyod la ha cang sred che ba dang*/ chang 'thung sogs kyi rkyen las bag med pa la dga' ba dang*/ dbang po gnyis sbyor las 'dzag bde la shin tu chags pa ste/ slob dpon du 'gyur ba la gegs byed pa'i skyon de dag go /zab cing sogs kyi don slob ma'i yon tan te/ zab rgya stong nyid snying rje la sems pa dang/ bla ma'i nges pa dam sdom srung ba la dga' ba dang*/ rdzas la ma chags pas sbyin pa gtong ba'i ngang tshul can dang*/ dkon mchog gi yon tan shes shing dad pa che ba dang*/ 'bras bu thar pa kho na la yid brnags pa dang*/ rgyud las ji skad gsungs pa'i blang dor la gus pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i lam dang man ngag gis sems g.yo bar mi nus pa dang*/ de kho na nyid man ngag thob pa shin tu gsang zhing sbed pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi rdzas za ba la dga' ba dang*/ mi dge bcu sogs chos dang 'gal ba don du gnyer ba'i grogs ngan dang 'grogs pa la mi dga' ba rnams so/ /de rnams kyi nang nas med du mi rung ba ni/ dam tshig bsrung nus pa dang sdig pa'i grogs po sbangs pa'o/ /yon tan de dag phal cher dang ldan na rdzogs rim kyi snod yin la/ gtso bo gnyis po kho na dang ldan na yang bskyed rim gyi snod yin/ de tsam yang med pa la bla ma bsten na/ skyabs 'gro dang bslab gzhi lnga tsam gyi snod dang ldan pa ni yod do/ /de ltar slob ma dang bla ma'i mtshan nyid rags pa bstan zin nas/ dus kyi skyon gyis skyon kun spangs yon tan kun rdzogs tshang ba'i slob dpon rang yang rnyed dka' ba dang*/ rnyed du zin kyang rang gi blo ma dag na yon tan dang ldan pa la yon tan yod par mi mthong*/ skyon med pa la skyon du mthong*/ skyon yin pa skyon du mi mthong*/ yon tan ma yin pa yon tan du mthong*/ yon tan med cing skyon dang ldan pa rnams skyes bu mchog tu mthong bar 'gyur te/

skye ba snga mar las ngan bsags shing skal ba dman pa'i dbang gis so/ /de ltar yang*/ mkhas rnams yon tan la gus kyi/ /sangs rgyas dbang phyug sogs la min/ /yon tan med la gang gus pa/ /de blun mi dge'i las las skyes/ /zhes gsungs/ yon tan rdzogs pa ma rnyed na/ gong du smos pa ltar med mi rung gi mtshan nyid tshang ba 'tshol dgos shing*/ 'khrid zab mo'i skabs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi zhal thugs dang zhal la gnas pa de dgos so/ /don tshan gnyis pa 'brel ba brtags tshul 'phros don dang bcas pa ste/ de yang dpon slob phan tshun 'brel ba brtag pa ni/ chos kyis ma sbrail gong du bya dgos kyi/ sngar brtags sam ma brtags gang yin yang*/ chos kyi 'brel ba thob nas skyon mi rtog par gus pas bsten dgos te/ tshigs bcad gcig tsam thos pa la'ang*/ gal te bla mar mi 'dzin na/ khyi yi skye ba brgyar skyes te/ /sme sha can du skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ des na phyis kyi skye bo mang po zhig sngags chos la dam tshig yod do skad pa'i kha bshad byed/ srung ni de la'ang mi srung*/ mtshan nyid pa la dam tshig mi yong zer zhing*/ mdo chos mang du thos pa'i bla ma la'ang ma gus pa dang brnyas pa dang bskur sti ma yin pa ji tsam byas kyang nyes pa med pa skad smra ba mang du snang ste/ bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa kho na'o/ / des na sngags chos kyis ma sbrel ba la dam tshig gi ming 'dogs mi byed pa tsam yin gyi/ don gyi steng nas phal cher 'dra la/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde thos pa'i bla ma dang*/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud thos pa'i bla ma gnyis nang sel du 'doms na/ yul gnyan mi gnyan gyi khyad cung zad tsam yod mod kyang*/ spyir 'gangs la khyad cher med/ theg pa che chung gi sde snod gnyis so sor thos pa'i bla ma la'ang des rigs 'gre ste/ mdor na sdug gsog pa po slob ma ngan pa ste/ spyir nas gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur zhus dam tshig thob pa yin na ni/

des sngags chos zhus pa ma yin la/ mdo lugs theg pa che chung gang yin yang rung ste/ de lta bu zhus pa'i bla ma de la sdig bsags na/ spyir nyes pa che bar ma zad sngags kyi dam tshig kyang nyams pa yin te/ rgyud rnams las kyang*/ slob dpon mi smad/ bla ma'i thugs mi dkrug ces gsungs kyi/ rtsa ltung dang po'i yul du rdo rje slob dpon kho na'i nges gzung ma mdzad pa mang pa'i phyir ro/ /slob ma de nyid sngags kyi dbang su la'ang ma zhus dam tshig ma thob na ni/ slob dpon tsam yin yang kho rang gi rdo rje slob dpon du ma song ba'i phyir/ sngags pa'i slob dpon sngags chos kyis sbrel ba zhig la smad na/ byang chub sems dpa' la smad pa'i sdig pa chen po rtsa ltung dang phyogs 'dra nges 'byung mod kyang*/ dam tshig nyams pa'i ming rang ni mi thob ste/ kho rang gis dam tshig len ma myong bas nyams rgyu med pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rtsa ltung gi tha snyad thob par 'gyur ba la ltung ba byed mkhan rang nyid sngags la zhugs pa zhig dgos kyi/ ltung ba gsog pa'i yul sngags chos kyis sbrel ba kho na mi dgos par ma zad sngags pa yin yang mi dgos so/ /gnad 'di ma go bas dam tshig nyams pa ni/ mkhas par rlom pa dang chen por rlom pa la yang shin tu mang ste/ dper na glo bo mkhan chen bsod lhun lta bu'o/ /de yang khong gi lo rgyus khong rang gis brtsams pa na/ kho bos 'jam dbyangs chen po la mdo chos zla ba dgu'i bar du zhus kyang*/ sngags chos chen po zhu ma myong*/ phyis 'jam dbyangs chen po dang nged lugs ma legs kyang dam tshig gi sel yod pa med/ dper na/ rang re rnams kyi bla ma gong mas kyang*/ rin po che tsong kha pa la bka' gdams lam rim sogs mdo chos mang po zhus kyang*/ phyis dgag pa dang skyon brjod mang po mdzad 'dug pa zer ba yod 'jam dbyangs chen po zer ba de paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan yin/ bla ma gong ma zer ba de/

rje ngor chen kun bzang la zer bar 'dug khong gi rnam thar 'di shogs chen zhig gda'/ go ba myangs bas dpon slob bla rabs mang po zhig tu dam tshig mi srung ba'i phyag len gyi rgyun yod zer ba zhig byung ngo*/ /yang rang dang dngos brgyud gang gi sgo nas kyang chos kyi 'brel ba med na rang gi bla mar mi bgrong*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma yang rtsa ltung gi yul du mi 'jog smad na lar gyis nyes pa ni che mod/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma ma yin yang*/ spyir skyes bu dam pa smad pa rang la nyes pa dpag tu med/ sgos su byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ yang sgos su gsang sngags 'dzin pa yul ches gnyan te 'phros pa'i don no/ /da ni dkyus la 'jug ste/ don tshan gsum pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ngos gzung ba ni/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lugs la lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor bya ba yod cing*/ skal ldan rnams tshe gcig la sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs gal che shos shig 'di yin no/ /zhes kun la grags pa ni don la gnas nges pa zhig yin par 'dug de yang bla ma dam pa la gus pa byed tshul dang*/ drin dran pa dang*/ rnyed bkur rim gro'i bya ba sogs 'phral spyod kyi sgo nas bla ma bsten tshul la mdo sngags theg pa che chung la khyad tsam med/ chos 'dul ba dang*/ theg chen gyi mdo sde rnams las gzigs pas gsal/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa las yon tan thams cad 'byung tshul yang 'dra/ tha na mu stegs dra ma tshun chad kyang phyogs mtshungs ste/ khong rang rnams kyi las tshogs dngos grub 'grub pa yang bla ma gus par bsten pas byin rlabs zhugs pa las 'byung ba yin pa 'dug /'on kyang khyad par 'di yod de/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba bla ma sgom pa'i ming yin/ de yang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi rnam pa yid la byed cing*/ de la dmigs nas mos gus rgyun mi 'chad par rnal 'byor du byed pa 'di lam dngos gzhi'i nyams len gyi rtsa ba cig tu 'jog pa ni spyir gsang sngags dang*/

sgos su rnal 'byor bla med las rtsal du bton pa yin gyi/ theg pa 'og ma rnams la yongs su ma grags pas gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa bla ma'i byin rlabs lam du byed ces pa yang gtso che ba dang rags bshad kyi dbang du byas na shin tu 'thad do/ /don tshan bzhi pa mos gus ji ltar bsgom pa ni/ dngos po'i mtshan nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ bla ma stai sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa yin pa yang srid/ ma yin tha mal pa yin du chug kyang*/ rdo rje slob dpon de'i sku gsung thugs la yi dam gyi lha rnams rjes su zhugs pa'i tshul kyis 'gro don mdzad pa yin pas sangs rgyas dngos dang khyad par med pa lta bu ni yin/ de mnyes na sangs rgyas mnyes/ de la sdig bsags na sangs rgyas la sdig bsags par 'gro /de mchod pas sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa'i phyir slob ma'i sgrib pa thams cad zad par 'gyur te/ 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ ma 'ong rdo rje 'chang ba ste/ /de la brnyas byed sems can gang*/ /de yis nga la brnyas byed pas/ /ngas ni de kun dus su spong*/ /zhes dang*/ 'di yi don ldan 'ga' zhig la/ /nga ni de yi lus gnas te/ /sgrub po gzhan la mchod pa len/ /de mnyes de yis rang gi rgyud/ /las kyi sgrib pa dag byed do/ /zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang mos gus bsgom pa'i tshul ni rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid/ dngos po la su gang yin rung so so skye bo'am/ 'phags pa slob pa lta bu dang/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal pa sogs su blta ba ma yin/ sangs rgyas dngos su bsgom dgos don la sangs rgyas gcig dang mang po la khyad med kyang*/ mos gus 'jug tshul la khyad yod pas sangs rgyas kyang gcig gam gnyis lta bu ma yin/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin/ de'i phyir chos dang dge 'dun kun yang 'dus/ de bas na bdag gi bla ma 'di dngos gnas la dkon mchog kun 'dus/ bla ma nyid dkon mchog gsum/

dkon mchog gsum nyid bla ma yin/ rang re'i snang ngo dang bstun na/ dkon mchog gsum pas kyang bla ma bka' drin che/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams spyir ta bzang ste/ bdag la zhal mi ston gsung mi 'byon/ sangs rgyas dang*/ yi dam dang*/ byang sems mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs dngos su byon kyang rung*/ bdag la dpal ldan bla mas mdzad pa las lhag po mdzad rgyu dang ston rgyu med/ de dag dngos su mjal ba'i skal ba med dus 'dir/ de rnams kyi mdzad rgyu thams cad bla mas mdzad pa yin bka' drin rang che'o snyam/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus su shes nas yon tan mtha' med pa'i dad pa dang*/ bka' drin shin tu che bar shes pa gnyis 'dzom na mos gus kyi ngo bo go lugs sgom lugs bzang ba yin/ go yul bzang po de 'dra zhig yod pa'i lugs byas kyang*/ skabs skabs su min pa bla ma mi dran par brjed/ lan re dran pa'i skabs kyang ba spu g.yo nus pa'i gdung shugs mi 'byung na/ go ba tsam la lus pa yin/ nyams rtogs 'phral mar skyed thub pa de min/ gdung shugs drag po tha mal gyi snang ba gzhan 'gog nus pa/ rig pa bsgyur thub pa zhig byung na/ byin rlabs 'phral du 'jug nyon mongs glo bur du 'gagaye shes skad cig gis 'bebs/ de lta bu yang yang dran pas rtag tu sgoms par 'gro/ goms pa las skyon thams cad spong zhing yon tan thams cad skye ba yin/ sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba med na/ phyogs zhen dang pho rus dang*/ yid 'ong gi gdung shugs yod kyang*/ zag bcas 'jig rten pa'i rnam rtog yin pas grol mi thub/ dge bshes phal pa dang grub thob phal par brtse ba'i dad pa yang rnam rtog 'jig rten pa ka yin/ skye bo blun pos bla ma sangs rgyas zer ba zhig yod de/ de yang mi jo bzang gcig gam/ smad bud gcig gam/ zas nor gyis phan 'dogs byed pa zhig la sangs rgyas zer ram/ sangs rgyas sangs rgyas zhes pa'i tshig tsam min pa blo rtse brtad 'tshams ci yang med/

de 'dras sems rgyud grol ba la phan pa zhig kyang med des na sangs rgyas kyi yon tan shes nas/ de nyid bla ma la tshang ba'i mos gus dgos pa yin/ de ltar bla ma sangs rgyas su shes pa ste/ dmigs yul 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mchog sangs rgyas la dmigs pa yin pas lam sgom pa thams cad kyi snying po yin/ spyir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'jug sgos su rang re'i bla ma de la zhus pa'i yi dam rnams kyi byin rlabs 'phral rang la myur du 'jug bka' drin dran pa med na/ spyir byas pa mi gzo zhing*/ ngo tsha khrel med de byur chags nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin/ bsod nams dang dpal dang g.yang dang dge legs thams cad phyags ma btab pa bzhin nyams 'gro/ sgos su chos thob pa drin du mi sems pa de/ chos la yang rtsis med dad pa med pa yin pas/ 'bad pa byang tshad don med du 'gyur/ yang sgos su rtsa ltung dang po'i zhad kyis gos pa yin la/ bka' drin dran pas dge legs thams cad kyi gzhir 'gyur zhing*/ gus pa chen po rang shugs kyis skye ba yin no/ /de ltar na sangs rgyas su shes pa/ bka' drin dran la/ gdung shugs drag pa/ yang yang ma brjed par dran pa ste khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'i mos gus yod na mos gus tshad du phyin pa zhes bya/ des na rdo rje slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la/ slob ma dam tshig dang ldan pas mos gus de lta bu'i sgo nas bla ma bsgoms shing gsol ba btab na/ thabs gzhan med kyang*/ mchog thun mong gi 'dod don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no/ /don tshan lnga pa phan yon lung dang sbyar ba ni/ de yang dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ / bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang*/ /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las kyang*/ slob dpon ji ltar blta zhe na/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/

/de nyid rtag tu rdo rje 'chang*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog /de nyid ye shes rgya mtsho ste/ /yid bzhin nor bu rin chen sbyin/ /slob dpon gyi ni yon tan gzung*/ /skyon ni nam yang ma yin no/ /yon tan gzung bas dngos grub cing*/ /skyon rnams kyis ni dngos grub nyams/ /de yi grib ma'ang mi 'gom ste/ /mchod rten bshig dang 'dra bar gsungs/ /zhes dang*/ rdo rje gur las kyang*/ /slob dpon ston par gyur pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad pa/ /bdag cag rnams kyi pha dang ma/ /'di nyid yid la bsam par bya/ /zhes dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' ji lta bus/ /de ltar slob dpon gzugs 'dzin te/ /sems can rjes su gzung dmigs nas/ /phal pa'i gzugs su gnas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ dpal dri ma med pa'i 'od las/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud ston pa po rdo rje slob dpon ni bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal ji lta ba dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo dang po'i sangs rgyas ji lta ba bzhin du/ thar pa don du gnyer ba rnams kyi blta bar bya'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rim lnga las kyang/ ri dbang rtse las 'ga' zhig ltung gyur na/ /ltung bar mi 'dod kyang ni ltung bar 'gyur/ /bla ma'i drin gyis phan pa'i lung thob na/ /grol bar mi 'dod kyang ni grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis ni sdig pa 'phrog /slob dpon gyis ni 'jigs pa sel/ /slob dpon kyis ni sdug bsngal gyi/ /rgya mtsho'i 'jings las sgrol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ dpal sa ra has kyang*/ bla mas smras pa gang gi snying zhugs pa/ / lag pa'i mthil na gnas pa'i gter mthong 'dra/ /zhes dang*/ ind+ra bhu ti'i ye shes grub pa las kyang*/ skya ba 'dzin pa med par ni/ /gru yis pha rol 'gro mi 'gyur/ /yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs kyang*/ /bla ma med par srid mthar min/ /zhes dang*/ mthu stobs dbang phyug birwa bas kyang*/

bla ma dang ni rdo rje sems/ /tha dad par ni mi bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /de bzhin dge 'dun bla ma ste/ /dngos grub go 'phang mchog 'dod pas/ /kun nas bla ma mnyes par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje 'chang*/ /rtsod pa'i dus 'dir bdag don du/ /kun dang mthun par ston mdzad pa/ /de ltar shes nas dngos kun gyis/ /bsten bya dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /dngos grub bde chen thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ mdor na dngos grub thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla mar gsungs pa'i lung khungs mtha' yas so/ /da lta mngon sum gyis grub pa yang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la dad pa med pa rnams/ mi 'dod pa du ma thog tu 'bab pa dang*/ bla ma gus pas bsten pa rnams la/ bde skyid snyan gsum rang shugs kyis 'byung ba mthong ngo*/ /gzhan yang*/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung las 'di skad ces/ bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong na sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs 'jugabyang chub sems dpar mthong na byang chub sems dpa'i byin rlabs dang*/ grub thob tu mthong na grub thob kyi byin rlabs/ so so skye bo'i dge bshes bzang por mthong na/ de dang mthun par byin rlabs 'jug ste/ lar mos gus med na byin rlabs ye mi 'jug go /zhes gsung pa ltar yin no/ /don tshan drug pa lam zab mo zhes pa'i sgra don ni/ bla ma'i mos gus med na dngos grub lta ci smos/ yon tan kun gyi re thag chad dam tshig nyams par mi 'gyur tsam gyi mos gus tsam yod du chug kyang*/ mos gus khyad par can gyis lam 'khrid pa med na/ mchog sgrub par byed pa'i thabs gzhan zhig btsal nas/ de la gegs sel gzhan dang bogs 'don yang gzhan dang gzhan mang po dgos shing*/ 'dod don gzhan rnams la kha thag nye ba'i thabs kyang mi gcig pa mang po 'tshol dgos te/ tshe sgrub nor sgrub dbang bsdud la sogs pa ji snyed cig byas na yang 'ga' zhig ye mi 'grub/

'ga' zhig 'grub kyang dka' tshegs chen po dgos pas lam mi zab pa yin/ mos gus khyad par can gyis lam 'khrid pa 'di la ni/ mos gus kho nas mchog kyang 'grub/ lam gyi gegs sel dang*/ bogs 'don dang*/ tshe dang longs spyod dbang thang sogs 'dod don thams cad mos gus gcig pus dka' tshegs med par 'grub pa'i phyir/ gcig chog yin pas na lam zab mo zhes bya'o/ /don tshan bdun pa lam zab mo'i khrid lugs kyi dbye ba ni mos gus kyi lam 'khrid pa de la yang*/ spyod pas 'khrid pa dang gsol 'debs kyi 'khrid pa gnyis yod/ dang po ni/ skal ldan gyi gang zag cig bla ma mchog dang mjal ba tsam ni mos gus lhun gyis grub/ bla ma'i don du dka' ba chen po spyad pas/ sa lam gyi yon tan thams cad nyi ma shar ba ltar cig car tshul du 'byung ba yin/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten byung ba'i lo rgyus dang*/ mtsho skyes rdo rje dang*/ nā ro mai tri sogs rgya gar gyi grub thob dang*/ bod yul gyi lo tsā ba mang po dang*/ rnal 'byor pa a mes byang chub dang*/ bshes gnyen bya yul ba sogs kyi gtam rgyud sbyar/ gnyis pa ni/ deng sang gi gang zag phal cher la mos gus de 'dra'ang dkon dka' spyad kyang phal cher gyis mi nus/ re re tsam gyis byed pa srid na/ mi byed pa tsho'i tshor na ta dga' mor gda'/ lar pho rus dang*/ zhen dang*/ khengs dregs dang*/ 'gran sems dang*/ phugs rang bzang 'dod dang*/ yus dang bcas pa yin gyi/ chos ldan gyi mos gus snying thag pa nas med pas/ rnam dag legs pa'i lam gyi ye shes skyed mi thub/ des na gsol 'debs kyi sgo nas mos gus la rim gyis slob pa yin/ rim pas bsgoms pas/ mthar mos gus bcos ma ma yin pa skyes pa na/ lam gyi yon tan rnams kyang rim pas 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /des na mos gus rab la dge sbyor rab/ 'bring la 'bring dang tha ma la tha ma 'byung*/ mos gus med na dge sbyor med/

ma gus pa ni ngan song gi rgyu zhes bya'o/ /don tshan brgyad pa mtshan ldan gyi bla ma ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la ni mi rnams thar pa'i ched du skyabs su nye bar 'gro ba ste/ 'dir ni sangs rgyas gtsug lag khang na gnas pa 'di yang yi ger bris pa'i glegs bam chos nyid dang*/ /dge 'dun ngur smrig 'dzin pas mchog gi khyab bdag bde ba skye ba 'bum phrag dag gis ster ba min/ /zhes dang*/ gang zhig mi yi 'jig rten dag na dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa sdig bral de dag ste/ /de la gnod pa byas pas srog chags rnams ni nges par dmyal bar 'gro ste 'di la ngo mtshar med/ /de mnyes pa yis bdag ni mgu ste de la khros pas me yis khros pa zhes pa chen po'o/ /de nyid sems can rnams la thar pa bde mnyam 'bras ster bu rnams dag gi phyag 'os mchod 'os so/ /sdug can gang yin gang zhig dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs pad bzang la dus gsum phyag mi byed pa'o/ /mi shes gang yin gang zhig rnam mang me tog rnams kyis dus gsum du ni maṇḍal mi byed pa'o/ /myur du mnar med 'gro ba gang yin gang zhig bde mnyam ster byed bla ma skyo ba skyed pa'o/ /shes rab ye shes thob pa gang yin ma nyams gang zhig mchog gi bla ma'i zhabs ni mi spong ba'o/ /zhes gsungs/ dpal ldan gsang 'dus las kyang*/ rigs ngan smig ma mkhan la sogs/ /gsod don don gnyer sems pa rnams/ /theg chen bla na med pa yi/ / theg mchog 'di la 'grub par 'gyur/ /sems can mtsham med la sogs pa/ / sdig pa chen po byed pa yang*/ /rdo rje'i theg pa rgya mtsho che/ /theg pa mchog ni 'di la 'grub/ /snying nas slob dpon smod pa dag /sgrubs kyang 'grub par yongs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ 'di'i thad gyi sgron gsal las/ rang gi bla ma la snying thag pa nas smod mkhan de dang*/ rang yang snying nye bar byas na/

slob dpon la rang gis dngos su ma smad kyang*/ slob dpon smad pa dang khyad med par bshad do/ /yang de nyid las/ rigs kyi bu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das phyogs bcu na ji snyed bzhugs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi phung po ji snyed pa de bas kyang*/ slob dpon gyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig gi bsod nams khyad par du 'phags so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu byang chub kyi sems ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi snying por gyur pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ gsang 'dus rim lnga las kyang*/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod pa yang dag brtsams/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /bla med byed pa slob dpon gyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mchod byas pas/ / de yis bsod nams ma byas ci/ /dka' thub ma bsten gang zhig yod/ /de nyid mi bzang 'dod pa yis/ /shin tu yid 'ong gang dang gang*/ /shin tu khyad par gyur pa nyid/ /de dang de ni bla mar 'bul/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan las kyang*/ slob dpon gyi ni yon tan gzung*/ /skyon ni nam yang ma yin nyid/ /yon tan gzung bas dngos grub cing*/ /skyon rnams kyi ni dngos grub nyams/ /'dir mang smras pas ci zhig bya/ /bla ma mnyes byed gang yin bya/ /mi mnyes byed kun spang pa ni/ /de dang de la 'bad pas spyad/ /dngos grub slob dpon rjes 'brang bar/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gsungs phyir/ /shes nas dngos po thams cad kyis/ /bla ma yongs su mnyes par bya/ /zhes 'byung ba rnams gnad kyi dam pa yin te/ mdor na bla ma bsten tshul yang bsam pa dang sbyor ba gnyis las/ dang po la/ bsam pa'i rtsa ba ni gong du bstan pa'i bla ma'i mos gus nyid yin la/ de yi yan lag tu/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi skyon la mi brtag ste/ skyon gyi rnam pa mthong na/

blo sbyong tshul gnyis yod de/ dang po ni/ bla ma 'di lta bu'i skyon dang mdzad spyod ga la mnga'/ 'di ni bdag rang gi sems ma dag pas lan/ mkhris nad can gyis dung ser por mthong ba dang 'dra/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang gi bla ma bram ze rgyal ba'i drod dang*/ grub thob mtsho skyes kyi bla ma phag tshang ba dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis 'jam dpal khyim btsun du gzigs pa sogs kyis mtshon te/ de dag gis kyang ma dad pa med par/ gus pa phyir zhing 'phel bas/ dngos grub thob pa dang*/ ma dad pa'i rnam rtog skad cig re res kyang dngos grub la bar chad byung ba ltar/ bdag kyang bla ma'i mdzad pa ji lta bu mthong yang dad pa 'phel ba zhig byed dgos snyam du bsam/ blo sbyangs tshul gnyis pa ni/ bla ma de'i sku gsung thugs kyi skyon mthong ba'am/ mdzad spyod kyi sgo nas mi dge bcu mdzad par mthong yang*/ bla mas mdzad pa 'di lta bu mdzad pa ni/ gdul bya gang la gang 'dul gyi dbang las/ sems can dpag tu med pa smin grol du mdzad pa'i 'phrin las yin/ ded dpon snying rje chen po dang*/ khye'u skar ma dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags sogs kyi dpe dang mtshungs/ dper na bla ma rdzun gsung par shes na/ da lta 'di na skye bo mang po rdzun mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs la gnas pa yod pa yang*/ dge ba ngo mtshar che ste/ de kun pas bdag gi bla mas dgongs pa can gyi tshig rdzun ltar snang ba gsung pa 'di brgya stong 'bum 'gyur gyi ngo mtshar che/ 'dis sems can dpag tu med pa mtho ris dang thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa la 'god par mdzad pa zhig yin pa 'dug snyam du bsam pa lta bu ste/ des thams cad la rigs 'gre/ khyad par du rang la bka' bkyon pa dang*/ mi dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad na/ bka' bkyon mi theg dad pa log log lta byed na dngos grub dang sgom gyi ta re ba zad de/ de bas thu ba dam tshig nyams/

rdo rje dmyal ba'i gzhi things pa yin/ bka' bkyon byung na rang gi las ngan sdig sgrib 'dzad/ bgegs dang log 'dren ring du bros/ lhag par yang bdag la thugs nye bas gsong por gsungs pa yin te/ phas bu la bya ba bzhin zol 'grog mi mdzad pa bka' drin re ches snyam du bsams/ mi dgyes pa ltar snang na rang gi las sgrib ma dag pa yod pas de mdzub btsugs su brda sprod mdzad par 'dug snyam/ spyir sgrib sbyong dang*/ slar yang bla ma dgyes par byed pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos pa yin/ phyag chen pa 'ga' zhig bla ma'i bka' bkyon theg par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes zer ba yang mos gus kyi gnad dang ldan pa yin/ bod sgom 'ga' zhig gi zhal na re/ mtshan ldan bla ma rin che 'dis/ /gang mdzad thams cad legs pa yin/ /ci mdzad thams cad yon tan yin/ /mi gsod bshan pa mdzad na yang*/ de khas 'tshengs shing de kha legs/ /sems can thugs rjes 'dzin par nges/ /log g.yem 'chal ba'i tshul ston yang*/ /yon tan 'phel zhing yon tan 'byung*/ /thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i brda/ /rdzun gyis gzhan mgo bskor ba na/ /brda thabs rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /'gro kun thar ba'i lam la 'dren/ /rku 'phrog chom po mdzad na yang*/ /gzhan gyi yo byad tshogs su bsgyur/ /skye bo 'phongs pa zhi ba yin/ /don la 'di 'dra'i bla ma yis/ /bka' bkyon mdzad na drag sngags yin/ rkyen ngan bar chad sel bar nges/ /brdungs brdegs mdzad na byin rlabs yin/ /dngos grub thams cad de las 'byung*/ / mos gus can tsho nyams re dga'/ /zhes skad de/ bla ma'i mos gus kyi gnad de lta bu zhig rang yin/ rje grol mchog gis kyang*/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba de bla ma skad/ /bla ma de sangs rgyas dngos byon skad/ /ci mdzad de legs par blta dgos skad/ /mdzes mdzes su smra kyang sgra skad lags/ /dngos grub la thob rung ma thob rung*/ /sangs rgyas dang sems can gang yin yang*/

/mdzad pa yang legs nyes ci ston rung*/ /mi nga la snyems khrigs rdul tsam med/ /ces 'byung ba thag chod kyi mos gus de lta bu zhig dgos/ bla ma rang de cung zad ngan pa'i skyon yod pas sangs rgyas su bteg ste yar skyel mi dgos/ bla ma rang gis go chod/ mdzad pa nyes pa de bsgyur nas legs par sgom mi dgos/ gang mdzad de ka don chen yin de kas chog mdzad pa legs nyes la khyad mi gdog /rang la dngos grub re nas mos gus sgom pa min/ bla ma dang ma bral na dmyal bar gnas dgos kyang 'dod thog yin/ bla ma dang bral na dngos grub sangs rgyas sam de yod na'ang nga la dgos ched med do gzhan smos kyang ci dgos snyam pa zhig yin no/ /mdor na mos gus la re dogs spangs pa zhig gal che/ mkhas pa tshig gtso bor byed pa rnams dang*/ sgom chen pa'i brgyud 'dzin du khas blangs nas/ rtog ge dang sgra snyan ngag sogs tha snyad ngan pa'i g.yang sar lhung ba 'jig rten gyi che 'dod can 'di rnams don phun sum tshogs pa gnang la reg cing*/ tshig grong mi'i brda chad dang*/ bstun pa 'di lta bu la mi mos kyang*/ rgyud las/ 'tshe ba rig byed tshad ma can ni bde ba'i 'bras bu mi ster dus kun tu ni sdug bsngal ster/ /dam pa'i byams ldan rmongs pa'i tshig las mchog gi bde ba byed cing sems can bde la rjes su chags/ /de phyir sems can don ni gcig pu nyid la mi bdag yid kyi rang bzhin med pa bsgom par bgyi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ kho bo cag ni don la brton par byed pa'i phyir 'dir yang de tsam zhig smos so/ /gzhan yang*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bla ma dam pa la gnyen bshin pa ni/ dper na 'jig rten na grogs dang nye du snying nye ba'am/ g.yog bzang po dpon la gus pa zhig gis/ lus kyis bsnyen bkur dang zhabs dog byed/ zhes 'bul/ zhing las dang*/ tshong dang*/ pho nya dang*/ dgra la 'thab pa sogs gang dgos kyi bya ba thams cad sgrub/

ngag gis snyan pa'i tshig dang*/ bstod ra dang che ba brjod/ kha 'dzin gshag 'debs sogs sgo du ma nas smra/ sems kyis kyang*/ rang gi rgyal po la sogs pa de mnga' thang mtho na/ nor che na/ tshe ring na/ byus rgyal na/ gzhan dang mi mnyam pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam par byed/ las bya thabs kyis kyang*/ pha rol po gzhan rnams mnga' 'og tu 'jug e nus dang*/ mtha' na 'brel chags tsam yang 'jug pa'i thabs byed/ rang gis kyang bza' btung nor sogs gya nom pa 'bul khral 'jal tha na lus srog tshun chod kyang de dag gi don du gtong nus kyin 'dug na/ 'jig rten pa de dag lo zla zhag po kha shas kyi mdun ma tsam 'grub pa'i phyir du/ gnyen grogs dpon rnams la de tsam du byed nus na/ bla ma ni sangs rgyas ma thob bar du gtan gyi gnyen yin/ grogs yin/ dpon yin/ mgon yin/ skyabs yin/ rang gi tshe 'di'i bde skyid snyan gsum/ tshe ring nad med longs spyod/ mis mthong sogs legs pa gang byung thams cad kyang bla ma'i sku drin dang byin rlabs yin/ gzhan yang rang la thos bsam gyi shes rab bsrung sdom gyi tshul khrims bzlas nus byin rlabs zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las gang byung thams cad kyang bla ma'i drin/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi bar du mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad dang*/ 'di phyi dus rnams thams cad du bde skyid thams cad bla ma la rag las pa yin na/ gong du smos pa de lta bu'i lus ngag yid bya byed thams cad bla ma'i phyogs su 'bungs dgos pa'ang yin/ de ltar bya snyam du bsam pa yang dgos so/ /mdor na bla ma'i sku gsung 'phrin las mngon par mtho bar smon pa tshun chad byed dgos pa yin/ de ltar na skyon la mi brtag pa dang*/ ci mdzad yon tan du shes pa dang*/ re dogs 'gog pa'i thag chod dang*/ gnyen bshin pa'i bsam pa ste/ bla ma bsten tshul gyi bsam pa bzhi po de tshang na/ mos gus lam du 'gro bar the tshom med do/

/gnyis pa sbyor ba ni/ lus ngag yid kyi spyod pa thams cad kyis bla ma mnyes pa thams cad byed/ mi dgyes pa thams cad spong bar 'dus/ de yang 'ga' zhig bla ma ni man ngag zhu ba'i sgo tsam yin gyi/ dngos grub dang byin rlabs chen po zhig bla ma las bzang ba'i yi dam mam/ mkha' 'gro sogs la zhu snyam pa byed de/ rten 'brel thams cad rtsa ba nas 'chug dngos grub ta ga la 'ong*/ des na mos gus drag po rgyun ma chad par bya/ log lta skad cig kyang mi bya/ gal te byur chags kyi log lta rang shugs la dbang med du skyes na'ang de ma thag gnyen pos sleb par byas te/ 'phral du rgyun bcad nas/ lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur du ye ma thon par byas/ ngag gi sgo nas kyang*/ dngos lkog gang du yang skur 'debs dang gshe ba sogs tshig gcig kyang mi byed/ tshig 'jam pa dang drang po bden pa phyi nang med par smra/ bla ma'i thugs su 'thad pa dang*/ rang yang yid phebs pa dang*/ tshig gsal bas gab gsang med par nang yan byas kyin zhu/ sgo thams cad nas snyan pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ che ba brjod/ bla ma'i ci gsung ba de thams cad tshad mar gzung dgos/ lus kyis kyang phyag 'bul skor ba byed/ nye ba dang ring ba'i phyag g.yog dang las kyi mtha' dang*/ pho nya rkang 'gro sogs dgos pa'i bya ba thams cad byed de/ tha na chu 'chu thal 'phyag tshun chod kyang ngo*/ /yo byad kyi sgo nas kyang*/ shin tu khyad par gyur pa nyid ces pa ltar/ dngos po bzang ba dang*/ dag pa dang*/ 'phangs pa dang*/ rang la gces pa rnams 'bul/ cung zad yid 'ong gang dang gang*/ /zhes pa ltar/ gang bla ma de nyid la mkho ba dang gang la thugs dgyes pa de 'bul te/ dngos gnas la bzang ngan gang yin yang*/ gang mkho zhing dgyes pa de ka mchod pa'i mchog tu gyur/ thugs su byon pa dang rnam par dag pa'i dngos po 'bul mi nus par/ rang la gang mi mkho tshad kyi gyang gyong ngan ngon nor ma nyan dag 'bul/ nas sogs 'bru yin na sad khyer ngan ngon dang*/

bre tshad gang chung ba nas gzhal ba'i khal grangs byed pa sogs dngos po gang nyung nyung la ming dang*/ grags gang che che nas byed pa dang*/ rta phyugs sogs gang rdzud pa dang rgan pa dang nad khyer dang*/ gos yin na rnying pa sogs nor du ma btub pa rnams nas bag re 'bul zhing*/ bzang po thams cad rang gis tshags byed par 'dug ste/ rten 'brel gyi gnad rtsa ba nas 'chugs/ dam tshig gi 'gangs la sel zhugs/ byin rlabs kyi drod yal/ 'dod don dang dngos grub nam yang 'grub pa med/ ngal ba 'bras med dang byas pa don med kyi gsang sngags pa skad chos pa'i gzugs brnyan rnams snying re rje'o/ /yang bla ma bsten tshul 'di rnams/ bla ma'i ngo bsrung ba dang*/ mi gzhan ngor chos brgyad kyi mdzes khrigs dang*/ rang gi 'dod don 'dra sgrub pa'i phyir byed na/ kha zas bzang po dug gis sbags pa 'dra/ chos su ni mi 'gro / 'ga' zhig ni rang gi don yin pa ma go nas bla ma nyid rang la dgos pa'i don gcig yin pa 'dug snyam/ yus dang ngo so kho na lhur byed de/ bla ma mnyes par byas pa ste/ slob ma rang nyid kyi don dang khe chen po thob pa de ma shes par zad do/ /de ltar bla ma bsten tshul thams cad kyi 'gag bsdu na bka' ci gsung sgrub pa la 'dus/ dgongs pa la gang yod bzhin byed par 'dus pa lags so/ /de ltar na bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di dang*/ gong gi skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed de gsum po 'di ni/ chos kyi 'gangs rang yin pas/ dmigs phran re tsam yin pas 'gangs chung ngo snyam du bsam par mi bya ste/ skyabs 'gro ni chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin/ sems bskyed ni theg chen thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam*/ mas cad kyi rtsa ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /yang bsags sbyangs tsam gyi dbang du byas na/ tshogs bsags dang sgṛb sbyong du ma gyur pa'i dge ba'i chos cung zad kyang med la/

'on kyang yig brgya'i bzlas bsgom dang*/ maṇḍal ni cho ga'i yan lag sna re tsam yin mod kyi/ 'di gnyis gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa la shin tu mkho ba dang*/ tshegs chung ngus don rgya cher 'grub pa'i thabs mkhas kyi khyad par rer snang bas/ skabs 'dir thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i dmigs pa lnga zhes 'dra mtshungs su sa bcad bsgrigs pa yin no/ /de ltar de yan chad du bshad pa rnams/ chos 'di gcig pur ma zad skyabs sems bsags sbyangs mos gus kyi khrid gang na yod pa thams cad la sbyor shes par 'tshal lo/ /skabs 'dir spyir smin byed kyi dbang bskur dgos pa las/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sam/ thugs dkyil rgyas pa la brten nas/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun tsam mam/ dbang yongs rdzogs sngar thob zin nas/ de rjes skyabs 'gro nas brtsams khrid 'bogs pa thob thang yin la/ de tsam ma nus na/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gang rung zhig tu/ sbas rgyud rnams kyi lugs kyi dbang yongs rdzogs sam bum dbang thob par bya/ dmigs bsal la skyabs sems maṇḍal gsum la dogs pa med/ yig brgya dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor la/ sngar dbang bskur ye ma thob pa la gsang sgrogs su 'gyur ram snyam na/ 'dir dmigs bsal yin pas mi 'gyur te/ gzhi de las dad pa khyad par can skye ba'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dbang bskur snga rol nas ma grub na/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro'i skabs 'di rnams gang du bskur kyang 'dra/ gsang sgrogs mi 'byung ba tsam la de dang khyad med kyang*/ spyir bskyed rim gyi sngon du byis 'jug gam/ dkyil chog phal pa'i bum dbang tsam zhig nges par gal che'o/ /de ltar thun mong gi dbang bskur ba'i rjes su/ 'khrid kyi 'phros nas skyong ba la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro zhes pa/ thun mong ma yin pa ni sbyor drug las gzhan pa'i 'khrid mang po zhig dang thun mong ma yin pa ste/

phal che ba'i don yin/ gzhan la gtan nas med ces khyab mtha' 'cha' ba min no/ /'o na sngags kyi 'khrid phal cher la yang*/ lha sgom pa dang*/ mi rtog pa dang*/ stong nyid sgom pa yod pas shas che ba la bsams kyang*/ thun mong ma yin pa zhes zer du mi rung snyam na bden mod kyi/ lha dang mi rtog bsgom pa yod pa'i 'khrid rnams phal che ba la de dag dngos gzhir byed pa yin gyi sngon 'gror mi byed pas/ 'dir lha dang mi rtog pa sngon 'gror byed pa'i sgo nas/ chos gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa nyid kyi phyir/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro'o/ /de las dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi sgom thabs bshad zin pa'i rjes sam/ ji ltar 'os par go ba cung zad brjod na/ spyir lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs 'di nyams len du byed pa la/ thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams byas nas/ de rjes shu n+yā ta sogs la 'jug pa yin/ 'dir thun gcig po de thun mong gi sngon 'gro lnga po rgyas bsdus gang yin yang rung*/ khrigs chags su bsgoms zin pa'i 'phro 'thud pa yin na shu n+yā ta ma chad nas bsgoms pas chogaskyabs sems gong gi de kas go chod/ yang 'dir skyor mi dgos/ de la rang gzhan snang grangs kyi chos 'di rnams snang yang bden pas stong pa sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ de rjes snang ba thams cad nam mkha' la 'ja' ltar yal nas sems snang med la cung zad bzhag de nas shu n+yā ta'i sngags brjod cing*/ gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi ye shes bde gshegs snying po nga yin snyam nga rgyal bskyed/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su/ bzhugs gdan padma'i 'og tu 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor ri rab dang bcas pa bsgom thub na legs/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor yin pas/ lhan skyes kyi skabs 'dir gzhal yas khang gi dod thub pa lags/ mdor bsdu na/ ma sgoms kyang lhan skyes kyi skabs 'dir cho ga chad par mi 'gyur ro/ /lhan skyes kyi go don gnyis yod de/

gcig ni gdod ma'am rtsa ba'am thog ma nyid la lhan skyes zer ba yin/ lha phyag mang zhal mang yal ga lo 'dab rgyas pa lta bu'i rtsa ba'i 'byung khungs sa bon lta bu de phyag gnyis pa yin zhes btags pa'i sgo nas bzhag ste/ 'jig rten du rtsa bar 'jog pa phal cher chung ba'am nyung ba dang*/ 'phros shing 'phel ba rnams phal cher mang ba dang che bar 'gyur bas/ skabs 'di lta bur yang lhan skyes kyi sgra zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhig la 'jogade'i yang nang nas gsang sngags pa phal la grags che ba ltar na/ gcig gcig pu la lhan cig pa'i sgra mi 'byung bas/ dpa' bo gcig pu dang*/ dpa' mo gcig pu la phal du lhan skyes mi zer bar/ phyag gnyis pa kha sbyor gyi sku can gcig la lhan skyes su grags so/ /don steng nas zhal phyag mang nyung la rgyu 'bras kyi khyad dang*/ rtsa ba dang*/ yan lag gi dbye ba'i nges pa med mod kyang*/ mtshon don gyi dbang du byas nas/ rgyu'am rtsa ba chos sku spros bral mtshon pa phyag gnyis pa dang*/ 'bras bu'am yan lag gzugs sku spros pa'i rnam pa mtshon byed zhal phyag mang po can yin par 'jog pa mang bas/ rgyu'am rtsa ba'i lha la lhan skyes zhes bya/ de ni bskyed bya rnam pa'i sgo nas lhan skyes su 'jog tshul lo/ /lhan skyes kyi go don gnyis pa ni/ bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa 'ga' zhig 'di skad ces gsung ste/ zhal phyag rnam pa'i gzugs can nyid/ /mchog tu bde ba'i gzugs med pa/ /de phyir 'gro kun lhan cig skyes/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod/ /rnam dag rnam pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rang bzhin mya ngan 'das pa nyid/ /lha yi rnam pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /bzhin lag kha dog rnam pa ni/ /skyes pa tsam gyis rnam par gnas/ /'on kyang bag chags phal pas so/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems can du ma grub na phar zhogagrub phyin chad sems kyi gnas lugs bde ba dang*/ lus kyi gnas lugs lha'i skur grub/

sems can gyi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs gsum lhan cig tu gdod ma nas yod/ de glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs nas ma shes pa la/ shu n+yā ta'i sngags don bsams pas/ dri ma tha mal ba'i lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ gdod nas grub grub pa'i ye shes lha'i sku gsung thugs de mngon du gyur par mos pa'i tshul gyi sgom pa ni/ lhan skyes sgom pa zhes bya ste/ 'di ni mos tshul dang bskyed chog gi rim pa'i sgo nas lhan skyes sgom par 'jog pa'o/ /bskyed chog 'di lta bu'i sgo nas/ lha dpa' rkyang nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyas pa'i bar du rgyas bsdus gang bsgoms kyang rung*/ lhan skyes kyi sgra don tshang mod/ 'khor can dang zhal phyag mang po can la/ lhan skyes kyi tha snyad mi 'jog pa ni/ gsang sngags pa phal cher rnams la rab tu grags pa'i tshad mas grub pa ste/ chu las skyes pa gzhan mang po yod kyang*/ padma kho na la chu skyes su brjod pa bzhin no/ /des na dpa' bo gcig pa dang*/ dpa' mo gcig pa dang*/ 'khor tshogs can la yi dam de dang de lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs su rgya cher sgrog pa ni gsang sngags kyi brda chad la rmongs par zad do/ /'dir 'chad pa'i dus 'khor lhan skyes dang*/ bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa sogs ni/ bskyed bya lha'i rnam pa dang*/ skyed chog gnyis ka'i sgo nas lhan skyes kyi tshul kho na yin la/ spyir lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs su 'jog pa la/ bskyed chog las kyang rnam pa gtso che bas/ lhan skyes la sa bon dang cho ga gsum skyed dang*/ snying po'i tshig tsam dang*/ mngon byang lnga skyed sogs sna tshogs pa 'byung ba'ang mi 'gal lo/ /dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba zhes pa ni/ 'dom gang tsam 'khor yug tu 'od zer gyi tshul la/ de phan chad du me lce kha dog sna lnga'am drug pa 'phro ba'o/

kha cig dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi zhabs 'og tu mnan pa'i lha gnyis phyag bzhi pa dang*/ lha mo gnyis kyang sgom pa ni skabs su bab pa'i dbri bkyed ma shes par mngon rtogs rgyas pa'i gral sgrig bshig ma thub pa'i skyon te/ de lta na gtso bo las gdan gzi brjid ches pa'i skyon 'byung ste/ dgra bgegs mi thul ba dang*/ bar chad sdang ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur bas de ltar mi bya la/ drag po dkar po khro nyams dang*/ stag lpags dang*/ sprul rgyan can/ mig gsum pa/ 'dod lha dmar po zhi ba dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can mig gnyis pa/ gnyis kar yang phyag gnyis phyag mtshan med pa gan kyal du gnas pa/ dran med du rgyal zhing myos pa'o/ /sku la rdo rje'i rgyan zhes pa rgyu rdo rje pha lam las grub cing rnam pa yang rdo rje'i gzugs kyis mtshan pa'o/ /dus 'khor lhan skyes 'di rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa ltar byed na/ yab yum gnyis kar rdor sems kyi dbu rgyan can dang*/ 'bras bur ltar byed na/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can yin/ dus 'khor gyi chos skad la/ rigs bdag ces pa 'khor gyi dbu la bzhugs pa'i lha'i ming yin/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbu rgyan gyi lha ni/ rang rigs mtshon byed yin kyi rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs min te/ dus 'khor la tshur rgyas 'debs kyi lha med de/ dus 'khor nyid lha gzhan thams cad la phar rgyas 'debs pa'i rigs bdag yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa 'di go nas gzhan gyi kha rgyugs dang ma 'dres par bya'o/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i tshul gyi skyed chog 'di/ gdod ma rang byung gi lha'i rnam pa lam byed yin/ rang byung gi lha de sangs rgyas kun 'dus yin pas/ thog ma nyid nas dam ye dbyer med du rang grub pa'i phyir/ go cha byin rlabs dang*/ ye shes spyan 'dren dbang bskur rgyas gdabs sogs mi dgos pas/ skabs 'dir ni de bzhin yin la/ skyed chog gzhan gyi lugs su byas na/

rnam pa lhan skyes yin yang*/ cho ga de dag byed pa'ang mi 'gal lo/ /skabs 'dir gnas drug tu yi ge drug dgod pa ni/ sgo gsum dang skye mched sogs byin rlabs gyi don ma yin/ rig drug kun 'dus pa'i brda tsam yin/ yi ge bzhi 'god na'ang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje bzhi 'dus pa'i brda yin/ de nas 'od zer spro bsdus snod bcud sbyong ba ni/ mdzad pa 'phrin las lam du byed pa yin pas/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren du 'khrul bar mi bya'o/ /'khrid kyi skabs su ni bzlas pa cung zad byed du chug kyang*/ lha sku la dmigs pa ma gtogs gzhan mi dgos la/ spyir 'di la bzlas brjod bsnyen pa sogs byed na/ snying gar zla nyi sgra gcan brtsegs pa'i steng du/ rnam bcu dbang ldan sngon po zhig bsgom ste/ 'od zer spro bsdu'i bzlas pa spyi dang mthun pa byed/ de dag las/ dang por stong nyid sgom pas ni 'chi ba sbyong*/ chos sku lam du byed/ skad cig gis bskyed pas ni/ bar do sbyongs/ longs sku lam du byed/ yi ge dgod pa dang*/ 'od zer spros bsdus ni/ skye sring dang*/ las sna tshogs byed pa sbyong sprul sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa lam du byed pa'o/ /mthar 'od gsal du bsdu zhing ldang ba ni/ phyis nying mtshams sbyor ba la ltos pa'i srid pa mtha' dag sbyong zhing*/ rang bzhin chos sku las ma g.yos bzhin du/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa mtshon pa yin no/ /spyir sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ yongs su brtags pa'i rnal 'byor/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor te gsum gsungs/ dang po bskyed rim dang*/ phyi ma gnyis rdzogs rim gyi lha sku yin/ rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor dngos ste ye shes kyi lha sku zhig la zer ba yin na'ang*/ bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor pas kyang de dang rnam pa mtshungs par bsgom pa la/ rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor zhes slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas sogs mkhas mchog rdo rje 'dzin chen rnams gsung ngo*/

/de yang skyed chog lhan skyes kyi lugs su yod na/ bskyed rim rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor der 'gyur ba yin gyi/ de min skad cig gis bskyed pa ni dkrod bskyed tsam po'o/ /skabs 'di dag tu 'di ltar yang go bar bya ste/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ bskyed rim la smad cing rdzogs rim la bsngags pa cher mdzad/ 'khor lo sdom pa las/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis ka mang po zhig gsungs kyang*/ gnyis kar gyi che ba tsam min pa gang la'ang smad pa cher med/ dgyes rdor las/ gnyis ka gsal bar bstan nas bskyed rim la bsngags pa cher mdzad/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud du/ bskyed rim 'khor bcas rgyas shing*/ rdzogs rim gab pa'i tshul du yod pa shas che/ de ltar tshig dngos bstan la ston lugs mi 'dra ba du mar byung yang*/ dgongs pa gcig ste/ bskyed rim la bstod pa rnams ni las dang po pa phal che ba la dgos shing*/ gnas skabs kyi phan yon shin tu mang ba la dgongs/ bskyed rim la smad pa rnams ni rdzogs rim rgyud la skyes zin pa dang sngar ma skyes kyang dbang po rnon po la mi dgos pa dang*/ nges don ma yin pa la dgongs/ de tsam du rgyud thams cad dgongs pa mthun mod kyang*/ dngos bstan la bstod smad kyi khyad yod pas/ rjes 'jug rnams kyang de la gtso bor byed mi byed kyi khyad cung zad yod de/ gang zag dang bstan bcos mang po zhig tu rang la gang yod pa de bstod/ rang la med pa de smod par 'dug na'ang*/ 'dir de rigs ye min/ dus 'khor las/ bsgom bya dkyil 'khor gyi rigs mang po dang*/ skyed tshul cho ga shin tu rgyas pa sogs rgyas bsdus mang po dang*/ cho ga las tshogs thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub tshul shin tu gsal zhing zhi ba la rgyas te/ rgyud gcig nas bskyed rim gyi phyogs dus 'khor nas rgyas par bshad pa tsam gzhan phal cher la med do/ /de la rgyud 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi rnam gzhag mtha' yas pa gsungs pa las/

gtso che shos ni sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor yin/ gzhan yang sdom pa che chung dang*/ gsang 'dus dang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba la sogs pa mang ngo*/ /dang po la/ ye shes le'ur/ dpal ldan rgyu skar gyi nang na/ dus 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la lha stong dang drug yod pa dang*/ sgrub le'i dngos bstan gsung dbang gi dkyil 'khor la lha drug brgya so drug yod pa dang*/ nang ler padma gdan can 'ba' zhig pa lha tshogs brgya lnga bcu rtsa bdun pa yang gsungs/ de las bsdus pa/ thugs dkyil rgyas bsdus gnyis dang*/ bcu bdun ma dang*/ bcu gsum ma dang*/ lha dgu dang*/ lha lnga'i bar du dkyil 'khor gyi rim pa dang*/ gtso rkyang la yang phyag mang dang*/ lhan skyes dang*/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i bar du yod pa las/ bskyed rim gtso bor byed mkhan yin na/ bsgom bya dkyil 'khor dang*/ skyed chog bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi byed pa gtso che ba yin yang*/ skabs 'dir ni/ lhag pa'i lha'i byin rlabs pa'i don dang*/ rim pa gnyis cha tshang ba'i don dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi rgyud sbyangs pa'i phyir du/ bskyed rim cung zad sgom pa ma gtogs/ gtso bor rdzogs rim nyid la sgril ba'i skabs yin pas/ lhan skyes kho na bsngags par bzhed cing*/ brgyud pa nas brgyud par sgom pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun dang ldan pa yang yin no/ /dus 'dir bskyed rim gyi spros pa cher byas kyang*/ skabs kyi don rdzogs rim la 'phral du 'jug dgos pa las phyir phyogs par 'gyur bas spros pa spang par bya'o/ /da ni spyi ldog nas go ba cung zad bshad na/ gzhan yang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i lam gyi ngo bo ni/ gzhi sgrib bral du byed pa'i lam khyad par can zhes bya ba ste/ sbyangs gzhi bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po la/ sbyang bya glo bur gyi dri ma spong ba'i sbyong byed lam de yang*/ gzhi 'khor ba'i las nyon sdug bsngal rnams kyi rigs rgyun lam bde ba chen por bsgyur te sgom pa'i don no/

/de la dbye na lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis te/ bskyed rim ni rnam par rtog pas bskyed pa'i don dang*/ rdzogs pa ni rang byung du shar ba'i don no/ /de gnyis kyi tshad ma ni/ rgyud las/ lha yi dmigs pa gang yin mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag pa rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur ba ste/ /mngon sum dag ni de nyid sbyor bas mkha' la skar ma bzhin du du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /mngon sum med na rjes su dpag pa shi ba'i lus bzhin de nyid min pa yis ni brtags pa gang*/ /de ni ri mo sogs la blta bya yongs su ma smin blo can rnal 'byor rnams kyis bsgom pa'i don/ /zhes gsungs te/ bskyed rim rtog bcas nyid kyi phyir rjes dpag gi rim pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi dmigs pa'i yul blos gsar du brtags pa la ma rags par mngon sum du snang ba'i tshul la 'jug pa'i phyir mngon sum lam byed do/ /rim pa gnyis po de'i mtshan nyid dang khyad chos ni/ cho ga'i khyad par rgyud las gsungs pa'i skyed chog tshang ba/ rang 'bras kyi khyad par sngags kyi mthu skyed nus pa/ ngo bo'i khyad par zhu bde dang stong nyid kyi rang bzhin/ byed las kyi khyad par dag rdzogs smin gsum tshang ba ste/ khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'i lha sku rnam par rtog pa'i brtags pa ni/ bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor yin la/ rgyu'i khyad par rdo rje lus la gnad du bsnun pa/ byed las kyi khyad par rtsa rlung thig le dbu mar dag byed/ rnam pa'i khyad par bde ba dang stong gzugs lhan cig pa ste/ khyad par gsum ldan gyi mi rtog pa'i lam de ni rdzogs rim mo/ /grangs nges pa ni/ dgos pa la ltos pa'i grangs nges te/ skye ba kun rdzob bden pa lam du byed pa la bskyed rim dang*/ 'jig pa don dam bden pa lam du byed pa la rdzogs rim dgos pa dang*/ don dam gnas lugs kyi lam la 'jug pa'i rgyud sbyang ba dang*/ byang nas gnas lugs sgom pa dngos gnyis yod pa las/

dang po ni bskyed rim dang phyi ma ni rdzogs rim yin te/ rdzogs rim gyi ye shes skye ba la/ rgyud sbyang ba'i thabs thun mong ma yin pa zhig sngon du gtong dgos pa shas che ba'i phyir ro/ /rdo rje snying 'grel las/ rnam rtog rgya ru chud pa yi/ /'gro ba gsum po rnam gzigs nas/ /ji lta ji ltar grol gyur pa/ /de dang de yi thabs bstan no/ /rnam rtog bag chags kyis bcings la/ /thog mar rtog pa'i cho ga bstan/ /rnam rtog rang bzhin shes pa na/ /mi rtog pa la 'jug par bya/ /zhes gsungs de kho nas go rim nges pa yang grub ste/ snying 'grel las/ dang por re zhig zhing dag phyir/ khre tshe rnams ni btab par gyur/ /phyi nas dag pa'i zhing la ni/ /sa la'i 'bras ni 'debs pa'o/ /zhes dpe gsungs te/ rdzogs rim gyi ye shes skyes phyin chad dmigs bsal re re tsam ma gtogs/ bskyed rim sgom pa la dgos pa chen po med pa'i phyir/ bskyed rim sgom phyin chad/ dmigs bsal ma gtogs rdzogs rim gyi sngon du sgom dgos par grub bo/ /bskyed rim brtan pa thob nas rdzogs rim bsgom pa dang*/ brtan pa ma thob rung ci rigs pa bsgoms nas rdzogs rim la 'jug pa dang*/ thun stod la bskyed rim sgom/ thun smad la rdzogs rim sgom pa sogs gang byas kyang dgos don 'grub bo/ /rim gnyis kyi dgos pa ni/ las chen bcu gnyis sogs 'phrin las sna tshogs dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub 'grub pa ni bskyed rim dang*/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'grub pa ni rdzogs rim gyi dgos pa'o/ /dbang lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa la sbyar na/ byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun bskyed rim gyi smin byed dang*/ dbang gong ma rdzogs rim gyi smin byed yin/ lam ma dag sa bdun gyi rten 'brel byis 'jug dang bskyed rim gyis sgrib par byed/ dag pa sa gsum gyi rten 'brel rdzogs rim dang dbang gong ma las 'byung ba yin/
