'bras bu gzugs kyi sku bskyed rim dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i sku rdzogs rim dang sbyor ro/ /'dir lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs lta bu bsdus pa 'di rigs rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du sbyor na/ lha bsgom pa sor bsam gyi sngon 'gro/ sngags bzlas pa srog 'dzin gyi sngon 'gro/ shu n+yā ta'i sngags don rjes dran gyi smin byed/ 'od zer spro bsdu dang 'od gsal du 'jug ldang byed pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa'i rten du 'gyur zhes bya la/ yongs nas chos sbyor ba yan lag drug la 'di rgyud nyi tshe ba re la phyogs su lhung ba ma yin/ rgyud mtha' dag gi nges don nyid yin pa'i phyir/ rten bskyed pa'i rim pa yang*/ lha dus 'khor kho na la brten dgos par ma nges te/ spyir lha sku'i rnam rtog gis tha mal gyi rnam rtog sbyong ba nyid don gyi gtso bo yin pas/ bskyed rim gyi tha snyad 'jug mi 'jug la rag ma lus/ lhag pa'i lha sku gang bsgoms kyang don 'grub ste/ dper na dpe med 'tsho'i lugs 'dzin pa spyi khyab rnams dang*/ sgos su nags rin gyi rjes 'brang rnams sbyor drug gi sngon 'gror kha sarba ṇa bsgom pa bzhin no/ khyad par du yang*/ gsang 'dus sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum/ sgyu thod gdan gsum/ bde dgyes la sogs pa 'khor lo'i gtso bo kha sbyor gyi rnam pa can rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa dang*/ de bzhin du dpa' bo gcig pa dang*/ rdo rje phag mo dang*/ bdag med ma la sogs pa 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma/ yum rkyang gi tshul can rnams sam/ tha na bla med las 'byung ba'i las rgyas pa'i lhas kyang mi rung ba ma yin no/ /de bzhin du ye shes mgon po nag po chen po la sogs pa yang*/ sgrub tshul bka' sdod ltar sgrub pa ma yin par bdag bskyed yi dam ltar sgrub pa la ni rung ste/ rtsod dus las kyang ches rtsod dus kyi tha mar grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i sa brnyes pa/

zhi ba sbas pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs las kyang*/ bzhi pa lnga pa de rjes su/ /yan lag drug ldan slob dpon 'dod/ /ces nag po chen po bskyed rim la yan lag drug gi rdzogs rim sbyor bar gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /des na tsar tsi kā la sogs pa gsung gi rnal 'byor ma dang*/ tshes kyi lha bden bral la sogs pa yang 'jig rten pa rnam par sbyangs pa'i ye shes kyi lha sku yin pa'i phyir/ mgon po nag po dang 'dra'o/ / gzhan yang 'di ltar go dgos te/ bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud gsum la mchog sgrub/ thun mong sgrub/ las tshogs sgrub pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang yin yang*/ bskyed rim dngos dang rjes mthun gang yang mi 'jog pa dang*/ bla med kyi dkyil 'khor mngon rtogs rim pa rgyas pa rnams/ bskyed rim dngos yin pa la dogs pa med kyang*/ sgrub thabs phra mo rnams la bskyed rim gyi mtshan nyid ji bzhin ma tshang yang*/ bskyed rim gyi sder gtogs pa'i phyir/ de dag gi bsam gtan la yang bskyed rim zhes brjod de rjes mthun pa'o/ /'di dag la 'chi bar skye gsum dang*/ sku gsum sogs sbyang bya sbyong byed cung zad rtsi dgos shing*/ dmigs pa dang cho ga'i rim pa 'di dag dang 'dra yang*/ rgyud sde 'og ma la brten pa rnams la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dag sbyor de 'dra mi rtsi ste/ de gnyis 'dra ba las dag sbyor rtsi na rtsi mnyam dang*/ mi sbyor na mi sbyor mnyam dgos thang pa la/ bla med nas gsungs pa la sbyor/ cig shos de la mi sbyor ba'i khyad par ci snyam na/ 'di la rig pa'i sgo nas rgyu mtshan bsam par mi nus kyang*/ bla med kyi bskyed rim la sbyang bya srid pa'i rim pa dang sbyor tshul/ rgyud dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ grub thob rnams kyi gzhung las bshad la/ rgyud sde 'og ma'i cho ga rgyas pa la yang*/ sbyang bya 'khor ba la sbyor ba dang*/

lam gong ma'i smin byed du bshad pa tshang thub pa'i rgyud gzhung rnying pa gang nas kyang med do/ /rgyu mtshan des cho ga rgyas pa rnams la lung gis grub cing*/ sgrub thabs phra mo rnams ni de dang de'i sder gtogs pas/ de dag la yang*/ dag rdzogs smin gsum sbyor mi sbyor gyis khyad 'byung ba yin te/ gtso bo gang la 'jug pa de la 'khor rnams rjes su spyod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na/ rdo rje gur las gsungs pa'i 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs sgom na/ 'chi bar skye gsum sbyong stobs che/ rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gyur tshabs che/ spyod rgyud lugs kyi 'byung 'dul gyi sgrub thabs bsgoms kyang*/ spyod thabs dang smin tshabs chung ba ni/ rgyud gsungs pa po de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis/ gdul bya so so'i skal ba dang 'tshams par/ dgongs pa ji ltar brtad pa de dang de 'byung ba'i nus mthu las byung ba yin pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yis grub pa'o/ /yang rgyud sde 'og ma'i mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor la yang*/ bskyed rdzogs kyi tha snyad sbyor mkhan mang du byung ba rnams/ tha snyad sbyor tshul de mi 'thad mod kyang*/ phyogs mtshungs tsam yin pa'i phyir/ don la brton pa'i dbang du byas na/ skyon chen po'ang med pas/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig nga rgyal dang sdang shugs kyis smra ba mang du byed de/ che thang du 'bad pas 'gog dgos pa'i bya ba ma yin no/ /de ltar na lha'i rnal 'byor rigs mtha' dag skabs 'dir 'jug kyang*/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo zhig bsgom na mchog yin zhing*/ de la lha dpa' bo gcig pas kyang thabs shes zung 'jug mtshon mi nus pa ma yin la/ rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa yum rkyang mang po zhig gzhan pas ches zab pa'i gnas skabs kyang mang po 'dug mod kyang*/ spyir btang la thabs shes kha sbyor du sgom pa zab bo zhes/ rgyu mtshan dang bcas te gsang sngags pa kun la grags pa ltar/

re zhig 'dir yang khas blangs te dkyus ltar sgom pa yin no/ /de las kyang skabs 'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo nyid bsngags te/ rgyud sde mthar thug gi lha yin pa dang*/ rdzogs rim 'di yang*/ dus 'khor gyi bskyed rim gang du gsungs pa'i rgyud der/ ma sbas shing gsal la rgyas pa rtsal du bton nas gsungs pas/ bskyed rdzogs 'brel chags pa sogs rgyu mtshan 'ga' zhig kyang yod mod/ gtso bor rdzogs rim gyi 'khrid tshul 'di dang brgyud pa gcig cing*/ byin rlabs kyi bka' babs gcig tu 'dres pa'i dbang dang rgyud bshad ni dus 'khor kho na yin pas bskyed rim kyang dus 'khor bsgoms na/ rgyud pa thun tshags bsdus pa tsam ma yin par/ rkang chen po sel med par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ chos 'di nyid kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len dang byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma nyams pa de yang 'di nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rim gnyis thun mong gi go don dang*/ bskyed rim gyi don rgyas pa rnams skabs 'dir bshad mi dgos shing*/ bshad mi lang bas 'dir mi spro'o/ /rang lugs kyi skyes bu dam pa grub thob dbus pa'i khrid yig na bskyed rim gyi 'khrid med de khong rang gi nyams myong dang dbang po rnon po'i dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa dben gsum gyi skabs 'dir/ khrid yig dkyus su bshad pa kho nas kyang dmigs pa go don dang bcas pa legs par 'grub pa yod cing*/ dmigs pa 'bogs pa'i sngon rol du'am/ yang na dmigs pa ni phogamun 'khrid lam bcur gong du dmigs pa sbyong ba'i skabs go ba zhib par bskyed pa'i phyir/ spros bshad cung zad byed na/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i lugs kyi mchog dbang gong ma bzhi sngar gtan nas ma thob na/ 'khrid kyi dngos gzhi ston du ye mi rung la/ dben gsum tsam rang ston du rung tsam yin mod kyang*/ phyag len du dben gsum gyi mun 'khrid dang*/ sor sdud kyi dmigs pa dang po sbrel te sgom pa'i lugs yin pas/

de gnyis kyi bar du spros pa chung ba lag len bde bas/ gong ma rnams dkyus kyi phyag len la bskyed rim dang dben gsum gyi bar 'dir mchog dbang gong ma bskur ba nyid gtso bor phyag len du 'debs/ spyir dben gsum dang dngos gzhi'i bar du mchog dbang byas kyang legs mod/ rnam pa gcig tu na/ dben gsum yang sor sdud sogs dngos gzhi rnams kyi sbyor ba thun mong ma yin pa yin pas/ dngos gzhir gtogs su rung ste de'i phyir mchog dbang gong ma skabs 'dir bskur ba nyid thob thang yang yin no/ /sngar lar nas mchog dbang ma thob na bskur dgos pa lta ci smos/ snga rol dus gzhan du lan mang por thob kyang*/ slar yang skabs 'dir byin rlabs sgo 'byed kyi don dang*/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can 'phral du skyed pa'i don du dbang gong ma slar yang bskur dgos te/ 'di ma smin pa smin byed kho na'i dbang ma yin/ ye shes ma bskyed pa skyed par byed pa'i dbang yang yin pas so/ /mkhas pa kha cig 'khrid kyi dbang 'di la/ khong pa rang tsho dbang gong chen gyi ming can du bzhed pa'i rig ma bcu dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bar bzhed de/ 'di ni rdzogs rim nyan pa dang sgom pa'i don tsam du bskur ba yin gyi 'chad pa sogs kyi don du dgos pa ma yin pa dang*/ dbang de ni rdo rje slob dpon du 'os pa kho na la slob dpon chen po'i gnas thob pa'i phyir/ bskur bar bya rgyu kho na yin par rgyud 'grel nyid las gsal zhing bsnyon du med pa'i phyir skabs 'dir dbang de bskur ba ni skabs su ma bab bo/ /da ni dben gsum gang du bsgom pa'i gnas la/ mdo sde rgyan las/ blo ldan gang du sgrub pa'i yul/ /legs par rnyed dang gnas bzang dang*/ /sa bzang ba dang grogs bzang dang*/ /rnal 'byor bde ba'i yon tan ldan/ /zhes gsungs te/ zas gos gnas mal sogs 'tsho ba'i yo byad chos mthun mang nyung ran pa tsam rnyed sla ba dang*/

sangs rgyas byang sems skyes bu dam pas bzhugs pa'i gnas sam/ nyams dga' zhing rang gi yid 'thad pa'i gnas bzang ba dang*/ sa bsil drod dang*/ chu'i skyon sogs kyis lus la nad kyi gnod pa mi skye bas sa bzang ba dang*/ shin tu dben pa chom rkun gcan gzan sogs kyi 'jigs pa med pa bsam gtan gyi tsher mar 'gyur ba'i sgra dang*/ ku co med pa ni rnal 'byor ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par 'jog pa la/ gnod pa med pas bde ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /gang na sa skyong chos ldan sogs la/ yul de'i rgyal po dkar po dge ba'i chos la mi dga' na/ sgrub pa byed pa la gnod pa mang du 'byung zhing*/ rgyal po rang nyid dkar po'i chos la dga' yang*/ rgyal khrims kyi chos dang mi ldan na/ 'khor gyi gnod pa 'byung*/ yul 'khor gyi skye bo rnams mi bde na/ 'tsho ba dkon zhing chom rkun sogs 'phel sa 'dzin te rgyal po phan tshun 'thab rtsod du gyur pa'i phyogs su/ 'jigs pa dang nyer 'tshe du ma 'byung nyen yod cing*/ dngos su gnod pa ma byung yang*/ sems mi bde zhing rnam g.yeng mang*/ ting nge 'dzin mi 'grub pas/ yul phyogs bde zhing 'thab rtsod med la rgyal po dge ba can khrims gtsang ba'i chab 'og tu gnas pa dgos zhes pa yin te/ 'dis sa phyogs de na gnas pa'i mi dang dus skabs kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ gong gi blo ldan sogs gnas rang gi mtshan nyid ston pa yin no/ /spyir dge sbyor ma skyes pa thams cad rang gi blo las su ma rung ba dang*/ grogs po ngan pa dang 'grogs pas lan/ gnas kyi ma btub nas dge sbyor ma byung ba tsam med/ yang zhag shas zla shas tsam sdod pa'i gnas la/ mtshan nyid tsam brtsi mi dgos/ brtan pa thob pa la rgyun ring sdod sa la'ang khyad chen po med pas/ las dang po pa rnams gnas gcig tu yun ring sdod pa'i dbang du byas nas/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid kyang zhib mor gsungs pa yin no/ /'dir dben gsum bya ba/

gsang 'dus rim lnga pa'i dben gsum dang sgrig dgos pa min/ brgyud pa 'di nyid rang gi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag phyin ci ma log pa'i gsung rgyun la grags/ rigs ldan sprul sku kun spangs chen pos gsal bar yi ger bkod pa'o/ /dben gsum zhes pa'i sgra bshad tsam la ni rim lnga dang 'di phal cher 'dra ste/ rim lngar yang*/ lus ngag yid gsum tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pas dben pa'i don la 'chad cing*/ 'dir yang lus bya byed kyis dben pa/ ngag smras brjod kyis dben pa/ sems rnam rtog gis dben pa/ zhes pa'i don 'chad pas so/ /dben gsum zhes pa'i ming gang la 'jug pa'i mtshan gzhi ngos 'dzin lugs mi 'dra mod kyang*/ tha snyad cig kho na don du ma la 'jug pa shin tu mang ba'i phyir mi 'dra ba la 'gal ba cung zad kyang med do/ /spyir 'di rdzogs rim dngos gzhi'i skabs/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgom gyis rdo rje lus la gnad du bsnun pa zhig dgos kyin yod pa las/ de'i nang tshan mi rtog pa'i cha shas sgos su sgrub pa ste/ thog ma nyid du byed dgos te/ mi rtog pas lus la gnad du bsnun pa la mi rtog pa thog mar 'grub dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /des na ye shes rdo rje spyi khyab tu btang nas/ rdzogs rim dngos gzhi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i nyams len du 'dus la/ de'i sngon 'gror yang sems dben pa gcig por ma zad/ lus ngag dben pa'ang dgos te/ 'bras bu rgyu'i rjes su 'gro ba'i rig pas/ dngos gzhi 'bras bu'i tshul de la/ rdo rje gsum gyi dag sbyor yod pas/ sngon 'gro rgyu'i tshul la yang*/ rdo rje gsum gyi dbye ba dgos so/ /des na gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud kyi lus ngag sems rnams sogs lung drang ba'i don/ sems kyi ngo bo rnam par mi rtog pa de la/ dmigs pa rnam rtog gi spros pa mi dmigs pa dang*/ dmigs pa'i yul gang la'ang mi gnas/ ting nge 'dzin mnyam bzhag gi rig don tha dad du byed pa'i mtshan ma thams cad nub pas mnyam pa nyid de ka re zhig rnal 'byor pa rang gi lus ngag sems gsum gyi steng du tshul de ltar bsgom pa ste/

tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid gsum du 'dzin pa dbyings su 'gags par byas pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi gnas lugs sgom pa'am/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lam bsgom pa yin no/ /zhes pa'o/ /de nyid la ltos med bzhi ldan zhes kyang bya ste/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'grel nyid kyi brda chad dang dgongs pa'o/ /de ltar yang rgyud las/ bdud rtsi lnga la sogs dang chu gter rdo rje rnams dang sngags kyi bzlas pa sogs kyis bsnyen pa ste/ /so sor sdud pa sogs dang rdo rje padma las skyes bdud rtsi yis ni nye ba'i sgrub par 'gyur/ /dga' ba la sogs rnams kyi rdo rje gsum dang chu skyes ro mnyam gyur pa sgom pa sgrub par 'gyur/ /shes rab sbyar la gang tshe 'pho med phra mo'i rnal 'byor dag las nges par sgrub pa chen por 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs nas/ spyir rdzogs rim dngos gzhi la bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i dbye ba mdzad pa mang mod kyang skabs 'dir ni rdzogs rim gyi sngon 'gro dngos gzhi sbrags pa la/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi tshar gcig brtsi dgos pa las/ sngon 'gro ltos med bzhi ldan ni bsnyen pa/ dngos gzhi sor bsam srog 'dzin rnams nyer sgrub/ rjes dran sgrub pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin sgrub chen du 'jog pas/ sngon 'gro la gcig dang dngos gzhi la gsum du byas pa'o/ /rgyud tshig gsal po 'di yod pas dben gsum mam/ ltos med bzhi ldan gyi 'khrid 'di/ logs su mi dgos so gal chung ngo snyam du sems shing spong ba ni nyams len gyi skabs su gnad gal po che chad par ma zad yang yang kha nas 'don pa'i rgyud tshig 'di'i don tsam la yang gzhig 'brel ma bcug pa'i hol chod yin no/ /de las skabs 'dir dgos pa ni/ tshig rkang dang po yin la/ 'di'i don 'chad pa ni dri med 'od las/ 'dir las dang po pas dang por sgrub thabs kyi cho gas bsnyen pa bya ste/ bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pas bsnyen pa zhes pa la/

phyi rol tu bdud rtsi lnga ni/ bshad pa la sogs pa dang*/ sogs pa'i sgras go ku la sogs pa ste lha mnyes pa'i don du de rnams zab bsnyen pa'o/ /nang du bdud rtsi lnga ni/ phung po lnga ste sogs pa'i sgras dbang po lnga ni sgron ma lnga'o/ /de rnams la ltos pa med pa ni bsnyen pa ste/ lus dang rdzas la sred pa yongs su spangs pa'o/ /bsnyen pa des lha rnams mchog ster bar 'gyur gyi bshang ba la sogs zos pas ni ma yin no/ /chu gter rdo rje rnams dang zhes pa ni/ lus kyi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa dang*/ ngag gi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa dang*/ sems kyi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa dang*/ 'pho ba'i longs spyod la ltos pa med pa ni bsnyen pa ste/ lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ sems dang*/ tshangs par spyod pa'i sdom pa'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /'dis lha rnams mchog ster bar 'gyur gyi srid pa'i longs spyod la zhen pas ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di la mkhas pa kha cig ltos med drug ldan gyi tha snyad mdzad cing*/ sor sdud nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro yin gsung na/ ltos med drug tu mdzad pa ni/ 'grel chen gyi tshig zur dang 'grig pas legs pa'ang yin la/ 'di las sor sdud kyi yan lag kyang rim pas 'byung bas don la mi 'gal mod/ rnam gzhag 'jog pa'i skabs sor sdud kho na'i sngon 'gror bzhed pa ni mi legs pas rang lugs kyi bla ma rnams yan lag drug po thun mong gi sngon 'gror bzhed pa nyid don la gnas so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dngos gzhi yan lag drug po rdo rje bzhi'i rnal 'byor yin pas/ de'i gzhi 'dings pa'i sngon 'gro la yang ltos med bzhi po dgos pas chu gter rdo rje zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lus kyi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa sor bsam sku rdo rje rnal 'byor/ de bzhin du ngag la ltos med srog 'dzin gsung dang*/ sems la ltos med rjes dran thugs dang*/

'pho ba'i longs spyod la ltos pa med pa ting nge 'dzin ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi gzhi 'dings pa'i sngon 'gro yin pas/ sor sdud kho na'i sngon 'gro la sbyor rgyu min no/ /ltos med la yang don gyis rnam grangs drug gsungs 'dug mod kyang*/ phung po lnga dang*/ dbang po lnga la ltos pa med pa gnyis po ltos med bzhir ma 'dus pa med cing*/ ltos med bzhi la rdo rje bzhi'i brdas bstan pas/ grangs bzhi'i sgo nas 'chad pa nyid gtso bo yin par gsal la/ rnam grangs drug so sor gsungs pa'i dgos pa ni/ dper na yi dam lha cig bskyed rim gyi sgo nas sgrub na/ dngos gzhi rdo rje bzhi lam byed bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi bsgom/ cha lag tu mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ bza' ston sogs bza' ba'i dam tshig rnams sgrub/ sngags kyi bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul ba'i sgo nas bsnyen pa byed dgos pa bzhin du/ 'dir yang rdzogs rim gyi lha'i bsnyen pa dben gsum 'di la/ dngos gzhi nyams len ltos med bzhi dang*/ mchod gtor dang*/ bza' ba'i dam tshig gi dod phung dbang gi ltos med gnyis dang*/ bzlas pa'i dod tha mal rags pa'i rlung sbyong ba zhig dgos par gsungs so/ /des na rdzogs rim gyi sngon 'gro'i nyams len la/ bskyed rim gyi de dang de'i dod tshang tshul bshad pas/ ltos med kyi rnam grangs drug byung na'ang*/ don gyi rnam grangs dbye sgo sde tshan gnyis yar bsdu mar bsdu byas pa las drug byung ba tsam du zad kyi/ dbye sgo gcig dang dkyus thog gcig la drug bgrong rgyu ma yin tai/ de ltar yin na bdud rtsi lnga la sogs dang chu gter rdo rje zhes mi gsung par/ bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa drug po zhes gsung dgos par 'gyur ro/ /dper brjod na yang sde tshan gcig la bram rigs rgyal rigs rje rigs dmangs rigs zhes mi rigs bzhi bshad/ rnam grangs gzhan du phyug po'i rigs dang dbul po'i rigs zhes mi rigs gnyis bshad na/

de gnyis bsdoms te mi rigs drug gi tha snyad byas kyang ches legs pa ma yin pa bzhin te/ spyir dbye sgo tha dad pa'i dbye ba'i yan lag rnams gcig tu bsres te/ rnam grangs su bgrong ba la yang 'gal ba med pas 'dir yang ltos med drug gi tha snyad rang ta mi 'gog cing*/ sa bcad drug tshan sgrig pa'i legs cha tsam 'dug kyang ltos med kyi ngo bo mi 'dra ba drug yod do snyam/ bzhir ma 'dus so snyam pa'i 'khrul gzhi skye nyen che bas/ re zhig ltos med bzhi ldan kho na'i tha snyad bya'o/ /de ltar na yang skabs 'di dag tu nyams len dmigs pa'i ngo bo dang go rim la/ jo zhal gnyis mi 'dra ba'i khyad par med pas rtsod pa mi dgos kyang*/ ltos med kyi rnal 'byor 'di rdzogs rim spyi dang sor sdud kho na'i sngon 'gro gang du 'gro tshul dang*/ ltos med bzhi drug gi tha snyad 'jog tshul la/ dpal jo nang pa'i lugs 'di ka ches brling ngo*/ /ltos med de dag gi don ni/ rang lugs la gces par mi 'dzin pas gzugs phung dang*/ 'phral bde sdug gi dbang du mi gtong bar bsgom pas tshor ba dang*/ rnam rtog spong bas 'du shes dang*/ sgo gsum las med du 'jog pas 'du byed dang*/ rnam shes lnga'i rjes su rnam rtog mi 'brang bas rnam shes kyi phung po la ltos pa med pa'o/ /dbang po lnga la ltos pa med pa yang rnam shes kyi ltos med 'di las phye ba yin te/ gzugs kyi snang ba ma shar na der zad/ mig shes la dngos su gzugs snang shar yang rung*/ yid yul du gzugs kyi rnam par shar yang rung*/ mdzes pa la ma chags mi mdzes pa la mi sdang*/ bar ma la yang dngos por mi 'dzin/ gzugs snang shar ba tsam ma gtogs/ rnam rtog gi blang dor dang 'dzin pa gang yang mi byed pa ni/ mig gi dbang po la ltos pa med pa ste/ de bzhin du sgra dri ro reg la sbyar bas/ rna ba sna lce lus kyi dbang po la ltos pa med pa'o/

/lus kyi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa ni/ rnam grangs gcig tu na zas gos sogs lus kyi longs spyod mthun rkyen 'dzom na sgom nus ting nge 'dzin skye/ de dag ma 'dzom na sgom mi nus/ sems kyi tsher ma'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin mi skye na/ gang zag de'i dge sbyor de/ lus kyi longs spyod la ltos pa can du song*/ 'di'i rigs la mthun rkyen de 'bad pas bsgrubs na ni/ g.yeng bas khyer te dge sbyor bde skabs mi yong*/ 'bad med du 'byung ba ni shin tu dkon pas/ kho'i dge sbyor de rkyen khar las pas yong mi yong the tshom zab las phal du mi yong ba shas che/ lan gcig byung kyang rkyen ma 'dzom na sgom 'chor bas/ lus kyi longs spyod la ltos pa can gyi dge sbyor gyis rtag mi thub bo/ /des na rkyen bzang ngan la khyad med du bsres te 'byor ba dang ldan yang bza' btung mgron 'bod sogs kyi rnam g.yeng mi byed par blo thag bcad de bsgom/ dbul zhing 'phongs kyang tsha grang bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal khyad du bsad/ zas gos gnas mal ngan ngon gyis chog shes par byas/ dka' ba dang du blangs te bsgoms pas/ gang zag de'i dge sbyor de lus kyi longs spyod bzang ngan dang yod med la ltos pa med pas/ de la sgom skye bar the tshom med/ rkyen la rag ma las pa'i phyir/ sgom skyes nas kyang mi nyams shing mgo thon pa mthar phyin par 'ong bas longs spyod 'dzom ma 'dzom la ltos pa med pa'i don du 'chad pa ltar yin/ des mtshon pa'i ngag gi longs spyod ni/ gtam snyan mi snyan dang*/ rang la gzhan gyi stod smad dang*/ rang gi ngag la gzhan gyi nyan mi nyan sogs yin la/ de dag la ltos pa med tshul gong dang 'dra/ yid kyi longs spyod ni/ yid dga' ba dang*/ spro ba dang*/ skyo shas dang sems gcod dang*/ re ba dang*/ dogs pa dang*/ gnyen la 'dod chags dgra la gnod sems/ rang la nga rgyal la sogs pa'i ro myang zhing*/

rnam rtog de dag dang du len pa yin la/ de dag gi 'khri ba bcad/ ro mi myong*/ de dag gi dbang du mi btang bar dge sbyor la 'gril ba ni/ ltos pa med pa'i don te gong dang 'dra'o/ /yang rnam grangs gnyis pa longs spyod la ltos pa med pa'i go don gyi gtso bo ni/ longs spyod bya ba longs spyod bya'i yul dang*/ longs spyod pa po'i gang zag dang*/ ji ltar longs spyod pa'i tshul gsum ga la 'jug cing*/ bltos pa med pa'i don zhen pa med cing 'dzin pa med pa'i don yin pas/ longs spyod pa po dbang po rten dang bcas pa'i rang gi lus/ longs spyad bya'i yul lus kyi bde sdug dang*/ bde sdug 'byung ba'i rkyen zas gos khang pa nor rdzas yul zhing*/ dgra gnyen dug dang*/ mtshon cha dang*/ tsha grang gi rkyen la sogs pa sna tshogs pa rnams dang*/ ji ltar longs spyod pa'i tshul/ 'gro sdod/ nyal ldang*/ len 'jog brdeg 'tshog sogs lus kyi spyod lam rnams yin te/ de thams cad gnas skabs su mi rtag cing mi brtan la/ g.yas med 'gangs chung 'ba' zhig yin pa'i phyir/ chags sdang spang blang byed rin yang mi chog don du ni dngos po la cung zad yang ma grub pa'i 'khrul snang 'ba' zhig yin pa'i phyir/ chags rgyu dang*/ sdang rgyu dang*/ phan 'dogs rgyu dang*/ gnod par byed rgyu rang yang ma grub pas thams cad yul stong par shes pas/ blos tsam bzhag tu bsgyur nas bya byed spangs te mnyam par 'jog pa'i don yin/ de bzhin du ngag dang yid la'ang sbyar te/ de'i tshe lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya byed rang gis kyang mi byed/ gzhan byed pa la blo yang mi 'jug bya ba cig 'ong*/ de dag bsdoms pas gang la'ang bdag po mi byed/ byar med las med du 'jog bya ba zhig 'ong bas/ lus kyi longs spyod la ltos pa med pa dang*/ lus bya byed kyis dben pa'i lus dben gnyis don gcig de bzhin du ngag dang yid la'ang rigs 'gre'o/

/'pho ba'i longs spyod la ltos pa med pa ni/ theg le byang chub kyi sems 'dzag pa ni 'pho ba/ zhes bya ba yin pas/ dngos su thig le ma nyams par srung dgos/ de'i longs spyod la ltos pa med pa ni mtha' rgya bkyed nas/ re zhig gnyis sbyor gyi 'dod chags la brten pa'i rnam rtog gi rigs gang yang yid la mi byed/ gal te rang shugs su blo la shar na'ang*/ dang du mi len par de ma thag 'phro gcod pa'o/ /'di la spyir lus ngag yid gsum char gyi cha shas yod kyang*/ thig le 'pho ba'i gnas skabs kyi chags rtog 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin pas logs su bcad pa yin/ des na ltos med bzhi ru 'jog skabs su thig le 'pho ba'i lus kyi bya ba ma yin pa'i lus kyi longs spyod la 'dzin zhen spangs pa ni/ lus la ltos med yin/ des ngag dang yid la'ang 'gre/ thig le 'pho ba'i bya bar gtogs pa'i lus ngag yid kyi bya ba la 'dzin zhen spong ba ni/ ltos med bzhi pa yin gyi dang po gsum la mi bgrong ste/ chos 'di la bzhi pa rtsal du 'don dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ thig le 'pho ba dang 'brel ma 'brel la lus ngag yid kyi bya ba tsam du mtshungs kyang*/ ngo bo dang rnam pa yang mi 'dra ba'i khyad che zhing*/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba yin min dang sgrib pa sbyong dka' sla'i khyad par shin tu che bas nges par logs su bgrangs pa'o/ /dben pa gsum gyi skabs su/ dben pa'i don spangs pa tsam yin pas/ /ltos med bzhi pa 'di yang dben pa'i cha nas snga ma gsum gyi nang du bsdus pa ste/ spyir rdo rje bzhi yang rdo rje gsum gyi nang du 'dus pa dang*/ de las kyang khyad par du dus 'khor rang las ni/ dben pa gsum dang bzhi'i tha snyad mi gsal/ 'dus pa sogs gzhan las dben pa gsum gyi tha snyad kho na mdzad kyi bzhi pa ma gsungs pa'i phyir/ ltos dben 'di gnyis don gcig kyang rnam gzhag mi 'dra bas/ dben pa bzhi dang ltos med gsum kho na'i tha snyad mi byed do/

/des na dben pa'i skabs su gsum du 'dus/ ltos med kyi skabs su bzhir dbye dgos/ dbang po dang gzugs phung la ltos med ni lus la ltos med du 'dus shing*/ 'du shes sems la ltos med du 'dus/ 'du byed dang tshor ba la ltos med bzhi ka'i cha shas yod do/ /'o na rlung sbyong ba rdzogs rim gyi sngon 'gror bshad pa de ci snyam na/ skabs 'dir dgang ba dang*/ dbyung ba dang*/ bum pa can phal pa rnams kyi man ngag la bslab cing*/ de gnad du 'gro ba'i phyir lus sbyongs kyang mang du byas na/ phyis dngos gzhi sor bsam gyi dus su/ rtags bcu nges pa can rnams myur du 'char ba dang*/ sor bsam la brtan pa thob nas srog rtsol sgom pa na/ sngar rlung rags pa byang zin pa'i phan yon gyis/ skabs der srog rtsol gyi rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin myur du skye ba yin pas/ gang zag gi rigs gcig la 'khrid tshul de ltar 'jug pa bde ba zhig 'byung bas/ sngon 'gro'i rnam grangs su gsungs pa yin gyi/ sor bsam gyi nyams myong skye ba la med du mi rung ba'i sngon 'gro ma yin no/ /sngon byon dpal rga lo'i lugs kyi sbyor drug dang*/ khrom lo'i sbyor drug dang*/ phyis dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang brnyes pa slob dpon chen po zhi ba sbas pa'i zhal gyi gdams pa las kyang*/ sngon 'gro rlung sbyang ba lus sbyongs dang bcas pa mdzad do/ /'di rnams kyi lugs ltar na rlung sbyang ba zla drug gam lo sogs bsgoms pas/ pho rlung 'byongs pa tsam 'byung zhing*/ de'i rgyun ma chad pa la sor bsam dang bsdebs te bsgoms pas/ pho rlung de mo rlung du 'gyur nas sor bsam mthar phyin tsa na mo rlung 'byongs/ nam srog rtsol gyi rim pa la 'jug pa na/ mo rlung thul te ma ning gi rlung du song bas/ ma ning gi rlung nyag gcig la gnad du bsnun chog pas/ srog 'dzin gyi yon tan gegs med myur bar kho nar bde blag tu skye'o zhes gsung ba/

de'i nang nas kyang rga lo'i lugs la ni sor sdud dang srog rtsol bum can sbrags te bsgom par 'dod pas/ 'khrid tshul de rigs la rlung sbyang ba sngon 'gror dgos nges su 'dug gzhan yang rgyud las/ so sor sdud pa la sogs 'di dag rnams kyis gal te bsngags pa rnams kyi 'dod pa grub par ma gyur na/ /nā da bsgoms pas btsan thabs chu skyes gnas su rdo rje nor bur thig le bkag nas bsgrub par bya/ /zhes sor sdud kho na'i rnal 'byor pa la yang*/ spogs chog thig le'i btsan thabs bsgom pa gsungs pa'i phyir/ de 'dra'i rigs la yang sngon 'gro rlung sbyang ba nges par dgos so/ /snga phyi'i sbyor drug pa 'ga' zhig gi ngag sgros la/ rgyud gzhung gi dngos bstan sor sdud nas 'go rtsom pa 'di/ gzhung lam yin yang bla ma'i man ngag gis srog rtsol nas 'go rtsom pa yang yod zer ba yang sngon du rlung sbyong ba 'di rigs la bsam par 'dug sor sdud dang bum can sbrags pa la sor sdud srog rtsol sbrags pa yin zhes 'chad pa rnams kyang*/ srog rtsol rjes mthun pa dang*/ srog rtsol gyi ring rgyu tsam dang*/ srog rtsol gyi sgrub pa tsam po yin pa la bsam pa'am rlung gi rnal 'byor yin tshad la srog rtsol du ming 'dogs pa tsam yin na/ tha snyad tsam la dpyad pa byar med/ yan lag drug gi nang tshan srog rtsol gyi rim pa la bsam pa yin na ni lam gyi 'gangs ye ma go ba'i cal col te sor sdud dang po'i skabs gyi bum can yang srog rtsol gyi rim pa ma yin te/ skabs der rlung dbu mar 'bab pa tsam yin yang 'ching mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /srog rtsol gyi rim pa ta min yang srog rtsol gyi yan lag tsam yin/ sor sdud kyi srog rtsol lo snyam na/ de tsam la bum can sogs med mi rung ma yin/ mi g.yo gsum ldan kho nas kyang 'grub pas sor sdud yin na srog rtsol dang sbrags te sgom par khyab par thal lo/

/sngon 'gro'i rlung sbyang ba ni/ rlung sbyor rang gi sgo nas mu stegs byed tshun chad dang thun mong ba yin la/ srog rtsol gyi rim pa'i bum can sogs ni/ rags pa'i dbu mar rags pa'i rlung bcings pa stai/ ye shes kyi dbu ma'i nang du dgag pa'i thabs yin pa/ bla med sbas rgyud pa'i man ngag rnams la'ang cher med pas khyad shin tu che ba'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang man ngag lag len de ltar byed pa la ni 'gal ba med pas/ lag len man ngag gang yin pa de gnad ma 'chugs par bstan na legs kyi/ rgyud gzhung gi lam gyi rim pa la ma sbyangs pa dag go don bshad pa'i rigs mang du smra pa de shin tu mi mdzes so/ /de ltar yin mod kyang*/ deng sang gi sgom byed pa phal che ba zhig la ni/ sems gnas pa cung zad cig ma skyes na/ rlung gi rtsol ba rnams gnad du mi 'gro ba rang mang bar snang zhing*/ thog ma nas rlung sgom pa de skye bo shas che ba la 'jug pa yang mi bde ba dang*/ dpe bskyed rim gyi bsnyen pa'i skabs kyang*/ bskyed rim sgom pa gtso bo dang bzlas pa yan lag yin pas/ dbang po rno na bzlas pa med kyang bskyed rim bsgom pa 'ba' zhig gis don 'grub pa ltar/ 'dir yang ltos med gtso bo yin/ rlung sbyang ba yan lag yin/ rlung sbyang ba med kyang ltos med 'ba' zhig gis skabs 'dir don 'grub pas/ sbyor drug lugs srol tha dad pa phal cher la/ skabs 'dir rlung sbyang ba mi mdzad cing*/ 'bro lugs dang bi bhu ta'i lugs la'ang mi mdzad pas/ dpal jo nang ba'i rang lugs la yang de bzhin no/ /spyir yang ltos med bzhi ldan dang rlung sbyang ba las dang po pa phal gyis dus gcig la mi 'grub pas/ gnyis kar byed na snga phyi rim can du sbyong dgos la/ gnyis po'i go rim la mtha' gcig tu nges par rang med kyang*/ ltos med sngon du byas na phal cher la legs so/ /yang sbyor drug gi man ngag rnying pa mang po zhig la/

sor sdud kho na nas 'go rtsom par 'dug pa/ sor sdud la ltos med bzhi tshang ngo snyam par 'dug kyang*/ rgyud las ltos med bsnyen pa dang*/ sor sdud nyer sgrub tu gsungs pa'i skabs dang cung zad 'gal bas/ ltos med bzhi ldan logs su byed pa 'di chad na mi rung ngo*/ /yang don gcig po 'di la dben gsum zhes pa dang*/ ltos med bzhi ldan zhes pa'i tha snyad ming 'dogs gnyis po gang gtso che zhe na/ dus 'khor nyid las gsungs pas ltos med gtso che ba tsam yin yang*/ da lta lag len du 'debs pa dang mthun par go bde ba'i phyir/ rang lugs kyi brgyud pa 'di la dben gsum gyi tha snyad grags che'o/ /khrid yig tu/ sngar sgo gsum gyi las byas pa rnams/ don med dang don log tu song zhes pa'i go don ni/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya byed byas tshad/ dge sdig lung ma bstan gsum gang rung las ma 'das/ sgo gsum gyi sdig pa byas tshad don med tsam yang ma yin don log ste/ rang gi rang nyid sdug bsngal myong ba'i thabs 'ba' zhig tu song*/ lung ma bstan byas pa rnams tshe stong zad dang don med kho nar song*/ dge ba byas pa rnams kyang 'khor ba'i bde ba than thun gyi rgyur song yang*/ bde ba de rtag mi thub par nyams pas phubs blos brtad thub pa'i 'bras bu ma byung ba'i don chung ngu la dus 'das te/ don chen po med pas don med ces bya/ sngar dus mtha' med pa de 'dra'i bar du/ las de tsam byas kyang 'bras bu ma byung bas/ de yang sngar gyi de 'dra ji tsam byas kyang blo brtad thub pa'i 'bras bu mi yong bas/ da ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya byed thams cad ci dgar bor la/ bsam med du 'jog bya ba'i don yin no/ /dben gsum gyi skabs 'dir/ gnas mun khang dang*/ lta stangs dang byed bcings thun mong ma yin pa rnams mtha' gcig tu dgos pa'i nges pa med pas/ sngon dus mun khang ma yin pa'i gnas ji ltar 'os par lus gnad dkyus 'gro tsam 'cha' ba'i srol yang byung mod kyi/

skabs der lus gnad dkyus 'gro de yang 'byongs 'byongs su sbyongs dgos shing*/ yang dngos gzhi la zhugs dus mun khang la yang ma 'dris pas thog ma nyams mi bde ba 'byung*/ sngar gyi lus gnad 'byongs ba'i khungs des go mi chod par/ byed bcings kyi lus gnad gsar du sbyongs dgos pas/ snga ma de las nor 'gro ba'i rnam pa 'byung bas na/ kun spangs chen po phyin chad kyi phyag len du dben gsum la gnas dang byed bcings gang gis kyang rung ba'i phyir/ 'di yang rung ba las skabs 'dir mun khang dang thun mong ma yin pa'i byed bcings de lus gnad dkyus ma dang lhan cig skabs 'dir 'byongs pas/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su dka' tshegs mi dgos par/ dmigs pa gnad du 'gro ba zhig yong ba thugs myong gis grub nas/ mun khang dang lta stangs sogs dngos gzhi dang khyad med par mdzad do/ /des na dben gsum 'di mun khang dang byed bcings drag po'i khyad tsam ma gtogs bod nyid la grags pa'i phyag chen/ zhi byed/ rdzogs chen/ sems sde gcod yul/ bsam mi khyab/ 'khor 'das dbyer med/ ka dag khregs gcod la sogs par grags pa'i gdams ngag gi gnad ma lus pa 'di kho na la 'dus/ sor sdud yan chad la/ gdams ngag de dag gis snyoms par mi spobs pa'i mngon par mtho ba'i khyad chos du ma dang ldan pa yin no/ /gong ma rnams kyi gsung 'phros las/ gdams ngag gzhan gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro rnams/ 'dir thun mong gi sngon 'gror byed/ gzhan gyi dngos gzhi rnams 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gror byed/ zhes gsungs pa'ang 'di la dgongs/ 'o na 'dir mi rtog pa nyid la 'jog pa tsam du 'dug gzhan 'ga' zhig tu sems 'tshol dang dran pa'i tsho 'dzin byed pas de lhag snyam na/ dran pa'i so ba ni 'dir yang gtong la/ sems 'tshol du 'dod pa de tshan yang dgos pa'i skabs byung na/ chos 'di'i cha lag la yang yod cing*/

yod pa tsam du ma zad lhag dang bcas par yang yod mod/ lan gcig rtog dpyod kyi rtsol ba byed phyin/ sems 'tshol de la'ang gcig tu 'gangs che rgyu med/ de bas rgyus pa bdag med stong nyid kyi go myong thag chod gol sa gcod pa mtha' yas pa zhig chos 'di la yod pa yin/ 'on kyang lam gyi rkang la ma bcos par 'jog phyin/ sems 'tshol dang dran 'dzin yang dgos rgyu med de de gnyis kar blos byas yin pa'i phyir/ gnas lugs gdod ma la reg par mi nus so/ /bram ze chen pos kyang*/ chu dang mar me rang gsal zhig tu zhog /ces gsungs te/ dper na chu rnyog ma can de g.yo ba med par bzhag na/ rnyog ma thams cad rang sangs te dngas par gyur pa na/ chu nang na yod tshad gsal bar mthong 'ong*/ de'i tshe rnyog ma can gyi chu nang na dngos po ci yod 'tshol ba la/ lag nom byed cing chu dkrus mi dgos par dngos su mthong ba yin/ de bzhin du sems rnam rtog spangs te g.yo med du bzhag pas/ shes pa nyag nyog sangs shing dwangs pa na/ rig pa rang gi sdod lugs rang gzugs de gsal bar mthong yong*/ de tsa na sems dang rnam rtog 'dres pa'i rnyog chu la rtog dpyod sems 'tshol gyi lag pas dkrug mi dgos/ sems kyi ngo bo rtsol med du mthong yong*/ yang da lta phan cher dran 'dzin gyi tsho 'dzin dgos zer yang*/ nyon mongs dang rnam rtog skyes res kyi ngos gzung nas dbyings su ni gcod/ de la sgom chen pa rnams dran pa zer gyin 'dug pa/ de ni zhor byung thams cad du 'dir yang lag len la ni 'debs/ de tsam la nyams len mthar thug tu ni mi rtsi/ sems rang ngo shes dgos pa yin zhes grags te byar med kyi sgo nas rang rig pa ni/ sems dbye na rnam par mi rtog pa kho na rang yin/ blos byas kyi ngo shes la ha las rgyu tsam med/ de ni sems 'khrid gsha' ma zhig byas na thams cad la shugs 'byung du 'ong ba lags/ mdor na phal cig blos byas kyi chos kyis sangs mi rgya zhes 'gram pa bud bud kha na 'don bzhin du/

rig pa rkyang 'dod dang*/ dran pa bsten pa dang*/ rang zhal la blta ba dang*/ che re blta dgos bya ba sogs slar yang blos byas shig rang la blo rtse gtod pa 'di yang ya re che'o/ /sgos su yang ye shes kyi nyams rtsal phyogs med du rgyas nas/ rnam pa thams cad pa'i 'char sgo 'byams klas pa'i skabs shig tu/ nyams rang shar byung rgyal du bskyangs dgos pa la/ dran pa'i tsho 'dzin yin par rlom nas mgo bkug dbugs bsngams bsdad pas nyams myong dang yon tan phyogs med du 'char ba la gegs chen po byed pa yin/ dran pa'i so pa spong dgos pa'i skabs kyang mang ngo*/ /yang 'ga' zhig rnam rtog sgom gyi rtsal yin bcad du mi btub zer te/ sa ra has/ rtog pa nyams pas blo nyams shes/ /blo ngan rjes su rtog byed lo/ /de nyid las ni blo bzang po/ /nam mkha' las lhag ci yang 'byung*/ /zhes gsungs pas dngos su bkag cing*/ rgyud las/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ rnam rtog chad pa'i shul na rig pa tsam 'dug pa dang*/ rnam rtog sdod tshugs ma thub pa tsam la ci yang med pa 'dra zhig myong ba na/ sems nyid rnam rtog rnam rtog nyid sems nyid yin snyam zhing smra ba dang*/ rnam rtog stong nyid stong nyid chos sku'o snyam du sems shing smra ba ni 'char sgo dang sems kyi mtshan nyid phyogs re rig pa las/ go tshul phyogs re ba zhig byung*/ go tshul de dang mthun pa'i tha snyad re btags par 'dug dper na chu chad pa'i shul sar 'dug pas chu dang sa gcig par 'dzin pa dang*/ khang pa 'gyel bzhin pa'i dus na bar snang stong pa 'dug pas/ bar snang nyid khang pa'o snyam du sems pa dang 'dra'o/ /nyams myong cung zad dang 'brel ba'i go ba rab rib re ta yod de/ rnam par dbye ba 'chad pa'i tshe/ chos las ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du bya dgos kyi rang re so so skye bo'i nyams myong re dang bstun nas grub mtha' 'jog cing brda chad gsar pa re byed pa ni/

bdud kyi dkrugs ma'o/ /gzhan yang rnam rtog dang*/ rnam rtog gi rang bzhin gnyis dbye ba phyed dgos/ rnam rtog gi rang bzhin de ni stong pa yin mi rtog pa yin pas rnam rtog ma yin/ rnam rtog 'char sgo kho rang ni med bzhin du snang ba'i 'khrul ba yin pas/ rnam rtog kho rang gi rang bzhin yang ma yin/ gzhan gang su'i yang rang bzhin yang ma yin/ snang tsam ma gtogs ngo bo med do/ /dper na mig 'khrul mkhan gyis bre la sngags btab/ ltad mo ba rnams kyis mchod rten du mthong ba dang 'dra/ rnam rtog gi rang bzhin bre dang 'dra/ snang cha rnam rtog kho rang mchod rten dang 'dra/ bre shing yin kyang sgyu ma'i mchod rten la shing yin rgyu med/ rnam rtog gi rang bzhin ye shes yin du chug kyang*/ rnam rtog nyid ngo bos ma grub pas rnam rtog la ye shes yin rgyu ma byung*/ gal te rnam rtog ye shes yin na/ ye shes yin pa'i rnam rtog cig grub par thal/ dper na bre shing yin pas sgyu ma'i mchod rten yang shing ka yin na/ sgyu ma'i mchod rten gyi thad na shing gi mchod rten yod par thal ba bzhin no/ /des na rnam rtog gi rnam pa ma yal bzhin du gtad med yal yul zang thal le bar myong ba de ni/ rnam rtog de 'khrul snang gi 'char sgo tsam ma gtogs/ gdod ma nas yong ma myong ba'i rtags yin/ nam ngo bo la ltas dus ci yang med pa ltar snang ba de ni/ rjes 'thud med mtshams sbyor ba med/ ma 'brel ba skad cig gis 'jig pa/ mi gnas pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas/ yang dag pa'i lta ba'i gnad rig pa zhig gis bsgom na phra ba'i mi rtag pa dang rang bzhin med pa la 'jug nus kyang*/ ye shes chos sku yin pa'i rgyu mtshan du mi 'gyur ro/ / yang dag pa'i lta ba'i gnad la sbyor ma thub na yal yul dang ci yang med pa 'dra ba de lung ma bstan du las 'gro/ yang stong rkyang la chos sku'i ming 'dogs/ snang ba dang rang bzhin gyi dbye ba mi 'byed par bshad pa yin snyam na/

de ltar byed du zad mod/ lung gi brda chad dang rig pa'i tshul las ni 'das so/ /gzhan yang rig pa la ltas pas rnam rtog nyid/ mi rtog pa'i rig pa yin pa 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa ni/ dar la seng gi mig nas nam mkha' mthong ba lta bu yin/ rnam rtog shugs drag la bltas pas/ sems stong gsal gyi snang ba rnam rtog tu shar ba zhig 'dug snyam pa ni/ bya 'phur ba'i rjes su bya gdang 'gul ba ltar shugs drag 'gags pa'i rjes kyi sems gsal stong la snga ma'i dri ma chags pa yin pa la| dus myur bas shugs drag de ka gsal stong du 'dug go snyam snga phyi gnyis gcig tu 'khrul ba yin/ des na nyams myong shar tshul re yod kyang*/ ngo sprod lugs 'khrul na gol sa 'byung bas/ ngo sprod ma 'khrul ba yang gal che'o/ / mthar gtugs na yul gyis rnam pa ma bsgyur ba'i gsal rig tsam rgyun chad rgyu med pa 'di ni ye shes dngos ma yin kun gzhi rnam shes yin/ de dang ye shes rnam pa 'dra rung du yod pas/ ye shes dngos su ma bshad par dpe'i tshul gyi ye shes su ngo sprad na legs cha tsam yod do/ /kun gzhi rnam shes de yang ye shes bde gshegs snying po'i sgrib byed yin zhing*/ de yang dngos su na/ rmi lam snang ba'i skyes bus yod pa'i dngos po mi mthong*/ med pa'i rmi lam mthong ba dang*/ sgyu mas bslad pa rnams kyis yod pa'i tshogs pa mi mthong*/ med pa'i rgyu ma mthong ba ltar yin mod kyang*/ re zhig so so skye bo dang 'phags pa slob pa rnams kyi blo ngo na snang ba ltar rnam par bzhag na/ sems can de dang de la ltos nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po don dam pa'i rang rig ye shes te/ /sems can de nyid kyi kun gzhi rnam shes kyis g.yogs/ de'i tshe ral gri'i shubs ral gri dang dbyibs rjes mthun du 'byung ba ltar/ kun gzhi de yang snying po dang rnam pa 'dra rung du yod/ ral gri dngos su ma bstan kyang shubs mthong bas ral gri'i dbyibs rjes su dpog nus pa ltar/

kun gzhi gsal rig tsam nyid las snying po rjes su dpog pa'i ngo sprod byed pa yin/ 'dir ngo sprod thun mong ba na rgyas par bshad yod pas der gzigs/ kun gzhi snying po'i sgrib g.yogs yin yang*/ kun gzhi la gnad du bsnun na/ snying po rtogs pa'i lam du 'gyur te/ mi gos can gyi gos nas bzung bas mi yang zin par 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /dben gsum gyi skabs 'dir/ yun ring du sgom mkhan yin na/ bde gshegs snying po ngo sprod tshul de ltar yin la/ bde gshegs snying po dben gsum du ngo sprod na ni/ kun gzhi la brten nas byed/ dngos gzhi'i nyams skyes pa la ni/ kun gzhi rnam shes la brten nas rjes su dpog mi dgos te/ bde gshegs snying po'i snang ba dngos 'od gsal rtags bcu mngon du gyur pa la ngo sprod/ 'di 'khrid dngos gzhi'i skabs gtso che/ ngo sprod tshul ni ngo sprod thun mong ma yin par gzigs 'tshal/ dben gsum gyi skabs 'dir bshad pa'i mtha' gcod dang ngo sprod 'di rnams 'khrid 'chad pa po rang gi nyams myong la rags rim shar ba dang rnam gzhag zhib mor blo la nges pa gal che zhing*/ ngo sprod 'chad skabs dang*/ shes rab can 'dus par mtha' gcod dgos dus/ rang lugs kyi chos skad rkang tshug pa'i phyir nges par bshad dgos/ go ba chung chung tshogs pa la 'khrid 'chad dus/ mtha' gcod kyi bshad pa mi dgos shing*/ dben gsum zhag bdun tsam las yun ring mi byed par/ dngos gzhi la 'phral du 'jug pa'i lag len byed pa la skabs 'dir ngo sprod kyi rigs byed mi dgos/ rgyun du sgom mkhan gyi rigs yin na/ rjes su rim pas ngo sprod bya'o/ /de yang gong du zur tsam smos pa ltar dang*/ ngo sprod phyi nang gi yi ger gsal bar bris pa dang*/ rgyas par na/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo kun mkhyen chen po dngos slob dang bcas pa rnams kyi/ gsung rab ngo sprod rnams kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du/

bla ma'i gsung las 'byung ba ltar ngo sprod dgos kyi/ bod kyi sgom chen par grags pa phal pa byings 'di'i kha rgyug 'ad 'ud chal chol gyi bsre bslad med pa gal che/ don gyi snying po 'khor 'das snod bcud/ phyi snang ba/ nang rnam rtog /gzhi 'khor ba/ lam sgom pa/ 'bras bu gsar thob/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad/ mdor na snang grags kyi chos thams cad gzhi med rtsa bral du ngo sprod/ de ltar yin yang*/ rten 'brel gyi tshogs pa ma 'gags par*/ snang ba sna tshogs sgo thams cad nas 'char sgo mi 'gag ste/ sgyu ma lta bur ngo sprad/ don dam dbyings bde gshegs snying po kun khyab rtag pa srid zhi snang grags kyi chos thams cad las 'das gzhi lam 'bras bu'i khrem gnyer thams cad gdod ma nas sangs pa de/ rnam pa kun ldan du ngo sprad/ de gsum ka la da ltar cha shas dngos su myong ba rnams nyams myong dang bstun nas ngo sprad/ da ltar dngos su ma myong yang rang gi myong ba de la brten nas nges shes 'dren thub pa rnams la/ rjes dpag gi tshul gyis ngo sprod/ lam mthar thug mthon po'i gnas skabs rnams/ rgyud gzhung gi don lung tshad ma la brten nas ngo sprod/ mnyam gzhag la la zla ba dang*/ rjes thob 'khor 'das kyi ru shan 'byed pa gnyis po yang ma 'dres par ngo sprad dgos/ bod sgom snga phyi mang po zhig dang*/ da lta yod pa phal cher/ rang gi nyams su ma myong ba de mi 'dod nas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas man chad nyams 'og tu chud gyu ba byed cing*/ rang gis nyams su ma myong ba'i lam mthon po thams cad rang gi nyams myong yin tshul gyi ngo sprad pas/ rang la blo brtad pa'i slob ma thams cad bslus/ nyams myong chang chung la bdag rkyen che grags/ bsam mno btang ba'i rig gras la nyams myong du kha g.yar bas sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang mi mthun/ lung rigs dang 'gal ba'i bab col gyi don spyi wal wal la/ sangs rgyas kyi sa dang 'phags lam du ngo sprad pas 'phags pa thams cad dang chos la skur ba btab/

dper na sprang po mdzes khyer zhig bstan nas/ 'di 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yin zhes byas na/ ngo sprod tshul shin tu tha chad par ma zad/ 'khor los bsgyur rgyal la smad par yang 'gyur ba rgyal po'i khrims phog pa bzhin no/ /des na dpe don du sbyor dgos rnams dpe las don mtshon pa'i tshul gyis ngo sprod byed na mi 'gal yang*/ dpe nyid don du ngo sprod pa sogs ngo sprod log pa rdzun gyi phung po mi zad pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig par ma byed cig yang dben gsum gyi skabs 'dir/ chos thun mang rab byed cing*/ chos go nus pa la nges shes skye ba'i dgos pa yod na/ sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu nyes pa lnga/ spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi dbye ba sogs/ zhi lhag gi bshad pa ji ltar 'os pa yang drangs te/ 'di nyid kyi dmigs pa dang sbyar nas bshad na'ang legs la/ yang blo dman la bshad pa mang pos sems 'khrugs pa de mi legs pa dang*/ mdor bsdus kyi skabs su de lta bu'i spros pa mi dgos so/ /de la zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi ngo bo gang yin zhe na/ yang dag gnas pa la brten nas/ sems la sems ni 'jog phyir dang*// chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir/ /zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong yin/ /zhes byings rgod rnam rtog med par sems gsal stong du gnas pa ni zhi gnas/ gnas lugs rjen ne gnas pa'i sems rtse gcig pa ni lhag mthong ngo*/ /zhi lhag sgom pa'i dgos pa ni/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad zhi lhag sgom pa las 'byung bas/ phan yon dpag tu med pa de dag thob pa'i phyir dang*/ gnas skabs su ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ zhi gnas stobs kyis g.yo ba med par 'gro/ /lhag mthong gis ni ri dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ dgongs pa nges 'grel las/ skye ba po yis zhi gnas dang*/ /lhag mthong goms par byas na ni/

gnas ngan len gyi 'ching ba dang*/ /mtshan ma'i 'ching las grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ dgos pa de dag gi phyir bsgom mo/ /go rim ni/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes byas nas/ / thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni/ /'jig rten chags pa med par mngon dgag 'grub/ /zhes pa ltar yin mod/ theg pa 'dir ni de gnyis so sor 'tshol mi dgos par/ chabs gcig tu bsgrub pa yang yin no/ /zhi gnas ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul ni/ sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu zhes bya ba ste/ 'jog par byed/ rgyun du 'jog par byed/ bslan te 'jog par byed/ nye bar 'jog par byed/ 'dul bar byed/ zhi bar byed/ nye bar zhi bar byed/ sems kyi rgyud gcig tu byed/ mnyam par 'jog par byed/ zhes pa ste dgu yin la| dang po ni dmigs pa la sems gtod pa/ gnyis pa ni de'i rgyun yang yang 'thud pa/ gsum pa ni tshur bkug ste dmigs pa la 'jog pa'o/ /'di gsum thog ma'i skabs rang yin/ gnas skabs dang po'o/ /bzhi pa nyer 'jog ni/ cung zad dmigs pa la sems ngang gis gnas pa ni/ de nyid yang yang rgyun 'thud cing skyong ba yin/ lnga pa ni cung zad skyo na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan dran nas/ spro ba bskyed de yang bsgom pa yin/ drug pa ni/ rnam g.yeng dang rnam rtog gi nyes dmigs shes par byas nas chags sdang dang rnam g.yeng skyes pa dang du mi len par 'jog pa yin/ skyo ba dang rnam g.yeng shugs che ba yun ring ring 'dra ba byung na/ gnyen po de gnyis dgos/ bdun pa ni/ chags sdang sdug bsngal gyi rnam rtog shugs chung nge ba thol thol skye na/ rang zhi la gtong ba'am/ dga' mi dga' med par 'phro gcod pa'o/ /de rnams bar skabs gcig gi nyams len yin/ gnas skabs gnyis pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ bsgrims na bying rgod rnam g.yeng dang ma 'dres pa'i sems gnas pa de gang 'dod du skyong thub cing*/

ma bsgrims na rnam g.yeng gis gnod pa zhig yin te/ gnas skabs gsum pa'o/ / dgu pa ni/ de nas ma bsgrims kyang*/ skyon dang bral ba'i gnas pa stai/ ci 'dod 'dod du gnas shing*/ nam dgos su ldang nus pa ste/ gnas skabs bzhi pa'o/ /'di ci rigs par goms nas/ nyin mtshan khor yug tu 'gro ba la tshegs med do/ /skabs 'di dag tu spong rgyu'i nyes pa lnga ni/ le lo dang ni gdams ngag dag /brjed dang bying dang rgod pa dang*/ /'du mi byed dang 'du byed de/ /'di dag nyes pa lngar 'dod do/ /zhes le lo dang dmigs pa la g.yel ba gnyis kyis gnas skabs dang po dang*/ bying rgod kyis gnas skabs gnyis pa dang*/ 'du mi byed pas gsum pa dang*/ 'du byed de rtsol bas bzhi pa la bar du gcod pas/ gnas skabs de dang der de rnams spong dgos so/ /de rnams spong ba'i gnyen po 'du byed brgyad ni/ gnas dang de la gnas pa dang*/ / rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid du'o/ /dmigs pa brjed par ma gyur dang*/ /bying dang rgod pa rtogs pa dang*/ /de spong mngon par 'du byed dang*/ /zhi tshe rnal du 'dug pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ dad 'dun brtson 'grus shin tu sbyangs pa ste/ bzhi ni le lo'i gnyen po dang*/ dran pa ni dmigs pa brjed pa'i gnyen po dang*/ shes bzhin ni bying rgod kyi gnyen po dang*/ spong ba mngon par 'du byed pa ni/ mi rtsol ba'i gnyen po dang*/ rtsol ba klod pa'i btang snyom ni/ ha cang rtsol ba'i gnyen po'o/ /sems gnas dgu stobs drug gis 'grub pa yin te/ thos pa'i stobs kyis 'jog pa dang*/ bsam pa'i stobs kyis rgyun du 'jog pa dang*/ dran pa'i stobs kyis bslan te 'jog pa dang nye bar 'jog pa gnyis/ shes bzhin gyi stobs kyis 'dul byed zhi byed gnyis/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs kyis nyer zhi dang rgyud gcig gnyis/ 'dres pa'i stobs kyis dgu pa mnyam par 'jog pa 'grub bo/ /gnas skabs bzhi la yid byed bzhi yod de/

dang po ni bsgrims te 'jug pa'i yid byed dang*/ gnyis pa ni bar chad cing 'jug pa dang*/ gsum pa ni chad pa med par 'jug pa dang*/ bzhi pa ni lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa'i yid byed do/ /'dir ni de dag ming tsam smos par zad kyi don rgyas par dang nas bshad par bya la/ dmigs pa la yang yang sems 'thud cing*/ rnam rtog thol thol skye na sbad sbad bcad/ rnam g.yeng lcags thag sbrel du 'gro na rig pa la lcag bcug ste bsgrims/ nyon mongs la gnyen po bsten/ zhum pa dang rig pa shugs chung na spro ba bskyed/ rang shugs la gnas pa'i sgang la bcas bcos mi byed de/ gong du bshad pa'i sems gnas thabs thams cad kyang lag len du de la 'dus so/ /de'i tshe sems gsal stong 'dzin med/ ma yengs pa phyogs cha nye ring med pa zhig 'dug pa de ka zhi gnas yin/ deng sang lag tu yang long ba de yin/ shin sbyangs la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid gzhan du ma go babs tsam ma gtogs deng sang 'byung ba dkon/ la la 'dra rung byung yang khyad 'don gyi bogs tsam mi yong*/ lhag mthong la 'jig rten pa dang thar lam gyi dbye ba'am/ rtog dpyod yod med dang*/ dpyad sgom 'jog sgom sogs kyi dbye ba du ma yod kyang*/ theg pa mthar thug 'dir ni stong pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya snang ba dang*/ lus nyams ngag nyams sems nyams sna tshogs pa shar ba la/ bzo med du mnyam par 'jog pa 'di kho na lhag mthong yin te/ dgongs pa lung ston las kyang*/ gzugs sogs nang gi chos rnams ni/ /mthong bas lhag mthong zhes brjod do/ /zhes gsungs/ de ltar na zhi lhag zung 'jug gi lam 'di la mnyam par bzhag na/ srid pa dang zhi ba'i bde ba dang legs pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dkyus las/ dge ba'i las kyi spros pa yang phal cher bskyungs nas zhes pa'i don ni/ spyir dge ba'i las kyis sgrib par 'gyur ba ma yin/ mnyam bzhag mi nus pa'am/

mnyam bzhag la brtan pa thob na lus ngag gi dge ba la ji tsam brtson pa/ de tsam du bzang mod kyang re zhig ting nge 'dzin ma skyed pa skyed par byed pa'i skabs 'dir/ bya chos mang po de rnam g.yeng dang ngal dub tu song bas ting nge 'dzin mi skye/ skabs 'dir ting nge 'dzin che brtad bsgrub rgyu yin pas/ gnyis ka mi lcogs byin de bor nas ting nge 'dzin la 'jug dgos/ spyod 'jug las/ stobs nyams pa dang rjes 'brel na/ /slar bya'i don du dor bar bya/ /legs par zin nas phyi ma dang*/ /phyi ma 'dod pas de spang bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar mi 'grub pa'i gnas mang po la ha cang rtsol grags pa/ brtson 'grub kyi skyon yin pas/ de'i gnyen por dor ba zhes bya ba/ blo sna mang po dor te gcig la bsgril bar gsungs so/ /de ltar zhag 'ga' shas dmigs pa rnams yang yang bskyang zhing*/ lag len nges por bslabs/ skam bsgrigs kyi sgo nas sgom du yang bcug /de nas bca' 'grig pa na mun khrid dam po la 'jug khar/ byin rlabs 'jug pa'i don du skabs 'gar gtor dbang zhig mdzad pa'i srol yang yod/ gal che re re tsam ma gtogs gzhan la mi mdzad kyang gsung*/ phyis mi mdzad pa shas che/ med mi rung ni yin yang ma yin mod/ gong ma'i phyag len gyi rgyun yin pas res 'ga' 'grub na bzang bar ni mngon no/ /de la gtor dbang mi byed na der zad/ byed na de'i rjes su lus phud 'bul bar grags pa 'di byed/ de yang slob ma rnams 'dus/ slob dpon stan mtho ba la 'dug yungs kar ram/ me tog gang yang rung ba la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥmang du bzlas la bzhag /'o pha ri blta 'dod na tshu ri nas ltos bya ba yin/ nged kyi lus gnad 'cha' ba la legs par gzigs shig byas nas lus gnad re re nas slob ma la ston/ yang 'di skad du/ sngar brjod pa ltar lus bya byed kyis dben pa de yang*/ nyal ba dang*/ snyes pa sogs sdod lugs gang byung gis chog pa ma yin/

lus gnad byed bcings phun sum tshogs pa zhig dgos/ chos nas bshad pa gnad dang ldan pa zhig dgos/ las dang po pa ting nge 'dzin skye ba la/ lus gnad 'di gal che shos shig yin/ dam pa gong ma mang po'i rnam thar na yang*/ dus ga ge mo zhig na lus gnad 'byongs zhes yon tan khyad par can skyes pa'i rnam grangs su mdzad pa yod/ 'ga' zhig dge sbyor yod na sdod lugs la khyad med zer te/ sgom la brtan pa thob na lus gnad ma byas kyang mi gnod pa tsam yin gyi/ de nas kyang yon tan gong 'phel du 'gro ba la lus gnad mi dgos pa ma yin nyams rtogs te byang chub sems dpa' rgyal bu don grub las mtho ba mi yong ste/ de yang nyal nas ma yin/ 'gyel nas ma yin/ snyes nas ma yin/ phar tsam tshur tsam byed kyin ma yin/ kha yengs mig yengs byed ky-in ma yin/ lus gnad bcas te dben pa gsum gyi ngang nas sangs rgyas pa lags so/ /da lus gnad la yi rang stabs ma btub na ma gtogs/ rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung rang bcas dgos/ dri med 'od las/ bla ma'i nges pa'i dbang gis sgom pa'i dus dang*/ 'dod pa'i lha la bstod pa'i dus su grangs bzhin du sangs rgyas rnams la rdo rje'i gdan bsngags shing*/ zhes gsungs/ rgyu mtshan ro rkyang gi rtsa rkang pa'i dbus su 'gro zhing*/ rtsa'i rtse mo rkang mthil gyi bar du yod pas/ rkang pa gnyis gcig gis gcig gcer zhing 'dud pa na/ rtsa der rgyu ba'i rlung 'gag ste smad kyi rtsa rnams 'ching ba yin/ rgal tshigs drang por bsrangs pas/ rtsa dbu ma drang por 'drongs/ rtsa 'khor rnams gcig steng su gcig khel bas/ rlung rnams rang gnas su rgyu/ thig le yang rang gnas su gnas pa yin/ lus mdun du gug na dbus kyi rtsa mdun rlung khams kyi rtsa dang thug pas/ snying rlung sogs rlung nang 'jug shes pa 'phyo zhing rnam rtog 'khrug de bzhin du g.yas la yo na/ mai'i rtsa dang thug pas sems 'khrug

/zhe sdang skye/ khrag mkhris ldang*/ g.yon du yo na chu khams dang thug pas/ 'dod chags skye/ grang gzhi dang bad kan ldang*/ rgyab tu dgye na sa khams dang thug pas shes pa bying*/ 'dus pa'i nad ldang*/ yo 'khyog med par lus bsrangs pas skyon de dag mi skyed pas gegs phal cher mi 'byung*/ rlung rang gnas su rgyus/ rtsa thig rang gnas su gnas pas/ ting nge 'dzin skyon dang bral ba skye sla ba dang*/ rlung dbu mar 'bab sla ba'i dgos pa yod/ mgrin pa dgug bya ba/ ltag pa 'phreng la chag ske mdun la gug pa'i go ba ma yin/ mjing pa drang por bsrings pas lkog mas ol mdud non pa la zer/ 'di dang dpung pa phyir bkyed de mthong kha rgyas par byas pas/ stod kyi rlung rnams dbu mar 'ching*/ lag pa gnyis la'ang ro rkyang gi rtsa yod cing*/ rtse mo lag mthil dang lag sor gyi bar du'ang yod pas rdo rje khu tshur bcings pa na/ de dag gi rtse mo nas tshur bsdams te/ de'i 'phrul las lag pa dang stod kyi rlung 'chings thub/ srin lag 'dre rtsa yin te mthe bong gis btsir bas bgegs mi 'jug mnyam bzhag dang khu tshur brla bzhag gnyis ka rgyud 'grel las gsungs mod/ khu tshur brla bzhag byed bcings 'chun che bas 'di kho na gtso bor mdzad/ so mchu rang sar bzhag nas lce rtse rkan la sbyar bas/ mgrin pa nas smin mtshams man chad kyi rlung 'ching*/ lta stangs steng la brtad pas dpral ba dang*/ gtsug tor gyi rlung 'ching ba ni smos ma dgos/ yan lag dang dbang po thams cad la ro rkyang gi yal ka re yod kyang*/ gzhan rnams phal pa yin/ gtso bo rgyal po lta bu gsang ba'i dbang po la yod/ des bag chags dang*/ rnam shes mtha' dag skyed/ las byed blon po lta bu mig la gnas/ phyi yul gyi rnam rtog phal cher des skyed/ gsang ba'i rtsa 'bru chags pa lta bu dang*/ mig gi rtse me tog lta bu yin gsung*/ lus byed bcings pas gtso bo gsang bar gnas pa de yang g.yo mi thub par rang shugs la 'ching*/

mig steng du bstad pas ro rkyang mgo nas bzung ste btsir ba lta bu yin/ mgo nas btsir pas de'i shugs kyis mas sna gsang bar rlung rgyugs pa de mtha'i la thug pa na yar ldog ste rtsa dbu mar 'jug pa yin/ mig 'bras g.yo ba med par bzhag pas/ ro rkyang gi rtsa 'gul ma thub/ rtsa ma 'gul bas rlung g.yo ba mkhan med par gsar pa mi skye zhing*/ rnying pa'i rgyun rnams je phra je chung du 'gro/ ro rkyang gi rgyu ba ji tsam zhan du song ba bzhin/ dbu ma'i rgyu ba stobs rgyas pas ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag kyangalus gnad kho nas 'grub pa rang ta ma yin mod/ ji skad du/ mkha' 'drar byas na rlung ni rnam par 'ching*/ /zhes sa ra has gsungs pa ltar/ lta stangs kyi lam las sems spros pa dang bral bar rtse gcig tu gnas pas/ rlung sems dbu mar 'jug pa rtsom pa na lus gnad byed bcings de dag re res grogs byas te/ dmigs gnad dang byed bcings de kun 'dus pa las rlung btsan thabs su ldog par 'gyur ba yin no/ /da nged kyi lus gnad ji ltar byas pa bzhin khyed rang rnams kyang chos shig byas la/ de rnams lus gnad byed du bcug zhib mor brtags de yo 'khyog sogs skyon rnams bcos/ da lus gnad 'di ka ma gtogs lus bya byed gzhan thams cad dang bral ba la zhog cig sngar lus 'gro 'dug spyod lam sna tshogs dang*/ ngag gtam sna tshogs smras pas rlung 'khrugs yod/ de'i rgyun la dmigs pa brtad na rtsa log rlung log gi gegs 'byung*/ dper na snod la mi gtsang ba'am dug sogs kyi dri ma gos par/ bcud bzang po blug kyang chud 'dza' ba dang 'dra/ des na 'khrug pa de sel dgos pas/ nged kyis rlung ro bsal ba bzhin du khyed rang rnams kyang sna nas rlung dal la ring ba'i tshul gyis rlung ro lan gsum sangs te phyir bus shig byas la/ dpon slob thams cad kyis rlung ro lan gsum bsal/ des rlung 'khrugs pa rnams sangs te rang gnas su rgyu bas gegs mi 'byung*/

ting nge 'dzin dang gis skye/ rlung 'byongs pa'i bde ba 'byung*/ snod la bkru bshal dang khang pa la phyag dar byas pa dang 'dra/ da thun gyi 'gor rlung ro bsal ba 'di ma gtogs/ ngag gi smra brjod lta ga la zhig rlung yang rang babs kho nar zhog cig da ni sngar yang yang bstan pa bzhin 'gyu byed rnam rtog gang yang ma byed/ ci yang mi mno mi bsam gang yang yid la ma byed par cham me zhog cig byas la/ dpon slob thams cad lus gnad bcas te dar cig bsgom/ bar bar du dmigs pa gsal 'debs dang*/ rnam rtog gcod lugs yod tsam yod tsam bshad/ nus na chu tshod re tsam bsgom du 'jug de tsam byed mi 'dod na ji ltar 'os tsam bzhag de yang chu tshod re la ma ṇi dal brel ran po ste nyis stong lhag tsam re 'gro/ de'i yun la dpag nas ji ltar 'os pa sgom du gzhugade'i mthar da dung khyed rang rnams lus gnad ma zhig pa sems ma yengs par sgoms shig khyed rnams la nged kyis byin rlabs re byed do byas nas/ slob ma'i gnas drug tu yi ge drug slob dpon gyis bsgoms nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ kṣaḥdang*/ oṃ āḥr ra ra ra la la la la badzra ā be sha ya hūṃ/ zhes shub bur brjod cing sngar gyi me tog de nas slob ma'i mgor bzhag go /mthar me tog cung zad gtor la/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i ye shes khyad par can myur du skye bar gyur cigaces brjod/ ji ltar dwangs pa'i chu klung las/ /nya dag myur du ldang ba ltar/ /de bzhin thams cad stong gsal las/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes sems bsam med du mnyam par bzhag pas lus nyams ngag nyams sems nyams mthong nyams rmi nyams sogs ma nges pa ji snyed cig bcos min rang shugs su 'byung ste/ de thams cad byung rgyal du bskyangs pas/ skyon med rang sar grol 'gro ba legs so byas la/ cung zad cig nas lus gnad 'grol du gzhug slob ma rtsa bzang bla ma la nyams myong gi rgyun yod na chos grwa de khar/

gnas pa 'thug po dang nyams sna tshogs pa 'char ba'i rgyun yod do/ /de rjes de ma thag nas sgom khang du dam po la bcug na 'dis chu yur mgor chud pa dang 'dra bas/ sgom nyams myong 'phral du skye/ zhag gnyis gsum bdun tshun chad du lus gnad kyang 'byongs/ lta stangs kyang yun ring du mi sdod pa dang mig tsha ba sogs la'ang gang thub thub tu bsgril bas/ zhag gsum tshun chod du 'byongs yong ste/ mchi ma 'byung thengs 'ga' re song ba na/ zug kyang zhi g.yo med du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /lus gnad byed bcings kyi gtam thar thor thos pa'i rtog ge pa 'ga' zhig lus dang mig la sdug bsngal mi zad pa skyed do zhes/ chos 'di la skur ba 'debs pa ni/ de rnams nyid kyis mun 'khrid thun gcig kyang sgom ma myong bas/ dam po'i lag len gyi gtam rna bar thos pa na/ snying 'gas pa tsam du skrag cing dngangs pa'i mu cor kha nas rgyang ter shor ba la dgag sgrub yin par rlom zhing ngo sor byas pa'o/ /gzhan lus gnad lta stangs 'byongs pa la lo zla mang po dgos pa stai/ mun khrid dam po 'di zhag gsum mam lnga'am bdun tshun chad la mi 'byongs pa mi srid pas 'di thabs re mkhas gdams ngag re che'o/ /de nas lus gnad dang lta stangs thams cad bde zhing skyid pa 'ba' zhig yin/ sdug bsngal yul bud pa yin/ mig la sdug bsngal skyed pa ga la zhig¿mig nad yod pa tsho 'phral du dag 'gro ba mngon sum gyis grub pa 'di ka lags/ lus gnad 'byongs rtags snang mthong nas rtag tu bde ba'i nyi ma bcu gnyis shar ba'o/ /gzhan 'di na kha cig 'chol pa'i spyod par shor/ bcad kham gtsang por rlom pa'i bsam gtan pa rgan po'i ming re btags/ rgyu ma was brus pa bzhin du song*/ ro stod dang mjing pa sgur re/ mdog ro thal skya zhig byas/ chags sdang gi mno bsam la rgya yan pa rnams snying re rje/ chos zab mo 'di kun la bcol rtogs ye med do/

/de ltar na de yan chad kyis sngon 'gro'i 'khrid kyi lhan thabs rgyas par bshad zin/ spyir nyams 'khrid byed pa la sngon 'gros rgyud sbyong ba 'khrid thams cad la gal che/ sgos su chos 'di la sngon 'gro dmigs pa re re bzhin/ zhag shas zhag 'ga' re skyong ba'i phyag srol bzang po yod pas/ de bar la nyin re bzhin go ba skyed pa'i chos thun re byas na legs pa dang*/ sngar nas chos kyi go don la rang byan tshud pa ni shin tu dkon/ chos spyi'i go rgya la phan pa zhig kyang nges par dgos pas/ cung zad zhib pa tsam bshad pa yin no/ /blo gros chen po rnams bshad pa 'di tsam la bltos pa ga la yin/ 'bring po rnams kyis 'di la ci rigs bsnan pa'am 'di kho na'i steng nas gsung bar zhu/ blo chung na 'di'i nang nas nye bar mkho mkho bsdus te shod cig mchog tu zab pa'i chos tshul 'di/ /skye bo kun la ston pa'i phyir/ /lhan thabs mdo tsam bris pa 'di/ 'gro don mdzad bzhed rnams la mkho/ /da ni dngos gzhi'i skabs su khrid yig gi dkyus la ji tsam yod pa nges par byas nas/ spros pa la mos na go don rnams zung 'jug rab gsal tu zhib par bris yod pas/ de dag las ji ltar 'os pa drangs te bshad pas rung la/ rtags snang rgyas par bshad pa rtags tshad kyi yi ge dang*/ ngo sprod dgos pa rnams ngo sprod phyi nang gi yi ge las rtogs dgos so/ /de dag tu rgyas par bshad zin pa rnams 'dir mi spro/ /spyir ni tshig gi rgyud la lhad mi 'jug pa dang*/ grub mtha'i gnad mi 'chug cing*/ gdams ngag gi rkang grangs rnams mi 'chad pa dang*/ 'khrugs mi 'gro ba'i phyir yig rigs la thig tshad byed dgos pa yin mod/ gdams ngag gi gnad dang ngo sprod kyi tshul rnams/ nyams su myong zhing blo la gnas pa'i sgo nas slob ma'i 'char sgo dang mthun par ngo sprod dgos kyi/ dpe ris ded pa tsam gyis gdams ngag gi gnad kyang mi longs shing sems ngo sprod du nams kyang mi btub bo/

/'on kyang de la bsam med kyi rnal 'byor zhes ma bsgrims ma klod dmigs brtad can gang yang med pa'i don te/ dpe lha khang lder bzo lta bu zhes pa'i skabs/ lha khang nang gi lder bzo de/ /'dug tshul bcas shing zhal 'dzum yang*/ /mi bsam bsam med tshul du 'dug /ces lab sgron gsung*/ dpe de bzhin du byed bcings lta stangs bcas kyang*/ yid byed dang rtsol ba cung zad kyang med pa'i don no/ /bsam med kyi rnal 'byor bya ba ni/ dpal sa ra has kyang*/ bsam dang bsam bya yongs su spangs nas su/ /ji ltar bu chung tshul du 'dug pa yis/ / bsgrims te bla ma'i lung la gus 'bad na/ /lhan cig skyes pa 'byung bar the tshom med/ /ces gsungs te/ grim lhod dang bral ba bu chung btsas ma thag pa lta bu'i shes pa ste/ bsam pa rig pa nang na 'dug pa dang*/ bsam bya yul phyi rol na 'dug pa gang la'ang mi sems pa'o/ /rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor zhes pa ni/ rnam rtog gi 'dzin zhen ci yang med kyang*/ nam mkha' la rtse gcig tu bsgrims pa ste/ de yang do ha mdzod las/ sems ni nam mkha' 'dra bar bzung bya ste/ /nam mkha' rang bzhin nyid du sems nyid bzung*/ /yid de yid ma yin par byed gyur na/ /des ni bla med byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ rig pa nam mkha' la bsres pas/ sems nam mkha' 'dra ba ste/ rnam rtog spros pa'i mtshan ma gang yang med pa zhig 'byung*/ de goms pas sems nam mkha'i rang bzhin te spros bral du 'gyur/ yid yid ma yin par byed pa zhes pa ni/ sngar 'gyu byed can gyi sems de bsgrims te bzhag pa'i shugs kyis rnam rtog btsan thabs su 'gag pa'i don yin/ dpe spre'u sgo gcig pa zhes pa ni khang pa skar khung mang po yod pa gcig tu spre'u gcig bzhag na/ spre'u ni 'phyar rgod che bas skar khung thams cad nas nyug tsam nyug tsam yang yang blta bas na/ phyi nas bltas na spre'u mang po yod pa ltar snang*/

sgo gcig bzhag nas gzhan rnams bkag na/ de kho na nas blta zhing sdod pas/ phyi nas blta ba rnams kyis spre'u gcig tu go bar 'gyur/ de bzhin du sems 'di yang kha yan du bzhag na/ dbang po lnga dang 'grogs te dbang shes so so la brten yid rnam rtog mtha' yas pa zhig 'char bas/ sems du ma yod pa ltar snang yang 'phro ba bkag na/ sems kyi rgyud gcig la lhan ne 'phral du gnas pa yin no/ /sgom med kyi rnal 'byor zhes bya ba ni/ sngar rjes mi bcad sngon mi bsu/ /ltar 'dzin med pa nam mkhar bzhag /dus gsum rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul bcad/ /de ltar rtog med ting 'dzin gnas/ /zhes pa ste/ 'das ma 'ongs yid la mi byed par ma zad/ da lta dngos su snang ba la yang blta rgyu dang bzung rgyu gang yang med pas/ rnam rtog dang 'brel ba'i sgom pa ci yang med pa'i phyir/ sgom med ces bya/ yang do ha las/ 'khor ba'i rang bzhin sems kyi ngo bo nyid yin zhes/ /rmongs pa mda' bsnun gyis smras rtsen ne shes par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'di nam mkha'i snang ba dang 'dres pa'i sems gsal rig gi cha la blta ba yin pas/ 'khor ba rnam par rtog pa'i 'char sgo thams cad shar tsam nyid nas gsal rig gi ngo bo nyid du rang dag tu byed pa'i phyir/ rang grol gyi rnal 'byor ram/ 'char sgo thams cad dbyings su ro snyoms par byed pa'i phyir/ ro gcig gam ro mnyam gyi rnal 'byor zhes kyang zer la/ rtsen ne zhes pas 'dir sems kyi 'jog thabs bstan te/ dus 'das ma 'ongs gnyis dang phyogs phyi nang gnyis la ma reg par/ 'jog tshul grims lhod ran pos bar seng der/ dper 'dab chags sgrin po zhig shing rtser chags pa lta bu'i sems 'jog tshul te/ spyir 'di yang sems bsgrims pa'i phyogs so/ /dpe spun gsum gyi bar ma dang 'grogs pa zhes pa/ byis pa rnams rtsed mo byed pa na/ pha rol po spun gsum yod pa'i/ rgan pa ni rang bas che/

gzhon pa ni rang bas chung*/ bar pa rang dang mnyam pa zhig yod na/ rgan gzhon gnyis dang shed mi snyoms pas/ gnya' sbre rtse ba sogs mi bde la/ bar ma de dang shed snyoms pas 'grogs bde/ rtsed mo rtse spro ba bzhin du 'das pa ni 'das zin pas rjes bcad kyang mi chod/ ma 'ongs pa'i 'dod don dang re dogs ni 'byung bar ma nges pas/ re dogs byas kyang mi phan de gnyis la blo brtad kyang sems 'khrugs pa kho nar zad/ des na da ltar gyi snang ba gang shar 'di la/ blang dor med par bzhag na bde bas de skad ces pa'o/ /rtsol bral gyi rnal 'byor zhes pa bsgrims 'phro la klod pa de rtsol ba yin yang/ klod zin pa la rtsol bral la gnas pa yin/ de yang bram chen gyi zhal nas/ 'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid de/ /klod na grol bar the tshom med/ /ces gsungs shing*/ gcod pa rnams na re/ khrims kyis bsgrims la lhod kyis klod/ /sems kyi bzhag thabs de na gda'/ /zhes so/ /de'i phyir 'di la klod pa rang grol gyi gdams ngag ces kyang zer/ spyir ched du bsgrims pa kho na dang*/ ched du klod pa kho na dang*/ bsgrims klod spel ma dang*/ bsgrims kyang ma bsgrims lhod kyang ma klod pa ste gnad bzhi po rnams/ skabs su gang dang gang bab pa de dang der bogs dbyung ba'i thabs khyad par can byed pa kho na yin/ gnas lugs la ni de dag gang gis kyang ma gos mod/ kha cig spang blang dgag sgrub mi byed pa'i 'dzin stangs bzang pos/ mthar spang blang gcig tu ka sleb yod pa ste/ rang tshig 'gal zhing*/ lha bdud du 'bab/ sman dug tu song ngo*/ /dper na 'bri khung pa chen po'i rnam thar na/ ngas sa ra ha'i lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po bsgom/ de yang rig pa klod kyin gdog byas pas/ bla ma na re/ phyag rgya chen po la klod don ci yod/ gsungs skad/ de gdams ngag bzang bar byed/ yang 'bab rung ba'i slob ma/ lus gnad bcas nas bsgom pa la/

zhang 'tshal pa na re/ 'di tsug byas kyang phyag rgya chen po zhes yang yang gsung gin stangs stabs sna tshogs mdzad/ de yang gdams ngag gi gnad che zer te/ gang zag de la dus der de skad gsung dgos pa zhig yod pa ni yin te mchis/ spyi khyab kyi nyams len la ni/ gnad che rgyu tsam ma byung*/ khyad par blang dor dgag sgrub med par zhal gyis bzhes nas/ phugs dgag sgrub kyi steng du ka sleb/ phyag rgya chen po la klod don te med du chug /klod du mi rung ba'i don yang ci yod/ klod pa cher brtad bkag /klod mi dgos pa sgrub pa de ka spang blang dgag sgrub yin mod/ yang lus gnad la gzhur ba bkag /'dug tshul nges med sgrub pa de ka spang blang dgag sgrub yin/ klod don med gsung pa'ang*/ klod na grol bar the tshom med/ gsung ba dang ni rgyab 'gal lags/ de bzhin du sgom chen pa phal cher blos byas bkag nas/ ma bcos so ma sgrub ste/ dgag sgrub de ka blos byas yin/ bcos par song*/ dri mas phog yang sgom mtho mtho mor 'dod pa 'ga' zhig na re/ ma bcos so mar 'jog pa yang las su 'dug bdag po 'dug nga la ni bcos ma bcos med do/ /so ma dang las song la'ang khyad med do zer kyin 'ud gog 'thag ste/ ma bcos so ma la zhe brnag pa de ka khyad snga chen po phyung pa'i rtags yin pas kha dang don 'dzol/ go ba dang nyams myong ma mthun pa lags so/ /'phros pas chog go /dper rnga mong btags grol lta bu zhes pa ni/ sngon rnga rdzi gcig gis rnga mong zhig phur bu la brtod nas bzhag pas/ de gu dog nas ldang nyal tsab tsob 'then 'gros kho na byed/ rtsa yang mi za nyal yang mi nyal lo/ /des phur bu bkrol te btang bas/ dar cig rgyugs song ste bkrol bar shes pa na/ sngar gyi gu dog sangs bag phebs te/ khyu re nyal song bas/ rnga rdzi des grogs mo la smras pa/ btags na phyogs bcur rgyug par brtson/ /bkrol na g.yo med gnas pa yi/

/mdza' mo bdag gis rnga mo mthong*/ /bdag la phyin ci log tu snang*/ /zer skad/ don de'i dbang du byas nas mda' bsnun chen pos/ bcings pa dag ni phyogs bcur rgyug par brtson/ /thongs bar gyur na mi g.yo brtan par gnas/ / go bzlog rnga mong lta bur bdag gis rtogs/ /bu kye rnams kyang rang la cher re ltos/ /zhes gsungs/ dmigs pa bzhi po de dag re re bzhin nyams myong skyes skyes su bsgom/ de rjes bzhi kar gnad gcig tu dril te sgom tshul dkyus bzhin no/ /yang rgyud dang sems 'grel las nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gyi dbye ba tsam ma gtogs/ sor sdud kyi dmigs pa gcig las med/ sbyor drug gi man ngag gzhan phal cher na yang gcig kho na yin/ bi bhu ti tsand+ra'i nye rgyud man ngag la bzhi po 'di byung*/ 'o na rgyud gzhung dang 'gal snyam na mi 'gal te/ 'di'i dmigs pa bzhi kar rgyud 'grel las gsungs pa'i dmigs pa gcig po der 'dus shing*/ 'di'i lugs la yang bzhi po mthar gcig tu bsdus nas sgom pa'i phyir/ rgyud 'grel las gsungs pa mdor bstan dang*/ man ngag 'di rgyas bshad yin no/ /des na sor sdud kyi man ngag bi bhu ti'i lugs 'di gzhan pas kyang mchog tu gyur pa yin zhing*/ 'di la kha cig bi bhu tis khong rang gi slob ma mar ston/ gzhon tshul/ dpyal ba/ nyeg po bzhi la so so'i blo dang mtshungs par/ dmigs pa'i gnad mi 'dra ba so so bstan pa rnams/ kun spangs chen pos bzhi kar gsan nas/ phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa yin yang zer te/ don la de ltar rang yang ma yin/ grub thob shā bā ri pa ni/ bram ze chen po'i do has rgyud grol ba yin zhing*/ do ha la brten nas shā bā ri ba'i man ngag 'di dag bi bhu ti tsand+ra la gdams pa yin pa'i phyir/ nye brgyud 'di la dmigs pa bzhi po 'di gdod nas grub pa yin/ thun tshags bsdus pa min no/ /de yang khungs dang 'brel ba bden par smras pa yin gyi bzang por 'grub tu re nas nged cag rnams kyis mdzes sgrig smras pa ma yin te/

smra dgos med pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyu mtshan ni/ rigs ldan gyi sprul pa'i sku nyid kyi phyir kun spangs chen pos sgrig par mdzad na thun tshags sgrig pa yin yang des go chod de/ de bas lhag pa'i khungs 'tshol mi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dmigs skor lnga po 'dis/ sor sdud kyi mtshan nyid tshang bar 'gyur bas/ 'di rnams rdzogs par bshad nas/ dngos gzhi mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor gyi mun 'khrid la 'jug pa thob thang yin mod/ dmigs pa bzhi'am lnga po de/ thun gcig la 'chad pa sla yang*/ slob ma blo dman rnams kyi blo la nges dka' zhing*/ zhag shas dmigs pa skyong stabs mi bde bar/ dngos gzhi'i chos thun thog ma rang bshad/ de nub ka mun 'khrid la 'jug pa lag len bde bas/ bsam med kyi rnal 'byor gcig pu phog nas/ dam po zhag bdun byed/ de rjes kyang nyin mo'i rnal 'byor de ma thag sgom na/ bsam med kyi rnal 'byor kho na/ nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gyi gnas su byed bcings byed du bcug ste bsgom/ nyin 'khrid dam po zhag ji ltar 'os pa song ba na/ rtse gcig pa'i rnal 'byor sogs dmigs pa phyi ma rnams/ nyin mtshan gnyis ka'i thun mong du da gdod bskyangs kyang chog go /nyin mo'i rnal 'byor gyi thad na/ 'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni/ zhes pa'i skabs/ dmigs pa gtod sa la mun nag dang*/ snang ba dang bcas pa'i nam mkha' sngo sangs kyi khyad byung bas/ mig gi lta stangs kyi byed bcings kyang mi 'dra bar byung ba yin te/ mun khang du blta lugs ji ltar byas kyang nam mkha' mun nag kho na mthong yong*/ snang ba dang bcas pa'i phyogs su mig phyed bkab byas na/ nam mkha' sngo sangs mi mthong ba'i phyir/ mig gdangs pa dgos so/ /dang por mun 'khrid la chu shing ri brag dud 'gro mi sogs ma nges pa ji snyed 'char yang*/ nyin mo'i nam mkha' la ni 'od dang thig le sogs yang yang 'char ba las/ gzhan ma nges pa sna tshogs rang mi 'byung ba shas che/

shin tu goms na khyad med par 'byung*/ mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor la/ rtags snang sna tshogs mang po zhag bdun tshun chod la 'char ba'i rigs can la yang*/ nyin mo'i rnal 'byor la/ de ltar 'char ba la zla ba gsum bzhi tsam dgos pa shas che zhing*/ mtshan mo'i de la brtan mi brtan gnyis yod/ nyin mo'i de lan gcig shar na brtan po rang yong ba 'dug spogs chog gi skabs su/ bla ma tsa mi lo tsā ba'i gsung gis lus grong khyer dang 'dra/ rtsa lam srang dang 'dra/ rlung rta dang 'dra/ sems de la zhon pa'i mi dang 'dra/ byed bcings kyis rtsa sgo dgag thub na/ srang sgo dgag pa dang 'dra bas/ mi rta dang 'dra ba'i rlung sems phyir mi 'chor/ mi khegs na de las ldog pa'o/ /gsung skad/ sbud kra o rgyan pa'i man ngag rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub na/ nam mkha'i dbyings su gza' rnams brtan par bcings/ rgya mtsho'i dbus su rtsa gsum yan lag bsngam/ /zhes sor sdud kyi skabs su steng 'og bar gsum gyi bum can byed gsung pa yang*/ khong pa lto ba tshigs pa la gcer ba 'di mi byed/ gzhan thams cad spogs chog 'di kha bzhin byas nas/ de sor sdud kyi rtsa ba'i dmigs par 'dod pa yin/ rang lugs la de rtsa ba'i dmigs par byas na/ rgyud dang mi mthun/ snga ma nas sbyor ba dam grags pa de phyis bogs chung*/ rnal 'byor gsum snying dang dus zhabs snyan rgyud las/ phyis kyi spogs chog tu bshad pa ltar byas na/ rgyud las btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba spogs chog tu gsungs/ 'di yang rtsa'i btsan thabs kyi rigs yin pas rgyud dang mthun/ sngar dkyus kyi dmigs pa 'jam po de la lam 'byongs nas skabs skabs su sbyor ba drag po 'di brtsams na/ phyogs mthun la ni goms/ dngos la ni ma 'dris pas bogs skyed che bar yong*/ de yang phyogs mthun lam goms na/ gzhi rten ma thing ba'i skyon dang*/ sbyor ba drag po la 'dres grags na/ dper na rgyun du ga bur bsten pa'i mi de/

tshad pas na ba la ga bur gyi sman btang yang mi phan pa dang 'dra ba zhig 'ong*/ des na 'di spogs chog kho na yin no/ /de yang mig bsgrims pas mig gi rlung dang*/ sna bsnyer bas sna dang*/ kha bgrad lce sgril bas lce dang*/ sna dang mchu bcud pas rna ba krong 'byung bas rna ba dang*/ nya bzhi bsgrims pa sogs kyis lus kyi dbang po'i rlung la gzir ba yin/ rlung de rnams kyang srog thur gnyis dang ro gcig tu gnas pas/ lto ba 'phel 'grib gyi sbyor ba 'dis/ srog thur bcings bas de dag kyang 'ching ngo*/ /sgom don blo la 'god pa'i rtags ched kyi skabs/ sor bsam gyi ting nge 'dzin mngon sum tshad mar rgyud 'grel las gsungs/ dus 'khor gyi rgyud 'grel tshad mar khas len bzhin du/ stong gzugs 'khrul snang du 'dod na/ nang 'gal gyi btson rar chug 'khrul snang mthong ba'i shes pa la ma 'khrul ba ga la srid/ gzhan yang re zhig 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi dbang du byas na yang*/ ma dag las snang ma 'khrul ba dang*/ lam ma nor ba sgom pa'i rtags rnams 'khrul bar 'dod pa/ 'khrul ma 'khrul gyi rnam gzhag go log yin zhing*/ yang stong gzugs ni rlung sems dbu mar thim pa'i snang ba yin zhing*/ de ltar yin par 'o skol mthun par khas len na| stong gzugs 'khrul snang yin na/ rtsa dbu ma de ye shes skyed byed ma yin/ 'khrul pa skyed byed kyi rtsa yin par 'gyur te/ de la gnad du bsnun pa'i snang ba de 'khrul snang yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang stong gzugs log pa'i kun rdzob tu 'dod pa'ang dbu ma ye shes kyi rtsas log snang dang*/ ro rkyang 'khor ba'i rtsas yang dag kun rdzob bskyed do zhes par 'gyur bas/ 'di dag ji ltar yin blo rnal du gnas pa rnams kyis rtogs shig rang lugs ni stong pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i snang ba mngon sum du snang ba'i phyir/ dbang po'i mngon sum/ yid rnam rtog gi bzhon pa rlung 'gags pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir yid kyi mngon sum/

stong gzugs de don dam chos nyid kyi rang gzugs yin pas chos nyid mthong ba'i shes pa rnal 'byor mngon sum/ stong gzugs dang de mthong ba'i rig pa ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir des de mthong bas rang rig mngon sum yin pas/ spyir mngon sum bzhi char yin yang*/ sor bsam gyi skabs 'dir dbang po'i mngon sum gyi mtshan nyid gtso che gsung ngo*/ /de ltar na stong gzugs mthong ba ni/ yang dag pa'i tshad ma yin te/ 'di la 'phags mchog grub mchog thams cad dgongs pa mthun no/ /de la re zhig dpa' bo sa ra has/ rmongs pa nam mkha'i tshad ma ni/ /gal te shes na rmongs tshogs gcod/ /dang por rnam dag nam mkha' la/ /lta zhing lta bas mthong ba 'gag /ces phyi nang gi nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gnyis gsungs/ de la mthong ba 'gag pa ni nang gi nam mkha' yin/ des rnam rtog rmongs pa'i tshogs rnams bcad de/ ye shes skye bar 'gyur ba ni/ me long phyis pa tsam na gzugs brnyan 'char ba bzhin no/ /klu sgrub kyis kyang*/ gang rnams kyi blo rten dang bral/ /yod dang med las rnam par 'das/ /zab mo dmigs med de rnams kyis/ /mtshan ma'i don ni rnam par sgom/ /zhes gsungs te/ blo rten dang bral pa ni rig pa nam mkha'i dbyings su bsam med du bzhag pa'i don yin/ yod med las 'das pa ni de'i rnam rtog med pa'am/ ji skad du/ skye ba med pa mthong ba ni/ / gzhon nu ma yi bu ji bzhin/ /zhes pa lta bu ste/ de ltar na mtshan ma'i don ni stong gzugs yin la/ dmigs pa med pa'i sems kyis stong gzugs de sgom zhes pa'o/ /mtshan ma'i don zhes 'byung bas kyang*/ 'khrul snang tsam yin don du yod ces par go nus so/ /yang ji skad du/ /sngon med dpyid byung nam mkha'i me tog 'bras/ /lag pas thogs reg byar med sa ra ha/ /mig mi 'dzum par blta dang mi bsam dang*/ /rlung 'gags pa ste bla ma dam pas gsungs/ /zhes te mi g.yo ba gsum la brten nas/

rlung 'gag shing sems gnas pas bde ba skye ba ni/ sngon med pa'i dpyid kyi dus yin la/ skabs der nam mkha' ste sems stong nyid kyi ngang las/ me tog dang 'bras bu lta bu'i stong gzugs ji snyed pa shar/ de'i rgyu ni mig steng du mi 'dzum par blta ba'i byed bcings dang*/ sems bsam du med pa'i rnal 'byor gyis rlung 'gags pa las yin zhes pa ste/ 'dir mig dang sems dang rlung ni sna rtse gsum gcig tu bsdu ba'i gdams ngag ces 'chad pa yang*/ gzhung 'di'i don yin pa shin tu legs so/ /yang bar snang la ni yid dang rlung dang mig /dus gcig tu ni gal te nges sbyar na/ /rin chen rgyal ba'i yon tan nges par skye/ /'di dag mtha' dag de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs/ / sna tshogs rnam rtog bral zhing mi sems par/ /gal te bar snang la ni mig bltas na/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mtha' dag yin nam snyam/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug mtha' dag 'di las thob/ /ces gsungs te/ 'dis kyang sna rtse gsum gcig tu bsdu ba bstan nas/ rnal 'byor 'di kho na las sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad 'byung*/ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' dag gis rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i lam 'di rnams gsungs so/ /'dir/ mtha' dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'di dag gsungs/ /zhes bcos na go bde'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi yon tan ji ltar skye na/ sna tshogs pa'i rnam rtog rtog dpyod kyi sgo nas mi sems par/ stong gzugs bsgoms na mthar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten mtha' dag gi snang ba can rnam pa kun ldan gyi sku rjes dran du 'grub cing*/ de las yon tan mtha' yas pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sangs rgyas byang sems kyi go 'phang thams cad 'di las thob par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du zhi ba lha'i rdo rje'i glu las kyang*/ rmad byung nam mkha'i dkyil shar bhu su ku/ /stong nyid gzugs mdzes shar ro bhu su ku/
