/dpe med me tog shar ro bhu su ku/ /rin thang med pa'i me tog rin chen long*/ me tog 'di ni kha dog sna tshogs can/ /me tog 'di ni stong nyid dgon par rgyas/ /zhes 'byung ste/ nyin mtshan gyi nam mkha' la stong nyid kyi gzugs mdzes pa/ sngon khams gsum pa'i sems can sus kyang ma mthong ba rmad du byung ba ste/ sa'i rnam par snang yang sa ma yin/ sa ma yin yang sa dang mtshungs pa'i bya ba byed/ sdug bsngal gyi rnam par snang yang ngo bo bde ba yin/ kun rdzob kyi bya ba byed kyang don dam dbyings las ma 'das pa sogs/ dpe gang gis kyang mi mtshon pa'i stong gzugs kyi me tog shar ro/ /'di las lam dang 'bras bu'i yon tan thams cad 'byung bas/ stong gzugs 'di ni ring thang med pa'i rin po che yin/ 'khor 'das srid gsum thams cad kyi gzugs su 'char bas kha dog sna tshogs pa can/ mi'i rgyun klung med pa'i 'brog dgon pa bzang po na me tog rnams rgyas pa bzhin du/ me tog dang 'dra ba'i rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs 'di ni stong nyid nam mkha'i rnal 'byor rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings la mnyam par gzhag na rgyas par 'gyur gyi rnam rtog phal ba'am dge chos yin du chug kyang rtog dpyod kyi mi 'gro 'ong mang po byung na/ rgyas par mi 'gyur ro/ /dgon par zhes pa'i tshig zur gyi mi rtog pa 'ba' zhig dgos par bstan te/ lung de dang mthun par myong grub la yang*/ dpyad sgom dang*/ rnam rtog ngo lta'i sgom la/ yun ring bsgoms kyang stong gzugs yin nges lar mi 'char nyams than thun byung srid na'ang de yang mang po mi yong la/ byed bcings dang ldan pa'i mi rtog pa sgoms na stong gzugs mang po 'phral du 'byung ba/ da lta su'i lag len la btab kyang myong bas grub/ sngon dus byung ngo ba la khag 'jog mi dgos/ bre srang 'khris su bzhes nas bod tshod kyis ci byed/ dgag sgrub mtha' bkod mang po'i kha na med do/

/stong gzugs me tog dang ji ltar 'dra tshul la/ sa la me tog shar ba ltar tho lang de 'char ba'i don du 'chad pa dang*/ bkrag mdangs gsal ba'i don la 'chad pa dang*/ brda tshig tsam yin zer ba sogs 'dug kyang*/ rang lugs ni bde ba skye bas yid du 'ong*/ yid du 'ong bas me tog dang 'dra zhes kho bo'i bla ma gsung pa ltar ro/ /de bzhin du/ lā ma nam mkha'i me tog shar/ /rab tu mi gnas lci ba'o/ /blta zhing lta ba nam langs kyang*/ shān ti sgron mes lam 'tshol lo/ /skya rengs shar ro bhu su ku/ / shān tis smras pa nam langs thun/ /zhes 'byung ste/ lā ma ni dga' ma'am/ rol pa mo zhes phyag rgya'am rtsa dbu ma la bos nas/ thog mar dge ba'i skabs su lus kyi phyi'i nam mkha' la gtso bor snang ba dang*/ bar dge la rtsa'i nang gi nam mkha' la gtso bor snang ba dang*/ mtha' dge la mnyam nyid mkha' khyab ste/ nam mkha' de rnams kyi me tog stong gzugs shar/ 'di rnal 'byor pas lus kyi phyi nang sogs su yod par mthong yang*/ gnas tshul la gang du yang rab tu mi gnas te/ kun rdzob las snang 'di dag gdod nas med pa'i phyir/ dper na sad dus kyi bum pa de rmi lam gyi khang pa'i phyi nang gang na'ang med pa bzhin no/ /lci ba ni/ yal yul ma yin pa brjid dang ldan pa ste brtan pa'i don yin/ de yang sgrub po rang nyid gyis mthong ma mthong gi khyad par ma gtogs/ chos nyid yin pas sngar gdod nas grub grub pa dang*/ da dung 'pho 'gyur med pa'o/ /des na dngos po shin tu yang ba gcig rten gzhi la mi gnas par/ nam mkha' la phan tshun du 'khyer zhing yeng yeng 'dug pa 'thad kyang*/ dngos po brjid dang ldan pa rten gzhi med par nam mkha' la sdod mi thub pa 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa las/ brjid dang ldan pa la rten gzhi mi dgos par/ nam mkha' la brtan por sdod pa zhig kyang 'dug go zhes/ tshig gi brjod tshul 'gal 'du'i tshul gyis brda thabs mdzad pa'o/

/rtag tu ting nge 'dzin la blta zhing lta bas/ bdag med dang stong rkyang gi phyogs kyis nam langs pa ste/ de tsam gyis/ phyogs nas gnas lugs rtogs su chug kyang*/ mthar thug tu bgrod pa'i lam da dung ma rnyed pas/ shān ti da ni stong gzugs kyi sgron me thogs nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam 'tshol zhing yod do/ /yang na dang po rang du stong gzugs mthong ba tsam ni/ skya rengs shar ba dang 'dra/ de rjes rnam pa kun ldan du gyur pa ni/ nam langs pa lta bu'o zhes kyang 'chad do/ /dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel chen don dam bsdus par/ lung drangs pa la/ skabs 'dir 'grel ba'i rgya dpe rnying pa zhig la cung zad 'khrul gzhi yod par snang bas/ tshig de'i 'phros chad nas gang tshe zla ba gang ba sogs dang sbrel 'dug na/ zla ba gang ba sogs nag po spyod pa'i do ha'i tshig yin pa/ spyod pa'i glu'i mdzod 'grel las gsal zhing*/ de'i gseb tu/ dga' dang snying rje ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /'phags pa lha yi dmigs pa med pa gsal/ /zhes pa'i tshig 'di yang*/ gzhan zhig gi tshig 'phros yin par snang*/ grub thob ratna pā las bsgyur ba'i do ha mang po'i nang gi ārya de ba'i glu can ta pa nas brgyud pa yin gsung ba'i do ha gcig na/ kye ma snying rje'i ḍā ma ru/ /sgra sgrog pa ni ngo mtshar che/ /ārya de ba dmigs med pa'i/ /rgyal po'i srid la ngoms pa med/ / ces 'byung ba de ka drangs par mngon/ dga' dang zhes pa ngo mtshar dang rgyal po'i srid gsal bar bsgyur ba'i khyad du 'dug 'di ārya de ba rang gi do ha yin par 'dug pa la/ nam langs thun sogs dang sbrel nas bris pas/ zhi ba lha'i gsung du 'khrul nas/ zhi lha ārya'i dngos slob yin zhes yid bzang rtse ba gsung pa ni gad mo'i gnas so/ /des na 'grel pa de'i rtsom gdan lta bu phyi mo'i rgya dpe rnying pa bar bar na yi ge zubs pa zhig las bris bshus byas pa'i rgya dpe ma dag pa zhig las bsgyur ba'i skyon no/

/des na snga ma'i tshig nam langs thun zhes pa'i 'gros kyi dbang du byas na/ rnam pa kun ldan nam langs pa 'dra ba'i rjes su gzugs sems ro mnyam pa mi 'gyur ba'i bde bar gyur pa na nyi ma shar ba dang 'dra'o/ /zhes pa zhig don la yod dgos so/ /de bzhin du 'di skad ces/ rmad du byung ba gang zhig thun las byung*/ /gang zhig nyi zla bcings shing sgron me sbar/ /shān ti rang nyid dpang bzhag rang nyid dgod/ /nam mkha'i sbrum ma las ni skye ba mthong*/ /zhes dang*/ zab mo'i chos thos nas ni lam ngan pa/ /mun pa'i lam las ci yang mthong ba med/ /gal te nam mkha'i rtse mor me tog byung*/ /shān tis smras pa de tshe 'khrul pa chad/ /ces 'byung ste/ 'di skabs kyi shān ti zhes pa yang shān ta de ba dang shānti de ba la khyad yod dam med dpyad dgos la/ sngar drangs pa shān ti sgron me sogs ni bhu su ku zhes 'byung bas/ shān ti de ba ste zhi ba lha'i gsung yin pa bzhin du/ 'di yang shān ti de ba'i yin zhes bla ma rnams 'chad do/ /spyir ni spyod 'jug mdzad pa po la phal cher du shānta de ba zhes 'byung ba dang*/ grub thob shānti'i mtshan can gzhan mang du yod pa'ang go dgos so/ /thun las byung zhes pa ni/ thun bzhi ste nyi ma gcig kho na bsgoms pas rtags snang 'byung ba'i don yin/ nyi zla ro rkyang bcings shing*/ ye shes kyi rlung gi sgron me sbar bas/ nam mkha' stong pa'i bud med sbrum ma las stong gzugs gyi bu skye ba mthong*/ rang la cha rgyus yod pas rang nyid dpang por bzhag ste/ de 'dra ba mthong bas dga' nas 'god pa ste/ dga' ba'i don bdag nyid la yid ches pa'o/ /mun par zhugs pa bzhin du zab mo'i chos ma thos shing lam ngan la zhugs pa rnams kyis/ ye shes kyi snang ba mthong ba med la/ zab mo'i chos thos nas gal te mnyam par bzhag na/ mnyam gzhag rtog bral gyi nam mkha'i rtse mor/ 'od gsal rtags bcu'i me tog shar ba de'i tshe/

ma dag log snang gi 'khrul ba chad do zhes/ 'dis bsam gtan gyi rnal 'byor yang zhor la bstan to/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pas kyang spros med las/ rnal 'byor 'di las sgrub pa'o/ /du ba la sogs mngon shes sogs/ /rnam rtog dra ba ma lus gcod/ /shin tu spros med go 'phang thob/ /ces rlung dbu mar 'gags pa las/ rtags kyi ye shes skye bar gsungs te/ de yang spros med kyi lugs la/ bidhar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ni sngon 'gro rlung sbyang ba yin/ spros med nyid sor sdud dang gnad gcig rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor ni/ spogs chog btsan thabs su 'gyur/ de ltar sgoms pa las/ sor bsam thun mong la du sogs kyi ye shes dang*/ bsam gtan gyi 'bras bu mngon shes kyi bar du 'byung*/ zhes pa'i don yin pas/ ming 'dogs kyi khyad tsam ma gtogs/ shin tu spros med kyi gzhung gi dgongs pa yang rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di la 'bad pa yin la/ 'di dang de sbyor tshul gzhan yang yod do/ /de bzhin du/ /rang yid mtshan nyid mtha' dag bral pa yis/ /mig phyed gyen du blta ba dang bcas pas/ /gang tshe dbu mar rlung ni bus gyur pa/ /de tshe rdo rje me dang du ba 'byung*/ /de yang mtshan nyid dang bral ba ni mtshan ma rnam rtog spangs pa yin/ de dang byed bcings lta stangs dang bcas pa las/ las rlung dbu mar bus pa'i tshul gyis 'jug de las rdo rje ye shes kyi gtum mo'i me 'bar ba dang*/ du sogs khams gsum pa'i gzugs brnyan 'byung*/ zhes pa ste/ rgyu mi g.yo gsum ldan bsgoms pas 'bras bu srog 'dzin rjes dran sogs skye ba'i don yin no/ /'di la lung khungs ma smos kyang*/ ind+ra bhu ti'i do ha nas drangs pa yin gsung*/ de bzhin du grub thob lwa ba pas kyang*/ snang ba thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gzhan du rtags ni shes bya ste/ /grub pa'i 'khrul pa med pa rnams/ /lam nag gis ni du ba

bzhin/ /mig dag rengs par byed pa dang*/ /mgo bo dud pa nyid dang mi/ / sems dang sems byung mi g.yo dang*/ /stong nyid mthong ba'i stong pa nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ mig rengs pa ste lta stangs brtan pa dang*/ des ro rkyang gi rtsa'i mgo bo spyi gtsug nas mig gi gnas su bkug ste/ dud par byas nas 'then pa lta bur 'gyur ba dang*/ sems sems byung 'gags pa ni/ rnam rtog btsan thabs su bkag pa'i mi rtog pa ste/ de ltar bsgoms pas gzung 'dzin gyis stong pa'i stong nyid de yang rnam med tsam ma yin par/ dngos su mthong rgyu yod pa'i stong nyid kyi gzugs mthong*/ de nyid ye shes kyi snang ba thob pa yin/ de lam dngos yin yang*/ rnam gzhag 'jog tshul gzhan gcig la lam rtags kyi tha snyad 'jog par shes dgos te/ grub pa mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba thob par 'gyur ba'i rtags 'khrul pa med pa ni stong gzugs rnams la mnyam par bzhag pas bde ba skye ba 'di yin te/ lam nag ces pa me'i ming yin pa/ bud shing 'tshig bzhin pa'i me yod pa'i rtags/ du ba 'phyur ba mthong ba bzhin/ zhes pa'o/ /de bzhin du grub thob dharma pas kyang*/ dang po thog mtha' las grol zhing*/ /dbu ma tsam zhig brten par bya/ /der gnas gang zhig 'dod pa ste/ /'di yi snang ba bcu bdag nyid/ ces te/ tshig rkang phyi ma gsum la/ 'gyur gzhan las/ dbu ma tsam la rnam par gnas/ /de la gnas shing de spong gang*/ /de las mtshan ma bcu 'byung ngo*/ /zhes 'byung ba go bde'o/ /dang po thog mtha' zhes pa 'dis ni/ spun gsum gyi bar ma dang 'grogs pa'ang bstan la/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i dbu ma nam mkha' stong pa la sems gnas shing*/ nam mkha' dang rig pa rang nyid la yang*/ yin min yod med gnyis mnyam gyi 'dzin pa spong ba'i sgo nas bzhag cing gnas pas/ rtags bcu'i bdag nyid kyi ye shes kyi snang ba 'char bar 'gyur/ grub thob tsarba ṭi pas kyang*/

dngos min dngos por brten nas su/ /dngos po dngos po min par bya/ /sems ni sems min byas nas su/ /ci yang med par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ sems sngar rtog bcas de sems min pa rtog med du byed cing*/ de'i tshe ci med cang med/ rtags med mthong med du mi bya ste/ rdul phra rab kyi dngos po ma yin pa stong gzugs kyi dngos po la sems brtan zhing bzhag pas/ tha mal las snang gi dngos po rnams/ 'ga' zhig snang ba'i dngos po med pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig sna nga yang bden dngos min par rig par bya/ zhes pa ste/ 'dis kyang bsam gtan gyi rim pa gsal par byed do/ /yang bshad pa/ gang du dri ma med pa'i mkha' la mig phyed sprul pa na/ /'phro ba chen pos thugs rjes bslan pa'i bsam pa'i rten za las/ /yod dang med dang gnyis ka dngos po dngos med 'byed pa bral/ /stong pa nyid kyi rjes 'gro du sogs mtha' dag glo bur 'char/ /zhes 'byung ba/ 'di grub thob chen po dpe med mtsho'i sbyor drug gi gzhung na yod mod/ sngon du byon pa zhig gi grub thob kyi lung tshig skabs ngar bcug par ni nges par gsal la/ grub thob klu'i byang chub kyi gsung yin no zhes bla ma rnams gsung ngo*/ /nyin mtshan gyi nam mkha' dri ma med pa la/ mig phyed gyen du blta ba'i lta stangs sprul bar byas pa na/ bsam pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i mes yod pa dang med pa dang gnyis kar 'dzin pa sogs kyi rnam rtog bsregs/ sems can kun la 'phro zhing khyab pa'i snying rje dang*/ mi rtog pa sgom pa las gzhan dngos po dngos med 'byed pa ste dpyad sgom dang bral bar bsgoms na/ sems gdod nas spros pa dang bral ba'i stong nyid kyi rjes su 'gro ba du sogs rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid de/ yun ring dgug mi dgos par glo bur du 'char ro zhes so/ /grub chen nag po spyod pas kyang*/ gang tshe zla ba nya ba shar gyur pa/

/de tshe sems kyi rgyal po rab tu nyal/ /dga' dang snying rje ḍā ma ru yi sgra/ /zhes pa dang*/ g.yon dang g.yas su khral pa la/ /kahṇas smras pa bar lam mo/ /sems rtogs rin chen rab dgas grol/ /grong khyer mi smra rmongs pa rnams/ /me tog lnga byung de ru thim/ /dga' ba'i sems nyid nam mkhas byin/ /zhes gsungs te/ gang gi tshe stong gzugs kyi ye shes snang ba'i zla ba shar bar gyur pa na/ sems kyi rgyal po yid rtog bcas nyal zhing thim par 'gyur la/ de'i tshe bsam gtan gyi dga' bde lta bu'i dga' ba dang/ snying rje zhu bde 'gyur med kyi ḍā ma ru'i sgra grags par 'gyur zhes te skabs 'dir tshig de'i 'phros chad do/ /spyod pa'i glu'i mdzod 'grel na/ de tshe sems kyi rgyal po rab tu nyal/ /zhes 'byung dga' dang zhes pa 'di mi snang ngo*/ /g.yas g.yon ro rkyang gnyis kyi lam la rlung rgyu ba ni/ shog ma sogs khral sdud pa'i lam dang 'dra/ sems mgron po dang 'dra ba rlung de gnyis la brten nas song na/ khral sdud pas 'tshe ba byed pa dang 'dra bar/ nyon mongs sna tshogs skye/ sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'byung ngo*/ /lam de dag gi bar gseng lam khral sdud pas go rig mi 'byung ba zhig la tshong pa rnams song na/ khral sdud pas 'tshe ba med cing bde bar 'gro ba ltar/ byed bcings dang bcas pa'i rnam par mi rtog pa sgoms pas/ gsang lam dang 'dra ba dbu ma'i lam du rnam rtog dang*/ nyon mongs dang*/ sdug bsngal gyis 'tshe ba med par/ bde ba chen po'i dbyings su 'gro ste/ de yang zhu bde 'gyur med kyi thig le ni rin po che ste/ de'i rab tu dga' ba zhu bde lhan skyes kyis 'dzag bde mngon 'gyur gyi sgrib pa las grol bar byed cing*/ zhu bde 'gyur med kyi lhan skyes de ni/ don dam byang chub kyi sems rjes mthun pa yin pas/ sems rtogs pa zhes bya'o/ /rmongs pa rnams zhes bya ba ni bod pa ste/

grong khyer zhes pa kun la grags ba'i ngag tshig gsal po ste/ de ltar mi smra bar brda'i tshig gis nga smra'o/ /'byung ba lnga'i dwangs ma'i me tog thig le lnga gtsug tor nas nor bu'i bar du byung zhing*/ nor bur bcings pas/ rtsa dbu ma'i lam ji ltar 'os pa de nyid du thim par 'gyur la/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dga' ba'i sems nyid de ni/ don dam gyi nam mkha' stong gzugs phyag rgya chen pos byin zhes pa'o/ /de yang thig le nor bur son pa stong gzugs kyis bcings pas/ gzugs sems gcig tu 'dres pa na mi 'gyur ba'i don te/ 'dis yan lag drug kar gsal bar bstan to/ /ārya de bas kyang*/ bcom ldan srog gi lhag pa'i bdag po rje bo bdag nyid la ni thim gyur zhing*/ /'tsho ba'i rlung gi rgyu ba 'byung dang 'jug pa'i tshogs rab zhi bar gyur pa dang*/ /gang zhig rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams kyi 'od gsal skar ma'i snang ba rab 'byams 'di/ /rang lus nyid nas nges 'thon mun pa bcom nas 'jig rten gsum po snang bar byed/ /ces gsungs te/ de yang srog ste rlung thams cad kyi lhag pa'i bdag po'am rje bo na dbu ma'i rlung ste bcom ldan 'das zhes btags pa ste dus kyi 'khor lo'i rlung zhes rgyud las gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /gzhi dus kyi dbu ma'i dbus de lam du byas pas/ ye shes kyi rlung du gyur pa na las rlung rnams ye shes kyi rlung bdag nyid la ni thim par 'gyur zhing*/ 'tsho ba las kyi rlung 'di'i rgyu ba/ sna sgo nas 'byung 'jug byed pa'i tshogs rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar rlung thim pa las/ 'od gsal rtags bcu'i snang ba rab 'byams shar ba ni/ mkha' la skar ma shar ba lta bu'o/ /yang na skar ma'i skad dod/ dzyo ti ni 'ja' 'od la'ang 'jug go /stong gzugs kyi gtum mo 'bar ba de ni dbu ma las byung rang lus gang lus las thon nas nam mkha' gang ba'i mun pa bcom nas 'od gsal bar byed/

ma dag pa'i srid gsum gyi snang ba mgo gnon pa'i tshul gyis sbyong bar byed do/ /mun pa bcoms pa ni 'phral du mngon shes skye ba dang*/ phugs gnas lugs rtogs pa'o/ /'dis gtso bor rjes dran gyi stong gzugs bshad pa yin yang*/ rnam pa 'dra ba'i sgo nas yan lag drug ka la 'byor ro/ /des na 'od gsal rtags bcu la mnyam par gzhag pas ni/ ma dag pa'i srid gsum zil gyis mnan nas ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas par byed pa'o/ /de ltar na rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug thams cad kyi gshegs shul du grub cing*/ grub thob kun gyis du ba la sogs pa'i lam 'di bsgoms pa yin no/ /lung 'dren 'di rnams kyi don gsal bar bshad pa cher mi 'dug cing*/ mchan bu cung zad bris pa 'dra 'dug pa yang*/ bsdus grags pa dang*/ gnad don la 'byor pa ma mthong nas/ 'dir gsal la 'dus par bshad pa yin mod/ rgyas par bla ma'i gsung las shes par bya'o/ /klu sgrub yab sras dgongs pa yin tshul ni rgyas par rim lnga'i 'grel par bshad zin pa las shes par bya zhing*/ nag po'i dgongs pa'i ji lta ba yin pa yang*/ rdzogs rim gzhung gsum gyi 'grel par yang bshad zin pa/ spyod pa ba nyid kyi do ha'i 'grel pa zhig byas par shes par yang 'gyur ro/ /rtags bcu ni dkyus su bshad pa ltar dus 'khor bsdus rgyud las rdzogs par gsungs/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma las gtso bor mtshan rtags rnams gsal bar gsungs te/ 'gog pa'i rdo rjer bgrod sems la/ /mtshan ma nyer 'dzin 'byung 'gyur te/ /mtshan ma de ni rnam pa lnga/ / byang chub rdo rje bshad pa yin/ /dang po smig sgyu'i rnam pa ste/ /gnyis pa du ba'i rnam pa yin/ /gsum pa mkha' snang rnam pa ste/ /bzhi pa sgron me 'bar ba'o/ / lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ni/ /sprin med nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /zhes pa 'di dus 'khor phyogs su lung drangs pa'i 'gyur ltar yin la/ rgyud lo chen gyis bsgyur ba las/

rnam pa zhes pa rnams 'dra ba zhes par yod de smig sgyu 'dra ba dang po ste zhes sogs so/ /rnam pa zhes brjod na rtags snang kho na la 'byor gyi gzhan la mi 'byor/ 'dra ba zhes brjod na/ rtags snang la'ang 'jug mod/ rtags can gyi shes pa brtan g.yo'i tshad la'ang 'byor bas/ gsang 'dus kyi 'grel pa rnams na/ 'chad tshul sna tshogs yod pa kun la sbyor ba'i dbang du mdzad par snang*/ 'on kyang skabs 'dir rtags can gyi shes pa la sbyor du mi rung ste/ 'di 'dzin pa'i yan lag gi skabs su bzhed pa'i mtshan rtags yin la/ rtags can gyi shes pa gnas skabs lnga char yan lag snga ma gsum du grub zin pa'i phyir ro/ / des na 'di rtags snang kho na yin pa las/ 'dir smig sgyu dang por gsungs par dkrugs te bshad pa yin pas/ dung dang por byed dgos par dri med 'od las gsungs pas nges pa can yin/ mtshan rtags bzhi yin yang 'dir lnga bshad pa ni/ 'bro lugs kyi bla ma gong ma rnams mtshan rtags bzhi dang*/ nam mkha' sprin med la rtags can zhes pa'i tha snyad mdzad kyang don la lnga pa nam mkha' lta bu 'di/ nyin rtags drug po 'char ba'i gzhi la dgongs pa yin/ gsang 'dus 'phags skor ba rnams kyang*/ rang rig tsam gyi ye shes ni/ /nam mkha' lta bur mtshan nyid med/ /'on kyang 'di la dbyer yod de/ /mtshan mo nyin mo mtshams bdag nyid/ /zhes nam mkha' la dbye ba gsum gyis 'byed par byed de gnad gcig go /des na 'char ba'i gzhi nam mkha' bshad pas nyin rtags drug po sbas pa'i tshul gyis cung zad bshad pa'ang yin no/ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las/ nyin rtags drug po gsal bar gsungs te/ nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba/ /shes rab ye shes me po che ni ser po 'bar ba ste dus me'o/ /'od chen rnam par snang bar byed/ /ye shes snang ba lam me ba ni dkar po 'bar ba ste zla ba'o/ 'gro ba'i mar me ni dmar po 'bar ba ste nyi ma'o/

ye shes sgron me ni nag po 'bar ba ste sgra gcan no/ /gzi brjid chen po 'od gsal ba ni mchog gi cha ste glog 'gyu ba'o/ sngags mchog sngags bdag rig sngags rgyal/ /zhes pa ni sngags dang*/ rig sngags ni thig le tsam dang*/ mchog dang*/ bdag po dang*/ rgyal po'i sgras thig le chen po bstan/ de'i shugs la phal pa dang*/ mnga' 'og dang*/ 'khor yang yod dgos pas de ni sna tshogs gzugs brnyan no/ /'bro ba rnams kyis sna tshogs gzugs brnyan la yang rtags can gyi tha snyad mdzad 'dug 'dir rtags zhes bya ba lam rtags tsam la mi gzung ste/ gnas lugs kyang yin la rtags kyang yin/ dper na mtshan mo rgyang ring po nas mthong ba'i me de me dngos kyang yin/ der phyin na grang reg sa la nus pa la rtags kyang yin pa bzhin/ stong gzugs chos nyid kyi rang gzugs dngos kyang yin/ chos nyid bde gshegs snying po gdod nas bzhug pa'i rtags dang*/ sangs rgyas myur du thob pa'i rtags kyang yin par shes par bya'o/ /ye shes kyi phung po sogs zhes pa la/ ye shes kyi phung po dang ye shes kyi khams/ yid kyi dbang po sgra'i skye mched/ mchog gi dbang po dang dri chu 'dor ba ste drug yin/ lha ye shes khams pa drug tshan gcig zhes pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ sher phyin ma/ kun tu bzang po/ sgra rdo rje ma/ gnod mdzes dang shin tu sngon mo rnams so/ /snang ba'i steng du 'od gsal 'dzin pa 'di goms na/ sge'u khung nag dang nge ba lta bu dang*/ g.yabs sogs la bltas te der stong gzugs drangs nas ring du goms par byas na rims pas khyim gtan la phebs pa'i mngon shes 'byung*/ stong pa'i sgra la sems gtod pa goms shing*/ sgra phal cher stong pa'i sgrar 'gro na/ lkog gyur gyi don 'di lta bu zhig rtogs par bya'o/ /zhes 'dun pa btang ste/ stong pa'i sgra la sems brtad pas/ lkog gyur gyi sgra rna bar tshor ba'am/ lung ston pa'i rnam pa 'byung*/

rna ba'i mngon shes rjes mthun pa yin/ 'di gnyis la dang po thog mar la snang ba shar ba tsam ma gtogs ji bzhin things pa dka'/ 'dzin zhen dang rtsis btab mi byed par yang yang las la sbyar bas/ phyis nges pa can things par 'ong*/ bsam gtan gyi sgom don blo la 'god pa'i skabs rtog dpyod gnyis kyi thad du ngo sprod thun mong bas rgyas par ngo sprad na/ skabs su bab cing shin tu legs pa yin/ sor sdud kyi 'khrid tsam las mi byed cing*/ ngo sprod dgos na sor sdud kyi 'jug tu byed dgos mod kyang*/ thog dge'i 'khrid rgyas par dkyus thog gcig la byed cing ngo sprod dgos na/ bsam gtan yan lag lnga pa'i skabs su byed pa'ang yan lag so so dang bstun kyang rung ngo*/ /yun ring ma bsgoms pa la ngo sprod mi byed pa nyid thob thang ni yin te/ nyams myong ma skyes pa la ngo sprod par mi 'os pa'i phyir ro/ /yang snying po bsdus na bsam gtan gyi rtog pa'i yan lag tsam rgyud la skyes na ni/ bsgoms pa'i nyams myong gi stobs las/ stong gzugs rang sems su rtogs pa yin la/ sor sdud kyi nyams myong la de ltar rtog pa rang min yang*/ stong gzugs mthong ba'i nyams myong las brtsams te/ lung rig gi sgrub byed la ma ltos par/ myong ba'i stobs las stong gzugs rang sems las gzhan du med par nges shes 'dren nus pa yin te/ de tsam na de kho na la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i ngo sprod gnyis ka byar btub bo/ /sngon 'gro bltos med bzhi ldan yun ring du bsgoms na/ dngos gzhi'i 'khrid la ma sleb kyang*/ sngon 'gro'i nyams myong la stong phyogs kyi ngo sprod rnal ma 'debs thub/ skabs der ma nges pa'i rtags snang ji snyed 'byung bas/ snang phyogs kyi ngo sprod kyang rjes mthun rags pa thub pa zhig 'byung mod/ phyis kyi phyag len la dben gsum yun ring mi skyong bar/ dngos gzhi la 'phral du 'jug pa'i phyir/

skabs der ngo sprod par mi mdzad do/ /de yang da lta'i snang ba rags pa 'di sems snang yin/ bden med sgyu ma lta bu yin/ gzhi med rtsa bral yin/ bde gshegs snying po gdod nas lhun grub yin/ bya ba 'di lung dang rig pa'i sgo nas nges pa rnyed nus kyang*/ sgom rnam dag ma skyes kyi bar du myong stobs kyis nges pa 'dren mi thub/ stong gzugs kyi stobs kyis myong stobs ngo sprod na/ snang ba rags pa 'di la'ang de ltar myong stobs kyis nges shes gting nas skye thub pa yin no/ /de yang slob ma gcig la thig le sngon po lu gu brgyud yang yang 'char ba lta bu zhig yod na/ 'di skad ces bya ste/ khyed la thig le'i snang ba shar 'dugade gzugs ma yin/ mig gis mthong ba ma yin/ mig gis blta sar mi yong ba'i ltag pa'i phyogs su yang res 'ga' yong gin 'dug pa/ yang de la thal mos bkab nas kyang ltos shig des sgrib kyang mi thub/ thal mos rgyab skor nas tshur yong ba'ang min/ des na thig le de phyi na 'dug par mthong yang phyi na med/ de rang gi lus kyang min/ gzhi gang yang ma yin pas sems kho nar 'dug pa/ sems gnas tsam thig le'i gzugs de gsal ba/ mang ba/ brtan pa gcig gda'/ sems mi gnas pa'i skabs de las go log /des na sems ka stong gzugs yin/ stong gzugs ka sems yin pa'i rtags 'di ka yin/ sems mi gnas na sems kyi rang gzugs mi mthong*/ gnas na rang gzugs mthong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis de ltar byung ba yin/ des na stong gzugs 'di sems la gzhan phyi rol du grub pa med do/ /stong gzugs 'di 'di ltar gsal ba brtan pa zhig la/ phyi rol tu ma grub sems las gzhan du med pa bzhin du/ da lta'i las snang rags pa 'di thams cad kyang*/ gsal bar snang zhing brtan brtan 'dra mod kyang*/ sems las gzhan du cung zad kyang ma grub/ phyi na yod par snang ba tsam gyis phyi rol tu grub par mi 'gro ste/

da ltar mthong ba'i stong gzugs thig le dang 'dra/ yang gsal gsal 'dra/ brtan brtan 'dra bas kyang phyi don yin par mi 'gro ste/ khyed rang gis mthong ba'i thig le'i gzugs bzhin/ yang gnyid 'thug po log pa lta bu mig shes 'gags tsa na/ gzugs kyang 'gags te mi 'dug yang gnyid sad de mig shes skyes tsa na gzugs 'dug des na da lta'i gzugs snang 'di mig shes las gzhan du med/ don du ma grub shes pa'i snang ba tsam yin/ dpe sems gnas mi gnas la stong gzugs 'char mi 'char dang 'dra ba lags/ yang mi gcig gnyid la song ba na/ kho ras gzugs ma mthong ba yin gyi gzugs 'gags pa ma yin te/ kho gnyid la song pa'i skabs mi gzhan gyis mthong pa'i phyir snyam na/ de gnad ma go ba yin/ dper na khyed rang gnyid la song skabs/ khyed rang gi grogs mched kyis khang pa dang*/ yo byad mthong ba de ka grogs mched kho la mig shes yod pas byung ba yin/ yang gnyis kar gnyid du song skabs gzhan zhig gis mthong pa yang de dang 'dra/ de bzhin du thug med du sbyar te/ ji tsam du mig shes yod pa la gzugs yod/ med pa la med pas gzugs snang sems su thag chod/ sgra sogs lnga la'ang de bzhin du sbyar/ de ltar stong gzugs dang*/ rig thog gnyis po lhan cig tu ngo sprad do/ / de nas so sor phye ste/ shes rig 'di yang ngo bos grub rgyu mi 'dug ste/ rnam rtog 'di ni yad yud tsam las rtag thub pa mi 'dug snga ma 'gags nas phyi ma skye ba ma gtogs/ mu 'brel 'brel pa rgyun chags chags pa zhig kyang mi 'dugaskye bzhin pa la 'jig bzhin pa ma gtogs gnas rgyu gcig kyang mi 'dugalegs par brtags dus 'od dam mdangs 'gyur ba 'dra ba zhig ma gtogs/ 'di ltar yod ces bya ba gcig kyang mi 'dug ste/ des na rnam rtog 'di 'khrul snang ma gtogs dngos gnas la grub rgyu mi 'dug de bzhin du gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dzin pa'i shes pa thams cad la'ang 'don pa spos te ngo bos grub rgyu mi 'dug go

/yang phyi snang ba dang*/ nang rnam rtog gnyis char la ma reg pa'i rig pa gsal rig tsam 'di yang*/ rtag tu rgyun ma chad pa ltar snang mod kyi/ legs par brtags na rten dang gnas gang la'ang ma brten par 'dug skad cig gis skye 'jig gnas gsum du snang yang*/ mdangs 'gyur ba tsam min pa/ skye gnas 'jig gsum la ngos bzung rgyu mi 'dugango bo 'di ltar grub cig kyang mi 'dug pas/ ma brtags tsa na sems 'di nga yin snyam/ gsal zhing rig kyang ngos bzung gcig kyang mi 'dug pas/ sems de yang gzhi med rtsa bral yin/ rang gzhan snod bcud 'khor ba'i rnam pa 'di thams cad/ gdod ma nas yod ma myong ngo*/ /sgom chen pa byings de chos sku yin lhan skyes yin sems lhan cig skyes pa zer ba de yang 'di kho na yin/ 'di'i 'tshang rig pa na sangs rgyas la nyin khugs btang zhes kha pho 'don/ rang lugs la de tsam gyis mthar thug rang du ma sleb ste/ re zhig gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rnam grangs gcig tu 'jog kyang 'jog pa lags/ 'di stong phyogs kyi ngo sprod yin/ snang ba thams cad stong par ngo sprad pas/ stong pa'i rtsal snang ba ma 'gags pa'i rten 'brel cir yang 'char ba de shugs la 'byung bas rgyas bshad mi dgos/ de la snang stong zung 'jug dang*/ stong nyid dang rten 'brel zung 'jug dang snang sems dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa sogs sgom chen so so'i ming du ma 'dogs te/ don la sgyu ma lta bur 'dus/ gnas skabs kyi sgom bzang yang bzang ste/ rang lugs kun rdzob bden pa la bltos pa'i zung 'jug yin/ de rnams thun mong ba yin/ kun rdzob kyi rten 'brel dang*/ snang ba'i bshad pa mang yang stong phyogs su 'dus te stong pa gtso bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na rang re rnams chos la 'bad pa ni gang la dmigs pa yin/ gzhan de dag ni gang yang ma dmigs na/ gnas lugs la su zhig yod snyam na/ yod ngos shes pa mkha' khyab kyi chos sku rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de yin/

de la dmigs nas chos byed pa yin/ chos sku de kho shes bya la srid tshad kyi gnas lugs yin/ yod nges shes pa'i sdod lugs yin/ dper na bum par snang ba na bum pa med bum snang 'khrul ba yin/ de'i shul na phal bas mi mthong ba'i chos sku yod/ de ka bum pa'i gnas lugs yin/ sdod lugs yin/ rang bzhin yin/ rang gzugs yin/ de ka dang 'dra bar khyed rang lus ngag yid gsum 'dus pa'i gang zag gcig tu khyed rang la yang snang*/ gzhan 'gas kyang mthong gin 'dug ste/ 'khrul snang yin/ snang lugs yin gyi gnas lugs min/ lus ngag yid gsum 'dus pa'i gang zag de 'dra yod ma myong gdod nas ma grub/ khyed rang mi gcig tu snang gin 'dug ste snang bzhin pa'i dus na/ gnas lugs la mi med/ 'khrul lugs la mi yod par snang*/ mir snang ba de'i thad na/ gzhan phal bas kyang mi mthong*/ khyed rang gis kyang ma rig pa'i sangs rgyas chos sku mkha' khyab de bzhugs/ de khyed rang gi gnas lugs yin/ sdod lugs yin/ rang bzhin yin/ rang gzugs yin/ dper na shing 'bras kyi khog na tshig gu yod kyang mi mthong bas snying po zer ba dang 'dra bar/ kun khyab kyi chos nyid de bde gshegs yin/ de yod kyang ma mthong bas snying po yin/ des na khyod la bde gshegs snying po yod/ khyed rang bde gshegs snying po can yin/ de yang ji ltar yin na khyed rang la snang ba'i snod bcud thams cad dang*/ khyed rang gi lus ngag longs spyod thams cad khyed rang gi shes pa'i snang ba yin par 'dug pa/ de thams cad rang gi shes par 'dus/ shes pa las gzhan du med/ shes pa rnam shes dang*/ rnam rtog sna tshogs 'di yang sems gsal rig tsam 'di'i mdangs las gzhan du med/ chu la gzugs brnyan shar ba dang 'dra/ shes pa gsal rig tsam 'di/ kun gzhi rnam shes yin/ gzhom du med pa'i ma rig pa zhes bla ma snga rabs pa rnams tha snyad 'dogs/ 'dzag bde'i bag chags kyi ngo bor gnas/

kha nang log gis blta shes na/ 'di da lta blun po tshun chod kyis kyang myong bas grub pa yin/ mthong ba yin/ rang rig kun rdzob pa yin/ 'di yang snang tshul yin te gnas tshul ma yin/ rgyun chags pa'i rig pa rjen ne bzhin snang ste/ snang ba ltar ma grub 'khrul snang yin/ 'di gang na yod pa'i sa de ka na/ chos dbyings kun khyab kyi sangs rgyas de yod/ de sems 'di'i gnas lugs yin/ sdod lugs yin/ rang bzhin yin/ rang gzugs yin/ da lta'i sems 'di sems kyi rang bzhin ma yin/ gnas lugs ma yin/ sems 'di'i rang bzhin gnas lugs bde gshegs snying po de yin/ 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis ji lta ba rang de mkhyen/ byang sems sa bcu pa pas gsal bar mthong*/ brgyad pa dgu pa gnyis kyi 'ol spyi tsam mthong*/ ma dag sa bdun la gnas pas zur tsam mthong*/ nyan rang 'phags pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi thabs zab med na byang sems so skye rnams kyis dad pas rtogs bya yin gyi dngos su mthong ba med/ so so skye bo phal pa rnams kyis dad pas kyang mi rtogs te/ paṇḍi ta mkhas mkhas po sangs rgyas skyangs dang*/ legs ldan 'byed dang*/ zla ba grags pa dang*/ ye shes snying po dang*/ kā ma la shī la la sogs pa la yang*/ chos 'di dad pas rtogs pa'i bsod nams med na/ bod ston dang bod sgom za thang dang grags pa che tshad yod cing*/ nag phyogs kyi gdon gyis 'phrin las sgrub pa rnams la/ chos 'dir mos pa skye ba lta ci dgos/ ge bar yang ga la 'gyur zhing*/ tha na thos pa'i bsod nams kyang yod re rkan/ de bas na khyod rang 'di thos pas legs/ go zhing mos na a cang che/ gsang sngags zab mo thabs kyi che ba yin pas/ so so skye bo las dang po pas kyang phyogs tsam mthong ba yin/ khyed rang gis mthong ba'i thig le lu gu brgyud 'di ka bde gshegs snying po'i rang 'od yin par gdon mi za/ de ma zad bde gshegs snying po rang yang yin/

de'i rgyu mtshan snying po de stong phyang phyang cig med/ mun thom thom cig med/ ci med cang med zhig mid/ ril ril gong gong du med/ spros bral rnam pa thams cad du 'char ba/ /kun la khyab pa phyogs cha nye ring med pa zhig lags/ spros bral rnam pa thams cad pa byas tsa na/ da lta'i sems ngos bzung med pa la/ las snang tha mal ba sna tshogs 'char ba 'di ka yin nam mno ba zhig khyed rang la yang yod srid/ mi gzhan rnams kyang e zer ltos/ phal cher zer yang zer/ de skad du zer yang*/ cal col 'ba' zhig yin/ 'dod chags skyes tsa na zhe sdang med/ zhe sdang skyes tsa na 'dod chags med/ rta mthong tsa na ba glang med/ ba glang mthong tsa na rta med/ gtam snyan thos tsa na yi mug mi skye/ gtam ngan thos tsa na dga' ba mi skye/ bsdad na mi 'gro/ 'gro na mi sdod/ de ka rgyar chad phyogs su lhungs/ rnam pa thams cad pa ga re/ mthong thos bya byed rtog pa'i rjes 'brangs can de la ka spros pa zer ba yin/ spros med ga re/ las snang 'khrul pa 'di la spros bral rnam pa thams cad pa yin du re ba 'di rnams khyi lud la gser du mthong ba a re 'khrul/ 'o spros bral rnam pa thams cad pa bya ba/ ma dag las snang 'khrul pa 'di dag ci yang med pa'i shul na/ rang rig rang gsal don dam gnas lugs shig yod/ de ka la spros bral zer/ de nyid ka 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rnam par gdod nas rtag tu shar shar ba 'gyur med cig la rnam pa thams cad pa zer/ dam tshig gis rang ta mtshon du med de/ de skad smras pas/ sems la 'char lugs ma nor ba zhig yod/ dper na nor bu rin po che sa 'jim gyis gos pa zhig /phyogs gcig nas drad na/ dang por khab rtse'i khyon tsam nor bu mthong yong/ khab rtse tsam 'od tse re mthong ba de ka nor bu yin/ dpe de bzhin du bde gshegs snying po de/ bde stong zung 'jug ces bya ba mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba yang yin/ rnam kun mchog ldan yang yin/

de nor bu baiḍūrya dang 'dra/ sgrib pa'i rtsa ba 'dzag bde'i bag chags dang las rlung yin/ nor bu de sa 'dam skam pos g.yogs te ci yang mi mthong ba dang 'dra/ byed bcings kyi sgo nas mi g.yo ba gsum ldan bsgoms/ des las rlung cung zad cig 'gags/ thig le cung zad cig bstan yod/ de phyi g.yogs kyi sa de phyogs gcig nas drad pa dang 'dra/ snying po ste rnam pa thams cad pa yin yang*/ rnam pa gzhan rnams ma mthong*/ thig le lu gu brgyud kyi rnam pa de khyed kyis mthong bar gda'/ dpes 'dam drad pas nor bu khab rtse tsam mthong ba dang 'dra'o/ /des na thig le lu gu brgyud mthong ba 'di/ bde gshegs snying po mthong ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan de lags/ 'o na sngar stong gzugs rnam shes su gtan la phab pa dang 'gal snyam na mi 'gal te/ spyir rnam shes ye shes gnyis gser dang gser gyi g.ya' lta bu yin pas/ go sa tha dad na med/ gser rnyed na g.ya' rnyed/ gser la reg na g.ya' la reg gser mthong na g.ya' yang mthong ba bzhin yin pas/ bde gshegs snying po'i snang ba yin pa dang*/ rnam shes kyi snang ba yin pa'ang mi 'gal/ blon po'i g.yog de rgyal po'i g.yog kyang yin pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang skabs 'dir gser sa 'og na yod na 'od sa steng zer ba bzhin dang*/ nyi ma'i 'od me long dang chu la brdar nas 'ong na/ me long gi 'od dang chu'i 'od kyis mun nag bsal zer yang*/ don la nyi 'od gcig de dag la brdar nas 'ongs pas mun nag bsal ba yin pa dang*/ mun nag tu mar me sbar/ de la 'od skong ngam sbrang skyabs yod la/ 'od skong gi phyi rol tu gzugs sna tshogs mthong ba'i snang ba 'byung ba de snang ba ste dngos su 'od skong las byung yang*/ gdod nas mar me'i snang ba yin pas mar me'i snang ba dang*/ 'od skong gi snang ba'i dbye ba med/ dpe de bzhin du sgrib pa thams cad las gtan nas ma grol gyi bar du/ ye shes kyi snang ba dang rnam shes 'dre ba yin pas/

da ltar thig le lu gu brgyud kho na ma gtogs gzhan mi snang bas/ khyed rang gi snang ba la rgyar chad phyogs lhungs su snang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba mkha' khyab yin yang*/ da lta mnyam bzhag tsam gyi bde ba phra mo zhig las gzhan nyams su ma myong ba la/ bde ba chung ngu dang snang ba phyogs gcig pa'i cha nas rnam shes kyi snang ba yin/ thig ler mthong ba tsam dang/ bde ba tsam gyi phyogs nas bde gshegs snying po mthong ba yin/ de yang dar la'am gseng gi mig nas 'od rgyugs pa lta bu yin pas/ bde gshegs snying po'i rang 'od yin par yang 'thad do/ /yang tha mal gyi snang ba 'di las rlung gi nus pa las mthong ba yin/ 'dzag bde'i bag chags sems kun gzhi rnam shes dang 'dren pas nyon mongs dang rnam rtog skye ba yin/ byed bcings dang ldan pa'i mi g.yo ba gsum ldan gyis/ las rlung cung zad 'gags pas ma dag las snang gi cha shas cung zad dgasnying po'i mdangs kyi cha shas 'od gsal rtags snang cung zad cig shar/ shar bas thig le cung zad cig bstan te/ bde ba cung zad skyes pa de'i 'dzag bde'i bag chags cung zad cig 'joms pa yin/ rnam pa thams cad pa la las rlung gis sgrib/ mi 'gyur bde ba la 'dzag bdes sgrib pa yin/ byed bcings kyi rlung 'gag nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyis 'dzag bde 'joms/ de gnyis 'dzom pas snang sems gzung 'dzin tha dad du snang ba'i gnyen po byed/ yang las snang sems su gtan la phebs pas las rlung gi gnyen po byed/ sems stong par gtan la phebs pas 'gyur bde'i bag chags kyi gnyen po byed/ byed bcings mi rtog pas snang ba sems dang sems stong par rtogs pa'i thabs byed cing*/ sgrib pa 'joms byed du 'gyur/ yang dper na gser gyi mchod sdong zhig yod pa las de yol bas bsgribs/ de la sbar 'dzin byas kyang yol ba la lag pa thebs kyi mchod sdong la mi reg tha mal gyi snang sems la dmigs pa brtad kyang de dang 'dra/

ye shes la reg mi thub/ yol ba dbral ba'i seb nas sbar 'dzin byas na mchod sdong gsal po ma mthong yang*/ mchod sdong la lag pa thebs yong*/ dmigs pas tha mal gyi snang sems cung zad cig 'gags pa'i seng la sems brtad pas chos dbyings kyi cha shas shig mthong*/ mchod sdong la 'ju thub pa dang 'dra/ da khyod kyis chos sku'i sne nas sbar gyis zin 'ju thub pa yin pas/ ma shor bar gyis la stong gzugs 'di ka 'bad par sgoms/ mi gzhan gyi kha skad zer bgros la ye ma nyan cig lam bzang rin po che yid bzhin gyi nor bu lag tu thob pa yin no zhes brjod/ 'di snang phyogs sam zung 'jug la ngo sprad pa yin/ thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /snang phyogs bya ba kun rdzob kyi snang ba la byas na de gzhi med rtsa bral yin pas stong par ka 'dus/ ngo sprod logs su med/ bden med du ngo sprod na ni der zad/ ye shes sam gnas lugs su ngo sprod na 'khrul/ 'dir rang lugs la snang phyogs zhes pa/ don dam ye shes kyi snang ba yin pas ngo bo zung 'jug kho na'o/ /thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i ngo sprod rgyas pa ma lcogs na/ 'dir bshad pa de tsam ma nor bar ston shes na'ang don 'grub pa lags so/ /yang bsam gtan yan lag lnga dang sbrel te 'chad na/ thun mong ma yin pa stong gzugs la dmigs pa'i phyogs ni/ shes rab sogs bsam gtan rim pa lnga car la khyad par med/ thun mong gi skabs kyi yul snang dang shes pa 'gro ldog gcig tshul shes rab dang 'brel/ de las snang ba sems su rtogs pa rtog pa dang 'brel/ sems stong par ngo sprod pa dpyod pa dang 'brel/ las snang stong pa'i ngang nas/ stong gzugs la brten nas bde ba skye ba dga' ba dang 'brel/ stong gzugs rang bde bar myong bas 'dzin zhen dang bral ba ni/ g.yo med bde ba dang 'brel ba'o/ /des na bsam gtan rim pa lnga dngos su skyes na rab/ ma yin yang sor sdud kyi nyams myong shar ba la/

bsam gtan rjes mthun pa'i ngo sprod byed du btub/ ngo 'phrod na bogs kyang che bar 'ong bas don chen po 'grub bo/ /bsam gtan gyi dag dbye'i skabs su/ sbyangs bya phung khams drug ni/ rnam shes kyi phung po nam mkha'i khams/ rna ba'i dbang po chos kyi skye mched/ gsang ba'i dbang po khu ba 'pho ba rnams so/ /mthar thug gi 'bras bu/ lha nam mkha'i khams pa drug tshan gcig ni/ mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyugs ma/ phyag na rdo rje/ chos khams rdo rje ma/ khro bo gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ khro mo drag spyan ma rnams so/ /mngon shes lnga rjes mthun pa sgrub tshul rgyud kyi lung ni/ nyi ma la ni rgyab kyis phyogs nas nyi 'od la gnas rang gi grib ma brtan pa'i mig gis blta/ /phyi nas nam mkha' dag la mngon par brtags na ro mnyam skyes bu du ba'i mdog can mthong bar 'gyur/ /zla ba drug tu goms pa'i sbyor ba dag las sa la gnas pa'i gter ni sa'i bu gar mthong*/ /yang na shing gi grib mar rab tu zhugs te nam mkha'i mthil du thig le'i 'phreng ba bsgoms pas so/ /zhes dang*/ sgra ni gang zhig snying gi phyogs na gnas pa mi mchog rnams kyi rna ba'i bu gas thos gyur pa/ /de la mi yi sems ni gcig tu gyur pa sbyar ba dag kyang ro ni mnyam par 'gyur ba ste/ /'jig rten kun tu sgra ni gang zhig srid par skyes pas brjod pa de dang de ni de bzhin thos/ khyab bdag gi ni rnam shes nyid dang ring du thos pa dag kyang rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom par bya/ /zhes te/ snying kha'i phyogs na gnas pa zhes pas snying gar rlung sems 'dus pas stong pa'i sgra 'byung ba dang*/ rang ngam gzhan gyi snying ga'i rtsa chu shing gi me tog lta bu la dmigs pa gtod pa bstan/ rnam shes nyid dang zhes pas gzhan sems shes pa dang*/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'o/ /skabs 'dir mi gsal yang*/ snang ba'i steng du 'od gsal 'dzin pa goms shing*/

las snang 'di rnams gang 'dod du 'gog thub pa'i mtshams shig nas/ bum can rang tsam khegs par byas/ snang ba sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i ngang nas/ rlung ba gang stong dang*/ stong gzugs bsres te bsgoms na/ rtsig pa la mi thogs pa sogs dang*/ 'byung bzhi'i gnod pas mi tshugs pa sogs rdzu 'phrul ci rigs pa'ang 'byung gsung ste/ gtso bor bum pa can las 'byung ba yin no/ /rtags kyi dbye ba ni rgyud las/ nam mkha' kun nas zhen pa'i sems dang mig ni mi 'dzum rdo rje'i lam du rab tu zhugs pa yi/ /stong pa las ni du ba smig sgyu rab gsal dri ma med pa'i mkha' snang nyid dang mar me dang*/ /'bar ba dang ni zla ba nyi ma rdo rje rnams dang mchog gi cha dang thig le mthong bar 'gyur/ /de yi dbus su sangs rgyas gzugs ni yul dang rnam par bral ba du ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ /nam mkha' chu 'dzin bral ba dag ni rnal 'byor pa yi bgrad pa'i mig gis blta bar bya ba ste/ /re kha nag po dri med 'od zer 'phro ba dus kyi rtsa la mthong bar gyur gyi bar du'o/ /de la kun mkhyen gzugs ni chu la nyi ma lta bu gos pa med pa kha dog sna tshogs te/ /rnam pa kun ldan rang sems yul dang rnam par bral ba dag go gzhan gyi sems ni min pa nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ thig le mthong bar 'gyur zhes pa yan chad rtags bcu ste sor sdud nas 'grub/ de'i dbus su sogs nges pa gsum ldan gyi longs sku ste/ bsam gtan mthar phyin pa'i rtags yin/ du ma zhes pas sor bsam thun mong du sna tshogs gzugs brnyan de bstan/ re kha nag po ni srog 'dzin gnyis kar gyi rtags kyang yin/ srog rtsol mthar thug pa phan chad la 'byung bas gtso bor srog rtsol gyi rtags su'ang byed/ 'dzin pa mthar thug na de la kun mkhyen gzugs zhes pa de 'byung zhing*/ rnam pa kun ldan zhes sogs kyis dran ting gnyis kyi rtags te/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs de yang rnam pa thams cad par shar ba'o/

/rtags kyi dbye ba ston pa'i rgyud tshig 'dis/ yan lag drug kar gyi dbye ba ston tshul 'di/ grub thob zhi ba sbas pa'i zhal lung*/ rgya gar nub phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta skyes mchog dam pa gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las nan tan du thos pa yin/ kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa yang 'di kho nar gnas par 'dug rigs pas kyang grub ste/ re kha nag po dngos te sor bsam gyi rim pa la mi mthong ste/ 'di ye shes kyi rtsa dbu ma la 'char dgos pa las/ sor bsam gyi rim pa bas rtsa de mi mthong ba'i phyir dang*/ rim pa so so la mi sbyor na/ sangs rgyas kyi sku lan gnyis smos pa zlos par 'gyur ba'i phyir dang*/ sor bsam gyi skabs rnam pa kun ldan rang ma mthong ba'i phyir dang/ yul dang rnam par bral ba zhes pa ni/ gzung ba phyi don du med cing*/ rnam rtog gis brtags pa'i mthu las byung ba min/ dbang yid kyis shes pa bslad pa'i snang ba yang min zhes pa yin la/ de yang yul dang rnam par bral ba'i tshig snga mas rtags bcu dang*/ bsam gtan gyi longs sku tshun chod stong gzugs ci la de ltar gsungs zin kyang*/ kun mkhyen gzugs te rjes dran rnam kun mchog ldan gyi sku 'grub pa na/ des rnal 'byor ba'i lus dngos kyi bya ba byed cing*/ lus kyi gtso bo yang de yin pa dang*/ stong gzugs kyi rig ma dang 'dod yon rnams kyis kyang de dang de'i bya ba rlabs po che dngos su byed nus pas/ de rnams gzugs can gyi rjes su grub bo snyam pa'i dogs pa 'byung bar dgongs nas dogs pa sel ba'i phyir/ /gzugs can du lta ga la grub/ rnam shes kyi rnam par yang med de sems nyid chos sku'i snang ba'o/ /zhes pa'i don la yul dang rnam bral gyi tshig phyi ma smos so/ /gzhan du na yul dang rnam par bral ba zhes/ lan gnyis smos pa yang zlos par 'gyur zhing*/ thig le'i dbus kyi sangs rgyas dang bsam gtan gyi yin te/

re kha'i dbus kyi sangs rgyas la gang du sbyor med pa'i zol 'jog gis ci zhig bya/ yang kha cig sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang rnam pa kun ldan gyi gzugs sor sdud kho na nas kyang rdzogs par 'dod pa de dag 'di skad kyang smra ste/ 'di rnams sor sdud la rdzogs dgos te/ gzhan gyi sems ni min pa nyid/ /ces pa'i 'grel par/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes med pas mthong bar bshad cing*/ bsam gtan thob na mngon shes 'byung ba'i phyir zer ba ni rtog ge ba'i 'od thogs la/ gsang sngags pa'i khral gal bas bla ma'i man ngag gi zhal rgyun yang med/ don 'gang che sa mthong pa'i blo gros kyang med par/ grwa gshog pa kho na snying la bzhag nas/ mgo bkug ste dpe cha bltas pa'i yig rig nag 'ded la go ba log par shar ba de/ gzhan gyis ma go ba go tshul gyi mkhas khyad du smras pa'o/ /de'i don ni stong gzugs de dag rang sems yin na yin mnyam dang*/ min na min mnyam du byed dgos pa las/ gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes ma thob gong du stong gzugs mtha' yas pa mthong ba'i phyir/ rang sems kho na yin zhes pa ste/ 'di yang rnam shes ye shes kyi dbye ba ma phye bar/ rnal 'byor ba'i snang ngo dang bstun nas gsungs pa yin no/ /nges par dpyad na/ rang gzhan gnyis kar gyi sems rnam shes ni ma yin/ chos nyid kyi sems kyi dbang du byas na ni rang gzhan gnyis kar gyi yin yang*/ chos nyid de chos su dang sbrel yang rang gi rang bzhin yin gyi gzhan yin par mi 'jog go /chos nyid kyi sems dang sems nyid dang*/ kun gzhi ye shes dang*/ de bzhin nyid kyi bdag dang*/ dam pa'i bdag rnams don gcig ming gi rnam grangs lags so// //srog rtsol gyi skabs/ paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud ces pa la/ paṇa chen la chos rje sa paṇa gyis zhus/ sa paṇa yang*/ pha chos kyi thugs zhen mdzad nas/ lam 'bras kho na gzhan la ngom zhing bsngags brjod mdzad kyang kho rang gi

nyams len gyi mthil sbyor drug la mdzad/ sgo rum dpe khang gi 'og na sa paṇa gyi sgom khang yang mun khang du yod/ bum can la brten nas te te 'ching ba dang*/ bdud rtsi lce sbyor 'grub pa sogs sbyor drug gi rlung phyogs la yon tan kyang 'khrungs pa yin/ de 'dra rjes 'jug rnams kyis nyams mgo e non ni ma shes lags/ rwa lugs kyi sbyor drug la ni man ngag nyung zhing rno ba zhig 'dug kyang sgrub grwa bzang ba tsam ma byung ngo*/ /srog rtsol sgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi skabs su rgyud las/ dang por mtha' dag rgyal ba'i lus ni dngos grub rgyu ru sngags pa dag gis yang dag bsrung bar bya/ /lus med na ni dngos grub med cing skye ba 'di la mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba med/ /de phyir lus kyi don gyi rgyur ni nyin zhag so so'i 'dus su rtsa yi sbyor ba bsgom par bya/ /lus ni grub na gzhan pa'i dngos grub srid pa gsum gyi gnas su sngags zhugs nyid du rab tu 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ stong pa las ni du ba sogs lam bla ma'i nges pa'i dbang gi gzugs brnyan 'tshams su bsgom par bya/ /de nas rtsa yi 'khor lo rnams su srog dang thur sel rlung ni brtan pa dag kyang byed pa ste/ /phyi nas zla ba nges par 'gog pa gza' bzhin byed de byang chub sems ni rnal 'byor ba yis so/ /de nas gang zhig cung zad 'dod pa dag ni nyin zhag 'ga' yis skye ba 'di la thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ kha yang btsum ste sna yi bu ga gnyis ka dag nas phyi rol dag gi rlung rnams ma lus pa/ /srog gi shugs kyis bkug ste dri ma med pa'i glog dang mtshungs pa thur sel rlung dang sbyar byas pa/ /dus kyi goms pa'i sbyor ba dag las zla ba nyi ma me yi dbus su ro ni mnyam par 'gyur ba ste/ / lus la zas la sogs pa bkres pa dang ni skom pa 'phrog ste 'chi ba med pa nyid kyang ster/

/zhes dang*/ zla ba nyi ma 'gog pa mnyam dang mi mnyam bgrod pa la ste dbu ma me la rab tu zhugs/ /srog dang thur sel gnyis po dag kyang nyin zhag dang po song na dus min 'chi ba bslu ba ste/ /lag pa dang bcas rkang pa'i mthe bo'i tshigs dang sen mo'i mthar ni srog gis kun tu gang byas pa/ /'khor lo drug la sangs rgyas lha mo 'jigs med phyag gi padma rnal 'byor pas ni bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang*/ nus ma gang zhig lta ba'i dbus gnas gzhan gyi gnas su bcu gnyis mtha' dang bcu drug mthar 'gro ba/ /de ni lte bar 'gog pa dang bcas dri med glog dang mtshungs pa dbyug pa'i gzugs can langs pa yang*/ / 'khor lo nas ni 'khor lo'i bar du nges par dman zhing rol pa'i bgrod pas dbu ma'i rtsa la skyod/ /ji srid gtsug tor phug par btsan thabs nyid kyi phyi rol kyi ni pags pa dag la khab bzhin reg de yi dus su thur du sel ba mchog gi btsan thabs nyid kyis steng gi lam du bskul bar bya/ /zung gi rlung dag 'gags pa na ni gtsug tor phug nas mchog gi grong khyer dag tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /yid la rdo rje rab tu sad pas yul dang bcas pa mkha' la spyod pa nyid du rab tu 'gyur/ /zhes dang*/ srog rtsol rab tu bya ste snying ga de bzhin mgo bo dang ni ji srid me yis gdung gyur pa/ /de las steng dag tu ni bzang po'i padmar rgyal bar 'gyur te ma bsdams pa'am stobs dag gis/ /gtsug tor phug cing phung po dag dang khams rnams rnam par spangs nas 'chi ba nyid du 'gro 'gyur te/ /phyag rgya 'grogs pa rab nyams skyes bu rnams kyis skye ba 'di nyid la ni bde 'bras ster ba med/ /so sor sdud pa la sogs rnams kyis gal te sngags pa rnams kyis 'dod pa grub par ma gyur na/ /nā da goms pas btsan thabs chu skyes gnas su rdo rje nor bur thig le bkag nas bsgrub par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di rnams la/

srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i lag len gyi gnad thams cad 'dus te/ dmigs pa rnams la khrid yig gi dkyus dang go don rnams gzhan du bshad zin no/ /'di'i dag bya phung khams drug ni/ 'du byed kyi phung po rlung gi khams/ sna'i dbang po/ reg bya'i skye mched/ ngag gi dbang po/ bshang ba 'dor ba rnams so/ /mthar thug gi 'bras bu'i skabs/ lha rlung khams pa drug ni/ don yod grub pa/ dam tshig sgrol ma/ nam mkha'i snying po reg bya rdo rje ma/ bgegs mthar phyed/ shin tu brtson 'grus ma rnams so/ /de bzhin du 'dzin pa la yang sbyang bya drug ni/ tshor ba'i phung po/ me'i khams/ mig gi dbang po/ ro'i skye mched/ lag pa'i dbang po/ bya ba 'gro ba rnams so/ /'bras bu lha me khams pa drug ni/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ gos dkar mo/ sa'i snying po/ ro rdo rje ma/ shes rab mthar byed/ rmugs byed ma rnams so/ / rjes dran gyi 'khrid kyi skabs su rlung sbyang ba la/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥhi dang*/ l̥̄ ū ṝ ā+-i aḥsbyor ba dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi khrid yig na/ la wa ra ya ha la dbyangs so so sbyar ba'i ngag 'dren sna tshogs gsungs pa rnams/ ye shes le'u las/ ye shes dgug par byed pa 'di ni slar yang shin tu stobs te de ni gzhug pa rmugs byed kyis/ /de bzhin bcings pa rengs byed kyis te nges par mchog bde'i dbang gis khengs byed kyis ni mnyes pa yang*/ /ye shes 'khor lo dag la 'khor lo ro ni mnyam par byed pa rdo rje shugs kyis byed pa ste/ /de bzhin khro bo'i lha mo rnams ni rab gsal nges par rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud kyi sku la'o/ /zhes dang*/ l̥̄ sogs dbyangs brgyad gang dag yul dang yon tan du 'gyur dbyangs phyed kyis ni rnam par dman pa rnams/ /phan tshun dbye bas phye ba rkang pa dang bcas ro dang mnga' rnams dbu ma'i dbugs ni 'bab pa ste/ /zhes gsungs pa'i man ngag tu gong ma rnams bzhed de de bzhin du snang ngo*/

/rjes dran gyi sbyang bya drug ni/ 'du shes kyi phung po/ chu'i khams/ lce'i dbang po/ gzugs kyi skye mched/ rkang pa'i dbang po/ bya ba len pa rnams so/ / 'bras bu lha chu khams pa drug ni/ 'od dpag med/ mā ma kī spyan ras gzigs/ gzugs rdo rje ma/ padma mthar byed/ khengs byed ma rnams so/ 'dir rgyud las/ dbus su srog ni rab tu zhugs pa yul dang rnam par bral ba'i sna tshogs yum la 'khyud pa ste/ /padmar zhugs pa'i rang gi rdo rje spro ba dag kyang de bzhin zla nyi'i dbus su rab bzhugs pa'o/ /bde ba'i sa bon ma lhung ba las rab dga'i dga' bar gnas pa rnal 'byor pa yi rnal 'byor 'di/ /phyag rgya'i dngos grub don slad khyab bdag gi ni dpal ldan gsang ba las kyang mchog tu gsang ba'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dis rnam pa kun ldan gyi ye shes sku de srog ste rlung 'gags pa las byung ba'i gtum mo'i snang ba/ rtsa a wa dhū tī nas gzhi bcas pa dang*/ rtsa ba de lha sku kha sbyor gyi rnam pa yin pa'ang gsal bar bstan zhing*/ 'dis rjes dran dang zhor la ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid kyang gsal bar bstan no/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbye ba'i skabs su/ rtsa rgyud las/ yan lag bcu gnyis 'gags pa yis/ /dus sbyor rnams ni mi 'bab phyir/ /sa rnams bcu gnyis zhes grags pa/ /gnas la sogs pa don dam mo/ /zhes sa bcu gnyis dang*/ mchog tu mi 'gyur skad cig ni/ /stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig dang*/ /drug brgya yongs rdzogs rgyal po che/ /rdo rje sems dpar rang nyid 'gyur/ /zhes mi 'gyur ba'i skad cig ma nyi khri chig stong drug brgya dang*/ bsdus rgyud las/ chags dang chags bral thog mtha' la gnas skad cig ma yang khyab bdag gi ni dbugs kyi grangs 'phel lo/ /zhes mi 'gyur ba'i skad cig ma 'grub pa'i rgyu gsungs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sbyang bya drug ni/ gzugs kyi phung po/ sa'i khams/ lus kyi dbang po/

gzugs kyi skye mched/ bshang lam gyi dbang po/ bya ba smra ba ste drug go /'bras bu lhas khams pa drug ni/ rnam snang*/ sangs rgyas spyan ma/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ dri rdo rje ma/ gshin rje mthar byed/ rengs byed ma rnams so/ de ltar na/ rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ de phyir g.yo med bde ba'i skad cig lhan cig skyes pa 'dir ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ster byed de/ /srog gi ro yi 'gro ba rnams la gnas pa thams cad bkug cing nyon mongs bdud rnams bcoms byas nas/ /rdzu 'phrul kun mkhyen sa dang srid gsum bla ma nyid ni rnal 'byor rnams kyi skye ba 'di la ste/ /gal te lam du rab zhugs 'chi bar gyur na de tsho de yi 'dzin pas skye ba gzhan la'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lam 'di la mos shing dam tshig dang ldan na ji tsam 'gor yang*/ skye ba bdun tshun chad la phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par the tshom med do/ /rjes kyi 'khrid kyi skabs su/ mgrin snying kha sbyor la brten nas 'od gsal 'dzin pa ni/ lus gnad tsog pu bya/ rang lhar gsal ba'i snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo sngon po'am nag po rtsa 'dab brgyad/ kha gyen bstan rgya sor gsum tsam/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu so gnyis pa kha dog dmar po kha thur bstan/ rgya sor drug tsam/ de gnyis kyi bar 'khor lo'i lte ba gnyis rtsa dbu ma kha dog sngon po sbom phra gro sog tsam gyi sbrel pa/ snying ga'i 'khor lo'i lte bar thig le sngo skya sran chung tsam/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i lte ba na/ ṛ yig mgo bo thur bstan me'i rang bzhin can dmar po/ /de nas rlung ro bsal/ steng rlung shugs che zhing ring bar rngubs/ mgrin pa'i ṛ yig la phog de las 'od zer me'i rang bzhin dmar skya phra mo zhig thur du 'bar te/ dbu ma'i lam nas mdung btsugs pa ltar song ba snying ga'i thig le la reg pas/ de zhu zhing cil li li khol ba la sems brtad/

rlung kha sbyor drag tu bzung ngo*/ /snying ga'i bum can thob thang yin yang*/ lte ba'i bum can byas na gegs mi sdang zhing sad 'byams mi 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod pas da lta'i lag len la lte ba'i bum can ka byed yang rlung phyir gtong ba'i tshe 'od zer dmar po mgrin pa'i ṛ la thim/ snying ga'i thig le khengs pa'i tshul gyis 'od hril le 'dug /rlung phyir cung zad bzung ba'i skabs thig le de je phra je phra la yungs 'bru tsam/ yang je sbom je sbom la sngar bzhin sran chung tsam du song bar bsam/ de nyid nyin par yang yang bsgom/ nyal khar rlung thengs nyer gcig dang*/ dmigs pa nyer gcig sbyar/ de nas lus gnad tsog pu'am seṅge nyal stangs bya/ dmigs pa ṛ yig gi me 'od snying ga'i thig le la bsnun pa sngar bzhin bsgom/ rlung sbyor mi bya/ sems snying gar brtad pa de kha'i ngang nas gnyid du 'gro bar bya'o/ /lte snying kha sbyor gyi 'od gsal spel ba ni lus gnad skyil krung sogs spyi dang 'dra/ snying ga chos 'khor sngon po 'dab brgyad tshad sor gsum snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ kha thur bstan/ lte ba'i 'khor lo rgyas par na yongs rdzogs sgom/ de mi gsal ba'am bsdu na/ nang skor 'dab ma bzhi la sor gnyis/ phyi skor 'dab ma brgyad la sor bzhi pa ser po kha gyen bstan zhig bsgom/ de'i bar dbu ma gong bzhin 'dug pas sbrel/ snying ga'i 'khor lo'i lte ba thig le dkar po'am sngon po'i me re gang*/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus na/ thig le phra mo yungs 'bru tsam lnga ste/ rgyab ser g.yon dkar g.yas dmar/ mdun nag /dbus ljang pa'o/ de nas bum can kha sbyor drag tu bzung zhing*/ stod la shugs ma song ba'i ngos nas/ lte ba man chad g.yas skor g.yon skor drag tu bskor pas/ lte ba'i thig le ser po dkar po la thim de dmar po la/ de nag po la/ de ljang khu la thim/ ljang khu dbu ma'i lam nas rgyangs te 'phar/

snying ga'i thig le la thim/ snying ga'i thig le'i 'od kyis lus kyi nang thams cad khra gsal la khyab par bsam/ rlung phyir btang zhing phyir bzung ba'i tshe/ de ka la sems brtad/ de nyid skyar gyin sgom pa yin/ nyal khang rlung thengs nyer gcig sgom pa sogs gong dang 'dra/ snga ma ni gnyid kyi 'od gsal 'dzin pa la bsngags/ des gnyid kyi 'od gsal yang yang zin 'ong na/ phyi ma 'di bsgom pas bde nyams dang gsal snang gong 'phel la 'gro/ gsal snang mthar phyin pas/ lkog gyur shes pa'ang 'byung*/ dmigs pa 'di gnyis dus 'khor rang lugs la ngo bo bskyed rim yin pas srog rtsol gyi rim pa rgyud la skyes pa'i gang zag la mi dgos kyang*/ da lta las dang po pa la shin tu zab pa'i dmigs par 'gyur zhing*/ srog rtsol gyi gdam ngag dang ni 'brel ba yin no/ khams thim rim dang*/ snang bzhi'i rnam gzhag zhib mor bshad zhes pa la/ de yang rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ sa ni chu la rab tu 'jug cing chu yang 'bar byed la te gtsang bar byed pa rlung la'o/ /rlung ni stong pa la te stong pa nges par mtshan ma rnam pa bcu ru 'gyur zhing mtshan ma ni/ rnam pa thams cad pa ru 'gyur te mi yi bdag po gzhom du med pa ye shes sku/ /ye shes las ni rdzu 'phrul dngos grub tu 'gyur mi bdag skye dgu rnams kyi skye ba 'di nyid la'o/ /zhes te/ 'dis ni gtso bor tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba'i lam rgyud la skyed tshul gyi dbang du byas nas 'dzin pa rjes dran ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi skabs su 'od gsal du 'jug tshul bstan pa yin yang*/ ma dag pa'i phung khams thim tshul dang*/ de las ye shes kyi snang ba spro tshul spyir btang 'dra ba yin pas/ 'chi ba 'od gsal dang bar do lam du byed tshul yang bstan par 'gyur zhing*/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal dang rmi lam gyi rim pa yang ngo*/ /de bzhin du/ chu yis me ni rnam par nyams pa dang por 'dir ni lus kyi dbus su sdom brtson rnams kyis

bya/ /phyi nas 'dzin ma dag ni chu ru 'gyur te lan tsha bzhin du chu yi dbus su rab tu zhugs/ /rlung ni chu bo de dag skam nas nam mkha' la ni snang ba min par myur du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sems ni mun pa'i mtha' yi me ste yul dang rnam par bral ba dbus kyi mtha' la bzhag par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i tshig rkang dang pos rags pa thim pa dang*/ gnyis pas sa chu gnyis thim pa dang*/ gsum pas me rlung thim pa dang*/ bzhi pas nam mkha' rnam shes thim tshul lam/ snang ba bzhi po gsal bar ston pa yin te/ me dang mun pa'i mtha' zhes bsgyur ba ltar na a wa dhū tī dang*/ dung can ma'i rlung gcig tu 'dus pa 'od gsal gyi skabs ston par 'gyur zhing*/ mun pa'i mtha'i me zhes bsgyur ba ltar na yang*/ snang ba ni zla ba dang*/ mched pa ni nyi ma zhes kha bskang ste thog mar sbyar nas mun pa ni thob pa dang*/ dus me ni thams cad stong pa 'od gsal pa'o/ /de yang rtsa rkyang ma rlung dang thim ler bcas pa dbu mar 'gags pas snang ba dang*/ ro ma'i de dag 'gags pas mched pa dang*/ dbu ma'ang dung can mar thim pas thob pa dang*/ dung can ma la gnas pa ni 'od gsal ba'o/ /dbu mar dung can mar 'gags zhes pa'ang*/ de gnyis kyi byed pa ro gcig tu 'dres bzhin pa'i don yin gyi/ steng nas 'og tu sdib pa lta bu'i don ma yin no/ /bram ze chen po sa ra has kyang*/ rlung dang me dang dbang chen 'gags pa na/ /bdud rtsi rgyu ba'i dus su sems ni rlung la 'jug /nam zhig sbyor gzhi gnas gcig tu ni zhugs pa yi/ /bde chen mchog ni nam mkha'i khams su mi shong ngo*/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ ārya de bas bdag byin rlabs pa'i rim par yang*/ sa yi khams ni chu la thim/ /chu ni me la thim pa ste/ /me ni rlung phra'i khams la'o/ /rlung ni sems la thim par 'gyur/ / sems ni sems byung la thim ste/ /sems las byung ba ma rig pa/ /de yang 'od gsal bar 'gro'o/

/srid pa gsum po 'di ltar 'gags/ /zhes pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ sa la sogs pa bzhi po dang*/ /de bzhin stong pa bzhi po dag / skyed dang 'jig pa'i rgyu nyid du/ /dngos po brgyad po rnam shes bya/ zhes gsungs te/ mdor na 'od gsal nyid dngos po rnams gang du thim pa dang*/ gang las byung ba'i gzhir byas te/ gzhi dus kyi 'chi ba dang*/ bar do la gsal zhing rdzogs pa dang*/ gnyid la 'jug cing rmi lam dang sad dus su ldang ba'i skabs kyang ci rigs pa 'byung ba dang*/ gzhan yang gnas skabs du mar gsal ba dang*/ der ma zad shin tu phra ba ni/ rnam rtog re re 'gags cing skye ba la yang 'byung ste/ gang ltar na'ang de thams cad la rags pa phra ba la thim/ de shin tu phra ba la thim pa'i shin tu phra ba mthar thug de 'od gsal yin/ yang de nyid lugs zlog tu rag pa'i bar du skye/ de la rags pa ni/ dbang po lnga/ phung po lnga/ yul lnga/ ye shes lnga ste rags pa nyi shur grags pa lta bu yin/ ngos 'dzin rjen pa ni/ sha khrag rags pa'i lus dbang po rten bcas dang*/ sgo lnga'i dbang shes rnam rtog dang bcas pa rnams so/ /phra ba tsam po ni 'byung bzhi yin/ shin tu phra ba ni/ snang mched thob gsum yang yin la phra ba'i mthar thug 'od gsal lo/ /gzhi 'khor ba'i dus su de ltar 'byung ba de la/ de kho na dang 'dra bar lam bsgoms pas kyang nyams su myong bar 'gyur te/ lam gong ma rnams la lta ci smos/ sor sdud gcig po'i gnas skabs na yang de rnams tshang ste/ ltos med bzhi ldan gyi nyams myong skyes pa'i skabs rags pa rnams cung zad thim zhing*/ mi g.yo gsum ldan bsgom pas/ phra ba dang*/ shin tu phra ba'i thim rim 'char te/ thig le'i skabs su 'od gsal yin la/ de nas thig le chen po'i rim pa dang*/ sna tshogs gzugs brnyan ni bar do dang skye ba lam du byed pa ste/ 'on kyang phra mor na gcig la'ang tshang ste/ ltos med dang mi g.yos rnam rtog 'gags pa ni thim rim 'chi ba 'od gsal lam byed dang*/

de las rtags snang gcig shar bas ni bar do lam byed/ des tha mal gyi snang ba la rgyas btab pa ni skye ba sprul sku lam du byed do/ /'di ni zur tsam mtshon pa ste gzhan yang chos drug sogs las 'byung ba ltar/ mdor bsdus bshad kyang rung*/ dag cing zhib pa ni gsang 'dus 'phags skor las 'byung ba yin pa kho bos rim lnga'i 'grel par bshad zin pas/ de las rtogs par bya ba'i 'dir yi ge mang par 'gyur bas ma bris so/ /'pho ba'i dmigs pa snga ma ni/ chos rgyal phyogs pas mdzad pa'i yig chung gi lugs yin/ gdams ngag gi yi ge 'ga' zhig las zhes pa 'di/ kun spangs chen po'i bu chen la stod pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan gyi lugs yin/ bar do'i skabs 'chi ba las bar dor ldang tshul yang 'phags skor na gsal/ yang ba'i g.yang sa gsum ni/ dmyal ba la nag po dang*/ yi dwags la dmar po dang*/ dud 'gro la ser po ste g.yang sa phyams chen po rgya khyon tshad med pa 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba gsum mthong ba'o/ /'jigs pa'i sgra bzhi ni 'byung bzhi snang log gi sgra yin te spyi skad la grags/ lnga ni de'i steng du nam mkha'i snang log gi sgra bsnan pa ste/ dus 'khor ba'i grub thob rnams kyi bzhed pa yin/ rim pa bzhin du ri 'ur ba dang rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa dang*/ nags tshal mes tshig pa dang*/ 'jig dus kyi rlung gi sgra dang*/ 'brug sgra drag po lta bu rnams sa chu me rlung nam mkha' dang sbyar ro/ /ma nges pa'i rnam 'gyur drug ni/ gnas ma nges pa/ gos ma nges pa/ zas ma nges pa/ grogs ma nges pa/ spyod pa ma nges pa/ yid kyi 'gyur ba ma nges pa'am/ 'du shes ma nges pa'o/ /'gro ba'i lam bzhi ni/ dus yi 'khor lo'i rgyud nyid las gsal bar gsungs te/ ji skad du/ 'od zer lha rnams mtho ris su ste dkar min bgrod pa de bzhin lha min klu yi 'jig rten du/ /kun tu 'dres pa mi yi 'jig rten dus ni yi dwags dud 'gro mi rnams dag gi 'gyur/

/zhes 'od zer dkar po'i lam las lha dang*/ nag po'i las lha min klu dang dmyal ba dang*/ dmar po las yi dwags dud 'gro/ 'dres pa las mi ste bzhi'o/ chos gzhan las 'gro ba drug la lam drug tu'ang grags/ mdo lugs las/ dkar po nag po 'dres ma gsum du'ang 'byung bar bshad do/ /thun sgom gyis mnyam rjes bsre ba ni rkyen dang bsre ba yin/ snga rabs kyi co rma sogs lo tsā ba rnams kyis 'khrid mdzad dus/ sbyor drug gi sgom chen mang rab cig la/ mngon shes sogs kyi yon tan skyes kyang*/ gdams ngag 'di med pas/ na tsha sogs lam du 'khyer ma thub nas/ gzhan kun na re/ sbyor drug de rkyen mi thub pa zhig yod par 'dug zer 'phya ba byung skad/ des na 'di gal che/ 'bro ba'i man ngag la 'di rgyas par yod pa'ang lags/ kun spangs chen pos rtsal du 'don par mdzad pa'ang yin no/ /rkyen phra mo nas bsre ba 'di/ spyod 'jug las kyang gsungs te/ /goms na sla bar ma gyur pa'i/ /dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ / de bas gnod pa chung goms pas/ /gnod pa chen po bzod par byos/ /zhes dang*/ tsha grang char dang rlung sogs la'ang*/ /bdag gis gze re mi bya ste/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ snyi sar rkos nas sra sar drod kyi dpe yin no/ /shugs chad la sogs pa'i nyams ni/ rnam rtog snga ma 'gags shing phyi ma ma skyes pa'i bar stongs yin pas/ skabs der sems rnam par mi rtog pa gsal bar mtshon nus/ dmigs pa la mnyam par gzhag pas rnam rtog chad pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ / rnal 'byor mi nyams shing 'phel bar byed pa'i yan lag gi skabs/ gegs sel ni yi ge logs su yod/ dkyus la 'chad mi dgos/ bogs 'don ni bla ma'i mos gus dang*/ sems can la snying rje dang*/ snang ba sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ stong pa nyid dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po la nges shes skyed pa dang*/ gzhan yang dus skabs su bab pa na/ btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba rnam pa gsum gyis srog dbu ma'i thig ler drag tu gzhug pa dang*/

gzhan yang thun dbri bkyed dang*/ spyod lam yangs dog spel ba dang*/ yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pa sogs yin la/ 'dzin pa grub pa yan chad kyis ni/ spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med de/ rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa rnams so/ /de dag la spro na rgyas bshad cung zad bya/ bsdu na ming tsam smos pa de kas chog go /bka' rgya bzhis rgyas btab pa zhes bya ba/ rgyas gdab bya ba'i yul bzhi tshan gnyis 'khrid yig tu bshad pa ltar yin/ de la gnyis yod pa'i snga ma phyogs pa dang*/ phyi ma dbang rgyal ba'i gsung yin/ snga rabs pa 'ga' zhig phyis 'khrid kyi skabs su bla ma'i bka' rgyas 'debs mod kyang de ni slob ma la go ba bskyed phyir gsal 'debs tsam yin/ de'i rtsa ba dbang gi 'jug pa'i dus kyi dam bzhag nyid yin pas/ dam bzhag bzhi la bka' rgya bzhi zer yang gsung*/ yang kha cig dngos su rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bka' yin/ de la brgyud pa rnams 'dus pa'i rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' rgya dang gcig /snod min la gsang ba mi ston pa rgyud las dam tshig tu gsungs pa'i phyir/ bde gshegs rgyal ba'i bka' rgya dang gnyis/ snod min la gsangs/ snod ldan 'ga' zhig la spel/ de yang bla ma dang lha la gnang ba zhu/ de ltar byas na gzhan la phan pa ma zad/ rang nyid la yang nyes skyon med cing tshogs rdzogs pas gegs dang bar chad mi 'byung*/ dpal dang yon tan gong 'phel du 'gro/ snod min la bstan na rang dang slob ma gnyis kar phung*/ skal ldan don nyer can la ser sna byas na/ byang sdom gyi rtsa ltung phog gzhan don 'grib/ tshogs mi rdzogs pas phan yon nyes dmigs de bzhin yod pa/ dngos po'i gshis lugs yin pas 'da' bar mi nus pa ni/ chos nyid las 'bras kyi bka' rgya ste gsum/ chos 'di dang rang gi nyams myong rnams gsang ba 'dzags shing*/ srang khar yan na bka' srungs rnams kyis chad pa 'byung ba'i phyir dam tshigs mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya ste bzhi'o/

/zhes 'chad pa dang*/ yang bka' rgya dang po dkyil 'khor 'jug pa'i dus/ bka' rgya gnyis pa dbang rdzas dam tshig dus/ bka' rgya gsum pa gdams ngag 'khrid kyi dus/ bka' rgya bzhi pa ngo sprod 'dzug btsugs dus/ zhes kyang 'chad de/ 'di 'dra'i rigs rnams la bshad khungs mi dgos pas/ don dang mthun na gang ltar bshad kyang 'gal ba med pas/ dgag sgrub ni dgos kyang mi dgos/ thub kyang mi thub/ thams cad la go rgyu bzang po re ni 'dug go /bar chad spang ba'i yan lag gi skabs/ lam bzang rin chen 'di ni bag med pa'i sogs kyi 'bru bsnyer na/ chos zab mo 'di yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang 'dra/ de bsgoms pa las nyams myong che chung gang shar kyang*/ nyams myong de yang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang 'dra/ dbang dang stobs yod pa'i mi gcig gi lag tu rin po che de byung na ta/ chom rkun gyis 'phrog pa'i nyen med de/ rin po che de mi phal pa dbang med pa zhig gi lag tu byung na/ chom rkun gyis 'phrog pa'am/ g.yo can gcig gis bslus te 'phrog nyen che bas/ rin po che sus kyang ma tshor bar sbed thub pa'i cag byed dgos/ de bzhin du nyams myong dang 'brel ba'i gdams ngag zab mo thob pa 'di yang*/ rang nyid gegs kyis mi 'khyer ba'i gdengs dang brtan pa ma thob kyi bar du/ bag med dang g.yo can sogs skye bo skal med rnams la ston du yang mi rung zhing*/ rang nyid kyang mi gzhan gyis blo bsgyur ba'i dbang du mi 'gro ba zhig byed dgos/ rang gi nyams myong la gnod pa thams cad sgom 'jig par 'gyur ba'i chom rkun dang 'dra bas spong dgos/ zhes pa mdor bsdus kyi don blo la bzhag nas 'di ltar/ lam bzang po rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi rin po che 'di ni bag med cal col gyi sems can mi gzhan rnams la ston par mi bya/ gal te bstan pa na/ dper na 'brog dgon pa lung stong du chom rkun 'byung ba ltar/

sems can de dag rang gi khyim la shin tu chags shing*/ blos mi thongs bas rang khyim grong yin yang rung*/ gnas gzhi yin yang rung ste/ chags sdang 'phel ba'i khyim gyi 'brog dgon par rab tu zhugs shing gnas pa la/ zhing las dang*/ tshong gi las sogs khyim gyi 'tsho rtsis dang*/ bza' btung khyim thab/ 'khor dang*/ rnyed pa dang*/ gtam sogs la chags pa yul ngan pa'i chom rkun gyis chos zab mo de chud zos pa'i tshul gyis yon tan mi skye zhing cung zad skyes kyang nyams pa'i tshul gyis 'phrog par byed do/ /de ltar na slob ma des chos chung gsan pas g.yang shor te/ rang gi yang byin rlabs nyams pa'i don yin/ yang gcig tu na chos btsongs nas nor sgrub pa'i sgrib pa des/ rang gi sgom shor pa'i don la'ang sbyor yang nags thibs por choms rkun 'byung ba ltar/ sngar bla mas gdams ngag bstan pa'i dus su/ nyams myong gi rin po che ci rigs par thob kyang*/ gnyen 'dun ni mtshon byed de/ dgra gnyen la brten pa'i chags sdang sna tshogs 'phel ba'i yul phyogs nags thibs por rab tu zhugs shing gnas pa la/ dmigs pa'i yul la the tshom dang*/ bya byed 'khrul ba phra mo tshun chad la 'gyod pa dang*/ sgom pa la mi spro ba'i le lo dang*/ sgom blo byas kyang sems rnam g.yeng gis khyer ba'i rgod pa ste/ mnyam bzhag bsam gtan la bar du gcod pa'i sgrib pa lnga'i chom rkun 'di rnams kyis mnyam bzhag rtag tu 'phrog cing nyams par byed do/ /ji skad du/ rgod dang 'gyod dang gnod sems rmugs pa dang*/ /gnyid dang 'dod la 'dun dang the tshom ste/ /sgrib pa lnga po 'di dag dge ba'i nor/ /'phrog pa'i chom rkun lags par mkhyen par mdzod/ /ces 'byung ba ltar/ chos mngon pa sogs thams cad las/ rtog rigs bdun bgrangs nas sgrib pa lnga zhes gsungs pa la/ rgod 'gyod gnyis gcig tu sdoms/ gnyid rmugs gnyis gcig tu sdoms/ 'dir bshad pa'i le lo ma bgrangs/

'dod pa la 'dun pa dang gnod sems bsnan no/ /de dag bslab pa gsum la sgrib pa'i rnam gzhag sogs mdzad/ de la rgod pa zhes pa sngon de dag gi chos skad la/ /'dod yon la longs spyod pa da ltar dran pas sems ma zhi ba zhig la rgod par 'jog la/ 'dir ni dmigs pa la mi gnas pa'i rnam g.yeng spyi la rgod par bzhag pas/ rgod pa bkag na 'dod 'dun gnod sems zhor la khegs par dgongs pa yin gyi/ kha cig de gnyis gsang sngags pa la spong mi dgos pa'i skabs yang zer ba mi 'thad cing*/ skabs kyi don las phyir phyogs so/ /'dir bslab pa gsum gyi sgrib pa la mi sbyor/ sems gnas pa kho na'i sgrub pa mdzad do/ /dpal gsang ba grub pa las kyang*/ le lo gnyid dang 'gyod pa dang*/ /rgod dang the tshom zhes bya ba/ /sgrib pa lnga po sangs rgyas dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' mi bzhed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang 'di dang gcig pa nyid do/ /de bzhin du srog gcod pa dang*/ ma byin par len pa dang*/ gzhan gyi bud med bsten pa sogs log g.yem dang*/ 'du shes bsgyur te rdzun smra pa dang*/ dngos su rgol ba'i tshig rtsub dang*/ mdza' bo 'byed pa'i phra ma dang/ de gsum las gzhan du gyur pa nyon mongs can gyi tshig 'khyal bar gyur pa dang*/ gzhan gyi longs spyod rang gir 'dod pa'i brnab sems dang*/ pha rol po'i lus dang longs spyod la gnod sems dang*/ bden bzhi'i don la med par skur ba 'debs pa'i log lta ste/ des mtshon pa'i lta ba ngan pa gzhan rnams kyang ngo*/ /mi dge ba bcu lta ngan sna tshogs dang bcas pa de dag byas na/ ting nge 'dzin sngar ma skyes pa mi skye zhing*/ skyes pa nyams par 'gyur bas/ sngar sgom cung zad skyes pa rnams 'phrog pa'i tshom rkun no/ /yang srog gcod/ ma byin len/ 'dod logardzun tshigachang 'thung ste las ngo bo nyid kyis sdig par gyur pa/ rang bzhin gyis kha na ma tho ba yin pa'i phyir/ yod pa'i sdig pa lnga dang bcas pa ste chang 'thung ba rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho bar 'dod pa dge 'dun phal chen pa'i lugs dang 'dra'o/

/cho lo rtse ba dang*/ mtshan ma can gyi sha dang*/ bza' ba dang rin gyi don du bsad pa'i sha'i bza' ba la chags pa dang*/ long gtam sna tshogs la dga' ba dang*/ mu stegs kyi rig pa dang kla klo'i chos la blo 'jug cing brtson pa ste/ de rnams sdig pa'i las dang*/ rjes su mthun pa nye ba'i sdig pa lnga dang/ mchod sbyin gyi don du ba lang gsod pa dang*/ mi bsad mchod sbyin nam/ ma mo mchod pa'i don du/ byis pa gsod pa dang*/ nar son pa'i bud med gsod pa dang/ skyes pa gsod pa dang*/ lha mi'i bla ma dkon mchog gi rten gsum 'jig par byed pa ste gsod pa lnga'o/ /lnga po 'di rnams sdig pa shin tu che zhing*/ lhag par dang po bzhi po mu stegs byed mang po zhig chos su 'dod pa dang*/ lnga pa kla klo rnams chos su 'dod pas/ de dag gi log rtog bzlog pa'i phyir sgos su smos pa yin na/ 'khu ba ni/ 'khang zhing khros pa ste/ 'jig rten nam chos kyi grogs po dang*/ bkur bar 'os pa'i rje bo dang*/ sangs rgyas dang/ dge 'dun dang*/ bla ma la khro ba ste lnga dang*/ dbang po lnga yul lnga la mngon par zhen pa ni chags pa lnga ste/ 'di rnams byas na ting nge 'dzin nyams par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ lam bzang rgyud la skyes pa 'phrog pa'i lnga pa lnga ste nyi shu rtsa lnga po 'di rnams rtag tu ste nam byas res kyis lam bzang rin po che 'phrog cing nyams par byed do/ /nyi shu po de rnams byas na sdig pa'i bags kyis non nas sgom nyams par byed cing*/ dbang shes lnga'i rjes kyi rtog pas yul la chags pa ni/ rnam g.yeng nyid yin pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin dngos dang 'gal ba'o/ /sdig las spyad pas ting nge 'dzin rnams nyams 'gro bar mdo sngags thams cad nas gsungs pas/ sdig pa'i las mang po byas kyang rdzogs pa chen po dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du ye grol ye dag yin zer zhing*/ sgom bzang du song ba skad byed pa yin/

rnam pa gnyis te/ yang na rdzun kha thal kyis gzhan mgo bskor ba 'ba' zhig tu zad/ yang na ni bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sgom log thebs pa kho na'o/ /des na rang gi brtson 'grus las byung ba'i sgom gcig dang*/ byin rlabs rnam dag las byung pa'i sgom gcig dang*/ nag phyogs kyi 'gong po'i byed las kyi sgom gcig ste/ sgom thebs tshul gsum yod pa 'di go dgos nges rang zhig yin na'ang*/ phal cheragacig gis mi go bar 'dug go /gzhan yang bza' ba dang*/ btung ba sna tshogs dang*/ gnas khang dang*/ gos dang*/ 'khor g.yog dang*/ khyim thab dang*/ 'bru dang*/ phyugs dang*/ sa gzhi la sogs pa longs spyod du ma la shin tu mngon par chags shing g.yengs pa'i chom rkun de rnams kyis ni/ skyes bu brtson 'grus dang ldan pa yin du zin kyang*/ bag med pa'i spyod pa la yin par 'gyur zhing*/ dran pa nyams pas brgyal par gyur pa ste/ bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa mi shes pas/ sngar yod kyi yon tan thams cad nyams shing 'phrog par 'gyur na/ brtson 'grus chung zhing lhod pa rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos so/ /g.yo can gyi ston pa spang pa'i skabs/ rang la nyams myong 'dra skyes kyang zab mo'i rgyud don la rang byan chub pa ma yin na/ rang gi sgom de bzang ngan rang gi mi shes pas/ gzhan la 'dri dgos na chos 'di ston pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma de la zhu rgyu byung na legs/ de min chos rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di la go ba bzang zhing myong ba skyes pa zhig la dris na/ dogs pa chod cing legs par 'ong srid/ sgom med pa'i rtog ge ba dang*/ sgom yod par brdzu ba'i zog po dang*/ chos gzhan gyi lugs kyi sgom bzang rab yod du chug kyang*/ chos zab mo/ /'di'i ro ma myong ba rnams la/ sbyor drug gi nyams rtogs sogs rang gi nyams myong dang*/ phyag len du 'debs pa'i man ngag dang*/ bla mas ngo sprod tshul sogs dogs gcod ta nam yang mi byed de/

tshig zur tsam yang mi smra'o/ /gal te dogs gcod byas na/ de dag gis 'di ni lam log pa'o snyam/ kho rang gi lugs dang ma mthun pas smod pa shas che/ kha cig 'di sgom rang dga' tshad yin pa 'dra na'ang*/ 'di bzang ngo byas na chos 'di dang bla ma de la rtsis che ru song nas ltag shed skye bar 'dug 'di la smad ra btang na kho rang gi sngar gyi chos dang bla ma la dad pa log nas nga'i 'og tu chud 'ong shas che snyam nas g.yo sgyus smod pa yang srid/ de ltar gzhan gyis smad tsa na/ rang yang the tshom skye ba dang*/ blo log par 'gyur bas/ chos bzang po 'di bor te log pa'i lam la 'gro nyen yod/ dper na nor nyams med pa zhig gi lag tu nor bu yin nges la yin yang zer ba zhig byung*/ de mi sna tshogs la bstan zhing dris na/ 'ga' zhig gis/ nor bu'i nyams med nas ngo ma shes te de la smad ra gtong*/ g.yo can 'ga' zhig gis nor bu yin par shes kyang*/ 'di 'dra rdo phal pa zhig yin par 'dug pa/ nor bu'i rigs te 'di 'dra ba yod dogs med zer zhing*/ rin chung ngu zhig sprod pa'am/ kyal ka'i tshul gyis 'phrog par byed/ yang gzhan la ma bstan par nor bu'i nyams shes brdzun dang g.yo sgyu mi byed pa zhig la bstan nas dris na/ des 'di ni nor bu'i nang tshan 'di lta bu yin/ de'i rtags 'di dang 'di lta bu yin/ rin thang 'di tsam byed ces sogs drang por bshad pas/ nor bu ma shor bar ma zad phyin chad nyams kyang chug pa zhig 'ong*/ de bzhin du chos 'di'i nyams myong gis thugs rgyud phyug pa zhig la dris na/ rang gi sgom ma shor bar ma zad/ sngar kyi sgom la dogs pa chod/ phyis nyams myong 'char rgyu rnams ngo shes/ ma bde ba'i 'phrang thams cad las grol ba zhig 'ong ba yin no/ /de ltar ston pa ni/ rang nyid kyi nor bu'i mtshan nyid mi shes pas/ nor bu yongs su rtog pa po ma yin pa'i phyir/ nor bu de rin thang chen po zhig yin par 'gyur ram/

rin thang chen po ma yin zhes/ g.yo can gzhan nor bu'i mtshan nyid shes sam mi shes gang yin yang rung*/ de la bstan na/ 'di ni nor bu ma yin te rin thang chen por mi 'gyur ro zhes zer ba na/ de'i tshig la yid brtan bcas nas rin po che de rtsi sa med pas 'dor bar byed do/ /skyes bu drang po'i rang bzhin can gang dag /rin po che bzang po rnams kyi mtshan nyid rig pa rnams la/ rin po che chen po de yongs su rtog tu gzhug cing*/ 'di ci yin zhes dris na/ mkhas pa drang po'i rang bzhin can de rnams kyis rnam par dag pa bden pa'i tshig la brten nas/ rang gi lag gi rin po che de'i ming dang khyad chos dang*/ rtags mtshan dang*/ rin thang dang*/ rnam par dbye ba la sogs pa mtha' dag shes par 'gyur bas/ de la ni bstan par bya ba yin no/ /zhes te 'di don gzhan bkod pa'i tshul gyis gsungs pa'o/ /skabs 'dir bla mas 'di skad brjod de/ de yang bla ma ngan pa de dag gis chos zab 'di la tshul ji lta bas smod par 'gyur snyam na/ bod yul 'di na mu stegs byed dang*/ nyan thos ste gnyis dang*/ sems tsam mthar thug tu 'dod pa cher med pas dogs mi dgos/ dbu mar rlom pa rkyang pa yin yang*/ mdo lam la mthar thug tu 'dzin pa la'ang shin tu nyung mod/ gal srid mang po byung yang*/ sngags la ye ma zhugs pa rnams kyis/ skabs 'dir skyon brjod la sleb mi 'ong zhing*/ gzhan rnams kyang yid brtan mi 'cha' bas gnod tshab chung ngo*/ /des na 'dir sngags la zhugs par rlom pa'i rtog ge tha shal ba 'ga' dang*/ gsang sngags pa'i ming can gzhung phyogs re tsam las ma mthong ba 'ga' dang*/ sgom chen gyi ming can mang po zhig gis smad ra gtong bar 'gyur ro/ /dang po sngags la zhugs par rlom pa'i dbu tshad rtog ge pa tha shal dag ni/ stong gzugs 'khrul snang yin/ de mthong ba'i shes pa tshad min gyi blo yin/ sems mi rtog par bzhag na gti mug skye/

rig shes kyis dpyad pa'i don ma rtogs na mun sgom du 'gro/ stong gzugs la mi rtog par 'jog pa har sgom yin/ har sgom dbang shes yin/ dbang shes lnga kha phyir lta yin pas ting nge 'dzin man lam mi skye/ zhes sogs smra bar byed do/ / don la ni/ de dag phyin ci log ste/ stong gzugs ma 'khrul ba'i snang ba dang*/ de mthong ba'i shes pa tshang ma yin tshul bshad zin/ mi rtog pa bsgoms pas las dang po pa la ye shes skye/ grub thob rdo rje dril bu pas/ mgal me skyod pa'i rnam pa can/ /sems ni yul la rab tu rgyug /don de las ni rnam bzlog nas/ /mtshon du med pa mtshon par byed/ /ces dang*/ stong dang stong min la sogs pa/ /kun rtog rab spangs mkha' mnyam 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ rig shes bsgoms pas gnas lugs mi rtogs/ lcam dpal mos/ dbu ma'i 'dod lugs gzhung gi tshul/ /de ni rtsod pa kun la mos/ /bskal pa yal ga ngal bas kyang*/ /byang chub thob par mi nus so/ /zhes dang*/ sa ra has/ gal te mngon sum gyur na bsam gtan ci/ /gal te lkog tu gyur na mun pa 'jal/ /zhes so/ /har sgom bya ba'i tha snyad la don ngos bzung rgyu rang med/ har sgom yin yang ci to/ /stong gzugs ni dbang shes kyis mthong ba yang min/ dbang shes las ting nge 'dzin rnam dag mi skye ba yang ma yin te/ klu sgrub kyis/ mig dang gzugs la brten nas ni/ /dri ma med pa'i blo skye'o/ /zhes gsungs pa de ci yin zhes log par smra ba de dag sun dbyung bar bya/ lar rang sngags dpe 'dra klog dar byas pa'i mtshan nyid pa skam po la sgom gyi bcol gtogs rang med lags so/ /phyogs re'i mig can sngags par rlom pa ni/ phyis byung gi lam 'bras pa'am/ rim lnga pa sogs thabs gtso bor 'dod pa rnams yin/ de dag ni bskyed rim dang*/ dbang chog bshar sgom dang*/ ngag bzlas dang*/ dmigs bcas kyi gtum mo phra thig dang*/ las rgya sogs kyis grol bar 'gyur gyi/
