de dag ma sgom na stong gzugs bsgoms pas mi grol lo/ /zhes smra'o/ /'di ni drang don sad sud la zhen zhing nges don gyi phyogs tsam yang ma mthong ba yin/ khyed kyi gtum mo las rgya sogs ni kha bshad tsam du zad gda'/ kha bton dang bzlas pa bzang ste sgom 'khrid rang mi zer lags/ spyir rtogs bcas nges don gyi lam du mi 'gyur ba sogs gong du bshad zin pas dgag par bya'o/ /sgom chen gyi ming can ni rang rang gi chos kyi gnad ma go ba'i phyag rdzogs pa mang po zhig ste de dag 'di skad smra ste/ sems rtogs na sangs rgya ba yin gyi/ stong gzugs sogs kyis ci zhig bya/ stong gzugs dang rmi lam 'od gsal la sogs pa 'di dag nyams tsam yin pas gnas lugs la sleb rgyu med/ rtogs pa zhig rang dgos pa yin zer ma myong yang myong skad mang po byed du 'ong*/ yang byed bcings nges can dang*/ mun 'khrid sogs gu dog po des ci byed/ nged kyi chos 'di gu yangs cham me yod zer/ yang las 'bras kyi spang blang dang*/ dam tshig sdom pa'i khrims dang*/ dge sbyor gyi thun dang*/ gtsang sbra/ thos bsam/ khrigs bkod byed pa rnams lta ci smos/ lha sgom/ sngags bzlas cho ga dbang bskur/ lus ngag gi dge sbyor/ gtum mo khra thig la sogs pa 'di thams cad theg dman yin zer zhing*/ gang shar la spang blang dgag sgrub med pa 'di theg chen yin/ mthar thug yin/ khyed lus gnad byed bcings dang*/ stong gzugs sgom pa'i 'di nyams tsam yin/ theg dman de 'dras cir yang mi btub/ da rang ngo la ltos/ lhod de skyur la zhog spyod pa mno tshad kha thal byas pas chog /de ka chos yin zer du 'ong*/ de tsa na skya ser pho mo glen blun krog mo krog pho rnams tshig de rna bar snyan grags nas/ chos sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa 'di tsho bor/ chos log zos bde la kha lhan gyis 'gro/ de yin ni bsod nams zad pa yin/ khyi phag mi gtsang ba la rgyug pa dang 'dra/

ji skad du/ dud 'gro phag la kha zas gtsang mas ci/ /bong bu phyugs la mu tig nor bus ci/ /long ba ri mo 'on pa pi wang dang*/ /blun po dag la chos kyi ci byar yod/ /ces pa der gda' 'o/ /de skad smra ba de lung rigs kyis dgag sgrub byed thabs med de shin tu blun pa'i phyir/ yang na lung rigs khyad du gsod pa'i kha 'jam mang po 'don/ yang na 'thab mor 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang tshig de rnams shab shob kho na yin pas snying po cung zad kyang med par go dgos/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas bya ba/ sems tsam rtogs pa rang gis kyang min/ sems kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs shing*/ rtogs pa de yang mthar phyin na sangs rgyas thob pa'i don yin da lta'i rnam rtog 'og 'gyu skyes pa cha rgyus yod pa tsam la sems rtogs pa mi zer/ sems nyid mthong ba yin min/ 'di skad ces sems rtogs na ta sangs rgyas pa'ang srid de/ khyed rnams kyis sems ni ma rtogs par 'dug /sems rtogs na sangs rgya bas khyed rnams la ga la phan/ zhes bya/ rang lugs la sems rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i sgrib pa spong*/ sgrib pa spangs pas sems nyid rtogs/ tshogs bsags pas yon tan skye/ sgrib pa spangs pa dang yon tan mtha' phyin tsa na sems nyid rtogs pa mthar phyin/ de tsa na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung ba yin/ grong gseb la yan pa'i rtog ldan brdzus ma la sems nyid kyi gnyer kha med/ sems rang mngon sum du rtogs pa ni/ sa bdun po ni sems yin te bya ba de yin/ sems nyid rtogs pa mthar thug pa ni/ ye shes chos sku yin/ dpe'am rjes mthun pa'am cha shas phra mo tsam la nges pa med de/ de 'dra la de tsam du rbad gshod byed rin yang mi chog go /rig pa ngor lta tsam chos kyi ming yang mi shes pa'i phal pa la yang yod/ nad drag pos phog pa bag tsam zhig cig la/ da ga 'dra zhig 'dug byas na/ thom thom pa zhig min pa gang yang mi 'dug zer 'ong*/

de sems kyi gnas lugs rig pa yin nam ci/ yang nga da lta dga' byung*/ nga da lta tshig pa za zhig 'dug zer 'ong ste/ khos dga' ba dang*/ tshig pa zos pa la bltas 'dug /ngo shes 'dug ste/ des rnam rtog rang grol du e 'gro/ chos su e song*/ sems gnas pa dang 'gyu ba rang ngo shes pas chos su 'gro ba rang zhig byed na snang cha sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ rang bzhin brjod bral nam mkha' lta bur 'char thub pa zhig dgos pa yin/ rang re la ni sems nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo 'od gsal rtags bcu sgom pa 'di ka yin/ yin tshul rgyas pa bshad zin/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dang rang lugs la ta stong gzugs nyams tsam ma yin/ chos sku'i rang gzugs yin yang*/ re zhig de dag la 'di skad ces bya ste/ sgom nyams tsam yin pas gnas lugs mi rtogs/ nyams gang yang ma shar ba bzang na/ ngan song dud 'gro la sogs pa bzang bar 'gyur/ nyams len byas na nyams skye ba chos nyid yin mod/ 'o na nyams len mi byed pa de legs sam ci/ legs na kho rang la 'dug go /gu dog pos ci byed bya ba ni/ ri la sdod ma nus/ sgom ma nus pa'i kha skyengs su 'dug /gu mu lto ba rang yangs pa dang 'dra/ theg pa che chung gi dbye ba ni/ sems bskyed dang stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta bas 'byed pa yin/ spang blang yod med kyis 'byed pa min/ spang blang med pa la med lugs shig dgos/ byung tshad za ba dang*/ phag tshad du nyal ba dang*/ rigs ngan dang 'grogs pa la spang blang med pa mi zer/ dge ba thams cad theg dman du lta ba 'di lar nas mi dge ba bcu las log lta thu zer ba de yin pas ngo shes 'tshal/ spang blang med zer gyin dgag sgrub spang blang la mi tshe skyel ba 'di ci yin/ ltogs dad dang chags sred snying khungs su bcug pa'i spang blang med/ dgag sgrub med zer ba 'di bag med tho cho'i rgyab skyor nag po zang thal ma gtogs/ dkar po dge ba'i chos cung zad kyang ma 'dres pa'i ngan 'gro'i lam po che der gda' 'o/

/des na chos byed ma dgos par da lta nas sangs rgyas pa'i khungs la/ 'chi lugs lod cing shi na dmyal ba nas thar dus med pa'i chos log mi gtsang ba'i rgya mtsho la| dka' tshegs chung la ngo mtshar che ba'i zab chos bdud rtsi'i chu mig yin snyam du ma sems shig des na chos bya ba te/ dang por las 'bras kyi spang blang zhib pa zhig /bar du snying rje byang sems 'byongs pa zhig /mthar 'dzin pa thams cad las rang grol ba'i stong nyid rtogs pa zhig dgos/ gsang sngags la zhugs na de rnams kyi steng du/ dam tshig rnam par dag pa zhig /bla ma la mos gus chug pa zhig /rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pa zhig dgos pa yin/ yang sgos su gang la dmigs pa brtad de bsgoms na/ nyon mongs thams cad 'gag yon tan thams cad skye ba'i zung 'jug gi lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di dang mjal nas tsab tsob ma byed cig /lar chags sdang chos brgyad kyi dbang du song ba'i bla ma dge bshes zer ba tsho dang gtad med kyi rang nyams byung rgyal du skyong ba'i mkhas pa ming can dang*/ zog po mgo skor mkhan gyi sgom chen pa'i ming can gyi kha la ma rgyug par/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyis gsungs pa'i chos la 'jug dgos pa yin no/ /chos 'di dang mjal nas da blo sna ma mangs shig de khas 'tsheng ba yin no zhes pa lta bu ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ bdud kyi bar chad ngo shes par byed pa'i skabs su/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor 'di la rtse gcig tu nyams len byed pa la/ thog mar blo sna gshin du 'gro ba'i skabs dang*/ bar du dmigs pa gsal zhing rtags snang rgyas pa'i skabs dang*/ mthar nyams rtogs gong 'phel gyi skabs rnams su 'di'i sgom la bar chad byed pa byung na/ dge ba rlabs chen gzhan 'grub pa ltar snang yang*/ bdud kyi bar chad kho na yin/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba lung ma bstan dang mi dge ba yin na lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/

rgyal khams mi chen gyis gang ba'i slob ma skyangs pa dang*/ dge slong 'bum phrag bye ba la chos ston gsol ba las kyang*/ rgyud nas gsungs pa ltar gyi lam du 'gro nges rang zhig byung na rdo rje'i rnal 'byor so sor sdud pa thun gcig bsgom pa yang*/ tshogs gsum gang gyi sgo nas lam chod che ba'i phyir ro/ /spyir dge ba la bar gcod thams cad bdud yin/ dge ba la bskul ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mthu yin zhes kyang bya mod kyi/ nang sel dge ba chung ngu bor nas rlabs chen la 'phral du 'jug na/ chung ngu bkag pa tsam bdud ma yin/ nges don las bzlog nas drang don la 'jug pa sogs/ dge ba chen po bkag nas chung ngu la 'jug na/ chung ngu la 'khyogs pa de dge ba tsam yin mod kyang bdud kyi las su rig par bya'o/ /des na rang gzhan gyi chos la bar du gcod pa'i bdud rnams ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs dang*/ pha dang*/ ma dang*/ bu mo dang*/ sring mo dang*/ bu dang*/ sprun zla dang*/ 'dod cing chags pa'i yul chung ma la sogs pa/ nges pa med pa'i gzugs rnams su gyur nas/ yang dag pa'i lam sgom pa la gegs byed de/ dngos su sprul pa yang srid mod phal cher bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs kyis so/ /de'i phyir na bla ma dam pas gnang ba'i lam bzang rin po che 'di slob ma rnams kyis gces spras su byas nas/ gnyen nye ba rtsa lag tu brdzus pa'i chom rkun lta bu/ rang khyim dang*/ nye du dang*/ nyon mongs dang*/ 'du 'dzi dang*/ slob dpon ngan pa dang*/ sdig las dang*/ bdud kyi las thams cad ngo shes nas yongs su spangs te dran shes bzhin gyi sgo nas 'bad pas bsgrims te/ sgom nyams myong gi ye shes shin tu legs par sba zhing bskyang bar bya'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /dam tshig dang sdom pa'i yan lag gi skabs su/ gsang sngags rang gi tha snyad kyi dbang du byas na/ dam tshig dang sdom pa don gcig ming gi rnam grangs kyi dbang du byed pa dang*/

sbang bya bzlog pa'i tshul khrims la dam tshig /mnyams su blang bya sgrub pa'i tshul khrims la sdom pa/ zhes zer ba dang*/ de gnyis go bzlog pa'ang yod mod kyang*/ ming 'dogs tha dad byas kyang don steng nas 'gal ba med/ mdo phyogs su tshul khrims la dam tshig gi tha snyad ma grags kyang*/ dam tshig gi don 'da' bar mi bya ba yin pas/ tshul khrims la dam tshig gi don tshang ngo 'dir rtsa ltung bcu bzhi ni/ gal te g.yo sgyu'i dbang gis rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung na dmyal bar 'gro ste 'di dag sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes sogs rgyud tshig gis gsal bar bstan/ rtsa ltung dang po rdo rje slob dpon thugs mi mnyes par byas pa ste/ dmigs bsal la rang gis dge ba byas pa la ma dgyes na/ rtsa ltung du ni mi 'gyur/ slob dpon ma dgyes pa'i nyes pa ni yod dge ba de rang la phan yon yang yod pas/ dkar nag 'dres ma yin/ 'di la'ang dmigs bsal rtsa ltung du 'gro ba yod de/ sngar dge ba rlabs chen la 'jug par chad pa las/ dge ba dman pa chung ngu la zhugs pas/ thugs dkrugs na rtsa ltung ngo*/ /gnyis pa bla ma'i bka' las 'gongs pa ni/ sdig pa la sbyor ba'i tshig ma yin pa'i bla ma'i bka' gcog pa ste/ de yang lung ma bstan bcag na rtsa ltung yang ba'i rigs dang*/ dge ba'i gsung bcag na shin tu lci ba'o/ /mi dge ba can gyi gsung bcag na rtsa ltung ni med/ shad kyis sbyang ba'i mi dgyes pa med par ma byas na/ bka' 'das kyi nyes pa tsam yod do/ /'di gnyis yul rdo rje slob dpon la brten pa'i ltung ba yin pas/ sdig pa che la sbyang dka' ba'i rigs so/ /gsum pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi chos la brten pa'i bla ma gcig pa ni rdo rje spun te/ de la sdig gsog pa ni/ nang dam yin pa'i phyir/ 'di yang nyes pa lci zhing sbyong dka' ba'i rigs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ byams pa spong ba zhes smos kyang byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems spong ba ste/

gtan du byams pa spangs na sems can gcig la byams pa spangs kyang 'dir 'gyur te/ rtsa ltung gi gzhung gzhan gyi 'chad lugs ltar gyi/ lnga pa bzhi pa gnyis ka lugs 'di'i bzhi par 'dus so/ 'dir lnga pa ni mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba la ma dad cing zhu bde 'gyur med la dgos pa med par bsams nas/ kun da byang sems ched du nyams par byed pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i grub mtha' yin pa zhig la/ sdang sems kyis smod pa dang*/ bdun pa ni/ dbang bskur ma thob pa'am mi mos pa la gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba ston pa'o/ / brgyad pa ni/ lha'i khyad par sgrub pa sogs kyi dgos pa med par rang gi lus mi gtsang ngo zhes smod pas yan lag gcod pa nas bsnyung ba la sogs pa'i bar du gdung ba rtsom pa dang*/ dgu pa ni/ kun rdzob kyi chos rnams gdod nas stongs pa dang*/ don dam gnas lugs 'gyur med zung 'jug du gdod nas rang grub pa'i don go ba'i rjes su slar mi 'thad do snyam ma dad pa'o/ /bcu pa ni/ kha 'jam zhe gdug pas gzhan bslu ba dang*/ bcu gcig pa ni/ gsang sngags kyi thabs zab mo rmad du byung ba la ma dad pa dang*/ bcu gnyis pa ni/ dag pa'i sems can zhes bya ba nang du yang dag pa'i lam rgyud la skyes pa la zer/ de 'dra'i gang zag la de 'dra yin par nges pa'am/ yin min the tshom za bzhin du/ rang 'dod kyi dbang gis skur ba 'debs pa'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ sngags kyi spyod pa la zhugs nas tshogs kyi gral du thabs shes kyi rdzas sogs longs spyod kyi dam tshig rnams mi gtsang ba dang*/ nyes dmigs che ba'i bsam pas spong pa dang*/ bcu bzhi pa ni/ yul bud med gcig la smad kyang rung*/ du ma la smad kyang rung ste/ smod lugs rigs 'ded pa'i sgo nas smad na/ bud med thams cad la smad par 'gyur ba ste/ bud med kyi rigs 'dis cir yang mi rung zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de dag kyang ltung ba'i rnam gzhag shes bzhin du/

khyad du bsad nas de dag byed la/ da dung chos pa yin tshul gyi bzang rdzu byed pa ni/ g.yo sgyu can te nyon mongs drag po'i rtsa ltung gis sngags kyi dam sdom rtsa ba nas 'jig par byed pa dmyal ba brgyad po rnams su bskal pa ches mang par mnar bar 'gyur bas/ bsgrims te zhe zon gyi sgo nas 'bad de spong ba gal che'o/ /gal te bag med dang nyon mongs mang bas dbang med du gos na'ang de ma thag bshags pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dam tshig gso ba'i dbang zhus te/ sdig sbyong la 'bad par bya'o/ /gzhan yang gong du smos pa'i yod pa'i sdig pa lnga/ nye ba'i sdig pa lnga/ gsod pa lnga/ 'khu ba lnga/ chags pa lnga ste nyi shu rtsa lnga po rnams spong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs nyer lnga la yang dag par gnas dgos/ de las gzhan bsgrub par bya ba'i dam tshig ni rigs drug gi dam tshig dang*/ sdom pa rnams yin te/ 'dod pa'i rdo rje la ni zhes sogs gsungs/ de yang khyab byed rigs gnyis las/ khyab byed dang po rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig ni stong nyid spros bral dang brtse ba snying rje chen po phan tshun rgyas btab ro mnyam du byed kyin sgom pa thun bzhi'am/ ma tha yang zhag re'i nang du lan re med thabs med/ khyab byed gnyis pa mi bskyod pa'i dam tshig la/ rdo rje thugs snying rje dang*/ dril bu gsung stong nyid sgom pa yin na/ snga ma rdor sems kyi dam tshig 'dir 'dus pas/ sgrub pa nyams len gyi skabs/ snga ma yod na 'di logs su mi dgos kyang*/ go don gyi dbang du byas na/ 'jog lugs gnyis kyi dang po ni ldog pa mi 'dra ste/ stong nyid snying rje re re ba mi bskyod pa'i rigs dang*/ gcig tu bsres pa rdor sems kyi dam tshig tu 'jog pa'ang yin no/ /yang 'jog tshul gnyis pa ni/ sems can dang*/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rjes kun nas bslangs ba'i byang sems dang*/ kun rdzob spros bral gyi stong nyid sgom pa mi bskyod pa dang*/

dmigs med kyi snying rje dang*/ don dam rig pa'i ye shes kyi stong nyid gcig tu 'dres pa rdor sems la sbyor te/ mdo lugs la dmigs med snying rje dang*/ don dam rang rig sgom thub pa/ sa mtshams mthon po kho na la sbyor kyang*/ gsang sngags 'bras bu lam byed yin pas thog ma nas kyang 'byung ngo*/ /'o na de dngos ma yin rjes mthun pa'o snyam na/ rjes mthun pa yin par byas kyang don la 'dra bas 'gal ba med la/ theg pa gzhan gyi dngos dang*/ 'di'i rjes mthun pa skyon spong yon tan sgrub pa gang la'ang stobs che chung la khyad med pas/ dgos don gyi dbang las rjes mthun pa'i tha snyad mi byed par dngos su 'chad pa'ang yin no/ /'chad tshul gnyis po de yang gnad gcig ste/ dmigs pa gnyis kyi snying rje dang*/ spros bral rang sgom na phyogs re bar yong zhing*/ dmigs med snying rje byas na/ zung 'jug kho nar 'ong ste/ 'di'i dmigs med ni rig stong las gzhan du med pa'i phyir ro/ /phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig ni rang dang snang ba lha skur bsgom pa yin/ slob dpon gyi dam tshig ni/ bla ma la mchog tu gus pa'i sgo nas bla ma mnyes par byed pa ste/ bzhi po de mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi dam tshig yin/ rin po che'i rigs kyi dam tshig la/ rin chen lcags zangs ba lang rta/ /glang po bu mo yul 'khor dang*/ /'dod pa'i chung ma rang gi sha /sbyin pa rnam pa bcu ru 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa mtshon byed de/ zang zing gi sbyin pa dus gsum du sbyin par 'dod pa'i sems dang ma bral ba dang*/ dngos su yang skabs su bab na ci nus sbyin pa yin/ 'khor lo'i rigs la bza' btung thams cad sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ yod na dam rdzas kyi ril bu brten zhing*/ dus khyad par gyi dam tshig dpa' bo'i ston mo sogs byed pa'o/ /las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig ni bla ma dang*/ yi dam dang*/ dkon mchog gsum spyi rnams mchod pa yin la/

bla ma mchod pa rdo rje'i rigs kyi skabs na'ang yod mod kyi/ dam tshig 'di dag phan tshun gzhi mthun pa yod du rung bas/ bla ma mchod pa ni rdo rje dang las gnyis kar du gtogs par bya'o/ /padma'i rigs kyi dam tshig ni/ nus pa rnyed na las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgyas thig le 'ching dgos pa yin la/ las dang po pas kyang kun da lta bu ci nus su srung ba'o/ /de ltar na de rnams bskyed rdzogs gnyis kar gyi thun mong pa yin/ lugs 'di'i dbang bskur thob tshad kyis srung dgos 'di rnams dngos su kun rdzob gtso che yang*/ rdzogs rim nges don gyi dam tshig gi gzhi rten du yang med ka med yin no/ /nges don rdzogs rim gyi dam tshig ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs la mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang rnam kun mchog ldan zung 'jug sgom pa/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs la rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba dang*/ dril bu gsung gi dam tshig dang gzhom med kyi sgra dang*/ phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig lus stong gzugs su 'char bar byed pa la bslab/ slob dpon gyi dam tshig ni/ sgrib pa po'i nyams rtogs kyi khyad par gyis mos gus mchog dman gyi khyad ma gtogs rnam pa 'dra ba yin/ rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig ni/ rlung bcu dbu mar bcings pa dang*/ rnam snang rigs kyi dam tshig ni/ phung po lnga'i dwangs ma dang*/ dbang po lnga'i dwangs ma 'dzag med du byed pa dang*/ don yod rigs la drod dang rjes chags kyis gtum mo 'bar bas/ thig le zhu ba dang ldog ste bde ba'i phung khams dbang yul tshims par byed pa dang*/ 'od dpag med kyi rigs la/ stong gzugs phyag chen la brten nas zhu bde 'gyur med du sgrub pa rnams yin no/ /'o na de dag phal cher las dang po pas sgrub par mi nus pa'i phyir/ ji ltar bzung snyam na/ de tsam du skrag mi dgos spyir rig drug gi sdom pa bzung pa tsam gyis rdzogs rim gyi dam tshig 'di dag sgrub dgos par ni ma nges te/

byis 'jug kho na'i don du sdom pa bzung ba la mi dgos pa'i phyir dang*/ don 'di rnams sdom bzung gi sbas don yin gyi/ sgra ji bzhin pa'i tshig don ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /dbang gong ma dang 'brel ba'i sdom bzung yin na ni/ don 'di rnams khas blangs pa yin te/ rdzogs rim gyi sdom pa thob pa'i phyir nges don gyi dam tshig gi bslab bya 'di dag la/ las dang po pas kyang gnas dgos pas/ lam mthon por ma sleb bar du sgrub mi dgos pa dang mi nus pa ma yin no/ /de yang stong nyid snying rje rigs gnyis na de'i dmigs pa sgom pa yin/ 'byung ba lnga'i rlung bcings pas rlung bcu bcings par 'gyur/ dga' bzhi'i thig le 'ching ba rjes mthun pa sgom na/ rnam snang gi dam tshig 'grub pa dang*/ mas brtan rjes mthun pa dang*/ yul sna tshogs kyi bdud rtsi bsten pas don yod grub pa'i dam tshig 'grub/ btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba gsum la bslabs pas/ 'od dpag med kyi dam tshig 'grub/ stong gzugs bsgoms pas phyag rgya sku dang*/ rlung bum can sgoms pas dril bu gsung dang*/ mi g.yo gsum ldan bsgoms pas rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig kyang 'grub/ btsan thabs kyi sbyor ba dang*/ stong gzugs gnyis rgyas phar 'debs tshur 'debs byed kyin sgom na/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dam tshig kyang 'grub pas so/ /mdor na nges don de rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu tshogs bsgrubs nas rang rang gi nges don de dag mos pas bzung bas chog pa yin te/ de'i phyir shin tu sgrub dka' ba ma yin no/ /gzhan mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig dang*/ bza' ba'i dam tshig sogs ni/ spyir bskyed rim pa la gal che yang*/ ma 'byor na bskyed rim pas kyang yid kyis bsam pas chog /rdzogs rim pa la de dag gal che rgyu yang med pas che thang du byed kyang mi dgos/ brnyes par yang mi bya/ dngos su ci rigs par sgrub pa'am/ yid kyis bsams pa tsam byas na'ang legs/

gtso bor mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyid sgom pa dang*/ rjes thob spyod lam du de kha'i nyams myong rgyun chags su bskyangs pas/ nyams len sgrub pa'i dam tshig thams cad de la tshang*/ 'dir rgyas par bshad mi dgos so/ /spyod pa bskyang pa'i yan lag gi skabs su/ theg pa che chung thams cad kyi thun mong kyi spyod pa dang*/ theg chen gyi thun mong ma yin pa yin zhing*/ mdo sngags gnyis po rang gi thun mong rnams la skabs 'dir rgyas bshad byed kyis mi lang*/ khrid yig gi dngos bstan ltar rkang grangs ming tsam brjod dam/ de las bag tsam spros nas chos thun re tsam 'chad/ skabs su gang bab sbyor/ gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i spyod pa ni/ gong du bshad ma thag pa'i dam tshig rnams kyang yin/ khyad par rdzogs rim nges don gyi dam tshig ni/ don rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sgom zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bar chad thams cad spangs/ rtse gcig tu bsgoms pa las gzhan du mi g.yel bar byed/ lus ngag yid gsum po yo byad dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sgo nas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi grogs su 'gro ba 'ba' zhig byed pa la 'dus mod/ rgyud las gsungs tshul dang go babs kyi dbang du byas na zur tsam brjod na/ rdo rje bzhi'i spyod pa/ rigs drug gi spyod pa/ phar phyin bcu'i spyod pa ste gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ nyin dang mtshan mor thig le dag las dkar po'i rgyun 'bab gang zhig mā ma kī ste chad ma yin/ /go ku la sogs mig la sogs pa nyin zhag so sor spros te sha gzhan res 'ga' dag kyang min/ /rang rigs sa la gnas pa'i lha rnams ngag gi dag pa'i lus la bdud rtsi lnga rnams bsnyen pa ste/ /stong par sems ni rab tu zhugs nas ro mnyam byed pa 'khrig pa de ni skye gnas la ma yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ kun rdzob tu nus pa rnyed pa'i rnal 'byor pas myos 'gyur lnga btung*/ sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga bza'/

rigs lnga'i phyag rgya bsten pa yin/ nges don du de dag gi don rim pa bzhin du/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rtsal sbyong*/ dbang po lnga'i rlung dang rnam rtog dgag rtsa 'khor rnams su rlung gi sbyor bas thig le bcings/ stong gzugs la brten par sems mnyam par 'jog pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ nges par rdo rje'i rigs dag la ni srog gcod bya ste ral gri la yang bden pa min pa'i tshig /rin chen la ni gzhan nor dbrog bya mchog gi padma'i rigs nyid la yang gzhan gyi bud med 'phrog /chang dang sgron ma sangs rgyas rnams dang bzang po'i yul rnams mtha' dag 'khor lo la ni bskyang bar bya/ /g.yung mo la sogs mtha' dag bud med rnams ni gri gug la yang mkha' yi padmar smad mi bya/ /sems can don gyi slad du nor dang bcas pa'i lus ni sbyin par bya ste khyod kyis bsrung mi bya/ /rigs kyi bu kye sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ba gzhan du mtha' yas bskal pas min par rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes pa ste/ drang don du stong nyid snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi gsal snang ni rgyas/ 'phrin las thog med du 'grub pa'i nus pa ni rnyed/ thabs gzhan med cing thabs de kho nas 'gro don du 'gyur nges pa yin na/ srog gcod pa dang*/ brdzun smra ba dang*/ gzhan nor 'phrog pa dang*/ pha rol gyi bud med 'phraug pa rnams kyang tshogs chen po'i yan lag tu 'gyur ro/ /de yang nus mthu'i sgo nas yin gyi/ dug mtshon sogs phal pa'i byed pas ma yin no/ /chang dang*/ sgron ma ste/ sha dang*/ sangs rgyas te bdud rtsi lnga bsten tshul gong dang 'dra/ gzugs mdzes pa dang*/ sgra snyan pa sogs yul lnga bsten/ zhu bde 'dzag med du 'ching bar nus na/ g.yung mo la sogs pa'i rigs ma nges pa'i phyag rgya sgrub pa ste/ mdor na rmad byung 'gal ba'i spyod pas/ sems can gyi don byed pa yang yin la/ nges don du ni de dag rim pas las lung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya 'gog pa dang*/

gang la gang 'dul gyi chos ston pa dang*/ mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba sgrub pa'i thabs la brtson pa dang*/ rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po 'grub pa'i thabs la brtson pa ste bzhi dang*/ sngar bshad pa'i nges don gyi dam tshig bzhi gcig tu bgrangs pa dang*/ stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po nyid kyis dbu mar thig le dgag pa'am/ 'di yod phyin phyag rgya gnyis ldan dang gsum ldan yang ste/ de ltar na rigs drug gi so so'i dam tshig go /lus dang longs spyod sems can la blos btang ba ni/ rigs drug thun mong gi spyod pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ nor rnams spangs pas sbyin pa yid dang bud med 'grogs pa las kyang 'pho ba med pa tshul khrims te/ /bzod pa sgra la sogs pa mi 'jug pa ste rlung gis gnyis ka'i bgrod pa 'jig pa brtson 'grus nyid/ /bsam gtan shes rab dag kyang lhan skyes bde la gnas pa'i sems dang kun tu 'gro ba kun gyi skad/ /de las sems can don dang rdzu 'phrul srid pa mthar byed mi skye thob ste gzhan pa bzhi rnams so/ /zhes gsungs te/ ltos med bzhi ldan ni sbyin pa/ rjes dran ni tshul khrims/ sor bsam ni bzod pa/ srog 'dzin ni brtson 'grus/ ting nge 'dzin las lus sems lhan skyes mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ni bsam gtan/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ngag gzhom med kyi sgra dbyangs ni shes rab/ de ltar rang rgyud dag pas chos bstan pa sogs lta ci smos/ mthong thos dran reg sogs thams cad myur du byang chub la 'god pa'i sems can gyi don 'byung ba ni thabs/ sems can gang la gang 'dul du rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs pa dmigs pa med pa'i 'dun pa tsam las 'byung ba'i smon lam/ zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin las rang rgyud kyi srid pa ste nyon mongs spong zhing*/ gzhan rnams kyi sdug bsngal mthar byed pa'i stobs/ mi skye mi 'gag pa ste gdod ma'i rang bzhin mngon du gyur pa'i ye shes ni ye shes kyi phar phyin te de rnams ci nus su sgrub par byed pa'o/

/'di'i nang gi phyin drug dang*/ sor sdud shes rab nas ting nge 'dzin sbyin pa'i bar du/ yan lag drug phar phyin drug la lugs zlog tu sbyar ba gnyis 'gal lo snyam na/ mi 'gal te/ spyir yang rnam grangs tha dad pa'i bshad pa la/ 'gal 'du rtsir med cing*/ khyad par du yang sor sdud sher phyin sogs la sbyar ba ni/ sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i phyin drug dngos kyi dbang du byas la/ 'dir ni phar phyin drug spyi 'gro 'di chos 'di la 'dus pa'i dbang du byas pa yin zhing*/ sbyor tshul gnyis ka yang yan lag drug tsam la sbyor gyi/ rim pa drug kho na la sbyor bar ma nges so/ /de ltar na pha rol tu phyin pa bcu las/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gyur ro/ /gang bla na med pa'i byang chub tu gyur pa ni/ srid zhi thams cad kyi phan pa dang*/ bde ba dang*/ dge ba dang*/ legs pa sgo thams cad nas dus thams cad du gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byed pa'o/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor yid bzhin nor bu la/ /legs bshad gtam gyis byi dor bgyis pa 'dis/ /mtha' yas 'gro la dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi/ /bdud rtsi'i char gyis tshims pa ster gyur cig /zhes zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig mthong ba don ldan la nye bar mkho ba'i gsal byed lhan thabs su sbyor rgyu'i yi ge 'od brgya 'bar ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'gro don mdzad bzhed du mas snga sor nas bskul ba dang*/ nye bar yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhan chen kun dga' lung rigs rgya mtsho'i gsung gis yang yang bskul ba la brten nas sbyar ba las/ slad nas kyang 'phags pa 'jig rten mgon pos byin gyis brlabs pa dpal stag lung pa chen po rje ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub kyis bkas kyang bskul nas cung zad tshig sna bsrengs pa ste/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa gangs ri'i khrod kyi shambha la'i gnas su'o//
//zhus dag maṅga laṃ//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid yig mthong ba don ldan gyi lhan thabs 'od brgya 'bar ba bzhugs/ -PAGE 210--PAGE 209--PAGE 111-
